        if self.Running or self.WorkerToken then status("Wait for the build worker before copying a slot.");return false end
        if type(target)~="number" or target%1~=0 or target<1 or target>5 then status("Choose a copy target from 1 to 5.");return false end
        if target==self.Slot then status("Choose a copy target different from the source slot.");return false end
        local data=self:InspectSlot(self.Slot)
        if not data then status("Select a valid saved source slot before copying it.");return false end
        return self:StoreBlueprint(data,target)
    end
    function self:RestoreBackup()
        if self.Running or self.WorkerToken then status("Wait for the build worker before restoring a saved slot.");return false end
        local backup,reason=self:InspectBackup(self.Slot)
        if not backup then status("Cannot restore backup: "..tostring(reason));return false end
        local ok,copy=pcall(AutoBuild.Validate,backup)
        if not ok then status("Invalid backup: "..tostring(copy));return false end
        if not self:StoreBlueprint(copy) then return false end
        status("Restored "..copy.Name.." to slot "..self.Slot.." ("..self.Persistence[self.Slot].."). Load selected slot to use it; the current working preview is retained.")
        return true
    end
    local function positionKey(c)
        return string.format("%d,%d,%d",math.round(c[1]*1000),math.round(c[2]*1000),math.round(c[3]*1000))
    end
    local function workingPlan()
        if self.SavedPlan then return AutoBuild.Validate(self.SavedPlan) end
        assert(self.Cells and self.Anchor,"Preview or load a blueprint before editing blocks.")
        local data={Version=1,Name=inputs.Name.Text,BlockSize=self.BlockSize,Cells={}}
        for _,cell in ipairs(self.Cells) do
            table.insert(data.Cells,{Material=cell.Material,Components={self.Anchor:ToObjectSpace(cell.CFrame):GetComponents()}})
        end
        return AutoBuild.Validate(data)
    end
    function self:ExportBlueprint(savedSlot)
        if self.Running or self.WorkerToken then status("Wait for the build worker before exporting a blueprint.");return false end
        local ok,data
        if savedSlot then
            local stored=self:InspectSlot(self.Slot)
            ok,data=pcall(AutoBuild.Validate,stored)
        else ok,data=pcall(workingPlan) end
        if not ok then status("Cannot export: "..tostring(data));return false end
        if not ctx.EncodeBlueprint then status("Blueprint JSON encoding is unavailable.");return false end
        local encoded,text=pcall(ctx.EncodeBlueprint,data)
        if not encoded or type(text)~="string" or #text==0 or #text>1000000 then status("Blueprint export failed or exceeds the text limit.");return false end
        inputs.Transfer.Text=text
        local copied=false
        if ctx.CopyBlueprint then local ran,result=pcall(ctx.CopyBlueprint,text);copied=ran and result==true end
        status("Exported "..data.Name.." · "..#data.Cells.." blocks. "..(copied and "Copied to clipboard; JSON is also in the transfer field." or "Select and copy the JSON in the transfer field; clipboard copying is unavailable."))
        return text
    end
    function self:ImportBlueprint(text)
        if self.Running or self.WorkerToken then status("Wait for the build worker before importing a blueprint.");return false end
        if type(text)~="string" or #text==0 or #text>1000000 then status("Paste blueprint JSON of 1–1,000,000 bytes first.");return false end
        if not ctx.DecodeBlueprint then status("Blueprint JSON decoding is unavailable.");return false end
        local decoded,data=pcall(ctx.DecodeBlueprint,text)
        if not decoded then status("Invalid blueprint JSON. The working layout and saved slots were retained.");return false end
        local valid,copy=pcall(AutoBuild.Validate,data)
        if not valid then status("Import rejected: "..tostring(copy));return false end
        self:UseWorkingBlueprint(copy,true)
        status("Imported "..copy.Name.." · "..#copy.Cells.." blocks into the working layout. Preview to check materials and positioning, then Save preview to keep it. Saved slots were retained.")
        return true
    end
    local function markEdited()
        self.PlanDirty=true;self.BuildReport=nil;self.SetupReport=nil;self.SetupResult=nil
        self.Preset="Saved: "..self.SavedPlan.Name.." *";buttons.Preset.Text=self.Preset.."  ▼"
        self:UpdateMaterials(self.Cells and self:SelectedCells() or self.SavedPlan.Cells)
    end
    function self:RefreshEdits()
        self.MaterialUndo=self.UndoStack[#self.UndoStack]
        if buttons.UndoMaterial then buttons.UndoMaterial.Text="Undo ("..#self.UndoStack..")" end
        if buttons.Redo then buttons.Redo.Text="Redo ("..#self.RedoStack..")" end
    end
    function self:ClearEdits()
        self.UndoStack={};self.RedoStack={};self:RefreshEdits()
    end
    local function editSnapshot(plan,removal)
        local materials={}
        for _,cell in ipairs(self.Cells or {}) do materials[cell]=cell.Material end
        return {Plan=plan,Dirty=self.PlanDirty,Removal=removal,CellList=self.Cells,Materials=materials}
    end
    local function pushEdit(plan,removal)
        table.insert(self.UndoStack,editSnapshot(plan,removal))
        if #self.UndoStack>20 then table.remove(self.UndoStack,1) end
        self.RedoStack={};self:RefreshEdits()
    end
    function self:CycleRepeatOption(option)
        if not ctx.Alive() or self.Running or self.WorkerToken then status("Wait for the build worker before changing repeat options.");return false end
        if option=="Copies" then
            self.RepeatCopies=self.RepeatCopies==4 and 2 or self.RepeatCopies+1
            buttons.RepeatCopies.Text="Copies: "..self.RepeatCopies.." total"
        elseif option=="Gap" then
            local choices={0,1,2,4}
            self.RepeatGap=choices[((table.find(choices,self.RepeatGap) or 0)%#choices)+1]
            buttons.RepeatGap.Text="Gap: "..self.RepeatGap.." blocks"
        elseif option=="Scope" then
            self.RepeatScope=self.RepeatScope=="Entire layout" and "Selected layer" or "Entire layout"
            buttons.RepeatScope.Text="Repeat: "..self.RepeatScope
        else return false end
        status("Repeat options staged: "..self.RepeatScope.." · "..self.RepeatCopies.." total copies · gap "..self.RepeatGap..". Choose Right, Forward or Up; other layers are kept.")
        return true
    end
    function self:RepeatLayout(axis,copies,gap)
        if not ctx.Alive() then return false end
        if self.Running or self.WorkerToken then status("Wait for the build worker before repeating a layout.");return false end
        copies=copies==nil and self.RepeatCopies or copies;gap=gap==nil and self.RepeatGap or gap
        local ok,original=pcall(workingPlan)
        if not ok then status(original);return false end
        local height
        if self.RepeatScope=="Selected layer" then
            local heights=self:Layers()
            height=self.LayerIndex and heights and heights[self.LayerIndex]
            if not self.Cells or height==nil then status("Preview the layout and choose one Build layer before repeating Selected layer. Other layers will be kept.");return false end
        elseif self.RepeatScope~="Entire layout" then status("Choose Entire layout or Selected layer first.");return false end
        local valid,copy,step=pcall(AutoBuild.RepeatPlan,original,axis,copies,gap,height)
        if not valid then status("Repeat rejected: "..tostring(copy)..". Working layout kept.");return false end
        local staged,newCells
        if self.Cells then
            if not self.Anchor or type(self.BlockSize)~="number" or math.abs(self.BlockSize-original.BlockSize)>.001 then status("Preview the working blueprint again before repeating it.");return false end
            local oldFolder=self.PreviewFolder
            local made,err=pcall(function()
                staged=Instance.new("Folder");staged.Name="RebornBuildPreview"
                self.PreviewFolder=staged;newCells={}
                for _,cell in ipairs(copy.Cells) do
                    table.insert(newCells,makeGhost(self.Anchor*CFrame.new(table.unpack(cell.Components)),cell.Material,cell.Components[2],self.BlockSize))
                end
            end)
            self.PreviewFolder=oldFolder
            if not made then
                if staged then staged:Destroy() end
                status("Repeat preview failed: "..tostring(err)..". Working layout kept.");return false
            end
        end
        -- Geometry edits share the removal snapshot path for complete Undo/Redo.
        pushEdit(original,true)
        self.SavedPlan=copy
        if newCells then
            for _,cell in ipairs(self.Cells) do if cell.Preview then cell.Preview:Destroy() end end
            if self.PreviewFolder then self.PreviewFolder:Destroy() end
            self.PreviewFolder=staged;staged.Parent=space;self.Cells=newCells
        end
        self.Failures=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
        self.LayerIndex=nil;buttons.Layer.Text="Build: All layers"
        self.SelectedCell=nil;self.Picking=false;buttons.Pick.Text="Pick block: OFF"
        markEdited();self:RefreshSelection();self:RefreshReach()
        status(string.format("Repeated %s %s: %d total copies · %d blocks · %g-stud spacing. Other layers kept. Undo/Redo available; Save preview to keep it. No blocks placed.",self.RepeatScope:lower(),axis:lower(),copies,#copy.Cells,step))
        return true,#copy.Cells
    end
    function self:RemoveBlocks(material,selectedLayer,onlyCell)
        if self.Running or self.WorkerToken then status("Wait for the build worker before removing blueprint blocks.");return false end
        local ok,original=pcall(workingPlan)
        if not ok then status(original);return false end
        material=type(material)=="string" and material:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
        local height,cellKey
        if onlyCell then
            if not table.find(self:SelectedCells(),onlyCell) or not onlyCell.Preview then status("Select a preview block first.");return false end
            local c={self.Anchor:ToObjectSpace(onlyCell.CFrame):GetComponents()}
            cellKey=positionKey(c)
        end
        if selectedLayer then
            local heights=self:Layers();height=self.LayerIndex and heights and heights[self.LayerIndex]
            if not height then status("Choose one layer with the Build layer control before removing it.");return false end
        elseif not onlyCell and (material=="" or #material>128) then status("Enter an existing block name in the first edit field.");return false end
        local function matches(name,y)
            return selectedLayer and math.round(y*1000)/1000==height or not selectedLayer and name==material
        end
        local copy=AutoBuild.Validate(original);local remaining={}
        for _,cell in ipairs(copy.Cells) do
            local c=cell.Components
            local match=onlyCell and positionKey(c)==cellKey or not onlyCell and matches(cell.Material,c[2])
            if not match then table.insert(remaining,cell) end
        end
        local removed=#copy.Cells-#remaining
        if removed==0 then status("No matching blocks in the working blueprint.");return false end
        if #remaining==0 then status("Keep at least one blueprint block. Use Clear preview to hide the whole plan.");return false end
        copy.Cells=remaining
        pushEdit(original,true)
        self.SavedPlan=copy
        if self.Cells then
            local kept={}
            for _,cell in ipairs(self.Cells) do
                local y=cell.LayerY or self.Anchor:ToObjectSpace(cell.CFrame).Position.Y
                if onlyCell and cell==onlyCell or not onlyCell and matches(cell.Material,y) then
                    if cell.Preview then cell.Preview:Destroy() end
                else table.insert(kept,cell) end
            end
            self.Cells=kept
        end
        self.LayerIndex=nil;buttons.Layer.Text="Build: All layers"
        for _,cell in ipairs(self.Cells or {}) do if cell.Preview then cell.Preview.Transparency=.65 end end
        self.SelectedCell=nil;markEdited();self:RefreshSelection();self:RefreshReach()
        status("Removed "..removed.." blueprint blocks. Undo restores this edit; Save preview updates the selected slot.")
        return true,removed
    end
    function self:ReplaceMaterial(from,to,onlyCell)
        if self.Running or self.WorkerToken then status("Wait for the build worker before replacing materials.");return false end
        from=type(from)=="string" and from:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
        to=type(to)=="string" and to:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
        if from=="" or to=="" or #from>128 or #to>128 or from==to then status("Enter different source and replacement block names.");return false end
        local definitions=ctx.BlockDefinitions and ctx.BlockDefinitions()
        if not definitions or not definitions:FindFirstChild(to) then status("Replacement block is unknown or definitions are unavailable.");return false end
        local ok,original=pcall(workingPlan)
        if not ok then status(original);return false end
        local copy=AutoBuild.Validate(original)
        local changed,cellKey=0,nil
        if onlyCell then
            if not table.find(self:SelectedCells(),onlyCell) or not onlyCell.Preview then status("Select a preview block first.");return false end
            local c={self.Anchor:ToObjectSpace(onlyCell.CFrame):GetComponents()}
            cellKey=positionKey(c)
        end
        for _,cell in ipairs(copy.Cells) do
            local c=cell.Components
            if cell.Material==from and (not onlyCell or positionKey(c)==cellKey) then cell.Material=to;changed+=1 end
        end
        if changed==0 then status("No blocks named "..from.." in the loaded blueprint.");return false end
        pushEdit(original,false)
        self.SavedPlan=copy
        if self.Cells then
            for _,cell in ipairs(self.Cells) do if cell.Material==from and (not onlyCell or cell==onlyCell) then cell.Material=to end end
        end
        markEdited();self:RefreshSelection()
        status("Changed "..changed.." blocks in the working blueprint. Saved slots are unchanged; Preview then Save preview to keep this edit.")
        return true,changed
    end
    local function restoreEdit(source,destination,verb)
        if self.Running or self.WorkerToken then status("Wait for the build worker before Undo/Redo.");return false end
        local undo=source[#source]
        if not undo then status("No blueprint edit to "..verb..".");return false end
        local ok,current=pcall(workingPlan)
        if not ok then status(current);return false end
        table.remove(source)
        table.insert(destination,editSnapshot(current,undo.Removal))
        self.SavedPlan=AutoBuild.Validate(undo.Plan);self.PlanDirty=undo.Dirty;self.BuildReport=nil;self.SetupReport=nil;self.SetupResult=nil
        if self.Cells then
            if undo.Removal then
                for _,cell in ipairs(self.Cells) do if cell.Preview then cell.Preview:Destroy() end end
                if not self.PreviewFolder then
                    self.PreviewFolder=Instance.new("Folder");self.PreviewFolder.Name="RebornBuildPreview";self.PreviewFolder.Parent=space
                end
                self.Cells={}
                for _,cell in ipairs(self.SavedPlan.Cells) do
                    table.insert(self.Cells,makeGhost(self.Anchor*CFrame.new(table.unpack(cell.Components)),cell.Material,cell.Components[2],self.BlockSize))
                end
                self.LayerIndex=nil;buttons.Layer.Text="Build: All layers"
            else
                local byPosition={}
                for _,cell in ipairs(self.SavedPlan.Cells) do
                    local c=cell.Components;byPosition[positionKey(c)]=cell.Material
                end
                for index,cell in ipairs(self.Cells) do
                    local c=self.Anchor and {self.Anchor:ToObjectSpace(cell.CFrame):GetComponents()} or {0,0,0}
                    cell.Material=undo.CellList==self.Cells and undo.Materials[cell] or byPosition[positionKey(c)] or self.SavedPlan.Cells[index].Material
                end
            end
        end
        self.Preset="Saved: "..self.SavedPlan.Name..(self.PlanDirty and " *" or "");buttons.Preset.Text=self.Preset.."  ▼"
        self:RefreshEdits();self:UpdateMaterials(self.Cells and self:SelectedCells() or self.SavedPlan.Cells)
        self:RefreshSelection();self:RefreshReach()
        status("Blueprint edit "..verb.." complete. Saved slots are unchanged.")
        return true
    end
    function self:UndoMaterial() return restoreEdit(self.UndoStack,self.RedoStack,"undo") end
    function self:RedoEdit() return restoreEdit(self.RedoStack,self.UndoStack,"redo") end
    function self:RemoveSelected()
        if not self.SelectedCell then status("Select a preview block first.");return false end
        return self:RemoveBlocks(nil,false,self.SelectedCell)
    end
    function self:ReplaceSelected(to)
        if not self.SelectedCell then status("Select a preview block first.");return false end
        return self:ReplaceMaterial(self.SelectedCell.Material,to,self.SelectedCell)
    end
    function self:SavePreview()
        if self.Running then status("Stop the build before saving a blueprint.");return false end
        if not self.Cells or not self.Anchor then status("Preview a build before saving it.");return false end
        local data={Version=1,Name=inputs.Name.Text,BlockSize=self.BlockSize,Cells={}}
        for _,cell in ipairs(self.Cells) do
            table.insert(data.Cells,{Material=cell.Material,Components={self.Anchor:ToObjectSpace(cell.CFrame):GetComponents()}})
        end
        local saved=self:StoreBlueprint(data)
        if saved and self.SavedPlan then
            self.SavedPlan=self.Library[self.Slot];self.PlanDirty=false;self:ClearEdits()
            self.Preset="Saved: "..self.SavedPlan.Name;buttons.Preset.Text=self.Preset.."  ▼"
        end
        return saved
    end
    function self:UseWorkingBlueprint(copy,dirty)
        self:ClearPreview();self.SavedPlan=AutoBuild.Validate(copy);self.PlanDirty=dirty;self:ClearEdits()
        self.Preset="Saved: "..copy.Name..(dirty and " *" or "");buttons.Preset.Text=self.Preset.."  ▼"
        inputs.Name.Text=copy.Name
        self.OffsetX,self.OffsetY,self.OffsetZ=0,0,0
        self.Rotation=0;buttons.Rotate.Text="↻ 0°"
        self:UpdateMaterials(self.SavedPlan.Cells)
    end
    function self:LoadBlueprint()
        if self.Running or self.WorkerToken then status("Wait for the build worker before loading a blueprint.");return false end
        local data=self.Library[self.Slot]
        if not data and ctx.ReadBlueprint then
            local ran,result=pcall(ctx.ReadBlueprint,self.Slot)
            if ran then data=result end
        end
        local ok,copy=pcall(AutoBuild.Validate,data)
        if not ok then status("Cannot load slot "..self.Slot..": "..tostring(copy));return false end
        if not self.Library[self.Slot] then self.Persistence[self.Slot]="Loaded from file" end
        self.Library[self.Slot]=AutoBuild.Validate(copy)
        self:UseWorkingBlueprint(copy,false);self:RefreshLibrary(false)
        status("Loaded "..copy.Name..". Preview at your current position, adjust offset/rotation, then Start. Materials and permissions are still required.")
        return true
    end
    function self:CaptureIsland()
        if not ctx.Alive() then return false end
        if self.Running or self.WorkerToken then status("Stop the build and wait for request cleanup before saving island blocks.");return false end
        local _,root=characterRoot()
        local blocks=ctx.IslandBlocks and ctx.IslandBlocks()
        if not root or not blocks then status("Stand on your own island to save nearby blocks.");return false end
        local definitions=ctx.BlockDefinitions and ctx.BlockDefinitions()
        if not definitions then status("Block definitions are unavailable; island capture was not saved.");return false end
        local selected,minY={},math.huge
        for _,block in ipairs(blocks:GetChildren()) do
            if definitions:FindFirstChild(block.Name) and (block:IsA("BasePart") or block:IsA("Model")) then
                local ok,cf=pcall(function() return block:IsA("BasePart") and block.CFrame or block:GetPivot() end)
                if not ok then status("A block transform is unreadable; nothing was saved.");return false end
                if (cf.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=self.CaptureRange then
                    table.insert(selected,{CFrame=cf,Material=block.Name});minY=math.min(minY,cf.Position.Y)
                    if #selected>300 then status("Area exceeds 300 blocks. Reduce capture range or choose a smaller island section; nothing was saved.");return false end
                end
            end
        end
        if #selected==0 then status("No supported placed blocks within "..self.CaptureRange.." studs.");return false end
        local size=blockSize()
        local origin=CFrame.new(math.round(root.Position.X/size)*size,minY,math.round(root.Position.Z/size)*size)
        local data={Version=1,Name=inputs.Name.Text,BlockSize=size,Cells={}}
        for _,cell in ipairs(selected) do
            table.insert(data.Cells,{Material=cell.Material,Components={origin:ToObjectSpace(cell.CFrame):GetComponents()}})
        end
        return self:StoreBlueprint(data)
    end
    function self:Destroy() self:Stop();self:ClearPreview();self:ClearEdits() end
    local layoutItems={}
    local function register(control,y,height,x,offset,section,field)
        table.insert(layoutItems,{Control=control,Y=y,Height=height,X=x or 0,Offset=offset or 6,Section=section,Field=field})
        return control
    end
    local function layoutY(y) return y>=446 and y+44 or y end
    local function label(text,y,height)
        return register(ctx.Label({Parent=ctx.Parent,Text=text,TextSize=12,Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,height or 24),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,layoutY(y))}),layoutY(y),height or 24)
    end
    local function button(name,text,x,y,width,callback)
        local rowY=(name=="Preview" or name=="LearnPlacement" or name=="CheckSetup") and 446 or layoutY(y)
        local b=ctx.Button({Parent=ctx.Parent,Text=text,TextSize=13,Size=UDim2.new(width or 1,-12,0,32),Position=UDim2.new(x or 0,6,0,rowY)})
        buttons[name]=b;register(b,rowY,32,x)
        ctx.Track(b.Activated:Connect(callback));return b
    end
    local function invalidate()
        if not self.Running then self:ClearPreview();status("Settings changed. Preview the new plan.") end
    end

        local bottom=0
        for _,item in ipairs(layoutItems) do
            local y,visible=item.Y,true
            for _,section in ipairs(self.Sections) do
                if item.Section~=section.Key then
                    if item.Y>=section.Start and item.Y<section.Finish then
                        if section.Open then y+=section.Expanded else visible=false end
                    elseif item.Y>=section.Finish then y+=section.Open and section.Expanded or section.Collapsed end
                end
            end
            if speedMenu.Visible and item.Y>=layoutY(486) then y+=speedMenu.Size.Y.Offset+12 end
            item.Control.Visible=visible
            item.Control.Position=UDim2.new(item.X,item.Offset,0,y)
            if visible then bottom=math.max(bottom,y+item.Height) end

        ctx.Parent.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.None
        ctx.Parent.CanvasSize=UDim2.new(0,0,0,self.LayoutHeight)
    end

            if section.Key==key then
                if section.Open then
                    for _,item in ipairs(layoutItems) do
                        if item.Field and item.Y>=section.Start and item.Y<section.Finish then
                            pcall(function() item.Control:ReleaseFocus() end)
                        end
                    end
                end
                self:CloseMenus();section.Open=not section.Open
                self.SectionButtons[key].Text=(section.Open and "▾  " or "▸  ")..section.Title
                self:LayoutSections();return true
            end
        end
        return false

    self:LayoutSections()
    self:RefreshFailureUI()
    self.Buttons=buttons;self.Inputs=inputs
    return self
end
return AutoBuild
end)()

local CONFIG = {
	ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.F6,          -- fishing ON/OFF
	HarvestKey = Enum.KeyCode.F7,         -- mine / harvest ON/OFF
	MobKey = Enum.KeyCode.F4,             -- Auto Mobs ON/OFF
	ReportKey = Enum.KeyCode.F2,          -- Copy all reports to the clipboard
	StopAllKey = Enum.KeyCode.F3,         -- Stop all automation (panic)
	HopSize = 8,                          -- studs per TP hop (mobs, chests, harvest, wood)
	RequireTool = true,                   -- only cast while a Tool (rod) is equipped
	CastTimeout = 2.0,                  -- typical bobber response is quick; allow a small network margin
	CastHold = 0.35,
    CastDistance = 12,
    BiteTimeout = 45, -- reset the cast if a bobber never tugs
    ReelTimeout = 1.0,                    -- shorter confirmation window after reeling
	FishingPollInterval = 0.01,           -- check cast/bobber state more frequently
	ReelSettleDelay = 0.025,              -- brief time for the server to register a reel
	ActionCooldown = 0.04,                -- minimal guard against duplicate rapid clicks
	MaxFailedCasts = 5,                   -- pause and retry after this many casts with no bobber
	RecentCount = 5,                      -- how many recent catches to show

	-- Auto Mine settings
	MineRange = 90,                       -- studs from character
	MineDelay = 0.10,                     -- faster sequential actions while leaving server time to register drops
	MineBatchSize = 1,                    -- 1 at a time so drops actually register
	MineScanInterval = 0.20,              -- rescan a little more often when targets are absent

	-- Auto Plant settings
	PlantEnabled = true,                  -- plant after harvesting crops
	PlantType = "wheat",                  -- selected crop to plant
	HarvestCrop = "wheat",                 -- crop type to harvest
	WoodRange = 90,
    CropRange = 60,
    HarvestWalk = true,
    FarmTravelMode = "Walk",
    WoodTravelMode = "Normal",
	AutoReplant = true,
    FruitEnabled = false,
	PlantDelay = 0.15,                    -- delay between plant attempts
	PlantRadius = 12,                     -- how far around player to plant
	PlantSpacing = 3,                     -- grid spacing between plants
}

-- Optional persistence: supported only where the host exposes file APIs.
-- Failures are intentionally non-fatal so the UI still works in standard Roblox.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local SETTINGS_FILE = "IslandsFarmingHub_" .. tostring(player.UserId) .. "_settings.json"
-- Declare these before persistence helpers so the helpers capture the intended locals.
local woodToolPreference = "Auto best axe"
local mineToolPreference = "Auto best pickaxe"
-- Keys that can never be bound: Unknown (mouse clicks), Escape, the hub toggle, the capture
-- hotkeys F8-F10 and Q, which Auto Drop presses itself.
function RemoteCatalog.KeyReserved(code)
    for _,name in ipairs({"Unknown","Escape","RightControl","F8","F9","F10","Q"}) do
        if code==Enum.KeyCode[name] then return true end
    end
    return false
end
-- snapshotOnly returns the preference table without writing (hub profiles reuse it).
local function savePreferences(snapshotOnly)
    if not snapshotOnly and type(writefile) ~= "function" then return false end
    local data = {
        WoodTravelMode = CONFIG.WoodTravelMode, FarmTravelMode = CONFIG.FarmTravelMode, HarvestWalk = CONFIG.HarvestWalk, HarvestCrops = CONFIG.HarvestCrops, HarvestCrop = CONFIG.HarvestCrop, PlantType = CONFIG.PlantType,
        FruitEnabled = CONFIG.FruitEnabled, AutoReplant = CONFIG.AutoReplant, MineRange = CONFIG.MineRange,
        WoodRange = CONFIG.WoodRange, CropRange = CONFIG.CropRange, WoodTrees = CONFIG.WoodTrees, MineRocks = CONFIG.MineRocks, MineDelay = CONFIG.MineDelay,
        MineScanInterval = CONFIG.MineScanInterval, PlantDelay = CONFIG.PlantDelay,
        WoodToolPreference = woodToolPreference, MineToolPreference = mineToolPreference,
        MobRadius = CONFIG.MobRadius, MobWalk = CONFIG.MobWalk, MobTravel = CONFIG.MobTravel, MobKind = CONFIG.MobKind, MobAutoEat = CONFIG.MobAutoEat, MobWalkSpeed = CONFIG.MobWalkSpeed, MobKeep = CONFIG.MobKeep, MobHitRun = CONFIG.MobHitRun, MobKeepBias = CONFIG.MobKeepBias, MobCadence = CONFIG.MobCadence, MobRetreatBelow = CONFIG.MobRetreatBelow, MobHitsToKill = CONFIG.MobHitsToKill, MobScore = CONFIG.MobScore, HopSize = CONFIG.HopSize,
        DepositCategory = CONFIG.DepositCategory, DepositInterval = CONFIG.DepositInterval,
        MobWeapon = CONFIG.MobWeapon, LearnedDefinitions = CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions, MobHitBody = CONFIG.MobHitBody, RememberedChests = CONFIG.RememberedChests,
        AutoRejoin = CONFIG.AutoRejoin,
        Keybinds = { StopAllKey = CONFIG.StopAllKey.Name, ToggleKey = CONFIG.ToggleKey.Name, HarvestKey = CONFIG.HarvestKey.Name, MobKey = CONFIG.MobKey.Name, ReportKey = CONFIG.ReportKey.Name },
        Lifetime = CONFIG.Lifetime,
    }
    if snapshotOnly then return data end
    local ok = pcall(function() writefile(SETTINGS_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(data)) end)
    return ok
end
-- supplied: a profile's preference table, validated exactly like the saved file.
local function loadPreferences(supplied)
    local ok, data = true, supplied
    if supplied == nil then
        if type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then return false end
        ok, data = pcall(function()
            if not isfile(SETTINGS_FILE) then return nil end
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SETTINGS_FILE))
        end)
    end
    if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return false end
    if type(data.HarvestCrop) == "string" then CONFIG.HarvestCrop = data.HarvestCrop end
    if data.WoodTravelMode=="Normal" or data.WoodTravelMode=="Walk" or data.WoodTravelMode=="Hop" or data.WoodTravelMode=="Tween" or data.WoodTravelMode=="Teleport" then CONFIG.WoodTravelMode=data.WoodTravelMode end
    if data.FarmTravelMode=="Walk" or data.FarmTravelMode=="Hop" or data.FarmTravelMode=="Tween" or data.FarmTravelMode=="Teleport" then CONFIG.FarmTravelMode=data.FarmTravelMode end
    if type(data.HarvestWalk)=="boolean" then CONFIG.HarvestWalk=data.HarvestWalk end
    if type(data.HarvestCrops) == "table" then CONFIG.HarvestCrops = data.HarvestCrops end
    if type(data.PlantType) == "string" then CONFIG.PlantType = data.PlantType end
    if type(data.AutoReplant) == "boolean" then CONFIG.AutoReplant = data.AutoReplant end
    if type(data.FruitEnabled) == "boolean" then CONFIG.FruitEnabled = data.FruitEnabled end
    if type(data.MineRange) == "number" then CONFIG.MineRange = math.clamp(data.MineRange, 15, 150) end
    if type(data.CropRange) == "number" then CONFIG.CropRange = data.CropRange == 0 and 0 or math.clamp(data.CropRange, 10, 120) end
    if type(data.WoodTrees) == "string" and table.find(FarmLogic.TreeOptions, data.WoodTrees) then CONFIG.WoodTrees = data.WoodTrees end
    if type(data.MineRocks) == "string" and table.find(FarmLogic.RockOptions, data.MineRocks) then CONFIG.MineRocks = data.MineRocks end
    if type(data.WoodRange) == "number" then CONFIG.WoodRange = math.clamp(data.WoodRange, 15, 150) end
    if type(data.MineDelay) == "number" then CONFIG.MineDelay = math.clamp(data.MineDelay, 0.08, 1) end
    if type(data.MineScanInterval) == "number" then CONFIG.MineScanInterval = math.clamp(data.MineScanInterval, 0.15, 2) end
    if type(data.PlantDelay) == "number" then CONFIG.PlantDelay = math.clamp(data.PlantDelay, 0.08, 1) end
    if data.MobRadius==30 or data.MobRadius==60 or data.MobRadius==120 or data.MobRadius==200 then CONFIG.MobRadius=data.MobRadius end
    if type(data.MobWalk)=="boolean" then CONFIG.MobWalk=data.MobWalk end
    if data.DepositCategory=="Crops" or data.DepositCategory=="Crops + wood + ores" or data.DepositCategory=="Wood + ores" then CONFIG.DepositCategory=data.DepositCategory end
    if data.DepositInterval==30 or data.DepositInterval==60 or data.DepositInterval==120 or data.DepositInterval==300 then CONFIG.DepositInterval=data.DepositInterval end
    if type(data.MobKind)=="string" and #data.MobKind>0 and #data.MobKind<=60 then CONFIG.MobKind=data.MobKind end
    if type(data.MobAutoEat)=="boolean" then CONFIG.MobAutoEat=data.MobAutoEat end
    if type(data.MobHitRun)=="boolean" then CONFIG.MobHitRun=data.MobHitRun end
    if type(data.Lifetime)=="table" then
        CONFIG.Lifetime={}
        for _,key in ipairs({"Catches","Casts","Harvests","Wood","Mine","Kills","Seconds"}) do
            local value=data.Lifetime[key]
            CONFIG.Lifetime[key]=type(value)=="number" and value==value and value>=0 and value<1e12 and value or 0
        end
    end
    if type(data.MobKeepBias)=="number" then CONFIG.MobKeepBias=math.clamp(math.floor(data.MobKeepBias),0,3) end
    if type(data.MobCadence)=="number" then CONFIG.MobCadence=math.clamp(data.MobCadence,.4,.9) end
    if type(data.MobRetreatBelow)=="number" then CONFIG.MobRetreatBelow=math.clamp(data.MobRetreatBelow,.45,.6) end
    if type(data.MobHitsToKill)=="table" then
        CONFIG.MobHitsToKill={}
        for name,hits in pairs(data.MobHitsToKill) do if type(name)=="string" and #name<=64 and type(hits)=="number" and hits>0 and hits<1000 then CONFIG.MobHitsToKill[name]=hits end end
    end
    -- Validated on first use: the scoreboard helpers are defined after the preferences load.
    if type(data.MobScore)=="table" then CONFIG.MobScore=data.MobScore;CONFIG.MobScoreUnchecked=true end
    if data.MobKeep=="Auto" or data.MobKeep==3 or data.MobKeep==4 or data.MobKeep==5 then CONFIG.MobKeep=data.MobKeep end
    if data.MobWalkSpeed==16 or data.MobWalkSpeed==20 or data.MobWalkSpeed==24 or data.MobWalkSpeed==32 or data.MobWalkSpeed==40 then CONFIG.MobWalkSpeed=data.MobWalkSpeed end
    if data.HopSize==4 or data.HopSize==6 or data.HopSize==8 or data.HopSize==12 then CONFIG.HopSize=data.HopSize end
    if type(data.MobWeapon)=="string" and #data.MobWeapon>0 and #data.MobWeapon<=60 then CONFIG.MobWeapon=data.MobWeapon end
    if type(data.AutoRejoin)=="boolean" then CONFIG.AutoRejoin=data.AutoRejoin end
    if type(data.Keybinds)=="table" then
        local used={}
        for _,key in ipairs({"StopAllKey","ToggleKey","HarvestKey","MobKey","ReportKey"}) do
            local name=data.Keybinds[key]
            local ok,code=pcall(function() return type(name)=="string" and Enum.KeyCode[name] end)
            -- A colliding or reserved key keeps this action's current key.
            if ok and code and not RemoteCatalog.KeyReserved(code) and not used[code] then CONFIG[key]=code end
            used[CONFIG[key]]=true
        end
    end
    if type(data.RememberedChests)=="table" then
        CONFIG.RememberedChests={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(data.RememberedChests) do
            if type(entry)=="table" and type(entry.Name)=="string" and #entry.Name<=80 and type(entry.Item)=="string" and #entry.Item<=128
                and type(entry.X)=="number" and type(entry.Y)=="number" and type(entry.Z)=="number"
                and type(entry.Slot)=="number" and entry.Slot>=0 and entry.Slot<=12 and entry.Slot%1==0
                and type(entry.Amount)=="number" and entry.Amount>0 and entry.Amount%1==0 and #CONFIG.RememberedChests<64 then
                table.insert(CONFIG.RememberedChests,{Name=entry.Name,X=entry.X,Y=entry.Y,Z=entry.Z,Slot=entry.Slot,Item=entry.Item,Amount=entry.Amount})
            end
        end
    end
    if type(data.LearnedDefinitions)=="table" then
        CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions={}
        for kind,name in pairs(data.LearnedDefinitions) do
            if type(kind)=="string" and #kind<=40 and type(name)=="string" and name:match("^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+$") then CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions[kind]=name end
        end
    end
    if type(data.MobHitBody)=="table" then
        local body,count={},0
        for key,value in pairs(data.MobHitBody) do
            count+=1
            if count>32 or type(key)~="string" or (type(value)~="string" and type(value)~="number" and type(value)~="boolean") then body=nil;break end
            body[key]=value
        end
        CONFIG.MobHitBody=body
    end
    if data.MobTravel=="Walk" or data.MobTravel=="Teleport" then CONFIG.MobTravel=data.MobTravel end
    if type(data.WoodToolPreference) == "string" then woodToolPreference = data.WoodToolPreference == "Wood axe" and "Wooden axe" or data.WoodToolPreference end
    if type(data.MineToolPreference) == "string" then mineToolPreference = data.MineToolPreference == "Wood pickaxe" and "Wooden pickaxe" or data.MineToolPreference end
    return true
end
-- A damaged or unexpected settings file must never keep the hub from opening: defaults are kept
-- and the Settings tab says so.
local preferencesLoaded
do
    local ok, result = pcall(loadPreferences)
    if ok then preferencesLoaded = result else preferencesLoaded = false; RemoteCatalog.PreferencesError = tostring(result) end
end
CONFIG.HarvestCrops = FarmLogic.NormalizeCrops(CONFIG.HarvestCrops, CONFIG.HarvestCrop)
if not CONFIG.HarvestCrops[CONFIG.PlantType] then CONFIG.PlantType = FarmLogic.SelectedCrops(CONFIG.HarvestCrops, CONFIG.HarvestCrop)[1] end

-- Remove previous GUI (this also stops the previous script's loops)
local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("AutoFishingGUI")
if old then
	old:Destroy()
end

local connections = {}
local function track(conn)
	table.insert(connections, conn)
	return conn
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GUI helpers
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function corner(parent, radius)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	c.Parent = parent
	return c
end

local function label(props)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.FontFace = props.Font==Enum.Font.GothamBold and COLORS.fonts.Bold or COLORS.fonts.Regular
	l.TextSize = math.max(props.TextSize or 13, 12)
	l.TextColor3 = props.Color or COLORS.text
	l.TextXAlignment = props.Align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.Text = props.Text or ""
	l.Size = props.Size
	l.Position = props.Position or UDim2.new()
	l.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	l.Parent = props.Parent
	return l
end

local function button(props)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 32)
	b.Position = props.Position or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = props.Bg or (props.Primary and COLORS.accent or COLORS.panel)
	b.TextColor3 = props.Color or COLORS.text
	b.Text = props.Text
	b.FontFace = props.Primary and COLORS.fonts.Bold or COLORS.fonts.Medium
	b.TextSize = math.max(props.TextSize or 13, 12)
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.AutoButtonColor = false
    b.Active = true
    b.Selectable = true
    b.Modal = true -- Keep controls reachable when the game locks the pointer.
    b.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
    padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
    padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
    padding.Parent = b
	b.Parent = props.Parent
	corner(b, props.Radius or 8)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = COLORS.stroke
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    stroke.Parent = b
    stroke.Name="ControlStroke"
    local choiceTitle,choiceValue,choiceArrow,choiceChip,switchTrack,switchKnob,switchLabel
    local function updateChoice()
        local text=tostring(b.Text)
        local dropdown=text:find("▼",1,true) or text:find("▲",1,true)
        if dropdown and not choiceChip then
            choiceTitle=label({Parent=b,Text="",Size=UDim2.new(.48,-20,1,0),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,0),TextSize=b.TextSize})
            choiceTitle.Name="ChoiceTitle";choiceTitle.FontFace=COLORS.fonts.Medium
            choiceChip=Instance.new("Frame");choiceChip.Name="ChoiceChip"
            choiceChip.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5);choiceChip.Position=UDim2.new(1,-10,.5,0)
            choiceChip.BackgroundColor3=COLORS.surface;choiceChip.BorderSizePixel=0;choiceChip.ClipsDescendants=true;choiceChip.Parent=b
            corner(choiceChip,6)
            local constraint=Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
            constraint.MaxSize=Vector2.new(190,24);constraint.Parent=choiceChip
            choiceValue=label({Parent=choiceChip,Text="",Size=UDim2.new(1,-30,1,0),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,0),TextSize=13,Color=COLORS.muted})
            choiceValue.Name="ChoiceValue"
            choiceArrow=label({Parent=choiceChip,Text="",Size=UDim2.new(0,18,1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,-22,0,0),TextSize=12,Color=COLORS.muted,Align=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center})
            choiceArrow.Name="ChoiceArrow"
        end
        if choiceChip then
            choiceChip.Visible=dropdown~=nil;choiceTitle.Visible=dropdown~=nil
            local clean=text:gsub("▼",""):gsub("▲",""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            local title,value=clean:match("^(.-):%s*(.*)$")
            choiceTitle.Text=title or clean;choiceValue.Text=value or "";choiceValue.Visible=value~=nil
            choiceTitle.Size=value and UDim2.new(.48,-20,1,0) or UDim2.new(1,-58,1,0)
            choiceChip.Size=value and UDim2.new(.52,-12,0,24) or UDim2.new(0,34,0,24)
            choiceArrow.Text=text:find("▲",1,true) and "⌃" or "⌄"
            choiceChip.ZIndex=(b.ZIndex or 1)+1;choiceTitle.ZIndex=(b.ZIndex or 1)+1
            choiceValue.ZIndex=(b.ZIndex or 1)+2;choiceArrow.ZIndex=(b.ZIndex or 1)+2
        end
        return dropdown~=nil
    end
    if props.Switch then
        padding.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,0);padding.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,0)
        switchLabel=label({Parent=b,Text=b.Text,Size=UDim2.new(1,-66,1,0),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,0),TextSize=b.TextSize})
        switchLabel.Name="SwitchLabel";switchLabel.FontFace=COLORS.fonts.Medium
        switchTrack=Instance.new("Frame");switchTrack.Name="SwitchTrack"
        switchTrack.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5);switchTrack.Position=UDim2.new(1,-12,.5,0)
        switchTrack.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(34,20);switchTrack.BorderSizePixel=0;switchTrack.Parent=b;corner(switchTrack,10)
        switchKnob=Instance.new("Frame");switchKnob.Name="SwitchKnob"
        switchKnob.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(14,14);switchKnob.BorderSizePixel=0;switchKnob.Parent=switchTrack;corner(switchKnob,7)
    end
    local hovered,pressed=false,false
    local function refreshStyle()
        local available=b.Active
        local selected=b.BackgroundColor3==COLORS.on
        stroke.Color=available and (hovered or pressed or selected or props.Primary) and COLORS.accent or COLORS.stroke
        stroke.Transparency=not available and .8 or pressed and 0 or hovered and .1 or selected and .25 or props.Primary and .25 or .55
        stroke.Thickness=available and pressed and 2 or 1
        local dropdown=updateChoice()
        b.TextTransparency=(dropdown or switchTrack) and 1 or available and 0 or .42
        local inset=(dropdown or switchTrack) and 0 or 10
        padding.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,inset);padding.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,inset)
        b.TextColor3=props.Primary and b.BackgroundColor3==COLORS.accent and COLORS.accentDark or props.Color or COLORS.text
        if choiceTitle then
            choiceTitle.TextTransparency=available and 0 or .42
            choiceValue.TextTransparency=available and 0 or .42
            choiceArrow.TextTransparency=available and 0 or .42
        end
        if switchTrack then
            local on=tostring(b.Text):find(" ON",1,true)~=nil
            switchLabel.Text=b.Text;switchLabel.TextTransparency=available and 0 or .42
            switchLabel.ZIndex=(b.ZIndex or 1)+1
            switchTrack.BackgroundColor3=on and COLORS.accent or COLORS.surface3
            switchKnob.BackgroundColor3=on and COLORS.accentDark or COLORS.muted
            switchKnob.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(on and 17 or 3,3)
            switchTrack.BackgroundTransparency=available and 0 or .5
            switchKnob.BackgroundTransparency=available and 0 or .5
            switchTrack.ZIndex=(b.ZIndex or 1)+1;switchKnob.ZIndex=(b.ZIndex or 1)+2
        end
    end
    track(b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hovered=true;refreshStyle() end))
    track(b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hovered=false;pressed=false;refreshStyle() end))
    track(b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then pressed=true;refreshStyle() end
    end))
    track(b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then pressed=false;refreshStyle() end
    end))
    track(b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Active"):Connect(function() if not b.Active then hovered=false;pressed=false end;refreshStyle() end))
    track(b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(refreshStyle))
    track(b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(refreshStyle))
    track(b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ZIndex"):Connect(refreshStyle))
    refreshStyle()

	return b
end

local function panel(parent, size, position)
	local p = Instance.new("Frame")
	p.Size = size
	p.Position = position
	p.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.panel
	p.BorderSizePixel = 0
	p.Parent = parent
	corner(p, 8)

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
	pad.Parent = p

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = p

	return p
end

-- Airflow UI library from the user-supplied Insane_version_clean (1).lua.
-- Only the UI LIBRARY section is embedded; no remote code is downloaded or run.
local Airflow do
-- Some hosts provide task.spawn but omit task.defer. Keep the shim local to the UI library.
local task=setmetatable({defer=task.defer or task.spawn or spawn},{__index=task})
local R=game:GetService"TweenService"local p=game:GetService"UserInputService"local Z=game:GetService"GuiService"local F=game:GetService"RunService"local S=game:GetService"HttpService"local aa=game:GetService"Players"local ab=aa.LocalPlayer local g={}g.Flags={}g.Windows={}local function m(b,c)local a={}if type(b)=="string"then a.Name=b elseif type(b)=="table"then for b,c in pairs(b)do a[b]=c end end for b,c in pairs(c or{})do if a[c]==nil and a[b]~=nil then a[c]=a[b]end end if a.Range then a.Min=a.Min or a.Range[1]a.Max=a.Max or a.Range[2]end return a end local function n(e,b,a,d,f)a._type=f a._frame=d a._listeners=a._listeners or{}local c=e and e.Window if b.Flag then g.Flags[b.Flag]=a if c then local a=b.Callback b.Callback=function(...)if type(a)=="function"then a(...)end c:_autoSave()end end end function a:Destroy()if a._destroyed then return end a._destroyed=true for b,a in ipairs(a._listeners)do a()end a._listeners={}if b.Flag and g.Flags[b.Flag]==a then g.Flags[b.Flag]=nil end if c then for a,b in ipairs(c._controls)do if b==d then table.remove(c._controls,a)break end end end if d then d:Destroy()end end return a end
-- NAVY. Upstream ships a plum palette; these are the same roles in blue. AccentDark is
-- the text that sits ON the accent (primary buttons, the toggle knob), so it stays the
-- darkest colour here -- swapping it for a blue would leave that text unreadable.
g.Theme={Background=Color3.fromRGB(13,17,28),Surface=Color3.fromRGB(17,22,36),Surface2=Color3.fromRGB(21,27,44),Surface3=Color3.fromRGB(34,43,66),Stroke=Color3.fromRGB(32,41,63),StrokeHover=Color3.fromRGB(66,88,130),Accent=Color3.fromRGB(122,162,247),AccentDark=Color3.fromRGB(10,14,24),Text=Color3.fromRGB(226,232,240),Muted=Color3.fromRGB(128,141,166),Warning=Color3.fromRGB(240,176,108),Success=Color3.fromRGB(150,220,170),Error=Color3.fromRGB(240,120,120)}
g.Assets={Shadow="rbxassetid://6014261993",Glow="rbxassetid://8992230677",Logo="rbxassetid://6031090998"}
-- ICONS COME FROM THE SCRIPT, NOT FROM THE INTERNET. Upstream resolved lucide names by
-- downloading a table from a third-party GitHub repo and running it -- a dependency that
-- can execute anything it likes in the executor, on every launch, and the README promises
-- no dependencies and no phone-home. The script already ships the ten icons it uses in
-- LucideIcons (030_services.lua); the resolver is handed in from there, because this part
-- loads first and cannot see a later part's locals.
g.IconResolver=nil
function g:SetIconResolver(f)g.IconResolver=type(f)=="function" and f or nil end

RemoteCatalog.MenuClosers={}
RemoteCatalog.MenuRegions={}
function RemoteCatalog.RegisterMenuRegion(anchor,menu)
    table.insert(RemoteCatalog.MenuRegions,{Anchor=anchor,Menu=menu})
end
function RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    for _,close in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.MenuClosers) do close() end
end
-- One shared recorder serves every manual learner; its learn-only branches swallow other calls.
function RemoteCatalog.OtherLearning(own)
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if not recorder or recorder.Stopped then return nil end
    for _,entry in ipairs({{"LearnMobOnly","Mob attack"},{"LearnCraftOnly","Craft recipe"},{"LearnPlowOnly","Hoe"},{"LearnChestOnly","Chest"}}) do
        if entry[1]~=own and recorder[entry[1]] then return entry[2].." learning is active · finish or cancel it first." end
    end
end
-- Inline menus expand the scroll canvas instead of covering the next control.
function RemoteCatalog.ChoiceDropdown(page,anchor,options,settings)
    local self={Options={},Positions={}}
    local menu=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    self.Menu=menu
    menu.Name=settings.Name or "ChoiceDropdown"
    menu.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,math.min(#options*40+12,212))
    menu.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#options*40+12)
    menu.ScrollBarThickness=4;menu.ScrollBarImageColor3=COLORS.accent
    menu.ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
    menu.BackgroundColor3=COLORS.panel;menu.BorderSizePixel=0
    menu.Visible=false;menu.ClipsDescendants=true;menu.ZIndex=25;menu.Parent=page
    corner(menu,8)
    anchor.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    function self:Refresh()
        anchor.Text=settings.Title..": "..tostring(settings.Get())..(menu.Visible and "  ▲" or "  ▼")
        for i,option in ipairs(self.Options) do
            local chosen=options[i]==settings.Get()
            option.Text=(chosen and "✓  " or "    ")..tostring(options[i])
            option.BackgroundColor3=chosen and COLORS.on or COLORS.panel
        end
    end
    function self:Close()
        menu.Visible=false
        for child,position in pairs(self.Positions) do if child.Parent==page then child.Position=position end end
        self.Positions={}
        self:Refresh()
        if settings.Layout then settings.Layout() end
    end
    function self:Open()
        if settings.Locked and settings.Locked() then return false end
        RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
        if settings.GetOptions then self:SetOptions(settings.GetOptions()) end
        local y=anchor.Position.Y.Offset+anchor.Size.Y.Offset+6
        menu.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,y)
        for _,child in ipairs(page:GetChildren()) do
            if not settings.Layout and child~=menu and child~=anchor and child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Position.Y.Offset>=y-6 then
                self.Positions[child]=child.Position
                child.Position=UDim2.new(child.Position.X.Scale,child.Position.X.Offset,child.Position.Y.Scale,child.Position.Y.Offset+menu.Size.Y.Offset+12)
            end
        end
        menu.Visible=true;self:Refresh()
        if settings.Layout then settings.Layout() end
        return true
    end
    self.OptionConnections={}
    function self:DisconnectOptions()
        for _,connection in ipairs(self.OptionConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        self.OptionConnections={}
    end
    track({Disconnect=function() self:DisconnectOptions() end})
    function self:SetOptions(values)
        self:Close()
        self:DisconnectOptions()
        for _,option in ipairs(self.Options) do option:Destroy() end
        self.Options={};options=table.clone(values)
        menu.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,math.min(#options*40+12,212))
        menu.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#options*40+12)
        for i,value in ipairs(options) do
            local option=button({Parent=menu,Text=tostring(value),Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,38),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6+(i-1)*40)})
            option.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;option.ZIndex=26
            self.Options[i]=option
            table.insert(self.OptionConnections,option.Activated:Connect(function()
                if settings.Locked and settings.Locked() then self:Close();return end
                settings.Set(value);self:Close()
            end))
        end
        self:Refresh()
    end
    track(menu.Destroying:Connect(function()
        for _,connection in ipairs(self.OptionConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        self.OptionConnections={}
    end))
    self:SetOptions(options)
    track(anchor.Activated:Connect(function() if menu.Visible then self:Close() else self:Open() end end))
    table.insert(RemoteCatalog.MenuClosers,function() self:Close() end)
    RemoteCatalog.RegisterMenuRegion(anchor,menu)
    self:Refresh()
    return self
end
function RemoteCatalog.StyleFields(page)
    if not page then return end
    for _,field in ipairs(page:GetDescendants()) do
        if field:IsA("TextBox") and not field:FindFirstChild("FieldStroke") then
            field.FontFace=COLORS.fonts.Regular;field.TextSize=math.max(13,field.TextSize)
            field.TextColor3=COLORS.text;field.PlaceholderColor3=COLORS.muted
            field.BackgroundColor3=COLORS.surface;field.BorderSizePixel=0
            if not field:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then corner(field,8) end
            local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke");stroke.Name="FieldStroke"
            stroke.Color=COLORS.stroke;stroke.Thickness=1;stroke.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border;stroke.Parent=field
            if not field:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding") then
                local padding=Instance.new("UIPadding")
                padding.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,10);padding.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,10);padding.Parent=field
            end
            track(field.Focused:Connect(function() stroke.Color=COLORS.accent end))
            track(field.FocusLost:Connect(function() stroke.Color=COLORS.stroke end))
        end
    end
end
local selectTabOriginal=hub.SelectTab
hub.SelectTab=function(self,tab,...)
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    RemoteCatalog.StyleFields(tab and tab.List)
    return selectTabOriginal(self,tab,...)
end
local toggleOriginal=hub.Toggle
hub.Toggle=function(self,...)
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    return toggleOriginal(self,...)
end

local function createPage(name)
    local tab = hub:Tab({ Name = name })
    tab._label.TextSize = 14
    airflowTabs[name] = tab
    -- Keep the existing farming controls and their callbacks in the Airflow page.
    -- Its stock list/empty state are replaced by our scrollable content.
    tab.List:Destroy()
    for _, child in ipairs(tab._page:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
    end
    local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    page.Name = name .. "Page"
    page.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 58)
    page.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 1, -90)
    page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    page.BorderSizePixel = 0
    page.ScrollBarThickness = 6
    page.VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar
    page.ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.WhenScrollable
    page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = COLORS.accent
    page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
    page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    page.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
    page.Parent = tab._page
    table.insert(hub._controls, page) -- Scrolling/clicking controls must not drag the window.
    -- Airflow's intro reveals its list's children. Use the content as that list.
    tab.List = page
    -- Auto Build owns collapsed-control visibility; the stock reveal would show hidden fields.
    if name=="Auto Build" or name=="Chests" or name=="Mobs" then tab._revealed=true end
    pages[name] = page
    return page
end

local buildController = AutoBuild.new({
    Player = player, Parent = buildPage, Label = label, Button = button, Track = track,
    Alive = function() return gui.Parent ~= nil end,
    GameModule = RemoteCatalog.GameModule,
    Place = RemoteCatalog.CallPlacement,
    PlacementReady = RemoteCatalog.PlacementStatus,
    LearnPlacement = function()
        if RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy or RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then return false,"Stop crafting, chest collection and Auto Plow before learning placement." end
        local other=RemoteCatalog.OtherLearning and RemoteCatalog.OtherLearning()
        if other then return false,other end
        local ok,recorder=pcall(RemoteCatalog.StartCapture)
        if not ok or not recorder then return false,"Placement capture unavailable on this host. Game placement API may still work; copy build diagnostics." end
        RemoteCatalog.Recorder=recorder
        return true,"Placement capture ready. Hide the hub, place one block manually on your island, then return and press Start build."
    end,
    BuildBlocked = function() return RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker and "Wait for Auto Plow input cleanup before building." end,
    TravelBlocked = function() return RemoteCatalog.BuildTravelBlocked and RemoteCatalog.BuildTravelBlocked() end,
    Approach = function(cell,reach,active)
        local navigation=RemoteCatalog.Navigation
        if not navigation then return false,"Walking is not ready" end
        -- Preview cells are not world blocks. Navigation receives a temporary
        -- target; no blueprint data or world instances are changed.
        local target={Parent=gui,Position=cell.CFrame.Position}
        local arrived,reason=navigation.Approach(player,target,reach*.8,active,function(obj) return obj.Position end,"Walk","Build")
        return arrived,reason and tostring(reason):gsub("; skipping this target","")
    end,
    StopTravel = function() if RemoteCatalog.Navigation then RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Stop("Build") end end,
    RegisterMenuCloser = function(close) table.insert(RemoteCatalog.MenuClosers,close) end,
    RegisterPicker = function(pick) RemoteCatalog.BuildPicker=pick end,
    ItemCount = function(item) return RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount and RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount(item) end,
    -- How much of a material the island's chests hold, and how far the nearest such chest is.
    MaterialStock = function(material)
        local items=RemoteCatalog.ChestContents()
        local entry=items[material]
        if not entry then return 0 end
        local char=player.Character
        local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local nearest
        for chest,amount in pairs(entry.Chests) do
            if amount>0 and root then
                local ok,distance=pcall(function() return (chest:GetPivot().Position-root.Position).Magnitude end)
                if ok and type(distance)=="number" and (not nearest or distance<nearest) then nearest=distance end
            end
        end
        return entry.Total,nearest
    end,
    OnPlaced = function(count) RemoteCatalog.LifetimeAdd("Blocks",count) end,
    CopyReport = function(report) return RemoteCatalog.CopyBuildReport(report) end,
    IslandBlocks = function() return RemoteCatalog.BuildIslandBlocks and RemoteCatalog.BuildIslandBlocks() end,
    BlockDefinitions = function() return ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Blocks") end,
    ReadFavorites = function()
        if type(readfile)~="function" then return nil end
        if type(isfile)=="function" and not isfile("RebornBuildFavorites_"..tostring(player.UserId)..".json") then return nil end
        local encoded=readfile("RebornBuildFavorites_"..tostring(player.UserId)..".json")
        if type(encoded)~="string" or #encoded>4096 then error("Invalid favorites file size") end
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(encoded)
    end,
    WriteFavorites = function(data)
        if type(writefile)~="function" then return false end
        writefile("RebornBuildFavorites_"..tostring(player.UserId)..".json",HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
        return true
    end,
    ReadBlueprint = function(slot)
        if type(readfile)~="function" then return nil end
        if type(isfile)=="function" and not isfile("RebornBlueprint_"..tostring(player.UserId).."_"..slot..".json") then return nil end
        local encoded=readfile("RebornBlueprint_"..tostring(player.UserId).."_"..slot..".json")
        if type(encoded)~="string" or #encoded>1000000 then error("Invalid blueprint file size") end
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(encoded)
    end,
    ReadBlueprintBackup = function(slot)
        if type(readfile)~="function" then return nil end
        if type(isfile)=="function" and not isfile("RebornBlueprint_"..tostring(player.UserId).."_"..slot.."_backup.json") then return nil end
        local encoded=readfile("RebornBlueprint_"..tostring(player.UserId).."_"..slot.."_backup.json")
        if type(encoded)~="string" or #encoded>1000000 then error("Invalid blueprint backup file size") end
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(encoded)
    end,
    EncodeBlueprint = function(data) return HttpService:JSONEncode(data) end,
    DecodeBlueprint = function(text) return HttpService:JSONDecode(text) end,
    CopyBlueprint = function(text)
        local copy=setclipboard or toclipboard
        if type(copy)~="function" then return false end
        local ok,result=pcall(copy,text);return ok and result~=false
    end,
    WriteBlueprint = function(slot,data,previous)
        if type(writefile)~="function" then return false end
        local encoded=HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
        if type(encoded)~="string" or #encoded>1000000 then error("Invalid blueprint file size") end
        if previous then
            local backup=HttpService:JSONEncode(previous)
            if type(backup)~="string" or #backup>1000000 then error("Invalid blueprint backup file size") end
            assert(writefile("RebornBlueprint_"..tostring(player.UserId).."_"..slot.."_backup.json",backup)~=false,"Blueprint backup write failed")
        end
        assert(writefile("RebornBlueprint_"..tostring(player.UserId).."_"..slot..".json",encoded)~=false,"Blueprint write failed")
        return true
    end,
})

local function showTab(name)
    -- Block picking is a tab-local mode: leaving the tab ends it so other modes are not blocked by it.
    if name~="Auto Build" and buildController and buildController.Picking and buildController.SetPicking then pcall(buildController.SetPicking,buildController,false) end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestSelectMenu then RemoteCatalog.ChestSelectMenu.Visible=false end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAmountMenu then RemoteCatalog.ChestAmountMenu.Visible=false end
    if RemoteCatalog.LayoutChestControls then RemoteCatalog.LayoutChestControls() end
    activeTab = name
    if RemoteCatalog.SetCropDropdown then RemoteCatalog.SetCropDropdown(false)
    else cropDropdownOpen=false;if cropDropdown then cropDropdown.Visible=false end end
    for _, child in ipairs(woodPage:GetChildren()) do
        if child.Name == "AxeDropdown" then child.Visible = false end
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(minePage:GetChildren()) do
        if child.Name == "PickaxeDropdown" or child.Name == "ToolDropdown" then child.Visible = false end
    end
    for _,refresh in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ToolMenuRefresh or {}) do refresh() end
    hub:SelectTab(airflowTabs[name])
end

RemoteCatalog.StatusHistory={}
local function setStatus(text, color)
    status.Text = tostring(text)
    status.TextColor3 = color or COLORS.muted
    -- Keep the last 30 distinct messages for the self-test and session report.
    local history=RemoteCatalog.StatusHistory
    local last=history[#history]
    if not last or last.Text~=status.Text then
        local stamp="?"
        pcall(function() stamp=os.date("%H:%M:%S") end)
        table.insert(history,{Time=stamp,Text=status.Text})
        if #history>30 then table.remove(history,1) end
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.CopyBuildReport(report)
    local function tryCopy(copy)
        if type(copy)~="function" then return false end
        local ok,result=pcall(copy,report)
        return ok and result~=false
    end
    if tryCopy(setclipboard) or toclipboard~=setclipboard and tryCopy(toclipboard) then
        setStatus("Build report copied",COLORS.good);return true
    end
    print(report);setStatus("Build report printed to console",COLORS.warn);return false
end

                overlayStartPosition.X.Scale, overlayStartPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
                overlayStartPosition.Y.Scale, overlayStartPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y

        end
    end

local function applyFishingMode(modeName)
    modeName="Fast"
    CONFIG.CastDistance=12
    local profile = FISHING_MODES[modeName]
    if not profile then return end
    activeFishingMode = modeName
    CONFIG.FishingPollInterval = profile.poll
    CONFIG.CastTimeout = profile.castTimeout
    CONFIG.ReelTimeout = profile.reelTimeout
    CONFIG.ReelSettleDelay = profile.settle
    CONFIG.ActionCooldown = profile.cooldown
    for name, modeButton in pairs(modeButtons) do
        modeButton.BackgroundColor3 = name == modeName and COLORS.accent or COLORS.panel
    end
    modeHeading.Text = "FISHING MODE  ·  " .. string.upper(modeName)
    if modeName == "Safe" then
        modeInfo.Text = "Safe: slower polling and longer waits; best for high latency or checking reliability."
    elseif modeName == "Balanced" then
        modeInfo.Text = "Balanced: responsive timing with extra catch-confirmation time for everyday use."
    elseif modeName == "Fast" then
        modeInfo.Text = "Fast: shortest waits and quickest retry; may count a slow server response as a miss."
    else
        modeInfo.Text = "Test: conservative confirmation timing for comparing catch rate against Fast mode. Reset Stats between runs."
    end
end
