function RemoteCatalog.BaitDiagnosticReport()
    local bait
    local ok,tools=pcall(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools)
    if ok then for _,tool in ipairs(tools) do if string.lower(tool.Name)=="bait" then bait=tool;break end end end
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("BaitBinding")
    local function property(name)
        if not bait then return "no tool" end
        local ok,value=pcall(function() return bait[name] end)
        return ok and tostring(value) or "unavailable"
    end
    return table.concat({"Reborn mob-stop-178",
        "Report scope: bait use. For crafting, open Crafting > Copy craft diagnostics.",
        "Food API: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.BaitNativeStatus or "not checked"),
        "Last transport: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.BaitTransport or "none"),
        "Last result: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.BaitLastResult or "none"),
        "Bait quantity: "..tostring(bait and (RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(bait) or "unreadable") or "no tool"),
        "Bait equipped: "..tostring(bait~=nil and bait.Parent==player.Character),
        "Current bait binding: "..tostring(recorder~=nil),
        "Binding refresh needed: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.BaitNeedsRefresh==true),
        "Last learned request: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.BaitLearnedStatus or "not tried"),
        "Next activation: "..(not baitEnabled and "not scheduled (Auto Bait OFF)" or RemoteCatalog.BaitTryMouseHandler and "food mouse handler" or RemoteCatalog.BaitTrySignal and "food signal/handler" or RemoteCatalog.BaitTryToolActivation and "Tool:Activate" or "mouse click"),
        "Food mouse handler: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodMouseStatus or "not inspected"),
        "Bait learner: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnBaitOnly==true),
        "Tool.Enabled: "..property("Enabled"),
        "Tool.ManualActivationOnly: "..property("ManualActivationOnly"),
        "Activation signal support: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.BaitSignalAvailable()),
        "Capture hook support: "..tostring(type(hookmetamethod)=="function" and type(getnamecallmethod)=="function"),
        "Auto Bait: "..tostring(baitEnabled),"Fishing: "..tostring(enabled)},"\n")
end
track(RemoteCatalog.BaitDiagnosticButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    local report=RemoteCatalog.BaitDiagnosticReport()
    local copy=setclipboard or toclipboard
    if type(copy)=="function" and pcall(copy,report) then setStatus("Bait diagnostics copied",COLORS.good)
    else print(report);setStatus("Bait diagnostics printed to the console",COLORS.warn) end
end))

-- BAIT TOOL INPUT BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.BaitCount=function(tool)
    if not tool then return nil end
    local keys={"amount","quantity","stacksize","count","stack"}
    local values={}
    local ok,attributes=pcall(function() return tool:GetAttributes() end)
    if ok then
        for name,value in pairs(attributes) do
            local number=(type(value)=="number" or type(value)=="string") and tonumber(value)
            if number and number>=0 then values[string.lower(name)]=number end
        end
        for _,key in ipairs(keys) do if values[key]~=nil then return values[key] end end
    end
    local childrenOK,children=pcall(function() return tool:GetChildren() end)
    if childrenOK then
        for _,child in ipairs(children) do
            if (child:IsA("IntValue") or child:IsA("NumberValue")) and child.Value>=0 then values[string.lower(child.Name)]=child.Value end
        end
        for _,key in ipairs(keys) do if values[key]~=nil then return values[key] end end
    end
end
-- Sent, but unverifiable: not a success, yet retrying in 5s would eat bait about 12x faster.
RemoteCatalog.BaitUnverified = "Bait input sent; quantity unreadable on this account, so consumption is not verified."
RemoteCatalog.WithBaitTool = function(tool, callback)
    if baitBusy or fishingInputBusy then return false, "Waiting for current rod input" end
    if RemoteCatalog.CastInFlight or RemoteCatalog.BobberActive and RemoteCatalog.BobberActive() then return false, "Waiting for the current cast to finish" end
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return false, "Wait for your character" end
    local previous = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    local token = baitCycleId
    local function active() return baitEnabled and baitCycleId == token and gui.Parent ~= nil and player.Character == character end
    if not active() then return false, "Auto Bait stopped" end
    baitBusy = true
    local sent, detail = false, "Auto Bait stopped"
    local ok, failure = pcall(function()
        if not RemoteCatalog.EquipTool(tool) then error("Could not equip bait") end
        task.wait(0.1)
        if not active() then return end
        if tool.Parent ~= character or character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") ~= tool then error("Bait tool not equipped") end
        local before=RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(tool)
        sent, detail = callback()
        if sent then
            local consumed=false
            local elapsed=0
            -- Food activation can complete asynchronously. Keep bait equipped while it finishes.
            repeat
                if not active() then sent=false;detail="Auto Bait stopped";return end
                if character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")~=tool and tool.Parent~=nil then
                    sent=false;detail="Bait tool changed before consumption";return
                end
                local after=RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(tool)
                consumed=before~=nil and (after~=nil and after<before or before==1 and tool.Parent==nil)
                if consumed then break end
                task.wait(.05);elapsed+=.05
            until elapsed>=2
            sent=consumed
            detail=consumed and "bait consumption confirmed" or before==nil and RemoteCatalog.BaitUnverified
                or ("Bait use unconfirmed; quantity stayed at "..tostring(before)..".")
        end
    end)
    -- Restore only if bait is still selected; preserve manual selection and respawns.
    if previous and previous ~= tool and player.Character == character then
        local current = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if current == tool or current == nil then pcall(RemoteCatalog.EquipTool, previous) end
    end
    baitBusy = false
    if not ok then return false, failure end
    return sent and active(), detail
end
-- BAIT NORMAL CLICK BEGIN
-- MOUSE CAMERA GUARD BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.MouseSteersCamera=function()
    local ok,behavior=pcall(function() return UserInputService.MouseBehavior end)
    if ok and behavior~=nil and behavior~=Enum.MouseBehavior.Default then return true end
    local checked,held=pcall(function() return UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) end)
    return checked and held==true
end
-- MOUSE CAMERA GUARD END
RemoteCatalog.ClickBaitTool=function(tool)
    local character=player.Character
    local camera=workspace and workspace.CurrentCamera
    local root
    pcall(function() root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end)
    if not camera or not root then return nil,"World input unavailable" end
    local focused,text=pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() end)
    if focused and text then return false,"Close chat before applying bait" end
    if RemoteCatalog.MouseSteersCamera() then return false,"Release right mouse or unlock the cursor before bait mouse input" end
    local viewport=camera.ViewportSize
    local candidates={}
    local projected,visible=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(root.Position+root.CFrame.LookVector*12)
    if visible and projected.Z>0 then table.insert(candidates,{X=projected.X,Y=projected.Y}) end
    for _,fraction in ipairs({.8,.65,.5,.35}) do table.insert(candidates,{X=viewport.X*fraction,Y=viewport.Y*.5}) end
    local point
    for _,candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
        local blocked=false
        if hub.Root.Visible then
            local p,size=hub.Root.AbsolutePosition,hub.Root.AbsoluteSize
            blocked=candidate.X>=p.X and candidate.X<=p.X+size.X and candidate.Y>=p.Y and candidate.Y<=p.Y+size.Y
        end
        local checked,objects=pcall(function() return playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(candidate.X,candidate.Y) end)
        if checked then
            for _,object in ipairs(objects) do
                if object:IsA("GuiButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") or object:IsDescendantOf(statsOverlayGui) then blocked=true;break end
            end
        end
        if not blocked then point=candidate;break end
    end
    if not point then return false,"Move the hub to leave clear game space for bait input" end
    local token=baitCycleId
    local function active()
        return baitEnabled and baitCycleId==token and gui.Parent~=nil and player.Character==character
            and tool.Parent==character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")==tool and not RemoteCatalog.MouseSteersCamera()
    end
    if not active() then return false,"Auto Bait stopped or tool changed" end
    local host=type(mousemoveabs)=="function" and type(mouse1press)=="function" and type(mouse1release)=="function"
    local moved=pcall(function()
        if host then mousemoveabs(point.X,point.Y) else VirtualInputManager:SendMouseMoveEvent(point.X,point.Y,game) end
    end)
    if not moved then return nil,"Mouse movement unavailable" end
    task.wait(.03)
    if not active() then return false,"Auto Bait stopped or tool changed" end
    local function input(down)
        if host then if down then mouse1press() else mouse1release() end
        else VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(point.X,point.Y,0,down,game,0) end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.BaitMouseInput=true
    local pressed=pcall(input,true)
    local held=pcall(function() if pressed then task.wait(.1) end end)
    local released=pcall(input,false)
    pcall(task.wait,.03) -- Let GUI activation from the release finish before accepting toggles.
    RemoteCatalog.BaitMouseInput=false
    if not pressed or not held or not released then return false,"Bait mouse input failed" end
    -- The last bait can vanish during the hold; WithBaitTool confirms consumption.
    local running=baitEnabled and baitCycleId==token and gui.Parent~=nil and player.Character==character
    return running,host and "host mouse bait click" or "virtual mouse bait click"
end
-- BAIT NORMAL CLICK END
RemoteCatalog.BaitSignalAvailable=function()
    return type(firesignal)=="function" and not RemoteCatalog.BaitDirectSignalFailed
        or type(getconnections)=="function" and type(getfenv)=="function"
end
RemoteCatalog.FireBaitSignal=function(tool,pressed,directRelease)
    if pressed and (tool.Parent~=player.Character or tool.Enabled==false) then return false,"Bait is not ready to activate" end
    local event=pressed and tool.Activated or tool.Deactivated
    if type(firesignal)=="function" and (not RemoteCatalog.BaitDirectSignalFailed or directRelease) then
        local ok,result=pcall(firesignal,event)
        if pressed and not ok then RemoteCatalog.BaitDirectSignalFailed=true end
        return ok,result
    end
    RemoteCatalog.BaitTransport="Tool.Activated food handler"
    return RemoteCatalog.FireBaitFoodEvent(tool,event,pressed)
end
RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodConnections=function(tool,event)
    if type(getconnections)~="function" or type(getfenv)~="function" then return {},"Food handler inspection unavailable" end
    local found,food=pcall(function() return tool:FindFirstChild("food") end)
    if not found or not food then return {},"Bait food script unavailable" end
    local ok,list=pcall(getconnections,event)
    if not ok or type(list)~="table" then return {},"Food activation callbacks unavailable" end
    local matched={}
    for _,connection in ipairs(list) do
        local valid,callback=pcall(function()
            if connection.Enabled==false or type(connection.Function)~="function" then return end
            if getfenv(connection.Function).script==food then return connection.Function end
        end)
        if valid and callback then table.insert(matched,{Connection=connection,Callback=callback}) end
    end
    return matched,#matched>0 and "Enabled food handlers found" or "No enabled food activation handler found"
end
RemoteCatalog.FireBaitFoodEvent=function(tool,event,pressed)
    if pressed and (tool.Parent~=player.Character or tool.Enabled==false) then return false,"Bait is not ready to activate" end
    local list,reason=RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodConnections(tool,event)
    local sent=0
    for _,handler in ipairs(list) do
        if pressed and tool.Parent~=player.Character then break end
        local fired=pcall(function()
            if type(handler.Connection.Fire)=="function" then handler.Connection:Fire() else handler.Callback() end
        end)
        if not fired then return false,"Food activation handler failed" end
        sent+=1
    end
    return sent>0 or not pressed,reason
end
RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodMouse=function()
    local ok,mouse=pcall(function() return player:GetMouse() end)
    if ok and mouse then return mouse end
end
RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodMouseAvailable=function(tool)
    local mouse=RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodMouse()
    if not mouse then RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodMouseStatus="Player mouse unavailable";return false end
    local list,reason=RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodConnections(tool,mouse.Button1Down)
    RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodMouseStatus=reason
    return #list>0
end
RemoteCatalog.ActivateBait = function(tool, prepared)
    local function activate()
        if RemoteCatalog.BaitTryMouseHandler~=false and RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodMouseAvailable(tool) then
            local mouse=RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodMouse()
            RemoteCatalog.BaitTransport="Mouse.Button1Down food handler"
            local pressed,reason=RemoteCatalog.FireBaitFoodEvent(tool,mouse.Button1Down,true)
            local held=pcall(task.wait,.15)
            local released=RemoteCatalog.FireBaitFoodEvent(tool,mouse.Button1Up,false)
            return pressed and held and released,pressed and "bait food mouse handler attempted" or reason
        end
        if RemoteCatalog.BaitTrySignal~=false and RemoteCatalog.BaitSignalAvailable() then
            RemoteCatalog.BaitTransport="Tool.Activated signal"
            local direct=type(firesignal)=="function" and not RemoteCatalog.BaitDirectSignalFailed
            local pressed,reason=RemoteCatalog.FireBaitSignal(tool,true)
            local held=pcall(task.wait,.15)
            local released=RemoteCatalog.FireBaitSignal(tool,false,direct)
            return pressed and held and released,pressed and "bait activation signal attempted" or reason
        end
        if not RemoteCatalog.BaitTryToolActivation then
            local clicked,reason=RemoteCatalog.ClickBaitTool(tool)
            if clicked~=nil then
                RemoteCatalog.BaitTransport=reason
                return clicked,reason
            end
        end
        RemoteCatalog.BaitTransport="Tool:Activate"
        -- Use the engine activation lifecycle, including its release. A signal alone
        -- does not update the Tool's internal activation state.
        local pressed,reason=pcall(function() tool:Activate() end)
        local held=pcall(task.wait,.15)
        local released=pcall(function() tool:Deactivate() end)
        return pressed and held and released,pressed and "tool activation attempted" or tostring(reason)
    end
    if prepared then return activate() end
    return RemoteCatalog.WithBaitTool(tool, activate)
end
-- BAIT TOOL INPUT END

local function applyBait()
    local character = player.Character
    local baitTool = character and character:FindFirstChild("bait")
    if not baitTool then
        local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        baitTool = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("bait")
    end
    if not baitTool then
        for _,owned in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools()) do
            if string.lower(owned.Name)=="bait" then baitTool=owned;break end
        end
    end
    if baitTool and RemoteCatalog.BaitInputCharacter~=character then
        RemoteCatalog.BaitInputCharacter=character
        RemoteCatalog.BaitTryMouseHandler=nil
        RemoteCatalog.BaitDirectSignalFailed=nil
        local checked,manual=pcall(function() return baitTool.ManualActivationOnly end)
        -- These tools explicitly require Tool:Activate. Prefer it to a synthetic signal.
        RemoteCatalog.BaitTrySignal=not (checked and manual==true) and RemoteCatalog.BaitSignalAvailable()
        RemoteCatalog.BaitTryToolActivation=not RemoteCatalog.BaitTrySignal
    end
    -- Inventory rebuilds can replace the Tool without replacing the character.
    -- Keep fallback progress so each replacement cannot restart a failed signal path.
    RemoteCatalog.BaitInputTool=baitTool
    local count=baitTool and RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(baitTool)
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.AcceptFreshBaitBinding()
    local binding=recorder and recorder.BaitBinding
    local sample=RemoteCatalog.BaitSample
    local consumed=sample and type(sample.Count)=="number" and sample.Tool and
        (baitTool==sample.Tool and type(count)=="number" and count<sample.Count or sample.Count==1 and sample.Tool.Parent==nil)
    if consumed and type(sample.At)=="number" and sample.Character==character
        and binding and binding~=sample.Binding and binding.Target==sample.Tool
        and (os.clock()-sample.At<=15 or sample.Manual and type(binding.ObservedAt)=="number"
            and binding.ObservedAt>=sample.At and os.clock()-binding.ObservedAt<=15) then
        RemoteCatalog.BaitNeedsRefresh=false
        RemoteCatalog.BaitFailedBinding=nil
        RemoteCatalog.BaitPending=false
        RemoteCatalog.BaitOutOfStock=not baitTool or count==0
        RemoteCatalog.BaitSample={Character=character,Tool=baitTool,Count=count,Binding=binding,At=os.clock()}
        local observed=type(binding.ObservedAt)=="number" and binding.ObservedAt or os.clock()
        RemoteCatalog.BaitRefreshDelay=math.clamp(math.floor(60-(os.clock()-observed)),1,60)
        baitInfo.Text="Manual bait consumption confirmed; ready to fish."
        baitInfo.TextColor3=COLORS.good
        return true,"bait consumption confirmed"
    end
    if not baitTool then
        RemoteCatalog.BaitOutOfStock=true
        RemoteCatalog.BaitPending=false
        baitInfo.Text = "No bait in inventory. Fishing continues without bait; checking again every 5s."
        baitInfo.TextColor3 = COLORS.warn
        setStatus(enabled and "No bait — fishing continues without it" or "No bait in inventory; Auto Bait will check again in 5s",COLORS.warn)
        return false, "bait tool not found"
    end
    RemoteCatalog.BaitOutOfStock=false
    RemoteCatalog.BaitSample={Character=character,Tool=baitTool,Count=count,Binding=binding,At=os.clock()}
    if count==0 then
        RemoteCatalog.BaitOutOfStock=true;RemoteCatalog.BaitPending=false
        baitInfo.Text="No bait remaining. Fishing continues; checking again in 5s."
        return false,"bait tool not found"
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.PrepareBaitLearning then RemoteCatalog.PrepareBaitLearning() end
    RemoteCatalog.BaitAttemptedBinding=nil
    local ok, result = RemoteCatalog.WithBaitTool(baitTool, function() return RemoteCatalog.CallBait(baitTool, true) end)
    if not ok then
        if result~="Waiting for current rod input" and result~="Waiting for the current cast to finish" and result~="Auto Bait stopped" and result~=RemoteCatalog.BaitUnverified then
            -- Normal input can capture a NEW request even when consumption is late.
            -- Reject only the exact learned template that was actually replayed.
            if RemoteCatalog.BaitAttemptedBinding then
                RemoteCatalog.BaitFailedBinding=RemoteCatalog.BaitAttemptedBinding
            end
            RemoteCatalog.BaitNeedsRefresh=true
            if RemoteCatalog.BaitTransport=="game food request" then
                RemoteCatalog.BaitNativeFailed={Character=character,Tool=baitTool}
                if RemoteCatalog.BaitNativeStatus=="Food request sent; awaiting consumption" then
                    RemoteCatalog.BaitNativeStatus="Food request sent but consumption was not observed"
                end
            end
            -- A successful mouse API call can still produce no game input on this host.
            -- Try one other normal activation method on the next scheduled attempt.
            local transport=RemoteCatalog.BaitTransport or ""
            -- Give an observed food mouse handler a turn after normal mouse input fails.
            RemoteCatalog.BaitTryMouseHandler=(transport=="host mouse bait click" or transport=="virtual mouse bait click")
                and RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodMouseAvailable and RemoteCatalog.BaitFoodMouseAvailable(baitTool) or false
            local signal=transport=="Tool.Activated signal" or transport=="Tool.Activated food handler"
            if transport=="Tool.Activated signal" then RemoteCatalog.BaitDirectSignalFailed=true end
            local handlers=transport=="Tool.Activated signal" and type(getconnections)=="function" and type(getfenv)=="function"
            RemoteCatalog.BaitTrySignal=handlers or not signal and transport~="Tool:Activate" and RemoteCatalog.BaitSignalAvailable()
            RemoteCatalog.BaitTryToolActivation=signal or transport~="Tool:Activate" and not RemoteCatalog.BaitTrySignal
        end
        baitInfo.Text = "Bait waiting: " .. tostring(result) .. (enabled and " Fishing continues." or " Fishing is OFF.") .. " ["..tostring(RemoteCatalog.BaitTransport or "no request").."]"
        baitInfo.TextColor3 = COLORS.warn
        if result~="Waiting for current rod input" and result~="Waiting for the current cast to finish" then
            setStatus("Auto Bait failed: " .. tostring(result))
        end
    else
        RemoteCatalog.BaitNeedsRefresh=false
        RemoteCatalog.BaitFailedBinding=nil
        local learned=RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("BaitBinding")
        RemoteCatalog.BaitSample={Character=character,Tool=baitTool,Count=RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(baitTool),Binding=learned and learned.BaitBinding,At=os.clock()}
        baitInfo.Text = "Bait consumption confirmed. Refreshes after 60 seconds."
        baitInfo.TextColor3 = COLORS.good
    end
    RemoteCatalog.BaitLastResult=tostring(result)
    return ok, result
end

local function setBaitEnabled(state)
    if state and RemoteCatalog.Mobs and (RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Worker or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press) then
        RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Stop("Stopped · another mode started")
        if RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press then setStatus("Weapon release pending · press STOP in Mobs",COLORS.warn);return false end
    end
    if state and RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(false);setStatus("Wait for Auto Plow input cleanup, then start this mode",COLORS.warn);return end
    if baitEnabled == state then
        if not state and RemoteCatalog.StopBaitLearning then RemoteCatalog.StopBaitLearning() end
        return
    end
    RemoteCatalog.BaitPending=state
    if state then
        RemoteCatalog.BaitInputCharacter=nil
        RemoteCatalog.BaitTryMouseHandler=nil
        RemoteCatalog.BaitNativeFailed=nil
        RemoteCatalog.BaitDirectSignalFailed=nil
        RemoteCatalog.BaitTrySignal=RemoteCatalog.BaitSignalAvailable()
        RemoteCatalog.BaitTryToolActivation=not RemoteCatalog.BaitTrySignal
    end
    RemoteCatalog.StartFishingOnBait=state
    baitEnabled = state
    baitCycleId += 1
    local myCycle = baitCycleId
    baitToggle.Text = baitEnabled and "AUTO BAIT ON · CHECKING" or "AUTO BAIT OFF  [60s]"
    baitToggle.BackgroundColor3 = baitEnabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    if not baitEnabled then
        if RemoteCatalog.StopBaitLearning then RemoteCatalog.StopBaitLearning() end
        setStatus("Auto Bait stopped")
        return
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while baitEnabled and baitCycleId == myCycle and gui.Parent do
            RemoteCatalog.BaitPending=true
            local succeeded,applied,detail=pcall(applyBait)
            if not baitEnabled or baitCycleId ~= myCycle or not gui.Parent then return end
            if not succeeded then
                detail="Unexpected bait error: "..tostring(applied)
                applied=false
                baitBusy=false
                RemoteCatalog.BaitPending=false
                RemoteCatalog.BaitLastResult=detail
                baitInfo.Text=detail.." Retrying; Fishing stays under your control."
                baitInfo.TextColor3=COLORS.warn
                setStatus(detail,COLORS.warn)
            end
            local waiting=not applied and (detail=="Waiting for current rod input" or detail=="Waiting for the current cast to finish")
            RemoteCatalog.BaitPending=waiting
            if waiting then
                baitInfo.Text="Bait queued: finishing the current cast first."
                baitToggle.Text="AUTO BAIT ON · QUEUED"
                task.wait(.1)
                continue
            end
            if applied and detail=="bait consumption confirmed" and RemoteCatalog.StartFishingOnBait then
                -- setEnabled clears the one-shot flag only when it accepts; a refusal keeps it for the next refresh.
                if not enabled then setEnabled(true) else RemoteCatalog.StartFishingOnBait=false end
            end
            if applied then setStatus(detail == "tool activation attempted" and "Bait tool activated; next attempt in 60s" or "Auto Bait applied; refresh in 60s", COLORS.good) end
            baitToggle.BackgroundColor3 = applied and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
            -- Bait runs once a minute. Only an empty inventory or a client error before use is rechecked sooner.
            local delay = applied and (RemoteCatalog.BaitRefreshDelay or 60) or (RemoteCatalog.BaitOutOfStock or not succeeded) and 5 or 60
            RemoteCatalog.BaitRefreshDelay=nil
            for remaining = delay, 1, -1 do
                if not baitEnabled or baitCycleId ~= myCycle or not gui.Parent then return end
                baitToggle.Text = string.format(applied and "AUTO BAIT ON  [%ds]" or RemoteCatalog.BaitOutOfStock and "AUTO BAIT ON · NO BAIT  [%ds]" or "AUTO BAIT ON · RETRY  [%ds]", remaining)
                task.wait(1)
            end
        end
    end)
end

RemoteCatalog.LearnBaitButton=button({Parent=fishingPage,Text="Learn bait manually (pause fishing & bait)",TextSize=12,
    Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,32),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,452)})
track(RemoteCatalog.LearnBaitButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if baitBusy then setStatus("Wait for the current bait attempt to finish",COLORS.warn);return end
    setBaitEnabled(false)
    setEnabled(false)
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("BaitBinding")
    RemoteCatalog.BaitSample=nil
    for _,tool in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools()) do
        if string.lower(tool.Name)=="bait" then
            RemoteCatalog.BaitSample={Character=player.Character,Tool=tool,Count=RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(tool),
                Binding=recorder and recorder.BaitBinding,At=os.clock(),Manual=true}
            break
        end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.BaitFailedBinding=recorder and recorder.BaitBinding
    RemoteCatalog.BaitNeedsRefresh=true
    RemoteCatalog.PrepareBaitLearning()
    local capture=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if capture and not capture.Stopped and (capture.Active or capture.LearnBaitOnly) then
        baitInfo.Text="Hide the hub, use bait once manually, then immediately turn Auto Bait ON. Learning sends no requests."
        baitInfo.TextColor3=COLORS.good
        setStatus("Manual bait learning ready. Hide the hub with Right Ctrl and use bait once.",COLORS.good)
    else
        setStatus("Manual bait capture is unavailable on this client",COLORS.warn)
    end
end))

local function refreshCropSelectionUI()
    local selected=FarmLogic.SelectedCrops(CONFIG.HarvestCrops,CONFIG.HarvestCrop)
    local summary=#selected<=2 and table.concat(selected,", ") or tostring(#selected).." selected"
    cropSelect.Text=(#selected==1 and "Crop: " or "Crops: ")..summary..(cropDropdownOpen and "  ▲" or "  ▼")
    for i,option in ipairs(cropButtons) do
        local chosen=CONFIG.HarvestCrops[cropOptions[i]]==true
        option.Text=(chosen and "[x] " or "[ ] ")..cropOptions[i]
        option.BackgroundColor3=chosen and COLORS.off or COLORS.panel
    end
end

RemoteCatalog.ChestControlPositions={}
for _,child in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestPage:GetChildren()) do
    if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestSelectMenu and child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestAmountMenu and child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestItemMenu and child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestStockMenu.Menu and child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatMenu.Menu and child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestBatchMenu.Menu and child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestOrderMenu.Menu then
        RemoteCatalog.ChestControlPositions[child]=child.Position
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.LayoutChestControls()
    local exclusionOffset=RemoteCatalog.ChestExclusionPanel.Size.Y.Offset+12
    local orderOffset=RemoteCatalog.ChestOrderMenu.Menu.Visible and RemoteCatalog.ChestOrderMenu.Menu.Size.Y.Offset+12 or 0
    local batchOffset=RemoteCatalog.ChestBatchMenu.Menu.Visible and RemoteCatalog.ChestBatchMenu.Menu.Size.Y.Offset+12 or 0
    local selectOffset=RemoteCatalog.ChestSelectMenu.Visible and RemoteCatalog.ChestSelectMenu.Size.Y.Offset+8 or 0
    local amountOffset=RemoteCatalog.ChestAmountMenu.Visible and RemoteCatalog.ChestAmountMenu.Size.Y.Offset+8 or 0
    local itemOffset=RemoteCatalog.ChestItemMenu.Visible and RemoteCatalog.ChestItemMenu.Size.Y.Offset+8 or 0
    local stockOffset=RemoteCatalog.ChestStockMenu.Menu.Visible and RemoteCatalog.ChestStockMenu.Menu.Size.Y.Offset+12
        or RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatMenu.Menu.Visible and RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatMenu.Menu.Size.Y.Offset+12 or 0
    for child,base in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestControlPositions) do
        local y=base.Y.Offset
        if child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestConveyorButton and base.Y.Offset>=214 then y+=44 end
        if base.Y.Offset>=214 then y+=batchOffset end
        if base.Y.Offset>=534 then y+=orderOffset end
        if not RemoteCatalog.ChestDetailsOpen and base.Y.Offset>=676 then y-=134 end
        if base.Y.Offset>=328 then y+=selectOffset+exclusionOffset end
        if base.Y.Offset>=730 then y+=amountOffset end
        if base.Y.Offset>=490 then y+=stockOffset end
        if base.Y.Offset>=260 then y+=itemOffset end
        if child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestConveyorButton and child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesButton and child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesPanel and child~=RemoteCatalog.ChestQuickButton and base.Y.Offset>=214 then
            y+=44+(RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesPanel.Visible and RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesPanel.Size.Y.Offset+8 or 0)
        end
        child.Position=UDim2.new(base.X.Scale,base.X.Offset,base.Y.Scale,y)
    end
    local profileOffset=88+batchOffset+(RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesPanel.Visible and RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesPanel.Size.Y.Offset+8 or 0)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestItemMenu.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,254+profileOffset)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAmountMenu.Position=UDim2.new(0,6,0,716+selectOffset+itemOffset+profileOffset+stockOffset+orderOffset+exclusionOffset-(RemoteCatalog.ChestDetailsOpen and 0 or 134))
    RemoteCatalog.ChestOrderMenu.Menu.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,RemoteCatalog.ChestOrderButton.Position.Y.Offset+RemoteCatalog.ChestOrderButton.Size.Y.Offset+6)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestBatchMenu.Menu.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,RemoteCatalog.ChestBatchButton.Position.Y.Offset+RemoteCatalog.ChestBatchButton.Size.Y.Offset+6)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestStockMenu.Menu.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,RemoteCatalog.ChestStockButton.Position.Y.Offset+RemoteCatalog.ChestStockButton.Size.Y.Offset+6)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatMenu.Menu.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatButton.Position.Y.Offset+RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatButton.Size.Y.Offset+6)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestSelectMenu.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,326+itemOffset+profileOffset)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestExclusionPanel.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,RemoteCatalog.ChestSelectButton.Position.Y.Offset+RemoteCatalog.ChestSelectButton.Size.Y.Offset+6+selectOffset)
end
table.insert(RemoteCatalog.MenuClosers,function()
    RemoteCatalog.ChestSelectMenu.Visible=false;RemoteCatalog.ChestAmountMenu.Visible=false;RemoteCatalog.ChestItemMenu.Visible=false
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestItemSearch then pcall(function() RemoteCatalog.ChestItemSearch:ReleaseFocus() end) end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesPanel.Visible=false;RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesButton.Text="Chest profiles  ▾"
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferPanel.Visible=false;RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesPanel.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,196)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferButton.Text="Backup / share setup  ▾"
    pcall(function() RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferText:ReleaseFocus() end)
    pcall(function() RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileName:ReleaseFocus() end)
    RemoteCatalog.LayoutChestControls()
end)
RemoteCatalog.LayoutChestControls()
RemoteCatalog.RegisterMenuRegion(RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesButton,RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesPanel)
RemoteCatalog.RegisterMenuRegion(RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferButton,RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferPanel)

RemoteCatalog.TravelSelectors={}
function RemoteCatalog.TravelLabel(mode) return mode=="Hop" and "TP hops" or tostring(mode) end
RemoteCatalog.TravelKeys={}
function RemoteCatalog.TravelSelector(page,y)
    local key=page==woodPage and "WoodTravelMode" or "FarmTravelMode"
    local title=page==woodPage and "Mode: " or "Travel: "
    -- "Hop" (shown as TP hops) teleports in short steps along the walking path.
    local modes=page==woodPage and {"Normal","Walk","Hop","Tween","Teleport"} or {"Walk","Hop","Tween","Teleport"}
    local show=RemoteCatalog.TravelLabel
    local selector=button({Parent=page,Text=title..show(CONFIG[key]).."  ▾",TextSize=12,Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,32),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,y)})
    table.insert(RemoteCatalog.TravelSelectors,selector)
    RemoteCatalog.TravelKeys[selector]=key
    local options={}
    for i,mode in ipairs(modes) do
        local option=button({Parent=page,Text=show(mode),TextSize=12,Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,30),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,y+34+(i-1)*31)})
        option.Visible=false;option.ZIndex=20
        RemoteCatalog.RegisterMenuRegion(selector,option)
        table.insert(options,option)
        track(option.Activated:Connect(function()
            CONFIG[key]=mode
            RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Stop()
            for _,item in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.TravelSelectors) do
                if RemoteCatalog.TravelKeys[item]==key then item.Text=title..show(mode).."  ▾" end
            end
            for _,item in ipairs(options) do item.Visible=false end
            savePreferences()
        end))
    end
    local function close()
        for _,item in ipairs(options) do item.Visible=false end
        selector.Text=title..show(CONFIG[key]).."  ▾"
    end
    table.insert(RemoteCatalog.MenuClosers,close)
    track(selector.Activated:Connect(function()
        local show=not options[1].Visible
        RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
        for _,item in ipairs(options) do item.Visible=show end
        selector.Text=title..RemoteCatalog.TravelLabel(CONFIG[key])..(show and "  ▴" or "  ▾")
    end))
end
RemoteCatalog.TravelSelector(harvestPage,286)
RemoteCatalog.TravelSelector(woodPage,280)

end

-- Lifetime totals across sessions (saved with the preferences; never part of a profile).
function RemoteCatalog.Lifetime()
    if type(CONFIG.Lifetime)~="table" then CONFIG.Lifetime={Catches=0,Casts=0,Harvests=0,Wood=0,Mine=0,Kills=0,Blocks=0,Seconds=0} end
    if type(CONFIG.Lifetime.Blocks)~="number" then CONFIG.Lifetime.Blocks=0 end
    return CONFIG.Lifetime
end
function RemoteCatalog.LifetimeAdd(key,amount)
    local totals=RemoteCatalog.Lifetime()
    if totals[key]==nil or type(amount)~="number" or amount<=0 then return end
    totals[key]+=amount
end
function RemoteCatalog.LifetimeText()
    local t=RemoteCatalog.Lifetime()
    local seconds=math.floor(t.Seconds)
    return string.format("Lifetime (all sessions): %d catches · %d harvests · %d wood · %d mined · %d kills · %d blocks · active %dh %02dm",t.Catches,t.Harvests,t.Wood,t.Mine,t.Kills,t.Blocks,math.floor(seconds/3600),math.floor(seconds%3600/60))
end

function RemoteCatalog.AllReports()
    local parts={RemoteCatalog.SessionReport()}
    if RemoteCatalog.MobResultReport then
        local ok,text=pcall(RemoteCatalog.MobResultReport);table.insert(parts,ok and text or ("Mob report failed: "..tostring(text)))
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.MobScoreText then
        local ok,text=pcall(RemoteCatalog.MobScoreText);table.insert(parts,"Mobs scoreboard\n"..(ok and text or tostring(text)))
    end
    return table.concat(parts,"\n\n")
end
function RemoteCatalog.CopyAllReports()
    local report=RemoteCatalog.AllReports()
    local copy=setclipboard or toclipboard
    if type(copy)=="function" and pcall(copy,report) then setStatus("All reports copied",COLORS.good)
    else print(report);setStatus("All reports printed to console",COLORS.warn) end
    return report
end
track(RemoteCatalog.CopyAllButton.Activated:Connect(function() RemoteCatalog.CopyAllReports() end))

function RemoteCatalog.CycleModeGoal(mode)
    local goal=RemoteCatalog.ModeGoals[mode]
    RemoteCatalog.StopGoalMode(mode)
    local limits={0,10,25,50,100}
    local index=table.find(limits,goal.Limit or 0) or 1
    local limit=limits[index%#limits+1]
    goal.Limit=limit>0 and limit or nil;goal.Progress=0;goal.Reached=false
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateModeGoals()
    setStatus(RemoteCatalog.GoalNames[mode].." goal updated. Start that mode when ready.",COLORS.muted)
end
function RemoteCatalog.UpdateModeGoals()
    for mode,goal in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ModeGoals) do
        goal.Button.Text=RemoteCatalog.GoalNames[mode]..(goal.Limit and (": "..goal.Progress.."/"..goal.Limit..(goal.Reached and " ✓" or "")) or " goal: Unlimited")
        goal.Button.BackgroundColor3=goal.Reached and COLORS.on or COLORS.panel
        if goal.PageButton then
            goal.PageButton.Text=goal.Button.Text
            goal.PageButton.BackgroundColor3=goal.Button.BackgroundColor3
        end
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.ResetModeGoal(mode)
    local goal=RemoteCatalog.ModeGoals[mode]
    goal.Progress=0;goal.Reached=false
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateModeGoals()
end
function RemoteCatalog.ProgressModeGoal(mode)
    local goal=RemoteCatalog.ModeGoals[mode]
    local active=mode=="fishing" and enabled or mode=="crop" and harvestEnabled or mode=="wood" and woodEnabled or mode=="mine" and mineEnabled or mode=="mobs" and RemoteCatalog.Mobs and RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled
    if goal and active and not goal.Reached then goal.Progress+=1 end
end
function RemoteCatalog.CompleteModeGoal(mode)
    local goal=RemoteCatalog.ModeGoals[mode]
    if not goal or not goal.Limit or goal.Reached or goal.Progress<goal.Limit then return end
    goal.Reached=true
    RemoteCatalog.StopGoalMode(mode)
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateModeGoals()
    setStatus(RemoteCatalog.GoalNames[mode].." goal reached: "..goal.Progress..". That mode is stopped.",COLORS.good)
end
function RemoteCatalog.UpdateDashboard()
    if not gui.Parent then return end
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI then RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI() end
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateModeGoals()
    local deadline=RemoteCatalog.StopTimerDeadline
    if deadline and os.clock()>=deadline then
        RemoteCatalog.StopTimerDeadline=nil
        RemoteCatalog.StopAllAutomation()
        setStatus("Session timer finished. All automation stopped.",COLORS.warn)
    end
    local remaining=RemoteCatalog.StopTimerDeadline and math.max(0,math.ceil(RemoteCatalog.StopTimerDeadline-os.clock()))
    -- Lifetime active time follows the session's active time; a session reset starts a new baseline.
    local activeNow=RemoteCatalog.ActiveTime and RemoteCatalog.ActiveTime() or 0
    local seen=RemoteCatalog.LifetimeActiveSeen
    if seen~=nil and activeNow>seen then RemoteCatalog.LifetimeAdd("Seconds",activeNow-seen) end
    RemoteCatalog.LifetimeActiveSeen=activeNow
    if RemoteCatalog.LifetimeLabel then RemoteCatalog.LifetimeLabel.Text=RemoteCatalog.LifetimeText() end
    -- Corner stats: the mob farm's kills, rate, HP and goal at a glance.
    if overlayValues.mobs and RemoteCatalog.Mobs then
        local farm=RemoteCatalog.Mobs
        local kills=(farm.Defeats or 0)+(farm.LikelyDefeats or 0)
        local seconds=tonumber(farm:RunTime()) or 0
        overlayValues.mobs.Text=not farm.StartedAt and "off" or (kills.." kills"..(seconds>=30 and string.format(" · %.1f/min",kills*60/seconds) or "")..(farm.Enabled and "" or " · stopped"))
        local char=player.Character
        local okHuman,human=pcall(function() return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end)
        if not okHuman then human=nil end
        local goal=RemoteCatalog.ModeGoals and RemoteCatalog.ModeGoals.mobs
        overlayValues.mobsHp.Text=(human and (tonumber(human.MaxHealth) or 0)>0 and ("HP "..math.floor((tonumber(human.Health) or 0)/human.MaxHealth*100+.5).."%") or "HP –")..(goal and goal.Limit and (" · goal "..goal.Progress.."/"..goal.Limit) or "")
    end
    if overlayValues.build and type(buildController)=="table" then
        local p=buildController.Progress
        local text="off"
        if p and buildController.Cells and p.PreviewRevision==buildController.PlanRevision then
            local checked=math.min(p.Total or 0,(p.Placed or 0)+(p.Skipped or 0)+(p.Failed or 0))
            local pace=buildController.PaceText and buildController:PaceText(" · ") or ""
            text=(buildController.Running and (buildController.Paused and "paused " or "") or (p.State=="Finished" and "done " or "stopped "))..checked.."/"..tostring(p.Total or 0)..(buildController.Running and pace or "")
        end
        overlayValues.build.Text=text
    end
    RemoteCatalog.StopTimerButton.Text=remaining and "Cancel stop timer" or "Start stop timer"
    RemoteCatalog.StopTimerButton.BackgroundColor3=remaining and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    RemoteCatalog.StopTimerHint.Text=remaining and ("Stops all automation in "..math.floor(remaining/60)..":"..string.format("%02d",remaining%60)..". Cancel to keep playing.")
        or "Timer is OFF. Starting it does not enable any mode. Expiry uses Stop All."
    local function state(value) return value and "ON" or "OFF" end
    local chest=RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled and "collecting" or RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker and "stopping" or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy and "manual request" or "idle"
    RemoteCatalog.DashboardStatus.Text="Fishing "..state(enabled).." · Bait "..state(baitEnabled)..
        "\nHarvest "..state(harvestEnabled).." · Wood "..state(woodEnabled).." · Mining "..state(mineEnabled)..
        "\nChests: "..chest.." · Build "..(buildController.Running and "ON" or buildController.WorkerToken and "stopping" or "OFF")..
        "\nConfirmed chest items this run: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal or 0)
end

-- ANTI AFK BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.AntiAFKClass=(function()
-- Idle-event driven; no input loop and no startup listener.
local AntiAFK={}
function AntiAFK.new(player,virtualUser,camera,changed)
    return setmetatable({Player=player,VirtualUser=virtualUser,Camera=camera,Changed=changed,Enabled=false}, {__index=AntiAFK})
end
function AntiAFK:SetEnabled(state)
    state=state==true and not self.Destroyed
    if self.Enabled==state then return self.Enabled end
    self.Enabled=state
    if self.Connection then self.Connection:Disconnect();self.Connection=nil end
    if state then
        local ok,connection=pcall(function()
            return self.Player.Idled:Connect(function()
                if not self.Enabled or self.Destroyed then return end
                local sent,failure=pcall(function()
                    local user=self.VirtualUser()
                    local camera=self.Camera()
                    if not camera then error("Camera unavailable") end
                    user:CaptureController()
                    user:ClickButton2(Vector2.zero,camera.CFrame)
                end)
                if not sent then
                    self:SetEnabled(false)
                    if self.Changed then self.Changed(false,"input unavailable") end
                elseif self.Changed then self.Changed(true,"idle response sent") end
            end)
        end)
        if not ok then
            self.Enabled=false
            if self.Changed then self.Changed(false,"idle event unavailable") end
            return false
        end
        self.Connection=connection
    end
    if self.Changed then self.Changed(self.Enabled) end
    return self.Enabled
end
function AntiAFK:Destroy()
    self:SetEnabled(false)
    self.Destroyed=true
end
return AntiAFK

end)()
RemoteCatalog.AntiAFKButton=button({Parent=settingsPage,Switch=true,Text="ANTI AFK OFF",TextSize=12,Bg=COLORS.off,
    Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,32),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,52)})
RemoteCatalog.AntiAFK=RemoteCatalog.AntiAFKClass.new(player,function() return game:GetService("VirtualUser") end,
    function() return workspace.CurrentCamera end,function(on,reason)
        RemoteCatalog.AntiAFKButton.Text=(on and "ANTI AFK ON" or "ANTI AFK OFF")..(reason and " · "..reason or "")
        RemoteCatalog.AntiAFKButton.BackgroundColor3=on and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    end)
track(RemoteCatalog.AntiAFKButton.Activated:Connect(function() RemoteCatalog.AntiAFK:SetEnabled(not RemoteCatalog.AntiAFK.Enabled) end))
RemoteCatalog.AntiAFK:SetEnabled(true)
-- ANTI AFK END

local function resizeHub(factor)
    local size = frame.Size
    frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
        math.clamp(math.round(size.X.Offset * factor), 640, 1080),
        math.clamp(math.round(size.Y.Offset * factor), 420, 705)
    )
    hub:_fitToScreen(true)
    hub:_clampToScreen()
end
track(smallerUI.Activated:Connect(function() resizeHub(0.9) end))
track(largerUI.Activated:Connect(function() resizeHub(1.1) end))
track(resetUI.Activated:Connect(function()
    frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(720, 470)
    frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    hub:_fitToScreen(true)
    hub:_clampToScreen()
end))

local movementController = (function()
    local self = {WalkEnabled=false,JumpEnabled=false,Speed=20,JumpPower=60,JumpHeight=10}
    local originals = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local function humanoid()
        local char = player.Character
        return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
    local function override(hum,property,value)
        local original=originals[hum]
        if not original then original={};originals[hum]=original end
        if original[property]==nil then original[property]=hum[property] end
        hum[property]=value
    end
    local function restore(hum,property)
        local original=originals[hum]
        if original and original[property]~=nil then
            hum[property]=original[property]
            original[property]=nil
        end
    end
    local info = label({Parent=movementPage,Text="Adjust walking and jumping. Changes apply only while enabled; Reset restores your character's original values.",
        TextSize=12,Color=COLORS.muted,Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,48),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,4)})
    info.TextWrapped=true
    local walk = button({Parent=movementPage,Text="Custom walk: OFF",Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,36),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,66)})
    local speed = button({Parent=movementPage,Text="Walk speed: 20  ▾",Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,34),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,110)})
    local jump = button({Parent=movementPage,Text="Custom jump: OFF",Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,36),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,162)})
    local height = button({Parent=movementPage,Text="Jump strength: Medium  ▾",Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,34),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,206)})
    local reset = button({Parent=movementPage,Text="Reset movement",Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,34),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,258)})
    self.Status=label({Parent=movementPage,Text="Movement uses the game's character settings; the server may override changes.",
        TextSize=12,Color=COLORS.muted,Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,42),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,302)})
    self.Status.TextWrapped=true
    function self:Apply(feature)
        walk.Text=self.WalkEnabled and "Custom walk: ON" or "Custom walk: OFF"
        jump.Text=self.JumpEnabled and "Custom jump: ON" or "Custom jump: OFF"
        walk.BackgroundColor3=self.WalkEnabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
        jump.BackgroundColor3=self.JumpEnabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
        local hum=humanoid()
        if not hum then self.Status.Text="Wait for your character to spawn.";return end
        if feature~="jump" then
            if self.WalkEnabled then override(hum,"WalkSpeed",self.Speed)
            else restore(hum,"WalkSpeed") end
        end
        if feature~="walk" then
            local property=hum.UseJumpPower and "JumpPower" or "JumpHeight"
            local other=hum.UseJumpPower and "JumpHeight" or "JumpPower"
            restore(hum,other)
            if self.JumpEnabled then override(hum,property,self[property])
            else restore(hum,property) end
        end
        self.Status.Text="Movement updated. Reset restores only settings changed here."
    end
    -- Another owner (the Mobs boost) restoring a speed while Custom walk is ON: its original
    -- becomes the value Custom walk restores later, instead of the boosted one it captured.
    function self:SetBaseline(hum,property,value)
        local original=originals[hum]
        if original and original[property]~=nil then original[property]=value end
    end
    function self:Reset()
        self.WalkEnabled,self.JumpEnabled=false,false
        local hum=humanoid()
        if hum then
            restore(hum,"WalkSpeed");restore(hum,"JumpPower");restore(hum,"JumpHeight")
        end
        walk.Text="Custom walk: OFF";jump.Text="Custom jump: OFF"
        walk.BackgroundColor3=COLORS.off;jump.BackgroundColor3=COLORS.off
        self.Status.Text="Original movement restored."
    end
    track(walk.Activated:Connect(function() self.WalkEnabled=not self.WalkEnabled;self:Apply("walk") end))
    track(jump.Activated:Connect(function() self.JumpEnabled=not self.JumpEnabled;self:Apply("jump") end))
    track(reset.Activated:Connect(function() self:Reset() end))
    local function dropdown(anchor, options, y, select)
        local menu=Instance.new("Frame");menu.BackgroundColor3=COLORS.panel;menu.BorderSizePixel=0
        menu.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,#options*36);menu.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,y);menu.ZIndex=30;menu.Visible=false;menu.Parent=movementPage;corner(menu,8)
        table.insert(self.Menus,menu)
        RemoteCatalog.RegisterMenuRegion(anchor,menu)
        table.insert(RemoteCatalog.MenuClosers,function() menu.Visible=false end)
        for i, option in ipairs(options) do
            local choice=button({Parent=menu,Text=tostring(option),Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,34),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,(i-1)*36)})
            choice.ZIndex=31
            track(choice.Activated:Connect(function() select(i);menu.Visible=false end))
        end
        track(anchor.Activated:Connect(function()
            local open=not menu.Visible
            RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
            menu.Visible=open
        end))
    end
    self.Menus={}
    local speeds={16,20,24,32}
    dropdown(speed,speeds,146,function(i) self.Speed=speeds[i];speed.Text="Walk speed: "..self.Speed.."  ▾";if self.WalkEnabled then self:Apply("walk") end end)
    local powers={50,60,75};local heights={7.2,10,14};local names={"Normal","Medium","High"}
    dropdown(height,names,242,function(i)
        self.JumpPower,self.JumpHeight=powers[i],heights[i];height.Text="Jump strength: "..names[i].."  ▾"
        if self.JumpEnabled then self:Apply("jump") end
    end)
    track(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if self.WalkEnabled or self.JumpEnabled then
            task.spawn(function()
                local hum=char:WaitForChild("Humanoid",5)
                if hum and player.Character==char and gui.Parent and (self.WalkEnabled or self.JumpEnabled) then self:Apply() end
            end)
        end
    end))
    self.WalkButton,self.JumpButton,self.ResetButton=walk,jump,reset
    return self
end)()

RemoteCatalog.LearnedBindingKinds={"ChestBinding","CraftBinding","PlowBinding","BaitBinding","WoodHitBinding","MineHitBinding","HotbarBinding","PlacementBinding","HarvestBinding","FruitBinding","MobBinding"}
-- Scalar fields of a learned melee hit body, without the target; nil when the body is unusable.
function RemoteCatalog.MobHitBodyOf(binding)
    local args=type(binding)=="table" and binding.Args
    local body=type(args)=="table" and type(args[1])=="table" and binding.BodyKey and args[1][binding.BodyKey]
    if type(body)~="table" then return nil end
    local copy,count={},0
    for key,value in pairs(body) do
        if key~="hitUnit" then
            count+=1
            if count>32 or type(key)~="string" or (type(value)~="string" and type(value)~="number" and type(value)~="boolean") then return nil end
            copy[key]=value
        end
    end
    return copy
end
function RemoteCatalog.RememberDefinitions()
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if not recorder then return end
    CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions=CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions or {}
    local changed=false
    for _,kind in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.LearnedBindingKinds) do
        local binding=recorder[kind]
        local remote=type(binding)=="table" and binding.Remote
        if remote and remote.Parent then
            local name=RemoteCatalog.RequestDefinitionFor(remote)
            if name and CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions[kind]~=name then CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions[kind]=name;changed=true end
            -- The melee body (minus the target) is what the stable definition needs on another server.
            if kind=="MobBinding" and name then
                local body=RemoteCatalog.MobHitBodyOf(binding)
                local ok,encoded=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(body) end)
                if body and ok and encoded~=RemoteCatalog.MobHitBodyEncoded then
                    RemoteCatalog.MobHitBodyEncoded=encoded;CONFIG.MobHitBody=body;changed=true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local live=recorder.GetChestBindings and recorder:GetChestBindings() or {}
    if #live>0 and RemoteCatalog.SnapshotChestMemory then
        local snapshot=RemoteCatalog.SnapshotChestMemory(live)
        -- Live bindings only cover this character/server; merge so earlier chests are kept.
        local merged=RemoteCatalog.MergeChestMemory(CONFIG.RememberedChests,snapshot)
        local ok,encoded=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(merged) end)
        if #snapshot>0 and ok and encoded~=RemoteCatalog.ChestMemoryEncoded then
            RemoteCatalog.ChestMemoryEncoded=encoded;CONFIG.RememberedChests=merged;changed=true
        end
    end
    if changed then savePreferences() end
end
function RemoteCatalog.UpdateCaptureUI()
    pcall(RemoteCatalog.RememberDefinitions)
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI then pcall(RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI) end
    local recorder = RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if not recorder then
        RemoteCatalog.CaptureStatus.Text = RemoteCatalog.CaptureAttempted
            and "Capture unavailable: this host does not provide working hook APIs."
            or "Recorder OFF. Farming uses the game API; capture is optional."
        RemoteCatalog.CaptureToggle.Text = RemoteCatalog.CaptureAttempted and "Retry capture setup" or "Start capture (optional)"
        return
    end
    local state = recorder.LearnMobOnly and "Waiting for one manual slime attack (no call log)" or recorder.LearnCraftOnly and "Waiting for one manual bait craft (no call log)" or recorder.LearnPlowOnly and "Waiting for one manual hoe action (no call log)" or recorder.LearnChestOnly and "Learning chests; press Stop learning when finished" or recorder.LearnBaitOnly and "Waiting for one bait use (no call log)" or recorder.LearnWoodOnly and "Learning axe request; normal input stays available (no call log)" or (recorder.Stopped and "Stopped" or (recorder.Active and "Recording" or "Paused"))
    local learned = {}
    for _, name in ipairs({"OEzzgCCBzocxJw", "ohy6O10QKzyGZE", "raqRasAwcny1zh", "RZQQNNDRUvfj1N"}) do
        if RemoteCatalog.RequestId(name) then table.insert(learned, RemoteCatalog.VerifiedRequests[name]) end
    end
    if recorder.HarvestBinding then table.insert(learned, "crop harvest") end
    if recorder.CraftBinding then table.insert(learned, "item crafting") end
    if recorder.BaitBinding then table.insert(learned, "bait (current remote)") end
    if recorder.PlacementBinding then table.insert(learned, "placement (current remote)") end
    if recorder.PlowBinding then table.insert(learned, "hoe / plow") end
    if recorder.WoodHitBinding then table.insert(learned, "axe / wood hit") end
    if recorder.MineHitBinding then table.insert(learned, "mining hit") end
    if recorder.AutoReplantBinding then table.insert(learned, "game AutoReplant") end
    if recorder.FruitBinding then table.insert(learned, "fruit picking") end
    if recorder.ChestBinding then table.insert(learned, "chest items") end
    if recorder.HotbarBinding then table.insert(learned, "hotbar (current remote)") end
    if recorder.MobBinding then table.insert(learned, "mob attack") end
    local mining = #learned > 0 and ("Ready: " .. table.concat(learned, ", ")) or "Perform actions manually once to learn their request IDs"
    if RemoteCatalog.CopyNotice and os.clock()>(RemoteCatalog.CopyNoticeUntil or 0) then RemoteCatalog.CopyNotice=nil end
    RemoteCatalog.CaptureStatus.Text = RemoteCatalog.CopyNotice or string.format("%s: %d / %d calls. %s.", state, #recorder.Records, recorder.MaxCalls, mining)
    RemoteCatalog.CaptureToggle.Text = recorder.Active and "Pause capture (F8)" or "Resume capture (F8)"
end
function RemoteCatalog.EnableCapture()
    RemoteCatalog.CaptureAttempted = true
    local ok, recorder = pcall(RemoteCatalog.StartCapture)
    RemoteCatalog.Recorder = ok and recorder or nil
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateCaptureUI()
end
function RemoteCatalog.PrepareBaitLearning()
    RemoteCatalog.AcceptFreshBaitBinding()
    if not RemoteCatalog.BaitNeedsRefresh and RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("BaitBinding") then return end
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if recorder and not recorder.Stopped and (recorder.Active or recorder.LearnBaitOnly) then return end
    local ok,result=pcall(RemoteCatalog.StartCapture)
    if ok and result then
        RemoteCatalog.Recorder=result
        result.LearnBaitOnly=true
        result.Active=false
        RemoteCatalog.UpdateCaptureUI()
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.StopBaitLearning()
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if recorder and recorder.LearnBaitOnly then
        recorder.LearnBaitOnly=false
        if not recorder.LearnCraftOnly and not recorder.LearnWoodOnly and not recorder.LearnChestOnly and not recorder.LearnPlowOnly and not recorder.LearnMobOnly then recorder:Stop() end
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.PrepareWoodLearning()
    if RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("WoodHitBinding") or RemoteCatalog.GameEndpoint("BLOCK_HIT_REQUEST") then return end
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if recorder and not recorder.Stopped and recorder.Active then return end
    local ok,result=pcall(RemoteCatalog.StartCapture)
    if ok and result then
        RemoteCatalog.Recorder=result
        result.LearnWoodOnly=true
        result.Active=false
        RemoteCatalog.UpdateCaptureUI()
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.StopWoodLearning()
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if recorder and recorder.LearnWoodOnly then recorder.LearnWoodOnly=false;if not recorder.LearnCraftOnly and not recorder.LearnBaitOnly and not recorder.LearnChestOnly and not recorder.LearnPlowOnly and not recorder.LearnMobOnly then recorder:Stop() end end
end
track(RemoteCatalog.CaptureToggle.Activated:Connect(function()
    RemoteCatalog.CopyNotice = nil
    if RemoteCatalog.Recorder then RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnCraftOnly=false;RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnWoodOnly=false;RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnBaitOnly=false;RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnChestOnly=false;RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnPlowOnly=false end
    local recorder = RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if not recorder then
        RemoteCatalog.EnableCapture()
    elseif recorder.Active then
        recorder.Active = false
    else
        recorder:Resume()
    end
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateCaptureUI()
end))

            RemoteCatalog.CopyNotice = message
        else
            RemoteCatalog.CopyNotice = "Kopiering fejlede; brug F9 til eksport."
        end
        RemoteCatalog.UpdateCaptureUI()
    end
end))
track(RemoteCatalog.CaptureStop.Activated:Connect(function()
    if RemoteCatalog.Recorder then RemoteCatalog.Recorder:Stop() end
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateCaptureUI()
end))

function RemoteCatalog.RefreshUI()
    local found = RemoteCatalog.Refresh()
    RemoteCatalog.Summary.Text = string.format("Remotes found: %d / %d", found, #RemoteCatalog.Entries)
    for _, entry in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.Entries) do
        entry.Label.Text = (entry.Instance and "OK  " or "Missing  ") .. string.match(entry.Path, "([^.]+)$") .. "  [" .. entry.Class .. "]"
        entry.Label.TextColor3 = entry.Instance and COLORS.good or COLORS.muted
    end
end
