-- Reflect restored preference values in the controls (startup and hub profile loads).
function RemoteCatalog.ReflectPreferences()
    replantToggle.Text = CONFIG.AutoReplant and "AUTO-REPLANT: ON" or "AUTO-REPLANT: OFF"
    replantToggle.BackgroundColor3 = CONFIG.AutoReplant and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    woodRangeBtn.Text = "Range: " .. CONFIG.WoodRange .. " studs  ±"
    mineRangeBtn.Text = "Mining range: " .. CONFIG.MineRange .. " studs  (+ / −)"
    delayButton.Text = "Mine delay: " .. string.format("%.2fs", CONFIG.MineDelay) .. "  ↻"
    scanButton.Text = "Scan interval: " .. string.format("%.2fs", CONFIG.MineScanInterval) .. "  ↻"
    if RemoteCatalog.CropRangeButton then RemoteCatalog.CropRangeButton.Text = RemoteCatalog.CropRangeText() end
    if RemoteCatalog.WoodTreesButton then RemoteCatalog.WoodTreesButton.Text = "Trees: " .. (CONFIG.WoodTrees or "All") .. "  ↻" end
    if RemoteCatalog.MineRocksButton then RemoteCatalog.MineRocksButton.Text = "Rocks: " .. (CONFIG.MineRocks or "All") .. "  ↻" end
    if RemoteCatalog.HarvestWalkButton then
        RemoteCatalog.HarvestWalkButton.Text = CONFIG.HarvestWalk and "AUTO MOVE: ON" or "AUTO MOVE: OFF"
        RemoteCatalog.HarvestWalkButton.BackgroundColor3 = CONFIG.HarvestWalk and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    end
    woodToolSelect.Text = "Axe: " .. woodToolPreference .. "  ▼"
    mineToolSelect.Text = "Tool: " .. mineToolPreference .. "  ▼"
    for _,selector in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.TravelSelectors or {}) do
        local key=RemoteCatalog.TravelKeys[selector]
        selector.Text=(key=="WoodTravelMode" and "Mode: " or "Travel: ")..RemoteCatalog.TravelLabel(CONFIG[key]).."  ▾"
    end
    pcall(refreshCropSelectionUI)
    fruitToggle.Text=CONFIG.FruitEnabled and "FRUIT PICKING: ON" or "FRUIT PICKING: OFF"
    fruitToggle.BackgroundColor3=CONFIG.FruitEnabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshSettingsText()
end
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshSettingsText()
    settingsText.Text = string.format("Fish toggle: %s\nHarvest toggle: %s\nMine range: %d studs\nPlant type: %s\nHarvest crop: %s\nPlant radius: %d studs", CONFIG.ToggleKey.Name, CONFIG.HarvestKey.Name, CONFIG.MineRange, CONFIG.PlantType, CONFIG.HarvestCrop, CONFIG.PlantRadius)
end
RemoteCatalog.ReflectPreferences()
saveButton.Text = preferencesLoaded and "Preferences loaded" or RemoteCatalog.PreferencesError and "Settings file ignored (damaged) · Save preferences" or "Save preferences"
showTab("Fishing")

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Stats
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local stats

local function newStats()
	return {
		casts = 0,
		bites = 0,
		catches = 0,
		missed = 0,
		streak = 0,
		bestStreak = 0,
		harvests = 0,
        resourceCounts = {wood=0,mine=0,crop=0},
        resourceAttempts = {wood=0,mine=0,crop=0},
        resourceLast = {},
		lastMineName = "–",
		activeTime = 0,
		onSince = nil,
		perFish = {},   -- [name] = count
		recent = {},    -- { {name=, at=}, ... } newest first
	}
end

stats = newStats()

local function getActiveTime()
	local t = stats.activeTime
	if stats.onSince then
		t += os.clock() - stats.onSince
	end
	return t
end
RemoteCatalog.ActiveTime=getActiveTime

local function formatTime(seconds)
	seconds = math.floor(seconds)
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d",
		math.floor(seconds / 3600),
		math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60),
		seconds % 60)
end

local function formatAgo(seconds)
	seconds = math.floor(seconds)
	if seconds < 60 then
		return seconds .. "s ago"
	elseif seconds < 3600 then
		return math.floor(seconds / 60) .. "m ago"
	end
	return math.floor(seconds / 3600) .. "h ago"
end

local function getTopFish()
	local bestName, bestCount = nil, 0
	for name, count in pairs(stats.perFish) do
		if count > bestCount then
			bestName, bestCount = name, count
		end
	end
	if bestName then
		return bestName .. " ×" .. bestCount
	end
	return "–"
end

-- PROPELLER TRACKER BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.PropellerTotal=0
RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistory={}
RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoal={Progress=0,Reached=false}
RemoteCatalog.PropellerStats={Seconds=0,Events=0,GapTotal=0}
function RemoteCatalog.UpdatePropellerStatsClock(active)
    local data=RemoteCatalog.PropellerStats
    local now=RemoteCatalog.PropellerNow()
    if data.Since then data.Seconds+=math.max(0,now-data.Since) end
    data.Since=active and now or nil
    return data.Seconds
end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerStatistics()
    local seconds=RemoteCatalog.UpdatePropellerStatsClock(enabled and gui.Parent~=nil)
    local data=RemoteCatalog.PropellerStats
    return {Seconds=seconds,Events=data.Events,PerHour=seconds>0 and RemoteCatalog.PropellerTotal*3600/seconds or nil,
        AverageGap=data.Events>1 and data.GapTotal/(data.Events-1) or nil}
end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerStatisticsText()
    local data=RemoteCatalog.PropellerStatistics()
    return "Propellers/hour: "..(data.PerHour and string.format("%.1f",data.PerHour) or "waiting for fishing time")..
        " · Active Fishing: "..math.floor(data.Seconds).."s\nAverage between observed gains: "..(data.AverageGap and string.format("%.1fs",data.AverageGap) or "needs 2 finds")..
        " · "..data.Events.." gains. OFF time excluded; gains can be parts of one catch."
end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerTimestamp()
    local ok,value=pcall(function() return os.date("!%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC",os.time()) end)
    return ok and type(value)=="string" and value or "timestamp unavailable"
end
function RemoteCatalog.StartPropellerRun()
    RemoteCatalog.UpdatePropellerStatsClock(enabled and gui.Parent~=nil)
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoal.Progress=0;RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoal.Reached=false
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow=nil;RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow=nil
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetPropellerGoal(limit)
    if not gui.Parent then return false end
    if enabled then
        if setStatus then setStatus("Stop Fishing before changing the propeller goal.",COLORS.warn) end
        return false
    end
    if not table.find({0,1,5,10,25,50,100},limit) then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoal.Limit=limit>0 and limit or nil
    RemoteCatalog.StartPropellerRun()
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshPropellers then RemoteCatalog.RefreshPropellers() end
    if setStatus then setStatus("Propeller goal updated. Start Fishing when ready; new finds count from zero.",COLORS.muted) end
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.CheckPropellerGoal()
    local goal=RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoal
    if not enabled or not goal.Limit or goal.Reached or goal.Progress<goal.Limit then return end
    goal.Reached=true
    if RemoteCatalog.StopGoalMode then RemoteCatalog.StopGoalMode("fishing")
    elseif setEnabled then setEnabled(false) end
    if setStatus then setStatus("Propeller goal reached: "..goal.Progress.." / "..goal.Limit.." new. Fishing stopped.",COLORS.good) end
end
function RemoteCatalog.RecordPropellerGain(amount,now)
    local seconds=RemoteCatalog.UpdatePropellerStatsClock(enabled and gui.Parent~=nil)
    local data=RemoteCatalog.PropellerStats
    if data.LastFindActive then data.GapTotal+=math.max(0,seconds-data.LastFindActive) end
    data.LastFindActive=seconds;data.Events+=1
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerTotal+=amount
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerLastAt=now
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoal.Progress+=amount
    local ok,stamp=pcall(RemoteCatalog.PropellerTimestamp)
    table.insert(RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistory,1,{Amount=amount,Timestamp=ok and type(stamp)=="string" and stamp or "timestamp unavailable",ObservedAt=now,Total=RemoteCatalog.PropellerTotal})
    while #RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistory>50 do table.remove(RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistory) end
end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalText()
    local goal=RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoal
    return "This run: "..goal.Progress..(goal.Limit and (" / "..goal.Limit.." new"..(goal.Reached and " · REACHED" or "")) or " new · Unlimited")..". Each Fishing start resets run progress."
end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistoryText()
    local lines={}
    for _,entry in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistory) do
        table.insert(lines,entry.Timestamp.." · +"..entry.Amount.." · session "..entry.Total)
    end
    if #lines==0 then return "No loot entries retained. New confirmed gains appear here (latest 50; this hub session only)." end
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistoryReport()
    RemoteCatalog.PollPropellers()
    return table.concat({"Reborn mob-stop-178 · Propeller loot history (UTC)",
        "Session total: "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerTotal,"Last propeller: "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerLastText(),
        RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalText(),RemoteCatalog.PropellerStatisticsText(),"Retained entries: "..#RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistory.." / 50 (newest first)",
        RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistoryText(),"Observed inventory gains in confirmed fishing windows; one catch may replicate in several gains."},"\n")
end
function RemoteCatalog.ClearPropellerHistory()
    if not gui.Parent then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistory={}
    if RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistoryLabel then RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistoryLabel.Text=RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistoryText() end
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerNow() return os.clock() end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerCount()
    local total=0
    local ok,tools=pcall(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools)
    if not ok or type(tools)~="table" then return nil end
    for _,tool in ipairs(tools) do
        local name=string.lower(tool.Name):gsub("[%s_%-]","")
        if name=="propeller" or name=="propellor" or name=="propellers" or name=="propellors" then
            if not tool.Parent then return nil end
            local quantity=RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(tool)
            if type(quantity)~="number" or quantity<0 or quantity%1~=0 or quantity>9007199254740991-total then return nil end
            total+=quantity
        end
    end
    return total
end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerConflict()
    return RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy or RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker~=nil or (RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker~=nil and not RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused)
end
function RemoteCatalog.BeginPropellerCatch(timeout)
    RemoteCatalog.PollPropellers()
    if not enabled or not gui.Parent then return false end
    local previous=RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow
    if previous and previous.Confirmed then RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow=previous end
    local before=RemoteCatalog.PropellerCount()
    local pending=RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow
    if before~=nil and pending and not pending.Blocked and pending.Before~=nil then before=math.max(before,pending.Before) end
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow={Before=before,Character=player.Character,Until=RemoteCatalog.PropellerNow()+(timeout or 3)+5,Blocked=RemoteCatalog.PropellerConflict()==true}
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ConfirmPropellerCatch()
    local window=RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow
    if window and RemoteCatalog.PropellerNow()<=window.Until then window.Confirmed=true;window.Until=RemoteCatalog.PropellerNow()+5
    else RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow=nil end
    RemoteCatalog.PollPropellers()
end
function RemoteCatalog.PollPropellers()
    RemoteCatalog.UpdatePropellerStatsClock(enabled and gui.Parent~=nil)
    local now=RemoteCatalog.PropellerNow()
    if not enabled or not gui.Parent then RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow=nil;RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow=nil;return end
    local keys={"PropellerPendingWindow","PropellerWindow"}
    for _,key in ipairs(keys) do
        local window=RemoteCatalog[key]
        if window and (player.Character~=window.Character or now>window.Until) then RemoteCatalog[key]=nil
        elseif window and RemoteCatalog.PropellerConflict() then window.Blocked=true end
    end
    if not RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow and not RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow then return end
    local current=RemoteCatalog.PropellerCount()
    if current==nil then return end
    for _,key in ipairs(keys) do
        local window=RemoteCatalog[key]
        if window and window.Confirmed and not window.Blocked and window.Before~=nil and current>window.Before then
            local amount=current-window.Before
            -- Shared high-water marks prevent overlapping windows crediting the
            -- same replicated stock twice; unreadable baselines stay excluded.
            for _,otherKey in ipairs(keys) do
                local other=RemoteCatalog[otherKey]
                if other and other.Before~=nil then other.Before=math.max(other.Before,current) end
            end
            RemoteCatalog.RecordPropellerGain(amount,now)
            RemoteCatalog.CheckPropellerGoal()
            if not enabled then return end
        end
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerLastText()
    if not RemoteCatalog.PropellerLastAt then return "none yet" end
    local seconds=math.max(0,math.floor(RemoteCatalog.PropellerNow()-RemoteCatalog.PropellerLastAt))
    return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d ago",math.floor(seconds/3600),math.floor(seconds%3600/60),seconds%60)
end
function RemoteCatalog.ResetPropellers()
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerTotal=0;RemoteCatalog.PropellerLastAt=nil;RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow=nil
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerStats={Seconds=0,Events=0,GapTotal=0}
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistory={};RemoteCatalog.StartPropellerRun()
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshPropellers then RemoteCatalog.RefreshPropellers() end
end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerTrackingStatus(count)
    if not enabled then return "Fishing OFF; session count kept" end
    if RemoteCatalog.PropellerConflict() then return "Paused: chest collection or crafting active" end
    local window=RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow
    local pending=RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow
    if pending and pending.Confirmed and not pending.Blocked and pending.Before~=nil then return "Confirmed catch; watching delayed inventory gain" end
    if window and window.Blocked then return "Catch excluded: inventory automation overlapped; waiting for next reel" end
    if window and window.Before==nil then return "Catch excluded: starting quantity unreadable; waiting for next reel" end
    if count==nil then return "Waiting for readable inventory quantity" end
    if not window then return "Waiting for next reel" end
    if not window.Confirmed then return "Waiting for catch confirmation" end
    return "Catch confirmed; watching for delayed inventory gain"
end
function RemoteCatalog.PropellerReport()
    RemoteCatalog.PollPropellers()
    local count=RemoteCatalog.PropellerCount()
    local window=RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow
    return table.concat({"Reborn mob-stop-178 · Propeller tracker",
        "Propellers this session: "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerTotal,
        "Last propeller: "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerLastText(),
        "Inventory quantity: "..tostring(count or "unreadable"),
        "Fishing: "..tostring(enabled==true),
        "Propeller goal: "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalText(),
        RemoteCatalog.PropellerStatisticsText(),
        "History entries: "..#RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistory.." / 50",
        "Previous confirmed window: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow~=nil),
        "Tracker status: "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerTrackingStatus(count),
        "Catch window: "..(not window and "none" or window.Confirmed and "confirmed" or "unconfirmed"),
        "Window baseline: "..tostring(window and window.Before or "unavailable"),
        "Window blocked: "..tostring(window~=nil and window.Blocked==true),
        "Window remaining: "..tostring(window and math.max(0,math.ceil(window.Until-RemoteCatalog.PropellerNow())) or 0).."s",
        "Chest worker: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker~=nil or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy==true),
        "Craft worker: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker~=nil),
        "Attribution: confirmed fishing window + observed inventory gain; external trades/purchases can overlap."},"\n")
end
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshPropellers()
    RemoteCatalog.PollPropellers()
    if RemoteCatalog.PropellerLabel then RemoteCatalog.PropellerLabel.Text="Propellers this session: "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerTotal.."\nLast propeller: "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerLastText() end
    if overlayValues.propellers then overlayValues.propellers.Text=tostring(RemoteCatalog.PropellerTotal);overlayValues.propellerLast.Text=RemoteCatalog.PropellerLastText() end
    if RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalLabel then RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalLabel.Text=RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalText().." Reset session clears counts, run progress and history. Other goals/timer still apply." end
    if RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalButton then
        RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalButton.Active=not enabled;RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalButton.Selectable=not enabled;RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalButton.AutoButtonColor=not enabled
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalMenu then RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalMenu:Refresh() end
    if RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistoryLabel then RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistoryLabel.Text=RemoteCatalog.PropellerHistoryText() end
    if RemoteCatalog.PropellerStatsLabel then RemoteCatalog.PropellerStatsLabel.Text=RemoteCatalog.PropellerStatisticsText() end
    if RemoteCatalog.PropellerInfo then
        local count=RemoteCatalog.PropellerCount()
        RemoteCatalog.PropellerInfo.Text="Inventory: "..tostring(count or "unreadable").." · "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerTrackingStatus(count)
    end
end
-- PROPELLER TRACKER END
function RemoteCatalog.SessionReport()
    local text={"Reborn mob-stop-178", "Active time: "..formatTime(getActiveTime()),
        "Fishing: "..stats.catches.." catches, "..stats.casts.." casts, "..stats.bites.." bites, "..stats.missed.." missed",
        "Fishing input: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.FishingInputAction or "not tried").." · "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.FishingInputTransport or "none").." · "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.FishingInputResult or "none"),
        "Fishing status: "..(RemoteCatalog.FishingStatusText and RemoteCatalog.FishingStatusText() or "not started"),
        "Resources: harvest "..stats.resourceCounts.crop..", wood "..stats.resourceCounts.wood..", mining "..stats.resourceCounts.mine,
        "Chest run: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal or 0).." confirmed items",
        RemoteCatalog.LifetimeText(),
        "Modes: Fishing "..(enabled and "ON" or "OFF")..", Bait "..(baitEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")..", Harvest "..(harvestEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")..", Wood "..(woodEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")..", Mining "..(mineEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")}
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowConfirmed~=nil then table.insert(text,"Plow run: "..(RemoteCatalog.PlowEnabled and "ON" or RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker and "stopping" or "OFF").." · "..RemoteCatalog.PlowConfirmed.." observed soil · "..RemoteCatalog.PlowFailed.." failed") end
    if RemoteCatalog.Mobs then
        local m=RemoteCatalog.Mobs
        table.insert(text,"Mobs: "..(m.Enabled and "ON" or "OFF").." · "..m.Message.." · "..m.Swings.." swings · "..m.Drops.." HP drops · "..m.Defeats.." defeats observed")
    end
    table.insert(text,"Game requests: "..RemoteCatalog.GameRequestHealth())
    do
        local names={}
        pcall(function() names=RemoteCatalog.RequestDefinitionNames() end)
        local remembered={}
        for kind,name in pairs(CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions or {}) do table.insert(remembered,kind.."="..name) end
        table.sort(remembered)
        table.insert(text,"Remembered across servers: mob weapon "..tostring(CONFIG.MobWeapon or "none").." · "..(#remembered>0 and table.concat(remembered,", ") or "no request definitions yet"))
        table.insert(text,"Request definitions ("..#names.."): "..(#names>0 and table.concat(names,", ") or "not readable on this host"))
    end
    table.insert(text,"Propellers: "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerTotal.." this session; last "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerLastText())
    table.insert(text,"Propeller goal: "..RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalText())
    local build=buildController.Progress
    if build then table.insert(text,"Build run: "..build.State.." · "..build.Placed.." confirmed · "..build.Skipped.." skipped · "..build.Failed.." failed · "..build.Total.." planned") end
    for _,mode in ipairs({"fishing","crop","wood","mine"}) do
        local goal=RemoteCatalog.ModeGoals[mode]
        table.insert(text,RemoteCatalog.GoalNames[mode].." goal: "..goal.Progress.."/"..tostring(goal.Limit or "unlimited")..(goal.Reached and " reached" or ""))
    end
    local fish={}
    for name in pairs(stats.perFish) do table.insert(fish,name) end
    table.sort(fish)
    for index,name in ipairs(fish) do
        if index>10 then table.insert(text,"More fish types: "..(#fish-10));break end
        table.insert(text,"Fish "..name..": "..stats.perFish[name])
    end
    return table.concat(text,"\n")
end
-- SELF TEST BEGIN
-- Read-only: checks host functions, character, island, chests, game requests and memory. Sends nothing.
function RemoteCatalog.SelfTest()
    local lines={"Reborn self-test"}
    local function line(name,value) table.insert(lines,name..": "..tostring(value)) end
    local executor="unknown"
    pcall(function() if type(identifyexecutor)=="function" then executor=table.concat({identifyexecutor()}," ") end end)
    line("Executor",executor)
    local functions={}
    for _,entry in ipairs({{"writefile",writefile},{"readfile",readfile},{"isfile",isfile},{"setclipboard",setclipboard or toclipboard},
        {"hookmetamethod",hookmetamethod},{"getnamecallmethod",getnamecallmethod},{"getgenv",getgenv},{"mousemoveabs",mousemoveabs},
        {"mouse1press",mouse1press},{"firesignal",firesignal},{"getconnections",getconnections}}) do
        table.insert(functions,entry[1].."="..(type(entry[2])=="function" and "yes" or "no"))
    end
    line("Host functions",table.concat(functions,", "))
    line("VirtualInputManager",pcall(function() return VirtualInputManager.Name end) and "available" or "unavailable")
    local char=player.Character
    local humanoid=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    line("Character",humanoid and ("ok · "..math.floor(humanoid.Health).."/"..math.floor(humanoid.MaxHealth).." HP") or "missing")
    -- getPlayerIsland is declared later in the file; the catalog adapter resolves the same owned Blocks.
    local blocks=RemoteCatalog.BuildIslandBlocks and RemoteCatalog.BuildIslandBlocks()
    local island=blocks and blocks.Parent
    local chestCount,blockCount=0,0
    if blocks then
        for _,block in ipairs(blocks:GetChildren()) do
            blockCount+=1
            if string.find(string.lower(block.Name),"chest",1,true) then chestCount+=1 end
        end
    end
    line("Own island",island and (island.Name.." · "..blockCount.." blocks · "..chestCount.." chests") or "not found")
    line("Game requests",RemoteCatalog.GameRequestHealth())
    local names={}
    pcall(function() names=RemoteCatalog.RequestDefinitionNames() end)
    line("Request definitions",#names)
    line("Remembered","mob weapon "..tostring(CONFIG.MobWeapon or "none").." · "..#(CONFIG.RememberedChests or {}).." chest slots")
    local remembered=RemoteCatalog.RememberedChestRecorder and RemoteCatalog.RememberedChestRecorder()
    line("Remembered chests found here",remembered and #remembered:GetChestBindings() or 0)
    line("Chest request (CLIENT_CHEST_TRANSACTION)",RemoteCatalog.ChestTransactionRemote and RemoteCatalog.ChestTransactionRemote() and "found" or "missing")
    local contents=RemoteCatalog.ContentsChestRecorder and RemoteCatalog.ContentsChestRecorder()
    local stacks=contents and contents:GetChestBindings() or {}
    local chestsWithStacks={}
    for _,binding in ipairs(stacks) do chestsWithStacks[binding.Chest]=true end
    local chestTotal=0;for _ in pairs(chestsWithStacks) do chestTotal+=1 end
    line("Chest stacks without learning",#stacks.." stacks in "..chestTotal.." chests")
    local depositable=RemoteCatalog.DepositItems and RemoteCatalog.DepositItems() or {}
    line("Deposit",tostring(CONFIG.DepositCategory).." · auto "..(RemoteCatalog.DepositEnabled and "ON" or "OFF").." · "..#depositable.." stacks to deposit now")
    line("Preferences file",type(isfile)=="function" and (pcall(isfile,SETTINGS_FILE) and isfile(SETTINGS_FILE) and "saved" or "not saved yet") or "file API unavailable")
    local fps="?"
    pcall(function() fps=math.floor(workspace:GetRealPhysicsFPS()) end)
    local ping="?"
    pcall(function() ping=game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValueString() end)
    line("Physics FPS / ping",tostring(fps).." / "..tostring(ping))
    line("Server",tostring(game.PlaceId).." · "..string.sub(tostring(game.JobId),1,8))
    table.insert(lines,"Recent status:")
    for _,entry in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.StatusHistory) do table.insert(lines,"  "..entry.Time.."  "..entry.Text) end
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end
function RemoteCatalog.CopySelfTest()
    local ok,report=pcall(RemoteCatalog.SelfTest)
    if not ok then report="Reborn self-test failed: "..tostring(report) end
    local copy=setclipboard or toclipboard
    if type(copy)=="function" and pcall(copy,report) then setStatus("Self-test copied",COLORS.good)
    else print(report);setStatus("Self-test printed to console",COLORS.warn) end
    return report
end
-- SELF TEST END
-- CHEST CONTENTS BEGIN
-- Read-only: lists what the owned island's chests hold, by item, using their content folders. Sends nothing.
RemoteCatalog.ChestContentFolders={"Contents","Items","Storage","Content","SellingContents"}
function RemoteCatalog.ChestContents()
    local blocks=RemoteCatalog.BuildIslandBlocks and RemoteCatalog.BuildIslandBlocks()
    local items,chests,unreadable={},{},0
    for _,chest in ipairs(blocks and blocks:GetChildren() or {}) do
        if string.find(string.lower(chest.Name),"chest",1,true) then
            table.insert(chests,chest)
            local folder
            for _,name in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestContentFolders) do folder=chest:FindFirstChild(name);if folder then break end end
            if not folder then unreadable+=1 else
                for _,stack in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                    local amount=1
                    local value=stack:FindFirstChild("Amount")
                    if value and type(value.Value)=="number" then amount=value.Value
                    else
                        local ok,attribute=pcall(function() return stack:GetAttribute("Amount") end)
                        if ok and type(attribute)=="number" then amount=attribute end
                    end
                    local entry=items[stack.Name] or {Total=0,Chests={}}
                    entry.Total+=amount;entry.Chests[chest]=(entry.Chests[chest] or 0)+amount
                    items[stack.Name]=entry
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return items,chests,unreadable
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestContentsReport(filter)
    local items,chests,unreadable=RemoteCatalog.ChestContents()
    local char=player.Character
    local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local numbers={}
    for index,chest in ipairs(chests) do numbers[chest]=index end
    local names={}
    filter=type(filter)=="string" and string.lower(filter) or ""
    for name in pairs(items) do if filter=="" or string.find(string.lower(name),filter,1,true) then table.insert(names,name) end end
    table.sort(names,function(a,b) return items[a].Total>items[b].Total or items[a].Total==items[b].Total and a<b end)
    local lines={"Reborn chest contents · "..#chests.." chests on your island"..(unreadable>0 and (" · "..unreadable.." without a readable content folder") or "")}
    for _,name in ipairs(names) do
        local places={}
        for chest,amount in pairs(items[name].Chests) do
            -- getPartPosition is declared later in the file; the catalog adapter is resolved at call time.
            local position=RemoteCatalog.ResourcePosition and RemoteCatalog.ResourcePosition(chest)
            local distance=root and position and math.floor((position-root.Position).Magnitude) or nil
            table.insert(places,{Number=numbers[chest] or 0,Text="chest #"..(numbers[chest] or "?").." ("..chest.Name..(distance and ", "..distance.." studs" or "")..") ×"..amount})
        end
        table.sort(places,function(a,b) return a.Number<b.Number end)
        local texts={}
        for _,place in ipairs(places) do table.insert(texts,place.Text) end
        table.insert(lines,name.." ×"..items[name].Total..": "..table.concat(texts,"; "))
    end
    if #names==0 then table.insert(lines,#chests==0 and "No chests found on your island." or "No readable items found.") end
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end
function RemoteCatalog.CopyChestContents(filter)
    local ok,report=pcall(RemoteCatalog.ChestContentsReport,filter)
    if not ok then report="Chest contents unavailable: "..tostring(report) end
    local copy=setclipboard or toclipboard
    if type(copy)=="function" and pcall(copy,report) then setStatus("Chest contents copied",COLORS.good)
    else print(report);setStatus("Chest contents printed to console",COLORS.warn) end
    return report
end
-- CHEST CONTENTS END
function RemoteCatalog.CopySessionReport()
    local report=RemoteCatalog.SessionReport()
    local copy=setclipboard or toclipboard
    if type(copy)=="function" and pcall(copy,report) then setStatus("Session report copied",COLORS.good)
    else print(report);setStatus("Session report printed to console",COLORS.warn) end
    return report
end
local function updateBoard()
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshPropellers then RemoteCatalog.RefreshPropellers() end
    -- The craft refresh reads other scripts' recorders; one bad entry must not end the dashboard loop.
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftMaterials and (activeTab=="Crafting" or RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker or RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled) then pcall(RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftMaterials) end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckResult and not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckCurrent(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckResult) then
        RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckResult=nil;RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue()
        if not RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker and not RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled and RemoteCatalog.CraftInfo and tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftInfo.Text):match("^Queue check") then
            RemoteCatalog.CraftInfo.Text="Queue check expired or context changed. Refresh Check queue before running."
        end
    end
    if buildController.RangeMarkers then buildController:RefreshReach()
    elseif buildController.SetupMarkers then buildController:RefreshPreviewColors() end
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateDashboard()
    if RemoteCatalog.UpdateChestSelectionUI then RemoteCatalog.UpdateChestSelectionUI() end
    if RemoteCatalog.UpdateTeleportLabels then RemoteCatalog.UpdateTeleportLabels() end
    RemoteCatalog.BaitNativeLabel.Text=RemoteCatalog.BaitNativeStatus or "Food API: not checked yet"
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateCaptureUI()
    if RemoteCatalog.UpdatePlowUI then RemoteCatalog.UpdatePlowUI() end
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshFishingStatus then RemoteCatalog.RefreshFishingStatus() end
	local t = getActiveTime()

	rows.harvests.Text = tostring(stats.harvests)
	rows.mineRate.Text = t >= 5
		and string.format("%.0f", stats.harvests / (t / 60))
		or "–"
	rows.lastMine.Text = stats.lastMineName or "–"
	rows.catches.Text = tostring(stats.catches)
	rows.missed.Text = tostring(stats.missed)
	rows.casts.Text = tostring(stats.casts)
	rows.bites.Text = tostring(stats.bites)
	rows.rate.Text = stats.bites > 0
		and string.format("%d%%", math.floor(stats.catches / stats.bites * 100 + 0.5))
		or "–"
    local rateText = stats.bites > 0 and string.format("%d%%", math.floor(stats.catches / stats.bites * 100 + 0.5)) or "–"
    local hourly = t >= 30 and string.format("%.0f", stats.catches / (t / 3600)) or "–"
    local baitState = "OFF"
    if baitEnabled then
        local countdown = baitToggle.Text:match("%[(.-)%]") or "ON"
        baitState = string.find(baitToggle.Text, "RETRY", 1, true) and ("Retry in " .. countdown) or countdown
    end
    overlayValues.catches.Text = tostring(stats.catches)
    overlayValues.hourly.Text = hourly
    overlayValues.attempts.Text = stats.casts .. " / " .. stats.bites
    overlayValues.success.Text = rateText .. " / " .. stats.missed
    overlayValues.session.Text = formatTime(t) .. " / " .. string.upper(activeFishingMode)
    overlayValues.harvests.Text = tostring(stats.harvests)
    overlayValues.bait.Text = baitState
    overlayValues.bait.TextColor3 = not baitEnabled and COLORS.muted
        or (string.find(baitToggle.Text, "RETRY", 1, true) and COLORS.warn or COLORS.good)
    local selected=hub.CurrentTab and hub.CurrentTab.Name
    local category=selected=="Wood Farm" and "wood" or selected=="Mining" and "mine" or selected=="Harvest" and "crop"
    if not category and selected~="Fishing" then category=woodEnabled and "wood" or mineEnabled and "mine" or harvestEnabled and "crop" end
    if category then
        local title=category=="wood" and "WOOD" or category=="mine" and "MINING" or "CROP"
        local count=stats.resourceCounts[category]
        local on=category=="wood" and woodEnabled or category=="mine" and mineEnabled or category=="crop" and harvestEnabled
        statsOverlayTitle.Text=title.." STATS"
        overlayTitles.catches.Text=category=="wood" and "WOOD HARVESTS" or category=="mine" and "BLOCKS MINED" or "CROPS PICKED"
        overlayTitles.hourly.Text="PER HOUR"
        overlayValues.catches.Text=tostring(count)
        overlayValues.hourly.Text=t>=30 and string.format("%.0f",count/(t/3600)) or "–"
        overlayLabels.attempts.Text="Actions / collected"
        overlayValues.attempts.Text=stats.resourceAttempts[category].." / "..count
        overlayLabels.success.Text="Range / state"
        local range=FarmLogic.Range(category,CONFIG)
        overlayValues.success.Text=(range==math.huge and "whole island" or range.." studs").." / "..(on and "ON" or "OFF")
        overlayValues.session.Text=formatTime(t).." / "..title
        overlayLabels.harvests.Text="Last collected"
        overlayValues.harvests.Text=stats.resourceLast[category] or "–"
        overlayLabels.bait.Text=category=="crop" and "Crop" or "Tool"
        overlayValues.bait.Text=category=="wood" and woodToolPreference or category=="mine" and mineToolPreference or (#FarmLogic.SelectedCrops(CONFIG.HarvestCrops,CONFIG.HarvestCrop)>1 and tostring(#FarmLogic.SelectedCrops(CONFIG.HarvestCrops,CONFIG.HarvestCrop)).." selected" or CONFIG.HarvestCrop)
        overlayValues.bait.TextColor3=COLORS.text
    else
        statsOverlayTitle.Text="FISHING STATS"
        overlayTitles.catches.Text="FISH CAUGHT";overlayTitles.hourly.Text="FISH / HOUR"
        overlayLabels.attempts.Text="Casts / bites";overlayLabels.success.Text="Catch rate / misses"
        overlayLabels.harvests.Text="Harvests";overlayLabels.bait.Text="Bait"
    end
	rows.streak.Text = stats.streak .. " / " .. stats.bestStreak
	rows.perHour.Text = t >= 30
		and string.format("%.0f", stats.catches / (t / 3600))
		or "–"
	rows.time.Text = formatTime(t)

	local now = os.clock()
	for i, slot in ipairs(recentLabels) do
		local entry = stats.recent[i]
		if entry then
			slot.name.Text = "🐟 " .. entry.name
			slot.name.TextColor3 = COLORS.text
			slot.time.Text = formatAgo(now - entry.at)
		else
			slot.name.Text = i == 1 and "Nothing yet" or ""
			slot.name.TextColor3 = COLORS.muted
			slot.time.Text = ""
		end
	end
end

local function flash(lbl, color)
	lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	lbl.TextSize = 15
	TweenService:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		TextColor3 = color,
		TextSize = 12,
	}):Play()
end

local function registerCatch(fishName)
	fishName = fishName or "Fish"

	stats.catches += 1
	stats.streak += 1
	stats.perFish[fishName] = (stats.perFish[fishName] or 0) + 1

	table.insert(stats.recent, 1, { name = fishName, at = os.clock() })
	if #stats.recent > CONFIG.RecentCount then
		table.remove(stats.recent)
	end

	if stats.streak > stats.bestStreak then
		stats.bestStreak = stats.streak
		if stats.bestStreak > 1 then
			flash(rows.streak, COLORS.gold)
		end
	end

	flash(rows.catches, COLORS.good)
    RemoteCatalog.LifetimeAdd("Catches",1)
    RemoteCatalog.ProgressModeGoal("fishing")
	updateBoard()
end

local function registerMiss()
	stats.missed += 1
	stats.streak = 0
	flash(rows.missed, COLORS.bad)
	updateBoard()
end

local function registerHarvest(name, category)
    category=category or FarmLogic.Category(name or "")
    if category and stats.resourceCounts[category]~=nil then
        stats.resourceCounts[category]+=1;stats.resourceLast[category]=name
        RemoteCatalog.LifetimeAdd(category=="crop" and "Harvests" or category=="wood" and "Wood" or "Mine",1)
        RemoteCatalog.ProgressModeGoal(category)
    end
	stats.harvests += 1
	if name then
		stats.lastMineName = name
	end
	if stats.harvests % 10 == 0 then
		flash(rows.harvests, COLORS.harvest)
	end
	updateBoard()
end

local function refreshModeStatus()
    if modeStatus then
        modeStatus.Text = string.format("Fishing: %s  |  Bait: %s  |  Crops: %s  |  Wood: %s  |  Mining: %s",
            enabled and "ON" or "OFF", baitEnabled and "ON" or "OFF",
            harvestEnabled and "ON" or "OFF", woodEnabled and "ON" or "OFF", mineEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")
        modeStatus.TextColor3 = (enabled or harvestEnabled or woodEnabled or mineEnabled or baitEnabled) and COLORS.good or COLORS.muted
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- New-item detection (used to name the fish you caught)
-- Rods moving between Backpack and Character are the same instance,
-- so only genuinely new instances count.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local knownItems = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lastNewItem = nil -- { name = string, at = number }

local function markKnown(container)
	for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		knownItems[child] = true
	end
end

local function onItemAdded(child)
	if not knownItems[child] then
		knownItems[child] = true
		lastNewItem = { name = child.Name, at = os.clock() }
	end
end

local function hookBackpack(backpack)
	markKnown(backpack)
	track(backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(onItemAdded))
end

local currentBackpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
if currentBackpack then
	hookBackpack(currentBackpack)
end

track(player.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if child:IsA("Backpack") then
		hookBackpack(child)
	end
end))

if player.Character then
	markKnown(player.Character)
end
track(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(markKnown))

local cycleId = 0
local harvestCycleId = 0
local lastAction = 0

local function running(myCycle)
	return enabled and cycleId == myCycle and gui.Parent ~= nil
end

local function harvestRunning(myCycle)
	return harvestEnabled and harvestCycleId == myCycle and gui.Parent ~= nil
end

-- FISHING STATUS BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.FishingStatusText=function()
    local state=RemoteCatalog.FishingStatus
    if not state or state.Token~=cycleId then return enabled and "Fishing is starting..." or "Fishing is off." end
    local seconds=math.max(0,math.floor(os.clock()-state.At))
    local elapsed=seconds>=60 and string.format("%dm%02ds",math.floor(seconds/60),seconds%60) or seconds.."s"
    return (enabled and seconds>=1 and ("["..elapsed.."] ") or "")..state.Text
end
RemoteCatalog.RefreshFishingStatus=function()
    if not gui.Parent then return end
    fishInfo.Text=RemoteCatalog.FishingStatusText()
    local state=RemoteCatalog.FishingStatus
    fishInfo.TextColor3=state and state.Token==cycleId and state.Color or COLORS.muted
end
RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus=function(token,message,color,quiet)
    if token~=cycleId or not gui.Parent then return false end
    local text=tostring(message):gsub("[%c]"," "):sub(1,512)
    local previous=RemoteCatalog.FishingStatus
    local same=previous and previous.Token==token and previous.Text==text
    RemoteCatalog.FishingStatus={Token=token,Text=text,Color=color or COLORS.muted,At=same and previous.At or os.clock()}
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshFishingStatus()
    if not quiet then setStatus(text,color) end
    return true
end
RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus(cycleId,"Fishing is off.",COLORS.muted,true)
-- FISHING STATUS END

-- Note: VirtualInputManager is normally blocked in a standard LocalScript.
local function hasRodEquipped()
    local character = player.Character
    local tool = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    return tool ~= nil and (string.find(string.lower(tool.Name), "fishing", 1, true) ~= nil
        or string.find(string.lower(tool.Name), "rod", 1, true) ~= nil)
end
RemoteCatalog.EquipFishingRod=function(myCycle)
    if baitBusy or fishingInputBusy or not running(myCycle) then return false,"Waiting for bait/input to finish" end
    local character=player.Character
    if not character then return false,"Waiting for your character" end
    if hasRodEquipped() then return true end
    for _,owned in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools()) do
        local name=string.lower(owned.Name)
        if string.find(name,"fishing",1,true) or string.find(name,"rod",1,true) then
            if not running(myCycle) or player.Character~=character then return false,"Fishing stopped" end
            local ok,equipped=pcall(RemoteCatalog.EquipTool,owned)
            if not ok or not equipped then return false,"Could not equip your fishing rod" end
            task.wait(.1)
            if not running(myCycle) or player.Character~=character then return false,"Fishing stopped" end
            return hasRodEquipped(),"Fishing rod selected; waiting for equip confirmation"
        end
    end
    return false,"No fishing rod found in your inventory"
end
local lastFishingAim
local function clickOnce(action, myCycle, preferMouse)
    RemoteCatalog.FishingInputAction=action
    RemoteCatalog.FishingInputTransport="none"
    local function fail(reason,sent)
        RemoteCatalog.FishingInputResult=reason
        return false,reason,sent
    end
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if fishingInputBusy then return fail("previous rod input is finishing") end
    if baitBusy then return fail("bait is using the tool") end
    if not camera then return fail("camera not ready") end
    if not hasRodEquipped() then return fail("equip your fishing rod") end
    if not running(myCycle) then return fail("fishing stopped") end
    local character=player.Character
    local tool=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    local usingMouse=false
    local function mouseCaptured() return RemoteCatalog.MouseSteersCamera() end
    local function activeInput()
        if baitBusy or not running(myCycle) or player.Character~=character
            or not character or character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")~=tool then return false end
        if usingMouse and mouseCaptured() then return false end
        local ok,focused=pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() end)
        return not (ok and focused)
    end
    if not activeInput() then return fail("close text input and keep the rod equipped") end
    if action=="reel" and tool.Enabled==false then return fail("fishing rod is not ready to activate") end
    local transport,press,release
    local function useRod()
        if action~="reel" then return false end
        local available,activate,deactivate=pcall(function() return tool.Activate,tool.Deactivate end)
        if not available or type(activate)~="function" or type(deactivate)~="function" then return false end
        transport="rod activation";usingMouse=false
        press=function() return activate(tool) end
        release=function() return deactivate(tool) end
        return true
    end
    -- Reeling has no new cast target. Prefer a paired tool activation so the
    -- cursor and a captured camera do not move on every bite.
    if action=="reel" and not preferMouse then useRod() end
    if not press and mouseCaptured() and not useRod() then
        return fail("release right mouse or unlock the cursor for fishing input; fishing stays ON")
    end
    local x,y=camera.ViewportSize.X*.7,camera.ViewportSize.Y*.6
    local function overPanel(px,py)
        if not hub.Root.Visible then return false end
        local position,size=hub.Root.AbsolutePosition,hub.Root.AbsoluteSize
        return px>=position.X and px<=position.X+size.X and py>=position.Y and py<=position.Y+size.Y
    end
    local function clearInputPoint()
        if overPanel(x,y) then return false end
        local ok,objects=pcall(function() return playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(x,y) end)
        if ok then
            for _,object in ipairs(objects) do
                -- The draggable stats overlay is an Active frame and swallows the click too.
                if object:IsA("GuiButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") or object:IsDescendantOf(statsOverlayGui) then return false end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function attempt(fn)
        local ok,result=pcall(fn)
        return ok and result~=false
    end
    if not press then
        usingMouse=true
        if not activeInput() then return fail("release right mouse or unlock the cursor before fishing mouse input") end
        local root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if action=="reel" and lastFishingAim then x,y=lastFishingAim.X,lastFishingAim.Y
        elseif root then
            local aim=root.Position+root.CFrame.LookVector*12-Vector3.new(0,4,0)
            local point,visible=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(aim)
            if visible then x,y=point.X,point.Y end
        end
        if action~="reel" and overPanel(x,y) then x,y=camera.ViewportSize.X*.8,camera.ViewportSize.Y*.6 end
        if not clearInputPoint() then return fail("on-screen controls cover the fishing aim") end
        transport="virtual mouse"
        press=function() return VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,0,true,game,0) end
        release=function() return VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,0,false,game,0) end
        local moved=attempt(function() return VirtualInputManager:SendMouseMoveEvent(x,y,game) end)
        if not moved then
            if not activeInput() then return fail("camera, tool or text focus changed while aiming") end
            local moveHost,pressHost,releaseHost=mousemoveabs,mouse1press,mouse1release
            if type(moveHost)=="function" and type(pressHost)=="function" and type(releaseHost)=="function" then
                moved=attempt(function() return moveHost(x,y) end)
                if moved then transport="host mouse";press=pressHost;release=releaseHost end
            end
            if not moved then moved=useRod() end
        end
        if not moved then return fail("mouse movement was blocked; no usable alternate input") end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.FishingInputTransport=transport
    task.wait(action=="reel" and .01 or .03)
    if not activeInput() then return fail("camera, tool, character or text focus changed while aiming") end
    if usingMouse and not clearInputPoint() then return fail("on-screen controls moved over the fishing aim") end
    if usingMouse then lastFishingAim={X=x,Y=y} end
    fishingInputBusy=true;RemoteCatalog.FishingMouseInput=true
    local pressed=attempt(press)
    local held=pcall(function()
        if not pressed then return end
        local deadline=os.clock()+(action=="cast" and CONFIG.CastHold or .01)
        while activeInput() and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(.01) end
    end)
    local released=attempt(release)
    fishingInputBusy=false;RemoteCatalog.FishingMouseInput=false
    if not pressed then return fail(transport.." press was blocked") end
    if not held then return fail("input hold was interrupted",true) end
    if not released then return fail(transport.." release was blocked",true) end
    if not activeInput() then return fail("camera, tool, character or text focus changed during input",true) end
    RemoteCatalog.FishingInputResult="Input sent; catch confirmation remains separate"
    return true,nil,true
end

local function getBobber()
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("FishingBobbers")
    if not folder then return nil end
    local exact = folder:FindFirstChild(player.Name .. "Bobber")
    if exact and (exact:IsA("BasePart") or exact:IsA("Model")) then return exact end
    for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        local owner = child:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or child:GetAttribute("PlayerUserId")
        if owner == player.UserId and (child:IsA("BasePart") or child:IsA("Model")) then return child end
    end
    return nil
end

RemoteCatalog.BobberActive = function() return getBobber() ~= nil end

local function waitForTug(bobber, myCycle)
	local tugged = false
    local deadline = os.clock() + CONFIG.BiteTimeout

	local function checkTug()
		local value = bobber:GetAttribute("Tug")
		if value and value ~= false then
			tugged = true
		end
	end

	local conn = bobber:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Tug"):Connect(checkTug)
	checkTug()

	while running(myCycle) and bobber.Parent and not tugged and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(CONFIG.FishingPollInterval)
        if running(myCycle) and bobber.Parent then checkTug() end
	end

	conn:Disconnect()
	return tugged and running(myCycle) and bobber.Parent~=nil,
        running(myCycle) and not tugged and bobber.Parent ~= nil and os.clock() >= deadline
end

-- Polls until predicate() is true, the cycle stops, or timeout. Returns predicate result.
local function waitUntil(myCycle, timeout, predicate)
	local deadline = os.clock() + timeout
	while running(myCycle) and os.clock() < deadline do
		if predicate() then
			return true
		end
		task.wait(CONFIG.FishingPollInterval)
	end
	-- A stopped/restarted cycle must not report a stale success after cancellation.
	return running(myCycle) and predicate()
end

-- FISHING RECOVERY BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.RecoverFishingCast=function(myCycle,bobber)
    if not running(myCycle) or baitBusy or fishingInputBusy then return false end
    if player:GetAttribute("ToolsLocked")==true then return false end
    local loading=player:FindFirstChild("SessionLoading")
    if loading and loading.Value then return false end
    local focusedOK,focused=pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() end)
    if focusedOK and focused then return false end
    local character=player.Character
    local rod=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if not character or not hasRodEquipped() then
        RemoteCatalog.EquipFishingRod(myCycle)
        return false
    end
    local function active()
        return running(myCycle) and player.Character==character and not baitBusy
    end
    local current=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if current~=rod then return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus then RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus(myCycle,"Resetting stuck cast: putting the rod away...",COLORS.warn) else setStatus("Resetting stuck cast: putting the rod away...",COLORS.warn) end
    local service=RemoteCatalog.GameModule("Players."..player.Name..".PlayerScripts.TS.inventory.client-inventory-service","ClientInventoryService")
    if not active() or character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")~=rod then return false end
    local toggled=false
    if service then
        local slot=service.selectedHotbarIndex
        if slot~=nil and service.hotbar and service.hotbar[slot]==rod then
            toggled=pcall(function() service:setSelectedHotbarIndex(slot) end)
            -- A call that does nothing still "succeeds": confirm the rod actually left the character.
            if toggled then
                task.wait(math.max(CONFIG.FishingPollInterval or .1,.1))
                if not active() then return false end
                toggled=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")~=rod
            end
        end
    end
    if not toggled then
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then pcall(function() humanoid:UnequipTools() end) end
    end
    -- Never destroy/ignore a server bobber or claim a catch to unblock bait.
    local cleared=waitUntil(myCycle,2,function()
        return not active() or not bobber.Parent or getBobber()~=bobber
    end)
    if not active() then return false end
    cleared=cleared and (not bobber.Parent or getBobber()~=bobber)
    local selected=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if not selected and (not cleared or not RemoteCatalog.BaitPending) then
        pcall(RemoteCatalog.EquipTool,rod)
    end
    if cleared then
        setStatus("Stuck cast cleared; continuing fishing and queued bait.",COLORS.good)
    else
        setStatus("Cast reset not confirmed; Fishing stays ON and will retry.",COLORS.warn)
    end
    return cleared
end
-- FISHING RECOVERY END

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Auto Mine (Cobalt remotes for Islands)
-- Works with stone, iron, coal, ores, rocks, trees, etc.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- These paths come from the Cobalt snippets you provided.
-- They can break after game updates; re-spy if needed.

-- Plant a crop at a CFrame (from Cobalt plant capture)
local function firePlant(cf, blockType)
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        local names = RemoteCatalog.SeedNames(blockType or CONFIG.PlantType)
        for _, tool in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools()) do
            if table.find(names, tool.Name) then
                if not RemoteCatalog.EquipTool(tool) then return false, "Could not equip seed tool" end
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return RemoteCatalog.CallPlacement({ cframe = cf, blockType = blockType or CONFIG.PlantType })
end

-- Plant a grid of crops around the player
local function plantAroundPlayer(blockType,token)
    if not RemoteCatalog.PlacementAvailable() then
        setStatus("Place one block manually with capture active first.", COLORS.warn)
        return 0
    end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return 0
	end
	blockType = blockType or CONFIG.PlantType
	local origin = hrp.Position
	local planted = 0
	local r = CONFIG.PlantRadius
	local step = CONFIG.PlantSpacing

	for x = -r, r, step do
		for z = -r, r, step do
            if not gui.Parent or player.Character~=char or RemoteCatalog.PlantGeneration~=token then return planted end
			local pos = Vector3.new(origin.X + x, origin.Y, origin.Z + z)
			-- Keep upright rotation like the Cobalt sample
			local cf = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
			if firePlant(cf, blockType) then
				planted += 1
			end
			task.wait(CONFIG.PlantDelay)
		end
	end
	return planted
end

-- Hotbar layout remote (from Cobalt)
-- Example: "woodPickaxe,,sapling,hoe,berryHarvested,ironOre,saplingOrange,yellowFlowerSeeds"
local function setHotbarLayout(layoutString)
    return RemoteCatalog.CallHotbar(layoutString)
end

-- Shared tool support from the Auto Wood Farmer.
-- Prefer an axe when available; otherwise fall back to a pickaxe.
local function equipBestResourceTool(category)
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return false end

    local preference = category == "wood" and woodToolPreference or mineToolPreference
    local preferenceName=string.lower(preference)
    local wantAxe = category == "wood" or string.find(preferenceName,"axe",1,true) and not string.find(preferenceName,"pickaxe",1,true)
    local best, bestScore = nil, -math.huge
    local fallback, fallbackScore = nil, -math.huge
    for _, tool in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools()) do
        local name = string.lower(tool.Name)
        local isPick = string.find(name, "pickaxe", 1, true) ~= nil
        local isAxe = string.find(name, "axe", 1, true) ~= nil and not isPick
        -- Combat axes (the mob farm's ironWarAxe, battle axes) cannot chop and would steal the weapon.
        local compact = name:gsub("[%s_%-]", "")
        if isAxe and (string.find(compact, "waraxe", 1, true) or string.find(compact, "battleaxe", 1, true)) then isAxe = false end
        if type(CONFIG.MobWeapon)=="string" and name==string.lower(CONFIG.MobWeapon) then isAxe,isPick=false,false end
        if (wantAxe and isAxe) or (not wantAxe and isPick) then
            local score = 1
            if string.find(name, "mythic", 1, true) then score = 100
            elseif string.find(name, "diamond", 1, true) then score = 90
            elseif string.find(name, "gold", 1, true) then score = 80
            elseif string.find(name, "steel", 1, true) then score = 70
            elseif string.find(name, "iron", 1, true) then score = 60
            elseif string.find(name, "stone", 1, true) then score = 40
            elseif string.find(name, "wood", 1, true) then score = 20 end
            if score > fallbackScore then fallback, fallbackScore = tool, score end
            if not string.find(string.lower(preference), "auto best", 1, true) then
                local wanted = string.lower(preference):gsub(" axe", ""):gsub(" pickaxe", ""):gsub("^wooden$", "wood")
                if not string.find(name, wanted, 1, true) then
                    score = -math.huge -- Prefer the requested material; recover to an owned tool if absent.
                else
                    score = score + 1000
                end
            end
            if score > bestScore then best, bestScore = tool, score end
        end
    end
    if not best and fallback then
        -- Use the fallback for this hit and say so; the saved preference is the user's choice and a
        -- tool that is briefly out of the backpack must not rewrite it.
        best=fallback;bestScore=fallbackScore
        if category == "wood" then
            if woodStatus then woodStatus.Text=preference.." not in the inventory right now. Using "..fallback.Name.."." end
        else
            if mineInfo then mineInfo.Text=preference.." not in the inventory right now. Using "..fallback.Name.."." end
        end
    end
    if best and bestScore > -math.huge then
        local ok = RemoteCatalog.EquipTool(best)
        if not ok then
            local err=player:GetAttribute("ToolsLocked") and "tools are locked by the game" or "inventory tool selection unavailable"
            if setStatus then setStatus("Tool equip failed: " .. tostring(err), COLORS.bad) end
            return false,"Tool equip failed: "..err
        end
        return true
    end
    local reason=wantAxe and "No axe found. Put an axe in your inventory"..(type(CONFIG.MobWeapon)=="string" and " (the mob weapon "..CONFIG.MobWeapon.." is never used for chopping)" or "").."." or "No pickaxe found. Put a pickaxe in your inventory."
    if setStatus then setStatus(reason, COLORS.warn) end
    return false,reason
end

local function equipPickaxe()
    return equipBestResourceTool(woodEnabled and "wood" or "mine")
end

local function getPlayerIsland()
    local islands = workspace:FindFirstChild("Islands")
    if not islands then return nil end
    local owned = islands:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId) .. "-island")
    if owned then return owned end
    for _, island in ipairs(islands:GetChildren()) do
        if island:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == player.UserId then return island end
    end
    return nil
end

function RemoteCatalog.BuildIslandBlocks()
    local island=getPlayerIsland()
    return island and island:FindFirstChild("Blocks")
end
local function getPartPosition(obj)
	if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
		return obj.Position
	elseif obj:IsA("Model") then
        -- Model pivots may be far from their rendered rocks/crops.
        local boxed, bounds = pcall(function() return obj:GetBoundingBox() end)
        if boxed and bounds then return bounds.Position end
		local ok, pivot = pcall(function()
			return obj:GetPivot().Position
		end)
		if ok and pivot then
			return pivot
		end
	end
	local part = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	if part then
		return part.Position
	end
	return nil
end

local function targetCategory(name) return FarmLogic.Category(name) end
local function modeAllows(name)
    local category = targetCategory(name)
    if category == "crop" then return harvestEnabled and FarmLogic.CropsMatch(name, CONFIG.HarvestCrops, CONFIG.HarvestCrop) end
    if category == "wood" then return woodEnabled and FarmLogic.TreeMatches(name, CONFIG.WoodTrees) end
    return category == "mine" and mineEnabled and FarmLogic.RockMatches(name, CONFIG.MineRocks)
end
local FarmState = { Cooldowns = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), FruitTrees = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) }
-- anyRock: list every rock/ore in range regardless of the Rocks filter (diagnostics only).
-- anyRock "scan": every rock/ore in range even while Mining is OFF (read-only listing).
local function getMineTargets(anyRock)
    local targets, seen = {}, {}
    local char = player.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return targets end
    local function consider(obj, allowCrops)
        if seen[obj] then return end
        seen[obj] = true
        local category = targetCategory(obj.Name)
        if not category then return end
        if not (anyRock=="scan" and category == "mine" or anyRock and category == "mine" and mineEnabled or modeAllows(obj.Name)) then return end
        if category == "crop" and not allowCrops then return end
        -- Wood and Harvest never run together, so protection follows the saved fruit setting.
        if category == "wood" and allowCrops and CONFIG.FruitEnabled then
            if FarmState.FruitTrees[obj] or string.find(string.lower(obj.Name),"treeorange",1,true) or #FarmLogic.Fruits(obj)>0 then
                FarmState.FruitTrees[obj]=true;return
            end
        end
        if category == "crop" and not FarmLogic.IsReady(obj) then return end
        if category == "crop" and FarmLogic.PromptDisabled and FarmLogic.PromptDisabled(obj) then return end
        if (FarmState.Cooldowns[obj] or 0) > os.clock() then return end
        local position = getPartPosition(obj)
        if not position then return end
        local distance = (position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
        if distance > FarmLogic.Range(category, CONFIG) then return end
        table.insert(targets, {kind = category == "crop" and "model" or "block",
            instance = obj, name = obj.Name, distance = distance, position = position, category = category})
    end
    local function scan(folder, allowCrops)
        if folder then for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do consider(obj, allowCrops) end end
    end
    local function scanResources(folder, depth)
        if not folder or depth < 0 then return end
        for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            local category = targetCategory(obj.Name)
            local resource = category == "wood" or category == "mine"
            local containsResources = false
            if obj:IsA("Model") then
                for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
                    local childCategory = targetCategory(child.Name)
                    if child:IsA("Model") and (childCategory == "wood" or childCategory == "mine") then containsResources = true; break end
                end
            end
            if resource and not containsResources and (obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart")) then
                consider(obj, false)
            elseif not obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                scanResources(obj, depth - 1)
            end
        end
    end
    local prefabs = workspace:FindFirstChild("spawnPrefabs")
    if woodEnabled or mineEnabled then scanResources(prefabs, 5) end
    local owned = getPlayerIsland()
    local islands = workspace:FindFirstChild("Islands")
    -- Scanning every block of every island 5x a second lags busy servers. Skip islands whose
    -- bounds (cached 5s) are beyond the resource range; unknown bounds are still scanned.
    FarmState.IslandBounds = FarmState.IslandBounds or setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local resourceRange = woodEnabled and CONFIG.WoodRange or CONFIG.MineRange
    local function islandInRange(island)
        local entry = FarmState.IslandBounds[island]
        if not entry or os.clock() - entry.At > 5 then
            local ok, frame, size = pcall(function() return island:GetBoundingBox() end)
            entry = { At = os.clock(), Frame = ok and frame or nil, Size = ok and size or nil }
            FarmState.IslandBounds[island] = entry
        end
        if not entry.Frame or not entry.Size then return true end
        local ok, near = pcall(function()
            local point = entry.Frame:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
            local dx = math.max(math.abs(point.X) - entry.Size.X / 2, 0)
            local dy = math.max(math.abs(point.Y) - entry.Size.Y / 2, 0)
            local dz = math.max(math.abs(point.Z) - entry.Size.Z / 2, 0)
            return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) <= resourceRange
        end)
        return not ok or near
    end
    if islands then
        for _, island in ipairs(islands:GetChildren()) do
            if island == owned or (woodEnabled or mineEnabled) and islandInRange(island) then
                scan(island:FindFirstChild("Blocks"), island == owned)
                scan(island:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"), island == owned)
            end
        end
    end
    if harvestEnabled and CONFIG.FruitEnabled and owned then
        local blocks=owned:FindFirstChild("Blocks")
        if blocks then for _,tree in ipairs(blocks:GetChildren()) do
            for _,fruit in ipairs(FarmLogic.Fruits(tree)) do
                local position=getPartPosition(fruit)
                if position and not seen[fruit] and (FarmState.Cooldowns[fruit] or 0)<=os.clock() then
                    local distance=(position-hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance<=FarmLogic.Range("crop",CONFIG) then
                        seen[fruit]=true;FarmState.FruitTrees[tree]=true
                        table.insert(targets,{kind="fruit",instance=fruit,model=tree,name=tree.Name.." fruit",distance=distance,position=position,category="crop"})
                    end
                end
            end
        end end
    end
    table.sort(targets, function(a, b) return a.distance < b.distance end)
    return targets
end

-- RESOURCE AIM BEGIN
local function getInteractionPoint(target, origin, visiblePoint, maxDistance)
    local best, distance
    local function candidate(point)
        local magnitude=(point-origin).Magnitude
        if maxDistance and magnitude>maxDistance then return end
        if visiblePoint and not visiblePoint(point) then return end
        if not distance or magnitude<distance then best,distance=point,magnitude end
    end
    local function consider(part)
        if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        local ok,closest=pcall(function() return part:GetClosestPointOnSurface(origin) end)
        if ok and closest then candidate(closest) end
        candidate(part.Position)
        if part.CFrame and part.Size then
            candidate(part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0,-part.Size.Y*.25,0)))
            candidate(part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0,part.Size.Y*.25,0)))
        end
    end
    if target:IsA("BasePart") then consider(target) end
    -- Some tree roots are invisible Parts with the rendered mesh beneath them.
    for _,part in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do consider(part) end
    if visiblePoint then return best end
    return best or getPartPosition(target)
end
function RemoteCatalog.ResourcePosition(target)
    local char=player.Character
    local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    return root and getInteractionPoint(target,root.Position) or getPartPosition(target)
end
-- RESOURCE AIM END

-- FARM NAVIGATION BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.Navigation=(function()
-- Farm travel is idle until an active worker asks to approach a target.
local Navigation={Generation=0}
local function halt(humanoid,root)
    if not humanoid then return end
    -- Clear the outstanding MoveTo destination as well as current movement.
    if root then pcall(function() humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position) end) end
    pcall(function() humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero) end)
end
function Navigation.Stop(owner)
    if owner~=nil and Navigation.Owner~=owner then return false end
    Navigation.Generation+=1
    if Navigation.Tween then pcall(function() Navigation.Tween:Cancel() end);Navigation.Tween=nil end
    local humanoid,root=Navigation.Humanoid,Navigation.Root
    Navigation.Humanoid=nil;Navigation.Root=nil;Navigation.Owner=nil
    halt(humanoid,root)
    return true
end
function Navigation.Approach(player,target,reach,active,positionOf,mode,owner)
    local character=player.Character
    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not humanoid then return false,"Waiting for your character" end
    local generation=Navigation.Generation
    local function valid()
        return active() and Navigation.Generation==generation and player.Character==character
            and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")==root
            and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")==humanoid
            and target.Parent~=nil and humanoid.Health>0
    end
    local function near()
        local point=positionOf(target)
        return point and (point-root.Position).Magnitude<=reach
    end
    if not valid() then return false,"Travel stopped" end
    if near() then return true end
    if mode=="Normal" then return false,"Normal mode: move closer to the target" end
    Navigation.Stop()
    generation=Navigation.Generation
    Navigation.Humanoid=humanoid;Navigation.Root=root;Navigation.Owner=owner
    local ok,result=pcall(function()
        local destination=positionOf(target)
        if not destination then return false end
        -- Stand beside dense bushes rather than pathfinding into their collision geometry.
        destination=destination+(root.Position-destination).Unit*(reach*.6)
        if mode=="Teleport" or mode=="Tween" then
            local destinationFrame=root.CFrame+(destination-root.Position)
            if not valid() then return false end
            if mode=="Teleport" then
                root.CFrame=destinationFrame
                task.wait(.1)
                return valid() and near()
            end
            local duration=math.clamp((destination-root.Position).Magnitude/24,.15,5)
            local tween=game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(root,TweenInfo.new(duration,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{CFrame=destinationFrame})
            Navigation.Tween=tween
            tween:Play()
            local deadline=os.clock()+duration+.5
            while valid() and not near() and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(.05) end
            tween:Cancel()
            if Navigation.Tween==tween then Navigation.Tween=nil end
            return valid() and near()
        end
        local path=game:GetService("PathfindingService"):CreatePath({AgentRadius=2,AgentHeight=5,AgentCanJump=true,WaypointSpacing=4})
        path:ComputeAsync(root.Position,destination)
        if not valid() or path.Status~=Enum.PathStatus.Success then return false end
        if mode=="Hop" then
            -- Teleport in short steps along the path: no long jumps and no cutting through walls.
            local waypoints=path:GetWaypoints()
            local lift=waypoints[1] and root.Position.Y-waypoints[1].Position.Y or 3
            local hopDeadline=os.clock()+math.max(5,(destination-root.Position).Magnitude/30+3)
            for _,waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
                local goal=waypoint.Position+Vector3.new(0,lift,0)
                while valid() and not near() do
                    local offset=goal-root.Position
                    if offset.Magnitude<.5 then break end
                    -- A server position reset would otherwise hop forever.
                    if os.clock()>hopDeadline then return false end
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
                    root.CFrame=root.CFrame+offset.Unit*math.min(Navigation.HopSize or 8,offset.Magnitude)
                    task.wait(.1)
                end
                if not valid() then return false end
                if near() then return true end
            end
            return near()
        end
        -- Far chests/trees need more than a fixed budget; per-waypoint stall checks still catch blocking.
        local speed=math.max(tonumber(humanoid.WalkSpeed) or 16,4)
        local deadline=os.clock()+math.max(10,(destination-root.Position).Magnitude/speed*1.5+2)
        for _,waypoint in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
            if not valid() then return false end
            if near() then return true end
            local function distanceToWaypoint()
                local offset=waypoint.Position-root.Position
                return Vector3.new(offset.X,0,offset.Z).Magnitude
            end
            -- Waypoint Y is at the feet; HumanoidRootPart stays above it.
            if waypoint.Action==Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then humanoid.Jump=true end
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            local best=distanceToWaypoint()
            local progressed=os.clock()
            while distanceToWaypoint()>2 or math.abs(waypoint.Position.Y-root.Position.Y)>6 do
                if not valid() then return false end
                if near() then return true end
                local distance=distanceToWaypoint()
                if distance<best-.3 then best=distance;progressed=os.clock() end
                if os.clock()>deadline or os.clock()-progressed>1.5 then return false end
                task.wait(.1)
            end
        end
        return near()
    end)
    -- A cancelled old path must not stop a newer worker's movement.
    if Navigation.Generation==generation and Navigation.Humanoid==humanoid then
        if Navigation.Tween then pcall(function() Navigation.Tween:Cancel() end);Navigation.Tween=nil end
        halt(humanoid,root)
        Navigation.Humanoid=nil;Navigation.Root=nil;Navigation.Owner=nil
    end
    return ok and result==true and valid(),ok and "Target not reached; skipping this target" or "Travel unavailable; skipping this target"
end
return Navigation
end)()
-- FARM NAVIGATION END
RemoteCatalog.Navigation.HopSize=CONFIG.HopSize

function RemoteCatalog.BuildTravelBlocked()
    if RemoteCatalog.Mobs and RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled then return "Stop Auto Mobs before Auto Walk." end
    if enabled then return "Pause Fishing before Auto Walk." end
    if harvestEnabled and CONFIG.HarvestWalk or woodEnabled and CONFIG.WoodTravelMode~="Normal" or mineEnabled then
        return "Stop farming movement before Auto Walk."
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker and RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel~="Stay" then return "Stop chest walking before Auto Walk." end
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then return "Stop Auto Plow before Auto Walk." end
    local navigation=RemoteCatalog.Navigation
    if navigation and navigation.Humanoid and navigation.Owner~="Build" then return "Other movement is active; stop it before Auto Walk." end
end

-- RESOURCE INPUT BEGIN
-- The equipped tool supplies live request names and session data through its own client code.
local function resourceInputHit(target)
    local myCycle = harvestCycleId
    local function active()
        return gui.Parent ~= nil and harvestCycleId == myCycle and target.Parent ~= nil
            and modeAllows(target.Name) and (woodEnabled or mineEnabled or harvestEnabled) and not enabled
    end
    if enabled then return false, "Pause Fishing before using resource input" end
    if not active() then return false, "Resource action stopped" end
    local char = player.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    local category = targetCategory(target.Name)
    local toolName = tool and string.lower(tool.Name) or ""
    local pickaxe = string.find(toolName, "pickaxe", 1, true) ~= nil
    local compactTool = toolName:gsub("[%s_%-]", "")
    local axe = string.find(toolName, "axe", 1, true) ~= nil and not pickaxe
        and not string.find(compactTool, "waraxe", 1, true) and not string.find(compactTool, "battleaxe", 1, true)
        and not (type(CONFIG)=="table" and type(CONFIG.MobWeapon)=="string" and toolName==string.lower(CONFIG.MobWeapon))
    local choice=type(mineToolPreference)=="string" and string.lower(mineToolPreference) or ""
    local miningAxe=string.find(choice,"axe",1,true) and not string.find(choice,"pickaxe",1,true)
    if not root or category == "mine" and not (miningAxe and axe or not miningAxe and pickaxe) or category == "wood" and not axe then
        return false, "Wait for the matching axe/pickaxe to equip"
    end
    local position = getInteractionPoint(target, root.Position)
    if not position then return false, "Resource has no position" end
    local focused, textBox = pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() end)
    if focused and textBox then return false, "Close chat or finish editing before resource input" end
    local reach = RemoteCatalog.GameModule("ReplicatedStorage.Shared.SharedConfig", "CLIENT_REACH")
    if type(reach) ~= "number" then reach = 20 end
    if (position - root.Position).Magnitude > reach then
        return false, "Move closer to " .. target.Name .. " (tool reach " .. reach .. " studs)"
    end
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return false, "Camera unavailable" end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
    position=getInteractionPoint(target,root.Position,function(candidate)
        local screen,visible=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(candidate)
