        if not visible or screen.Z<=0 then return false end
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(camera.CFrame.Position,candidate-camera.CFrame.Position,params)
        -- No hit means an unobstructed line, including custom non-queryable tree geometry.
        return not hit or hit.Instance==target or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target)
    end,reach)
    if not position then return false,"No clear point within reach; face "..target.Name.." or move around the obstacle" end
    local point, visible = camera:WorldToScreenPoint(position)
    if not visible or point.Z <= 0 then return false, "Face " .. target.Name .. " so it is on screen" end
    local x, y = point.X, point.Y
    if hub.Root.Visible then
        local p, size = hub.Root.AbsolutePosition, hub.Root.AbsoluteSize
        if x >= p.X and x <= p.X + size.X and y >= p.Y and y <= p.Y + size.Y then
            return false, "Move the hub away from " .. target.Name
        end
    end
    local checked, objects = pcall(function() return playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(x, y) end)
    if checked then
        for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
            if object:IsA("GuiButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
                return false, "Move the resource clear of on-screen controls"
            end
        end
    end
    local hostMouse=category~="crop" and type(mousemoveabs)=="function" and type(mouse1press)=="function" and type(mouse1release)=="function"
    local moved = pcall(function()
        if hostMouse then mousemoveabs(x,y) else VirtualInputManager:SendMouseMoveEvent(x,y,game) end
    end)
    if not moved then return false, "Tool input unavailable; record one manual hit to learn this session's request" end
    task.wait(category == "crop" and 0.1 or 0.03)
    if not active() or category ~= "crop" and tool.Parent ~= char then return false, "Resource action stopped or tool changed" end
    local function input(down)
        if category == "crop" then VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(down, Enum.KeyCode.F, false, game)
        elseif hostMouse then if down then mouse1press() else mouse1release() end
        else VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, down, game, 0) end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.ResourceInputBusy=true
    local pressed = pcall(input, true)
    local held = pcall(function() if pressed then task.wait(category == "crop" and 0.1 or 0.06) end end)
    -- Always release even if Stop, UI cleanup or an input error happened during the press.
    local released = pcall(input, false)
    RemoteCatalog.ResourceInputBusy=false
    if not pressed or not held or not released then return false, "Tool input unavailable in this environment" end
    return active(), hostMouse and "Host mouse tool input" or "Normal tool input"
end
RemoteCatalog.InputMine = resourceInputHit
RemoteCatalog.InputHarvest = resourceInputHit
function RemoteCatalog.WoodReach(target,origin)
    local reach=RemoteCatalog.GameModule("ReplicatedStorage.Shared.SharedConfig","CLIENT_REACH")
    if type(reach)~="number" or reach<=0 then reach=20 end
    local point=getInteractionPoint(target,origin,nil,reach)
    if not point or (point-origin).Magnitude>reach then
        return false,"Move closer to "..target.Name.." (axe reach "..reach.." studs; scan range is separate)"
    end
    return true
end
-- RESOURCE INPUT END

-- Mining → Scan rocks: names and counts of rocks/ores within the mining range, nearest first; no requests.
function RemoteCatalog.MineScanText()
    local counts,names,nearest={}, {},nil
    for _,entry in ipairs(getMineTargets("scan")) do
        if not counts[entry.name] then counts[entry.name]=0;table.insert(names,entry.name) end
        counts[entry.name]+=1
        if not nearest or entry.distance<nearest.distance then nearest=entry end
    end
    table.sort(names,function(a,b) return counts[a]>counts[b] or counts[a]==counts[b] and a<b end)
    local parts={}
    for _,name in ipairs(names) do table.insert(parts,name.." ×"..counts[name]..(FarmLogic.RockMatches(name,CONFIG.MineRocks) and "" or " (skipped by Rocks filter)")) end
    if #parts==0 then return "No rocks or ores within "..CONFIG.MineRange.." studs. Blocks are matched by name (rock, stone, ore, iron, coal, gold, aquamarine …)." end
    return "Within "..CONFIG.MineRange.." studs: "..table.concat(parts,", ")..string.format(" · nearest %s at %d studs",nearest.name,nearest.distance)
end
local function fireBlockMine(block)
    return RemoteCatalog.CallMine(block, targetCategory(block.Name))
end

local function fireModelHarvest(model)
    return RemoteCatalog.CallHarvest(model)
end

local function harvestLoop(myCycle)
    FarmState.LastFailure=FarmState.LastFailure or {}
    local function active()
        return harvestCycleId == myCycle and (harvestEnabled or woodEnabled or mineEnabled) and gui.Parent ~= nil
    end
    while active() do
        if baitBusy or RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy then task.wait(0.05);continue end
        local targets = getMineTargets()
        if #targets == 0 then
            local category=harvestEnabled and "crop" or woodEnabled and "wood" or "mine"
            local failure=FarmState.LastFailure[category]
            local scan=category=="crop" and "Scanning your island for selected ready crops." or category=="wood" and "Scanning nearby trees; recent targets may be cooling down." or ((CONFIG.MineRocks or "All")=="All" and "Scanning nearby rocks and ores." or "Scanning nearby "..CONFIG.MineRocks.." rocks · none in range yet (Rocks: All mines everything).")
            if category=="mine" and (CONFIG.MineRocks or "All")~="All" then
                -- Show what the filter is skipping so a wrong block name is obvious from the status line.
                local counts,names={}, {}
                for _,other in ipairs(getMineTargets(true)) do
                    if not counts[other.name] then counts[other.name]=0;table.insert(names,other.name) end
                    counts[other.name]+=1
                end
                table.sort(names,function(a,b) return counts[a]>counts[b] end)
                local parts={}
                for i=1,math.min(4,#names) do table.insert(parts,names[i].." ×"..counts[names[i]]) end
                if #parts>0 then scan=scan.." In range but skipped: "..table.concat(parts,", ").."." end
            end
            setStatus(failure and (category.." waiting: "..failure) or scan,failure and COLORS.warn or COLORS.muted)
            task.wait(CONFIG.MineScanInterval)
            continue
        end
        while #targets > 0 do
            if not active() then break end
            -- A deposit owns movement and bait owns the mouse; resume the batch on the next scan.
            if RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy or baitBusy then break end
            -- After walking or teleporting, the scan-time order zigzags; pick the nearest from here.
            local here = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local target = FarmLogic.TakeNearest(targets, here and here.Position)
            local obj = target.instance
            if not obj.Parent then continue end
            if target.category=="crop" and not FarmLogic.IsReady(obj) then continue end
            if target.kind=="fruit" then
                if not harvestEnabled or not CONFIG.FruitEnabled or not target.model.Parent or not obj:IsDescendantOf(target.model) then continue end
            elseif not modeAllows(obj.Name) then continue end
            local char = player.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local position = getPartPosition(obj)
            if not hrp or not position or (position - hrp.Position).Magnitude > FarmLogic.Range(target.category, CONFIG) then continue end
            if target.category=="crop" then
                local reach=RemoteCatalog.GameModule("ReplicatedStorage.Shared.SharedConfig","CLIENT_REACH")
                reach=type(reach)=="number" and math.min(reach,8) or 8
                if (position-hrp.Position).Magnitude>reach then
                    local reached,reason=false,"Move closer to "..target.name.." (scan range is not interaction range)"
                    if CONFIG.HarvestWalk then
                        setStatus((CONFIG.FarmTravelMode=="Hop" and "TP hops" or CONFIG.FarmTravelMode or "Walk").." to "..target.name,COLORS.muted)
                        reached,reason=RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Approach(player,obj,reach,function() return active() and CONFIG.HarvestWalk and harvestEnabled and not enabled and not RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy end,getPartPosition,CONFIG.FarmTravelMode,"Farm")
                    end
                    if not active() then break end
                    if not reached then
                        FarmState.Cooldowns[obj]=os.clock()+3
                        FarmState.LastFailure.crop=reason
                        setStatus(reason,COLORS.warn)
                        continue
                    end
                    hrp=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if not hrp then break end
                    position=getPartPosition(obj)
                    if not obj.Parent or not position then continue end
                    if (position-hrp.Position).Magnitude>reach then
                        FarmState.Cooldowns[obj]=os.clock()+3
                        FarmState.LastFailure.crop="Still outside crop interaction reach; trying another target"
                        continue
                    end
                end
            end
            if (target.category == "wood" or target.category == "mine") and enabled then
                -- Swapping to an axe/pickaxe would take the rod out of an active cast. Checked before
                -- any travel, so the message is the real blocker, not "Travel stopped".
                FarmState.LastFailure[target.category]="Pause Fishing to use the "..(target.category=="wood" and "axe" or "pickaxe")
                setStatus(FarmState.LastFailure[target.category],COLORS.warn)
                FarmState.Cooldowns[obj]=os.clock()+1
                continue
            end
            if target.category=="wood" or target.category=="mine" then
                -- Rocks share the axe reach rule: a block hit from across the island is rejected by the
                -- server, so a rock out of reach is travelled to or skipped, never requested.
                local reachable,reason=RemoteCatalog.WoodReach(obj,hrp.Position)
                if not reachable and CONFIG.WoodTravelMode~="Normal" then
                    setStatus((CONFIG.WoodTravelMode=="Hop" and "TP hops" or CONFIG.WoodTravelMode or "Normal").." to "..target.name,COLORS.muted)
                    reachable,reason=RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Approach(player,obj,8,function() return active() and (woodEnabled or mineEnabled) and not enabled and not RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy end,RemoteCatalog.ResourcePosition,CONFIG.WoodTravelMode,"Farm")
                    if not active() then break end
                    if reachable then reachable,reason=RemoteCatalog.WoodReach(obj,hrp.Position) end
                end
                if not reachable then
                    FarmState.LastFailure[target.category]=reason
                    if target.category=="wood" then woodStatus.Text=reason end
                    setStatus(reason,COLORS.warn)
                    -- A target that cannot be reached backs off longer every time: 1 s, 5 s, 15 s.
                    FarmState.TravelFails=FarmState.TravelFails or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
                    local fails=(FarmState.TravelFails[obj] or 0)+1;FarmState.TravelFails[obj]=fails
                    FarmState.Cooldowns[obj]=os.clock()+(fails>=3 and 15 or fails==2 and 5 or 1)
                    continue
                end
                FarmState.TravelFails=FarmState.TravelFails or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"});FarmState.TravelFails[obj]=nil
            end
            if target.category == "wood" or target.category == "mine" then
                local previous=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                local equipped,equipReason=equipBestResourceTool(target.category)
                if not equipped then
                    -- The blocker stays on the status line across the cooldown scans.
                    FarmState.LastFailure[target.category]=equipReason or "Tool equip failed"
                    FarmState.Cooldowns[obj] = os.clock() + 2;continue
                end
                if char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")~=previous then task.wait(0.1) end
            end
            if not active() then break end
            -- Tool equip and travel yield; another player may remove this resource meanwhile.
            if not obj.Parent or player.Character~=char or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")~=hrp then continue end
            if target.kind=="fruit" and (not target.model.Parent or not obj:IsDescendantOf(target.model)) then continue end
            position = getPartPosition(obj)
            if not position or (position - hrp.Position).Magnitude > FarmLogic.Range(target.category, CONFIG) then continue end
            local before = FarmLogic.Snapshot(obj)
            if target.category == "crop" and not FarmLogic.IsReady(obj) then continue end
            local recorder = RemoteCatalog.Recorder
            local binding = recorder and recorder.HarvestBinding
            local learned = binding and binding.Remote.Parent and (binding.Target:IsA("Model") == obj:IsA("Model"))
            local nativeHarvest = target.category == "crop" and RemoteCatalog.HarvestEndpoint()
            local prompt = target.kind ~= "fruit" and target.category == "crop" and not learned and not nativeHarvest and FarmLogic.HarvestPrompt(obj) or nil
            local plantedType=target.category=="crop" and target.kind~="fruit" and FarmLogic.ReplantType(target.name,CONFIG.HarvestCrops,CONFIG.PlantType) or nil
            local plantedFrame
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then plantedFrame = obj.CFrame
            elseif obj:IsA("Model") then plantedFrame = obj:GetPivot() end
            local ok, failure
            if prompt then
                local promptPosition = getPartPosition(prompt.Parent) or position
                if (promptPosition - hrp.Position).Magnitude > prompt.MaxActivationDistance then
                    FarmState.Cooldowns[obj]=os.clock()+3
                    FarmState.LastFailure.crop="Prompt out of range for "..target.name.."; move closer"
                    continue
                end
                if stats.resourceAttempts then stats.resourceAttempts[target.category]+=1 end
                ok = FarmLogic.HoldPrompt(prompt, active, task.wait, os.clock)
                if not active() then break end
            elseif target.kind == "fruit" then
                if stats.resourceAttempts then stats.resourceAttempts.crop+=1 end
                ok,failure=RemoteCatalog.CallFruit(target.model,obj)
                if not ok then setStatus("Fruit picking waiting: "..tostring(failure),COLORS.warn) end
            elseif target.kind == "model" then
                if stats.resourceAttempts then stats.resourceAttempts[target.category]+=1 end
                ok, failure = fireModelHarvest(obj)
                if not ok then setStatus("Harvest waiting: " .. tostring(failure), COLORS.warn) end
            else
                if stats.resourceAttempts then stats.resourceAttempts[target.category]+=1 end
                ok, failure = fireBlockMine(obj)
                if not ok then setStatus("Mining waiting: " .. tostring(failure), COLORS.warn) end
            end
            FarmState.LastFailure[target.category]=not ok and tostring(failure or "input not accepted") or nil
            if target.category=="wood" and woodStatus then
                woodStatus.Text=ok and ("Request sent to "..target.name.."; damage not yet confirmed.") or ("Wood waiting: "..tostring(failure))
            end
            local persistentBerry=target.category=="crop" and target.kind~="fruit" and string.find(string.lower(target.name),"berry",1,true)~=nil
            local confirmed = false
            if ok then
                local deadline = os.clock() + (persistentBerry and 0.15 or 0.8)
                repeat
                    if not active() then break end
                    confirmed = FarmLogic.Confirmed(obj, before, prompt)
                    if confirmed then break end
                    task.wait(0.05)
                until os.clock() >= deadline
            end
            if not active() then break end
            if ok and not confirmed then setStatus(persistentBerry and "Berry request sent; checking the next bush (collection unconfirmed)" or ("No target change confirmed; retrying " .. target.name), COLORS.muted) end
            if confirmed then
                registerHarvest(target.name, target.category)
                setStatus("Confirmed: " .. target.name .. " ×" .. stats.harvests, COLORS.good)
                -- A plant that regrows in place must never be planted over.
                if target.category == "crop" and target.kind ~= "fruit" and not obj.Parent and plantedFrame and CONFIG.PlantEnabled and CONFIG.AutoReplant and not (RemoteCatalog.ServerReplantEnabled()) then
                    if enabled then
                        -- Equipping the seed tool would take the rod out of an active cast.
                        FarmState.LastFailure.crop="Pause Fishing to replant"
                        setStatus("Harvest confirmed; pause Fishing to replant.",COLORS.warn)
                    elseif RemoteCatalog.PlacementAvailable() then
                        if active() then firePlant(plantedFrame, plantedType) end
                    else
                        setStatus("Harvest confirmed. Place one crop manually to enable replanting.", COLORS.warn)
                    end
                end
            end
            if confirmed then RemoteCatalog.CompleteModeGoal(target.category) end
            if not active() then break end
            local quickCrop=target.category=="crop" and (confirmed or persistentBerry and ok)
            FarmState.Unconfirmed=FarmState.Unconfirmed or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
            if confirmed then FarmState.Unconfirmed[obj]=nil end
            if (target.category=="wood" or target.category=="mine") and ok and not confirmed and obj.Parent then
                -- A tree or rock takes several hits: keep swinging at this one instead of walking to
                -- the next and back. Thirty unconfirmed hits in a row mean it cannot be damaged here.
                local swings=(FarmState.Unconfirmed[obj] or 0)+1;FarmState.Unconfirmed[obj]=swings
                if swings<30 then
                    FarmState.Cooldowns[obj]=nil
                    table.insert(targets,target)
                    task.wait(CONFIG.MineDelay)
                    continue
                end
                FarmState.Unconfirmed[obj]=nil
                FarmState.LastFailure[target.category]="No damage confirmed on "..target.name.." after 30 hits; trying another"
                FarmState.Cooldowns[obj]=os.clock()+5
            elseif target.category=="crop" and ok and not confirmed and not persistentBerry then
                -- An accepted request that changed nothing: unripe or still regrowing. Back off 2 s,
                -- then double it, so an unripe field is not requested every third of a second.
                local tries=(FarmState.Unconfirmed[obj] or 0)+1;FarmState.Unconfirmed[obj]=tries
                FarmState.Cooldowns[obj]=os.clock()+math.min(8,2^tries)
            else
                FarmState.Cooldowns[obj] = os.clock() + (persistentBerry and ok and 15 or quickCrop and 0.08 or ok and 0.25 or 2)
            end
            task.wait(quickCrop and math.min(CONFIG.MineDelay,0.08) or CONFIG.MineDelay)
        end
        -- All candidates may be out of prompt range; always yield before rescanning.
        task.wait(CONFIG.MineScanInterval)
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Main fishing loop
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local setHarvestEnabled

local function run(myCycle)
	local failedCasts = 0
    local countedBites = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local countedMisses = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local reelAttempts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local readyBites = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local mouseReels = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local function status(message,color)
        if not running(myCycle) then return end
        if RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus then RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus(myCycle,message,color)
        else setStatus(message,color) end
    end

    -- The game may reuse one bobber instance per player; state keyed by it must not survive a cast.
    local function forgetBobber(b)
        if b==nil then return end
        readyBites[b]=nil;countedBites[b]=nil;countedMisses[b]=nil;reelAttempts[b]=nil;mouseReels[b]=nil
    end
	while running(myCycle) do
        if baitBusy then status("Applying bait; fishing resumes automatically.",COLORS.muted);task.wait(.05);continue end
		local bobber = getBobber()

		if bobber then
            if (reelAttempts[bobber] or 0)>=3 then
                RemoteCatalog.RecoverFishingCast(myCycle,bobber)
                forgetBobber(bobber)
                task.wait(1)
                continue
            end
			failedCasts = 0
            local tugged,timedOut=readyBites[bobber]==true,false
            if not tugged then
                status("Waiting for fish...")
                tugged,timedOut=waitForTug(bobber,myCycle)
                if tugged then readyBites[bobber]=true end
            end
			if not running(myCycle) then break end
            if getBobber()~=bobber then forgetBobber(bobber);task.wait(.01);continue end

			if timedOut then
                status("No bite yet — resetting the cast and continuing without requiring bait.", COLORS.warn)
                RemoteCatalog.RecoverFishingCast(myCycle,bobber)
                forgetBobber(bobber)
                task.wait(1)
                continue
            elseif not tugged then
				status("Bobber disappeared")
				task.wait(0.1)
			elseif os.clock() - lastAction >= CONFIG.ActionCooldown then
				lastAction = os.clock()
				local reelTime = os.clock()
                if RemoteCatalog.BeginPropellerCatch then RemoteCatalog.BeginPropellerCatch(CONFIG.ReelTimeout) end
                if not running(myCycle) then break end
				if not countedBites[bobber] then stats.bites += 1; countedBites[bobber] = true end
				updateBoard()
				status("Tug! Reeling in...", COLORS.gold)
                local reeled,inputReason,inputSent=clickOnce("reel",myCycle,mouseReels[bobber]==true)
                if RemoteCatalog.FishingInputTransport=="rod activation" then mouseReels[bobber]=true end
                if reeled or inputSent then reelAttempts[bobber]=(reelAttempts[bobber] or 0)+1 end
                if not reeled then
                    if not running(myCycle) then break end
                    status("Reel paused: "..tostring(inputReason or "input blocked")..". Bite kept; retrying.",COLORS.warn)
                    task.wait(.25)
                    continue
                end
				task.wait(CONFIG.ReelSettleDelay)
                if not running(myCycle) then break end
				status("Waiting for catch...")
				local gone = waitUntil(myCycle, CONFIG.ReelTimeout, function()
					return getBobber() == nil
				end)
				if not running(myCycle) then break end
				if gone then
					forgetBobber(bobber)
					task.wait(0.05)
                    if not running(myCycle) then break end
					local fishName
					if lastNewItem and lastNewItem.at >= reelTime then fishName = lastNewItem.name end
					registerCatch(fishName)
                    if RemoteCatalog.ConfirmPropellerCatch then RemoteCatalog.ConfirmPropellerCatch() end
                    RemoteCatalog.CompleteModeGoal("fishing")
                    if not running(myCycle) then break end
					status("Caught " .. (fishName or "a fish") .. "! 🐟", COLORS.good)
				else
                    if not countedMisses[bobber] then
                        countedMisses[bobber]=true
                        registerMiss()
                    end
					status("Reel not confirmed - retrying", COLORS.warn)
					task.wait(0.05)
				end
            else
                -- Keep a transient bite while waiting out the current action gap.
                task.wait(math.max(.01,CONFIG.ActionCooldown-(os.clock()-lastAction)))
			end
		elseif baitEnabled and RemoteCatalog.BaitPending then
            status("Applying queued bait before the next cast...",COLORS.muted)
            task.wait(.05)
        elseif not hasRodEquipped() then
            local equipped,reason=RemoteCatalog.EquipFishingRod(myCycle)
            if not running(myCycle) then break end
            status(equipped and "Fishing rod ready" or reason,equipped and COLORS.good or COLORS.warn)
            task.wait(equipped and .05 or .5)
		else
			if os.clock() - lastAction >= CONFIG.ActionCooldown then
				lastAction = os.clock()
				status("Casting...")
                local cast,inputReason,castSent=clickOnce("cast",myCycle)
				if cast or castSent then
					-- castSent: press, hold and release all went out but the post-release check failed;
					-- the server may still spawn a bobber, so never cast again on top of it.
					if cast then stats.casts += 1 end
					updateBoard()
					-- Only wait for a bobber after an actual cast input; this avoids
					-- burning the full timeout on frames where the cooldown is active.
					-- Until the bobber spawns, Auto Bait must not swap the rod out of this cast.
					RemoteCatalog.CastInFlight = true
					local waited, found = pcall(waitUntil, myCycle, CONFIG.CastTimeout, function()
						return getBobber() ~= nil
					end)
					RemoteCatalog.CastInFlight = false
					if not waited then error(found, 0) end
					if not running(myCycle) then break end
					if not found then
						failedCasts += 1
						if failedCasts >= CONFIG.MaxFailedCasts then
                            status("No bobber detected — pausing before retrying. Fishing stays ON.", COLORS.warn)
                            task.wait(2)
                            failedCasts=0
                            continue
						end
						status(string.format("No bobber (%d/%d) - retrying", failedCasts, CONFIG.MaxFailedCasts), COLORS.warn)
						 task.wait(0.03)
					end
				else
                    if not running(myCycle) then break end
					status("Cast paused: "..tostring(inputReason or "input blocked")..". Retrying.",COLORS.warn)
					task.wait(0.25)
				end
			else
				task.wait(0.02)
			end
		end
	end

	if cycleId == myCycle and not enabled then
		if not (harvestEnabled or woodEnabled or mineEnabled) then
			setStatus("Idle")
		end
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Controls
--------------------------------------------------------------------
setEnabled = function(state)
    if state and RemoteCatalog.Mobs and (RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Worker or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press) then
        RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Stop("Stopped · another mode started")
        if RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press then setStatus("Weapon release pending · press STOP in Mobs",COLORS.warn);return false end
    end
    if not state then RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow=nil;RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow=nil end
    if state and RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(false);setStatus("Wait for Auto Plow input cleanup, then start this mode",COLORS.warn);return end
    RemoteCatalog.StartFishingOnBait=false
	if state == enabled then
		return
	end

	enabled = state
    if RemoteCatalog.UpdatePropellerStatsClock then RemoteCatalog.UpdatePropellerStatsClock(enabled) end
	cycleId += 1

	if enabled then
        if RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalMenu then RemoteCatalog.PropellerGoalMenu:Close() end
        if RemoteCatalog.StartPropellerRun then RemoteCatalog.StartPropellerRun() end
        RemoteCatalog.ResetModeGoal("fishing")
		if not stats.onSince then
			stats.onSince = os.clock()
		end
		toggle.Text = "FISH ON  [" .. CONFIG.ToggleKey.Name .. "]"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.on
		RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Stop()
        if RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus then RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus(cycleId,"Fishing started...")
        else setStatus("Fishing started...") end
        task.spawn(function(token)
            local ok, failure = pcall(run, token)
            if not ok and token == cycleId then
                setEnabled(false)
                if RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus then RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus(cycleId,"Fishing stopped: "..tostring(failure),COLORS.bad)
                else setStatus("Fishing stopped: "..tostring(failure),COLORS.bad) end
            end
        end, cycleId)
	else
		toggle.Text = "FISH OFF  [" .. CONFIG.ToggleKey.Name .. "]"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.off
        if RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus then RemoteCatalog.SetFishingStatus(cycleId,"Fishing is off.",COLORS.muted,true) end
		if not (harvestEnabled or woodEnabled or mineEnabled) and stats.onSince then
			stats.activeTime += os.clock() - stats.onSince
			stats.onSince = nil
		end
		if not (harvestEnabled or woodEnabled or mineEnabled) then
			setStatus("Idle")
		end
	end

	updateBoard()
    refreshModeStatus()
end

local function refreshFarmButtons()
    harvestToggle.Text = harvestEnabled and "CROP FARM ON" or "CROP FARM OFF"
    harvestToggle.BackgroundColor3 = harvestEnabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    woodToggle.Text = woodEnabled and "WOOD FARM ON" or "WOOD FARM OFF"
    woodToggle.BackgroundColor3 = woodEnabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    mineToggle.Text = mineEnabled and "MINING ON" or "MINING OFF"
    mineToggle.BackgroundColor3 = mineEnabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
end

local function setFarmMode(mode, state)
    if state and RemoteCatalog.Mobs and (RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Worker or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press) then
        RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Stop("Stopped · another mode started")
        if RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press then setStatus("Weapon release pending · press STOP in Mobs",COLORS.warn);return false end
    end
    if state and RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(false);setStatus("Wait for Auto Plow input cleanup, then start this mode",COLORS.warn);return end
    if state and (RemoteCatalog.FishingMouseInput or RemoteCatalog.BaitMouseInput or RemoteCatalog.MobMouseInput) then setStatus("Another tool input is finishing · start this mode in a moment",COLORS.warn);return false end
    -- Resolve the requested mode explicitly. The old chained `and/or`
    -- expression could read another mode's state when this mode was off.
    local current
    if mode == "crop" then
        current = harvestEnabled
    elseif mode == "wood" then
        current = woodEnabled
    elseif mode == "mine" then
        current = mineEnabled
    else
        return
    end
    if current == state then return end
    RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Stop("Farm")
    if state then
        RemoteCatalog.ResetModeGoal(mode)
        harvestEnabled,woodEnabled,mineEnabled=false,false,false
        if FarmState and FarmState.LastFailure then FarmState.LastFailure[mode]=nil end
    end
    if mode == "crop" then harvestEnabled = state
    elseif mode == "wood" then woodEnabled = state
    else mineEnabled = state end
    if woodEnabled then RemoteCatalog.PrepareWoodLearning() else RemoteCatalog.StopWoodLearning() end
    harvestCycleId += 1
    refreshFarmButtons()
    refreshModeStatus()
    updateBoard()
    if harvestEnabled or woodEnabled or mineEnabled then
        if not stats.onSince then stats.onSince = os.clock() end
        setStatus(mode == "crop" and "Crop farming started" or mode == "wood" and "Wood farming started" or "Mining started", COLORS.good)
        task.spawn(function(token)
            local ok, failure = pcall(function()
                if mode=="wood" and state and woodEnabled and token==harvestCycleId then
                    local layout=RemoteCatalog.WoodHotbarLayout()
                    if layout then
                        local applied,reason=RemoteCatalog.CallHotbar(layout)
                        if token~=harvestCycleId or not gui.Parent then return end
                        woodStatus.Text=applied and "Wood hotbar ready. Equipping the selected axe for tree hits."
                            or "Hotbar update failed: "..tostring(reason)..". Using owned axe directly."
                    end
                end
                if token==harvestCycleId and gui.Parent then harvestLoop(token) end
            end)
            if not ok and token == harvestCycleId then
                harvestEnabled, woodEnabled, mineEnabled = false, false, false
                RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Stop("Farm")
                if not enabled and stats.onSince then stats.activeTime += os.clock() - stats.onSince;stats.onSince = nil end
                refreshFarmButtons()
                refreshModeStatus()
                updateBoard()
                setStatus("Farm stopped: " .. tostring(failure), COLORS.bad)
            end
        end, harvestCycleId)
    else
        if not enabled and stats.onSince then
            stats.activeTime += os.clock() - stats.onSince
            stats.onSince = nil
        end
        if not enabled then setStatus("Idle") end
    end
    refreshFarmButtons()
    refreshModeStatus()
    updateBoard()
    savePreferences()
end

setHarvestEnabled = function(state) setFarmMode("crop", state) end
function RemoteCatalog.StopGoalMode(mode)
    if mode=="fishing" then setEnabled(false)
    elseif mode=="mobs" then if RemoteCatalog.Mobs and RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled then RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Stop("Stopped · kill goal reached") end
    else setFarmMode(mode,false) end
end

function RemoteCatalog.StopChestLearning()
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestLearnButton then RemoteCatalog.ChestLearnButton.Text="Start learning" end
    if recorder and recorder.LearnChestOnly then
        recorder.LearnChestOnly=false;recorder.LearnChestMany=false
        if not recorder.LearnCraftOnly and not recorder.LearnWoodOnly and not recorder.LearnBaitOnly and not recorder.LearnPlowOnly and not recorder.LearnMobOnly then recorder:Stop() end
    end
end
track(RemoteCatalog.ChestLearnButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferBusy then setStatus("Wait for chest setup import/export to finish",COLORS.warn);return end
    if RemoteCatalog.SetChestAuto then RemoteCatalog.SetChestAuto(false) end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration or 0)+1
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy then setStatus("Wait for the current chest request to finish",COLORS.warn);return end
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if recorder and recorder.LearnChestOnly then
        RemoteCatalog.StopChestLearning()
        setStatus("Chest learning stopped",COLORS.warn)
        return
    end
    local other=RemoteCatalog.OtherLearning and RemoteCatalog.OtherLearning("LearnChestOnly")
    if other then setStatus(other,COLORS.warn);return end
    local ok,result=pcall(RemoteCatalog.StartCapture)
    if not ok or not result then setStatus("This host cannot learn chest calls",COLORS.warn);return end
    RemoteCatalog.Recorder=result
    result.LearnChestOnly=true;result.LearnChestMany=true;result.Active=false
    setStatus("Withdraw each item you want to collect, then press Stop learning",COLORS.good)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestLearnButton.Text="Stop learning"
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateCaptureUI()
end))
-- GAME REQUEST HEALTH BEGIN
-- Stable game requests each feature can use without learning; missing ones fall back to learning or input.
RemoteCatalog.GameRequests={{"CLIENT_CHEST_TRANSACTION","chests"},{"CLIENT_PLOW_BLOCK_REQUEST","hoe"},{"CLIENT_EAT_FOOD","bait"},
    {"CLIENT_HARVEST_CROP_REQUEST","harvest"},{"BLOCK_HIT_REQUEST","wood/mining"},{"BLOCK_PLACE_REQUEST","build/replant"},{"CLIENT_HOTBAR_LAYOUT_UPDATE","hotbar"}}
function RemoteCatalog.GameRequestHealth()
    if not RemoteCatalog.PlacementClient() then return "game Requests module unavailable · every feature uses learning or normal input" end
    local ok,missing={},{}
    for _,entry in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.GameRequests) do
        local endpoint=RemoteCatalog.GameEndpoint(entry[1])
        table.insert(endpoint and ok or missing,entry[2])
    end
    return (#ok>0 and "OK: "..table.concat(ok,", ") or "none OK")..(#missing>0 and " · missing (learn or input): "..table.concat(missing,", ") or "")
end
-- GAME REQUEST HEALTH END
-- REMEMBERED CHESTS BEGIN
-- Learned withdrawals are remembered by chest name, position on the owned island, slot and item.
-- On a new server they are found again and sent through the game's own stable
-- CLIENT_CHEST_TRANSACTION request; the run still confirms every item by inventory gain.
function RemoteCatalog.ChestIslandOffset(chest)
    local island=getPlayerIsland()
    local position=getPartPosition(chest)
    if not island or not position then return nil end
    local ok,offset=pcall(function() return island:GetPivot():PointToObjectSpace(position) end)
    return ok and offset or nil
end
function RemoteCatalog.SnapshotChestMemory(bindings)
    local list={}
    for _,binding in ipairs(bindings) do
        local offset=binding.Chest and binding.Chest.Parent and RemoteCatalog.ChestIslandOffset(binding.Chest)
        if offset and type(binding.Slot)=="number" and type(binding.Item)=="string" then
            table.insert(list,{Name=binding.Chest.Name,X=math.floor(offset.X*10+.5)/10,Y=math.floor(offset.Y*10+.5)/10,Z=math.floor(offset.Z*10+.5)/10,
                Slot=binding.Slot,Item=binding.Item,Amount=type(binding.Amount)=="number" and binding.Amount or 1})
        end
        if #list>=64 then break end
    end
    return list
end
-- Newest entries first; one entry per chest position, slot and item; at most 64.
function RemoteCatalog.MergeChestMemory(old,new)
    local merged,seen={},{}
    local function add(entry)
        local key=table.concat({entry.Name,entry.X,entry.Y,entry.Z,entry.Slot,entry.Item},"|")
        if not seen[key] and #merged<64 then seen[key]=true;table.insert(merged,entry) end
    end
    for _,entry in ipairs(new or {}) do add(entry) end
    for _,entry in ipairs(type(old)=="table" and old or {}) do add(entry) end
    return merged
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestEndpoint()
    local endpoint=RemoteCatalog.GameEndpoint("CLIENT_CHEST_TRANSACTION")
    if endpoint and type(endpoint.CallServer)=="function" then return endpoint end
end
-- Field-confirmed shape (user's working script): the stable _NetManaged remote, called directly,
-- withdraws a stack Instance from the chest's Contents folder. Stack Amount values give the count.
function RemoteCatalog.ChestTransactionRemote()
    return RemoteCatalog.FindNamed and RemoteCatalog.FindNamed("CLIENT_CHEST_TRANSACTION","RemoteFunction") or nil
end
function RemoteCatalog.StackAmount(stack)
    local value=stack and stack:FindFirstChild("Amount")
    if not value then return 1 end
    local amount=tonumber(value.Value)
    return amount and math.max(0,math.floor(amount)) or 0
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestStack(chest,item)
    local contents=chest and chest:FindFirstChild("Contents")
    if not contents then return nil end
    for _,stack in ipairs(contents:GetChildren()) do if stack.Name==item then return stack end end
end
function RemoteCatalog.SendChestWithdraw(chest,item,amount,slot,stack)
    if not (stack and stack.Parent) then stack=RemoteCatalog.ChestStack(chest,item) end
    local remote=RemoteCatalog.ChestTransactionRemote()
    if stack and remote then
        amount=math.min(amount,RemoteCatalog.StackAmount(stack))
        -- A present but empty stack: a skip decided here, never a request for 0 items.
        if amount<=0 then return false,{success=false,error="EMPTY_SLOT"},"skip" end
        -- Plain index call so the capture hook does not record the hub's own request.
        local ok,result=pcall(function()
            return remote.InvokeServer(remote,{chest=chest,player_tracking_category="join_from_web",amount=amount,tool=stack,action="withdraw"})
        end)
        if not ok then return false,result,"transport" end
        if result==false or type(result)=="table" and result.success==false then return false,result,"rejected" end
        return true,result
    end
    -- Decided locally (no stack left): origin "skip" keeps it out of the pacing statistics.
    if remote and chest and chest:FindFirstChild("Contents") then return false,{success=false,error="EMPTY_SLOT"},"skip" end
    local endpoint=RemoteCatalog.ChestEndpoint()
    if not endpoint then return false,"Game chest request unavailable · learn one withdrawal on this server","unavailable" end
    local ok,result=RemoteCatalog.SendEndpoint(endpoint,{chest=chest,slot=slot,item=item,amount=amount,action="withdraw"})
    if not ok then return false,result,"rejected" end
    return true,result
end
RemoteCatalog.ContentsSlotIds=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
RemoteCatalog.ContentsNextSlot=1000
-- Every stack in every owned chest with a readable Contents folder, without any learning.
function RemoteCatalog.ContentsChestRecorder()
    if not RemoteCatalog.ChestTransactionRemote() then return nil end
    local island=getPlayerIsland()
    local blocks=island and island:FindFirstChild("Blocks")
    if not blocks then return nil end
    local cache=RemoteCatalog.ContentsChestCache
    if cache and cache.Blocks==blocks and os.clock()-cache.At<1 then return cache.Recorder end
    local recorder={FromContents=true,ChestBindings={}}
    for _,chest in ipairs(blocks:GetChildren()) do
        local contents=chest:FindFirstChild("Contents")
        if contents and string.find(string.lower(chest.Name),"chest",1,true) then
            for _,stack in ipairs(contents:GetChildren()) do
                -- A stable id per stack (from 1001) keeps a selection on the same stack when others empty;
                -- it never collides with learned slot numbers (0–12).
                local ids=RemoteCatalog.ContentsSlotIds
                if not ids[stack] then RemoteCatalog.ContentsNextSlot+=1;ids[stack]=RemoteCatalog.ContentsNextSlot end
                local amount=RemoteCatalog.StackAmount(stack)
                if amount>0 then
                    table.insert(recorder.ChestBindings,{Chest=chest,Slot=ids[stack],Item=stack.Name,Amount=amount,
                        Stack=stack,ObservedAt=0,FromContents=true})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    recorder.ChestBinding=recorder.ChestBindings[1]
    function recorder:CanUseChestBinding(binding)
        local b=binding or self.ChestBinding
        return b~=nil and b.Chest~=nil and b.Chest.Parent~=nil and b.Stack~=nil and b.Stack.Parent~=nil and player.Character~=nil
            and RemoteCatalog.StackAmount(b.Stack)>0
    end
    function recorder:GetChestBindings()
        local result={}
        for _,binding in ipairs(self.ChestBindings) do if self:CanUseChestBinding(binding) then table.insert(result,binding) end end
        return result
    end
    function recorder:WithdrawItems(amount,binding)
        local b=binding or self.ChestBinding
        if not self:CanUseChestBinding(b) then return false,"That stack is no longer in the chest","context" end
        amount=amount==nil and RemoteCatalog.StackAmount(b.Stack) or amount
        if type(amount)~="number" or amount<=0 or amount%1~=0 or amount>1000000 then return false,"Choose a positive whole withdrawal amount","invalid" end
        return RemoteCatalog.SendChestWithdraw(b.Chest,b.Item,amount,b.Slot,b.Stack)
    end
    recorder.WithdrawCarrots=recorder.WithdrawItems
    RemoteCatalog.ContentsChestCache={Blocks=blocks,At=os.clock(),Recorder=recorder}
    return recorder
end
function RemoteCatalog.RememberedChestRecorder()
    local memory=CONFIG.RememberedChests
    if type(memory)~="table" or #memory==0 or not (RemoteCatalog.ChestTransactionRemote() or RemoteCatalog.ChestEndpoint()) then return nil end
    local island=getPlayerIsland()
    local blocks=island and island:FindFirstChild("Blocks")
    if not blocks then return nil end
    local cache=RemoteCatalog.RememberedChestCache
    if cache and cache.Blocks==blocks and cache.Memory==memory and os.clock()-cache.At<2 then return cache.Recorder end
    local recorder={Remembered=true,ChestBindings={}}
    for _,chest in ipairs(blocks:GetChildren()) do
        local offset
        for _,entry in ipairs(memory) do
            if chest.Name==entry.Name then
                offset=offset or RemoteCatalog.ChestIslandOffset(chest)
                if offset and math.abs(offset.X-entry.X)<1 and math.abs(offset.Y-entry.Y)<1 and math.abs(offset.Z-entry.Z)<1 then
                    table.insert(recorder.ChestBindings,{Chest=chest,Slot=entry.Slot,Item=entry.Item,Amount=entry.Amount,ObservedAt=0,Remembered=true})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    recorder.ChestBinding=recorder.ChestBindings[1]
    function recorder:CanUseChestBinding(binding)
        local b=binding or self.ChestBinding
        return b~=nil and b.Chest~=nil and b.Chest.Parent~=nil and player.Character~=nil
    end
    function recorder:GetChestBindings()
        local result={}
        for _,binding in ipairs(self.ChestBindings) do if self:CanUseChestBinding(binding) then table.insert(result,binding) end end
        return result
    end
    function recorder:MakeChestTarget(binding,chest,slot)
        if typeof(chest)~="Instance" or not chest.Parent or chest.Name~=binding.Chest.Name then return nil end
        if type(slot)~="number" or slot<0 or slot>12 or slot%1~=0 then return nil end
        return {Chest=chest,Slot=slot,Item=binding.Item,Amount=binding.Amount,ObservedAt=0,Remembered=true,Generated=true}
    end
    function recorder:WithdrawItems(amount,binding)
        local b=binding or self.ChestBinding
        if not self:CanUseChestBinding(b) then return false,"Remembered chest is unavailable","context" end
        amount=amount==nil and b.Amount or amount
        if type(amount)~="number" or amount<=0 or amount%1~=0 or amount>1000000 then return false,"Choose a positive whole withdrawal amount","invalid" end
        return RemoteCatalog.SendChestWithdraw(b.Chest,b.Item,amount,b.Slot)
    end
    recorder.WithdrawCarrots=recorder.WithdrawItems
    RemoteCatalog.RememberedChestCache={Blocks=blocks,Memory=memory,At=os.clock(),Recorder=recorder}
    return recorder
end
-- REMEMBERED CHESTS END

-- CHEST CONVEYOR GUARD BEGIN
function RemoteCatalog.ChestConveyorProtected(binding)
    local chest=binding and binding.Chest
    return RemoteCatalog.ChestIncludeConveyor~=true and chest~=nil and type(chest.Name)=="string"
        and string.lower(chest.Name)=="chestmediumindustrialio"
end
-- CHEST EXCLUSIONS BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.ChestExcludedChests=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
RemoteCatalog.ChestPriorities=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
function RemoteCatalog.ChestIsExcluded(binding)
    local chest=binding and binding.Chest
    return chest~=nil and RemoteCatalog.ChestExcludedChests[chest]==true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestTargetProtected(binding)
    return RemoteCatalog.ChestIsExcluded(binding) or RemoteCatalog.ChestConveyorProtected(binding)
end
-- CHEST EXCLUSIONS END
-- CHEST CONVEYOR GUARD END
function RemoteCatalog.ChestTargets()
    local recorders={}
    if RemoteCatalog.Recorder then table.insert(recorders,RemoteCatalog.Recorder) end
    local ok,other=pcall(function() return (type(getgenv)=="function" and getgenv() or _G).RebornCapture end)
    if ok and other and other~=RemoteCatalog.Recorder then table.insert(recorders,other) end
    if #recorders==0 then
        local fallback=RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("ChestBinding")
        if fallback then table.insert(recorders,fallback) end
    end
    -- Remembered and Contents last: live learned bindings for the same chest are newer and win.
    local remembered=RemoteCatalog.RememberedChestRecorder and RemoteCatalog.RememberedChestRecorder()
    if remembered then table.insert(recorders,remembered) end
    -- Contents stacks need no learning and are offered in every scope; Scope only limits template discovery.
    local contents=RemoteCatalog.ContentsChestRecorder and RemoteCatalog.ContentsChestRecorder()
    if contents then table.insert(recorders,contents) end
    local targets={}
    for _,recorder in ipairs(recorders) do
        local bindings=recorder.GetChestBindings and recorder:GetChestBindings() or (recorder.ChestBinding and {recorder.ChestBinding} or {})
        for _,binding in ipairs(bindings) do
            if recorder.CanUseChestBinding and recorder:CanUseChestBinding(binding) then
                local duplicate=false
                if binding.FromContents then
                    for _,entry in ipairs(targets) do
                        if entry.Binding.Chest==binding.Chest and (entry.Binding.Item or "carrotHarvested")==binding.Item then duplicate=true;break end
                    end
                end
                for i,entry in ipairs(targets) do
                    if entry.Binding.Chest==binding.Chest and entry.Binding.Slot==binding.Slot then
                        duplicate=true
                        if (binding.ObservedAt or 0)>(entry.Binding.ObservedAt or 0) then targets[i]={Recorder=recorder,Binding=binding} end
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not duplicate then table.insert(targets,{Recorder=recorder,Binding=binding}) end
            end
        end
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestDiscover then
        local island=getPlayerIsland()
        local blocks=island and island:FindFirstChild("Blocks")
        local char=player.Character
        local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if blocks and root then
            local templates=table.clone(targets)
            -- Prefer the newest packet when one item was observed in multiple slots.
            table.sort(templates,function(a,b) return (a.Binding.ObservedAt or 0)>(b.Binding.ObservedAt or 0) end)
            for _,chest in ipairs(blocks:GetChildren()) do
                for _,entry in ipairs(templates) do
                    local binding=entry.Binding
                    if entry.Recorder.MakeChestTarget and chest.Name==binding.Chest.Name then
                        local exists=false
                        for _,known in ipairs(targets) do if known.Binding.Chest==chest and (known.Binding.Item or "carrotHarvested")== (binding.Item or "carrotHarvested") then exists=true;break end end
                        local position=getPartPosition(chest)
                        if not exists and position and (position-root.Position).Magnitude<=RemoteCatalog.ChestScanRange then
                            local generated=entry.Recorder:MakeChestTarget(binding,chest,binding.Slot)
                            if generated then table.insert(targets,{Recorder=entry.Recorder,Binding=generated}) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return targets
end
function RemoteCatalog.SelectedChestTargets(includeProtected)
    local targets,seen={},{}
    local candidates=RemoteCatalog.ChestTargets()
    local newest={}
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestWhole then
        for _,entry in ipairs(candidates) do
            local binding=entry.Binding
            local item=binding.Item or "carrotHarvested"
            newest[binding.Chest]=newest[binding.Chest] or {}
            local old=newest[binding.Chest][item]
            if not old or (binding.ObservedAt or 0)>(old.Binding.ObservedAt or 0) then newest[binding.Chest][item]=entry end
        end
    end
    for _,entry in ipairs(candidates) do
        local binding=entry.Binding
        local selected=RemoteCatalog.ChestSelection
        local item=binding.Item or "carrotHarvested"
        -- A Contents stack gets a new slot id every refill, so a selected stack is matched by item.
        local chosen=not selected or selected.Chest==binding.Chest and (RemoteCatalog.ChestWhole or selected.Slot==binding.Slot or (binding.FromContents or selected.FromContents) and selected.Item~=nil and selected.Item==item)
        if (includeProtected==true or not RemoteCatalog.ChestTargetProtected(binding)) and (not RemoteCatalog.ChestItems or RemoteCatalog.ChestItems[item]) and (not RemoteCatalog.ChestItem or RemoteCatalog.ChestItem==item) and chosen then
            if RemoteCatalog.ChestWhole and entry.Recorder.MakeChestTarget and string.lower(binding.Chest.Name)=="chestmediumindustrialio" then
                seen[binding.Chest]=seen[binding.Chest] or {}
                if newest[binding.Chest][item]==entry and not seen[binding.Chest][item] then
                    seen[binding.Chest][item]=true
                    local slots={}
                    if type(binding.Slot)=="number" and binding.Slot>=0 and binding.Slot<=12 and binding.Slot%1==0 then table.insert(slots,binding.Slot) end
                    for slot=0,12 do if slot~=binding.Slot then table.insert(slots,slot) end end
                    for _,slot in ipairs(slots) do
                        local generated=entry.Recorder:MakeChestTarget(binding,binding.Chest,slot)
                        if generated then generated.Probe=true;table.insert(targets,{Recorder=entry.Recorder,Binding=generated}) end
                    end
                end
            else
                table.insert(targets,entry)
            end
        end
    end
    local char=player.Character
    local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local order,distances={},{}
    for index,entry in ipairs(targets) do
        order[entry]=index
        local position=RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel~="Stay" and root and getPartPosition(entry.Binding.Chest)
        distances[entry]=position and (position-root.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
    end
    table.sort(targets,function(a,b)
        local ap,bp=RemoteCatalog.ChestPriorities[a.Binding.Chest] or 0,RemoteCatalog.ChestPriorities[b.Binding.Chest] or 0
        if ap~=bp then return ap>bp end
        local ad,bd=distances[a],distances[b]
        return ad<bd or ad==bd and order[a]<order[b]
    end)
    return targets
end
-- Highest priority first, then nearest to where the character stands now.
function RemoteCatalog.NearestChestState(states)
    local char=player.Character
    local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local best,bestPriority,bestDistance
    for index,state in ipairs(states) do
        if not state.Done and not state.Waiting then
            local chest=state.Binding.Chest
            local priority=(RemoteCatalog.ChestPriorities or {})[chest] or 0
            local position=root and chest and getPartPosition(chest)
            local distance=position and (position-root.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
            if not best or priority>bestPriority or priority==bestPriority and distance<bestDistance then
                best,bestPriority,bestDistance=index,priority,distance
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end
-- CHEST TARGETS END
-- CHEST EXCLUSION UI LOGIC BEGIN
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestExclusions()
    if not gui.Parent or not RemoteCatalog.ChestExclusionButton then return end
    local count=0;for _ in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestExcludedChests) do count+=1 end
    local selected=RemoteCatalog.ChestSelection
    local chest=selected and selected.Chest
    local excluded=RemoteCatalog.ChestIsExcluded(selected)
    local locked=RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled or RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker~=nil or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy or RemoteCatalog.ChestManualRunning
    local available=not locked and chest~=nil and chest.Parent~=nil
    for priority,control in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestPriorityButtons or {}) do
        local chosen=chest~=nil and (RemoteCatalog.ChestPriorities[chest] or 0)==priority
        control.Text=(chosen and "✓ " or "")..(priority==1 and "First" or priority==-1 and "Last" or "Normal")
        control.Active=available==true;control.Selectable=available==true
        control.BackgroundColor3=chosen and COLORS.on or COLORS.panel
        control.TextColor3=available and COLORS.text or COLORS.muted
    end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestExclusionButton.Text=not chest and "Choose one chest above" or excluded and "Allow selected chest" or "Exclude selected chest"
    RemoteCatalog.ChestExclusionButton.Active=available==true
    RemoteCatalog.ChestExclusionButton.Selectable=available==true
    RemoteCatalog.ChestExclusionButton.AutoButtonColor=available==true
    RemoteCatalog.ChestExclusionButton.TextColor3=available and COLORS.text or COLORS.muted
    RemoteCatalog.ChestExclusionButton.BackgroundColor3=excluded and COLORS.on or COLORS.panel
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestExclusionSummary then
        RemoteCatalog.ChestExclusionSummary.Text=count.." excluded chests · this hub session only. "..(locked and "Stop collection and wait for cleanup to edit." or not chest and "Choose a single chest in Targets, then exclude it." or excluded and "Selected chest: EXCLUDED, all slots/items." or "Selected chest: allowed by this list; conveyor protection still applies.")
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetChestExcluded(chest,excluded)
    if not gui.Parent or type(excluded)~="boolean" then return false,"Chest protection is unavailable" end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled or RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy or RemoteCatalog.ChestManualRunning then return false,"Stop collection and wait for cleanup before editing exclusions" end
    local known=false
    for _,entry in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestTargets()) do if entry.Binding.Chest==chest then known=true;break end end
    if not known or not chest or not chest.Parent then return false,"Choose a current individual chest in Targets first" end
    local island=getPlayerIsland()
    local cursor=chest
    while cursor and cursor~=island do cursor=cursor.Parent end
    if not island or cursor~=island then return false,"Choose a chest on your own island" end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestExcludedChests[chest]=excluded and true or nil
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateChestSelectionUI()
    RemoteCatalog.PreviewChestSelection()
    return true,excluded and "Selected chest excluded: all slots/items are protected from Auto Take and manual hub withdrawal for this hub session." or "Selected chest allowed again. Conveyor Skip still applies. Collection stays OFF."
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetChestPriority(chest,priority)
    if not gui.Parent or (priority~=-1 and priority~=0 and priority~=1) then return false,"Choose First, Normal or Last" end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled or RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy or RemoteCatalog.ChestManualRunning then return false,"Stop collection and wait for cleanup before editing priority" end
    local known=false
    for _,entry in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestTargets()) do if entry.Binding.Chest==chest then known=true;break end end
    if not known or not chest or not chest.Parent then return false,"Choose a current individual chest in Targets first" end
    local island=getPlayerIsland();local cursor=chest
    while cursor and cursor~=island do cursor=cursor.Parent end
    if not island or cursor~=island then return false,"Choose a chest on your own island" end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestPriorities[chest]=priority~=0 and priority or nil
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus();RemoteCatalog.UpdateChestSelectionUI();RemoteCatalog.PreviewChestSelection()
    return true,"Chest priority: "..(priority==1 and "First" or priority==-1 and "Last" or "Normal")..". Applies to all slots/items; exclusions still apply. Session only."
end
-- CHEST EXCLUSION UI LOGIC END

function RemoteCatalog.ChestItemSelectionText()
    if not RemoteCatalog.ChestItems then return "All learned" end
    local items={}
    for item,selected in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestItems) do if selected then table.insert(items,item) end end
    table.sort(items)
    return #items==0 and "None selected" or #items==1 and items[1] or #items.." selected"
end
function RemoteCatalog.ToggleChestItems()
    local menu=RemoteCatalog.ChestItemMenu
    if menu.Visible then RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus();return end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    for _,connection in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestItemConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(RemoteCatalog.ChestItemConnections)
    for _,child in ipairs(menu:GetChildren()) do child:Destroy() end
    local items,seen,options={},{},{}
    for _,entry in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestTargets()) do
        local item=entry.Binding.Item or "carrotHarvested"
        if not seen[item] then seen[item]=true;table.insert(items,item) end
    end
    table.sort(items)
    local search=Instance.new("TextBox")
    search.Name="ItemSearch";search.Text="";search.PlaceholderText="Search learned items…"
    search.ClearTextOnFocus=false;search.TextSize=14;search.TextColor3=COLORS.text
    search.BackgroundColor3=COLORS.panel;search.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,30);search.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,2)
    search.ZIndex=41;search.Parent=menu;RemoteCatalog.ChestItemSearch=search
    local empty=label({Parent=menu,Text="No matching items. Your selection is unchanged.",TextSize=12,Color=COLORS.muted,
        Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,44),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,68)})
    empty.ZIndex=41;empty.TextWrapped=true
    local none,done
    local function refresh()
        local query=string.lower(search.Text):gsub("[%s_%-]", "")
        local row,shown=36,0
        for index=0,#items do
            local option,item=options[index],items[index]
            local selected=index==0 and not RemoteCatalog.ChestItems or index>0 and RemoteCatalog.ChestItems and RemoteCatalog.ChestItems[item]
            option.Text=(selected and "✓ " or "")..(item or "All learned items")
            option.BackgroundColor3=selected and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
            option.Visible=index==0 or string.find(string.lower(item):gsub("[%s_%-]", ""),query,1,true)~=nil
            if option.Visible then
                option.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,row);row+=32
                if item then shown+=1 end
            end
        end
        empty.Visible=shown==0
        if empty.Visible then empty.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,row);row+=46 end
        none.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,row);done.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,row+32)
        menu.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,math.min(256,row+64))
        RemoteCatalog.ChestItemButton.Text="Items: "..RemoteCatalog.ChestItemSelectionText().."  ▾"
        RemoteCatalog.LayoutChestControls()
    end
    for index=0,#items do
        local item=items[index]
        local option=button({Parent=menu,Text="",TextSize=12,Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,30),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,36+index*32)})
        option.ZIndex=41;options[index]=option
        table.insert(RemoteCatalog.ChestItemConnections,option.Activated:Connect(function()
            RemoteCatalog.SetChestAuto(false)
            RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration or 0)+1
            RemoteCatalog.ChestItem=nil
            if not item then RemoteCatalog.ChestItems=nil
            else
                RemoteCatalog.ChestItems=RemoteCatalog.ChestItems or {}
                if RemoteCatalog.ChestItems[item] then RemoteCatalog.ChestItems[item]=nil else RemoteCatalog.ChestItems[item]=true end
            end
            refresh();RemoteCatalog.UpdateChestSelectionUI()
        end))
    end
    none=button({Parent=menu,Text="Select none",TextSize=12,Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,30)})
    none.ZIndex=41
    table.insert(RemoteCatalog.ChestItemConnections,none.Activated:Connect(function()
        RemoteCatalog.SetChestAuto(false)
        RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration or 0)+1
        RemoteCatalog.ChestItem=nil;RemoteCatalog.ChestItems={}
        refresh();RemoteCatalog.UpdateChestSelectionUI()
    end))
    done=button({Parent=menu,Text="Done",TextSize=12,Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,30)})
    done.ZIndex=41
    table.insert(RemoteCatalog.ChestItemConnections,done.Activated:Connect(RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus))
    table.insert(RemoteCatalog.ChestItemConnections,search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        refresh();menu.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero
    end))
    menu.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero;menu.Visible=true;refresh()
end
function RemoteCatalog.PreviewChestSelection()
    local targets=RemoteCatalog.SelectedChestTargets()
    local chests,items={},{}
    local count,ready=0,0
    local reasons,reasonOrder={},{}
    for _,entry in ipairs(targets) do
        local binding=entry.Binding
        if not chests[binding.Chest] then chests[binding.Chest]=true;count+=1 end
        items[binding.Item or "carrotHarvested"]=true
        local available,reason=RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestReady(binding)
        if available then ready+=1
        else
            reason=tostring(reason or "Unavailable")
            if not reasons[reason] then reasons[reason]=0;table.insert(reasonOrder,reason) end
            reasons[reason]+=1
        end
    end
    local names={}
    for name in pairs(items) do table.insert(names,name) end
    table.sort(names)
    local itemCount=#names
    while #names>4 do table.remove(names) end
    local protected,excluded={},{}
    for _,entry in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.SelectedChestTargets(true)) do
        if RemoteCatalog.ChestConveyorProtected(entry.Binding) then protected[entry.Binding.Chest]=true end
        if RemoteCatalog.ChestIsExcluded(entry.Binding) then excluded[entry.Binding.Chest]=true end
    end
    local protectedCount=0;for _ in pairs(protected) do protectedCount+=1 end
    local excludedCount=0;for _ in pairs(excluded) do excludedCount+=1 end
    local text=#targets==0 and (excludedCount>0 and "No eligible targets: selected chests are explicitly excluded. Use Allow selected chest in Chest protection to undo." or protectedCount>0 and "No eligible targets: selected conveyor I/O chests are skipped. Set Conveyor I/O chests: Include only if you want to withdraw from them." or "No targets selected. Learn a withdrawal and choose items first.") or
        (count.." chests · "..#targets.." slot checks · "..itemCount.." item types\n"..
        ready.." checks in reach; "..(#targets-ready).." need approach or attention.\n"..
        table.concat(names,", ")..(itemCount>4 and " …" or "").."\nInventory contents remain unknown until withdrawal.")
    text..="\nConveyor I/O chests: "..(RemoteCatalog.ChestIncludeConveyor and "Include; withdrawals can compete with the belt." or ("Skip; "..protectedCount.." selected chests protected. Manual hub withdrawal also skips them."))
    text..="\nExplicit exclusions: "..excludedCount.." selected chests; all slots/items protected from Auto Take and manual hub withdrawal. This hub session only."
    for index,reason in ipairs(reasonOrder) do
        if index>3 then text..="\nMore blocked checks: refresh after resolving the above.";break end
        text..="\n"..reasons[reason].." checks: "..reason
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestStockTarget then
        text..="\nAuto top-up: "..RemoteCatalog.ChestStockTarget.." of each item (manual batch unchanged)."
        for _,item in ipairs(names) do
            local ok,current=pcall(RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount,item)
            text..="\n"..item..": "..(ok and current~=nil and (current.." in inventory; "..math.max(0,RemoteCatalog.ChestStockTarget-current).." missing") or "inventory count unavailable")
        end
    end
    text..=RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeat and "\nRun: Repeat; wait 2 seconds between passes. Stop cancels. The combined goal applies to the whole run." or "\nRun: One pass; stop after the selected checks."
    text..="\nAuto batch: "..(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoBatch=="Max" and "adaptive 30–1000; grows only after confirmed full transfers" or tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoBatch or 30))..". TOO_FAST waits and retries the same batch."
    text..="\nChest priority: First → Normal → Last; Walk uses distance within each priority. Balance chests still rotates after each confirmed batch. Session only."
    text..="\nOrder: "..(RemoteCatalog.ChestOrder=="Balance chests" and "Balance chests; give another chest a turn after each confirmed batch. Retries stay on their slot." or "Same stack; drain the current stack before moving on.")
    RemoteCatalog.ChestPlanLabel.Text=text
    RemoteCatalog.ChestPlanView.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero
    return text
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestReady(binding)
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferBusy then return false,"Wait for chest setup import/export to finish" end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestIsExcluded(binding) then return false,"This chest is explicitly excluded for this hub session. Choose it in Targets and Allow selected chest to undo." end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestConveyorProtected(binding) then return false,"Conveyor I/O chest skipped. Choose Include to withdraw from it." end
    local chest=binding and binding.Chest
    local island=getPlayerIsland()
    local cursor=chest
    while cursor and cursor~=island do cursor=cursor.Parent end
    if not island or cursor~=island then return false,"The learned chest is not on your island" end
    local char=player.Character
    local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local position=getPartPosition(chest)
    if not root or not position or (position-root.Position).Magnitude>20 then
        return false,"Stand within 20 studs of the learned chest"
    end
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.WithdrawCarrots(amount,recorder,binding)
    if not recorder then
        local target=RemoteCatalog.SelectedChestTargets()[1]
        recorder=target and target.Recorder
        binding=target and target.Binding
    end
    if not recorder or not recorder.CanUseChestBinding or not recorder:CanUseChestBinding(binding) then
        return false,"Learn an item withdrawal on this character first","context"
    end
    binding=binding or recorder.ChestBinding
    local ready,reason=RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestReady(binding)
    if not ready then return false,reason,"blocked" end
    return (recorder.WithdrawItems or recorder.WithdrawCarrots)(recorder,amount or (RemoteCatalog.ChestAmount=="Learned" and binding.Amount or RemoteCatalog.ChestAmount),binding)
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(value)
    local seen={}
    local function describe(v,depth)
        if type(v)~="table" then return tostring(v):sub(1,200) end
        if seen[v] then return "[cycle]" end
        if depth>3 then return "[nested response]" end
        seen[v]=true
        local parts={}
        for _,key in ipairs({"message","error","reason","code","success","value"}) do
            if v[key]~=nil then table.insert(parts,tostring(key).."="..describe(v[key],depth+1)) end
        end
        if #parts==0 then
            for key,item in pairs(v) do
                table.insert(parts,tostring(key):sub(1,60).."="..describe(item,depth+1))
                if #parts>=6 then break end
            end
        end
        return "{"..table.concat(parts,", ").."}"
    end
    return describe(value,0):sub(1,600)
end
track(RemoteCatalog.ChestCopyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    local detail=RemoteCatalog.ChestLastDetail or "No chest request sent yet"
    local copy=setclipboard or toclipboard
    if type(copy)=="function" and pcall(copy,detail) then setStatus("Chest result copied",COLORS.good)
    else print(detail);setStatus("Chest result printed to console",COLORS.warn) end
end))
function RemoteCatalog.ApproachChest(recorder,active,binding)
    if not recorder:CanUseChestBinding(binding) then return false,"Learn this chest again" end
    binding=binding or recorder.ChestBinding
    local chest=binding.Chest
    local island=getPlayerIsland()
    local cursor=chest
    while cursor and cursor~=island do cursor=cursor.Parent end
    if not island or cursor~=island then return false,"The learned chest is not on your island" end
    local char=player.Character
    local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local position=getPartPosition(chest)
    if not root or not position then return false,"Waiting for your character and chest" end
    local distance=(position-root.Position).Magnitude
    if distance<=20 then return true end
    if distance>RemoteCatalog.ChestScanRange then return false,"Chest is outside approach range; move closer or increase the range" end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel=="Stay" then return false,"Stay mode: stand within 20 studs. Approach range controls walking only." end
    if harvestEnabled and CONFIG.HarvestWalk or woodEnabled and CONFIG.WoodTravelMode~="Normal" or mineEnabled then
        return false,"Pause other farming movement before walking to the chest"
    end
    local mode=RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel
    return RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Approach(player,chest,12,function()
        return active() and RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel==mode and recorder:CanUseChestBinding(binding)
    end,getPartPosition,mode=="Hop" and "Hop" or "Walk","Chest")
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestTargetLabel(binding,all)
    local seen,count={},0
    for _,entry in ipairs(all) do
        local chest=entry.Binding.Chest
        if not seen[chest] then count+=1;seen[chest]=count end
        if chest==binding.Chest then
            local priority=RemoteCatalog.ChestPriorities[chest] or 0
            return "Chest #"..seen[chest]..(RemoteCatalog.ChestWhole and " · whole chest" or binding.FromContents and (" · "..tostring(binding.Item)) or " · slot "..tostring(binding.Slot or "?"))..
                (priority==1 and " · FIRST" or priority==-1 and " · LAST" or "")..(RemoteCatalog.ChestIsExcluded(binding) and " · EXCLUDED" or "")
        end
    end
    return "Unavailable chest"
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestManualCaption()
    local targets=RemoteCatalog.SelectedChestTargets()
    if #targets==0 then return "Learn / select items first" end
    local amount=RemoteCatalog.ChestAmount
    if amount=="Learned" then
        amount=targets[1].Binding.Amount
        for _,entry in ipairs(targets) do if entry.Binding.Amount~=amount then return "Withdraw learned batches" end end
    end
    return "Withdraw ×"..tostring(amount)
end
function RemoteCatalog.UpdateChestSelectionUI()
    local all=RemoteCatalog.ChestTargets()
    local seen,count={},0
    for _,entry in ipairs(all) do if not seen[entry.Binding.Chest] then seen[entry.Binding.Chest]=true;count+=1 end end
    local selected=RemoteCatalog.ChestSelection
    local text=(RemoteCatalog.ChestDiscover and "All matching chests" or "All learned chests").." ("..count..")"
    if selected then
        text="Choose a chest again"
        for _,entry in ipairs(all) do
            if entry.Binding.Chest==selected.Chest and (entry.Binding.Slot==selected.Slot or (entry.Binding.FromContents or selected.FromContents) and selected.Item~=nil and selected.Item==entry.Binding.Item) then text=RemoteCatalog.ChestTargetLabel(entry.Binding,all);break end
        end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestSelectButton.Text=text.."  ▾"
    RemoteCatalog.ChestStats.CHESTS.Text=tostring(count)
    local learned=0
    for _,entry in ipairs(all) do if not entry.Binding.Generated then learned+=1 end end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestStats.SLOTS.Text=tostring(learned)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestStats["AUTO COLLECTED"].Text=tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal or 0)
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
    local learning=RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnChestOnly
    RemoteCatalog.ChestLearnButton.Text=learning and "Stop learning" or "Start learning"
    RemoteCatalog.ChestLearnButton.BackgroundColor3=learning and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
end
