        end))
    end
    menu.Visible=true
    RemoteCatalog.LayoutChestControls()
end))
function RemoteCatalog.WithdrawSelectedCarrots(generation)
    -- A withdrawal into a stack being deposited would break both confirmations.
    if RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy then return false,"Wait for the current deposit to finish" end
    local targets=RemoteCatalog.SelectedChestTargets()
    local details,checked={},{}
    local sent,skipped=0,0
    local pause=RemoteCatalog.ChestSpeed=="Fast" and .1 or .25
    for i,entry in ipairs(targets) do
        if not gui.Parent or generation and RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration~=generation then break end
        local chest=entry.Binding.Chest
        if not checked[chest] then
            local ready,reason=RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestReady(entry.Binding)
            checked[chest]={Ready=ready,Reason=reason}
        end
        local ready=checked[chest]
        local ran,ok,result=true,false,ready.Reason
        if ready.Ready then
            local function active() return gui.Parent~=nil and (not generation or RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration==generation) end
            for attempt=1,5 do
                if RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestAt and (RemoteCatalog.ChestRateDelay or 0)>pause then
                    if not RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInterval(RemoteCatalog.ChestRateDelay,active,nil,"pace") then return false,"Withdrawal stopped" end
                end
                if not gui.Parent or generation and RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration~=generation then return false,"Withdrawal stopped" end
                local gap=RemoteCatalog.MarkChestRequest()
                local origin
                ran,ok,result,origin=pcall(RemoteCatalog.WithdrawCarrots,nil,entry.Recorder,entry.Binding)
                if not ran then ok,result,origin=false,ok,"transport" end
                local kind=RemoteCatalog.ChestFailureKind(result,origin)
                if not ok and kind~="amount" and kind~="skip" and kind~="rate" then
                    RemoteCatalog.ObserveChestPace(false,nil,pause)
                    return false,"Withdrawal stopped at check "..i.."/"..#targets.."; "..sent.." earlier requests sent. Check inventory/result before restarting. "..RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(result)
                end
                if ok or not RemoteCatalog.ChestTooFast(result) then
                    if ran then RemoteCatalog.ObserveChestPace(ok,result,pause,gap,origin) else RemoteCatalog.ObserveChestPace(false,nil,pause) end
                    break
                end
                if attempt==5 then return false,"Server keeps returning TOO_FAST; stopped after five attempts without reducing the batch" end
                if not RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInterval(RemoteCatalog.ChestBackoff(gap),active) then return false,"Withdrawal stopped" end
            end
        end
        if ok then sent+=1 else skipped+=1 end
        if #details<4 and (ready.Ready or not ready.Reported) then
            table.insert(details,"Check "..i..": "..(ok and "request sent" or RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(result)))
        end
        ready.Reported=true
        RemoteCatalog.ChestManualProgress=i.."/"..#targets.." checks"
        RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
        if ready.Ready and i<#targets then
            local delay=math.max(pause,RemoteCatalog.ChestRateDelay or 0)
            if delay>pause then
                local function active() return gui.Parent~=nil and (not generation or RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration==generation) end
                if not RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInterval(delay,active,nil,"pace") then break end
            else task.wait(pause) end
        end
    end
    if #targets==0 then return false,"No eligible chest targets. Learn/select a chest and check explicit exclusions and conveyor protection." end
    return sent>0,"Sent "..sent.."/"..#targets.." requests; "..skipped.." skipped or rejected. Check inventory. "..table.concat(details,"; ")
end
-- CHEST PROFILES BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.ChestProfiles={}
RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilePersistence={}
RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileSlot=1
RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileOwner=player.UserId
function RemoteCatalog.ValidateChestProfile(data)
    assert(type(data)=="table" and data.Version==1,"Unsupported chest profile version")
    assert(type(data.Name)=="string" and #data.Name>=1 and #data.Name<=48 and data.Name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")==data.Name and not data.Name:find("[%c]"),"Use a profile name of 1–48 bytes")
    assert(data.ItemMode=="All" or data.ItemMode=="Selected","Invalid profile item mode")
    assert(type(data.Items)=="table" and #data.Items<=64,"Profiles support up to 64 selected items")
    local items,seen,count={},{},0
    for index in pairs(data.Items) do
        assert(type(index)=="number" and index%1==0 and index>=1 and index<=#data.Items,"Invalid profile item list")
        count+=1
    end
    assert(count==#data.Items and (data.ItemMode~="All" or count==0),"Invalid profile item list")
    for _,item in ipairs(data.Items) do
        assert(type(item)=="string" and #item>=1 and #item<=128 and item:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")==item and not item:find("[%c]") and not seen[item],"Invalid profile item name")
        seen[item]=true;table.insert(items,item)
    end
    table.sort(items)
    assert(type(data.Discover)=="boolean" and type(data.Whole)=="boolean","Invalid profile scope")
    assert(data.Speed=="Standard" or data.Speed=="Fast","Invalid profile pace")
    assert(data.Travel=="Stay" or data.Travel=="Walk" or data.Travel=="Hop","Invalid profile movement")
    assert(data.Range==30 or data.Range==60 or data.Range==120 or data.Range==240,"Invalid profile range")
    assert(data.Goal==0 or data.Goal==25 or data.Goal==50 or data.Goal==100 or data.Goal==250 or data.Goal==500,"Invalid profile goal")
    local stock=data.StockTarget==nil and 0 or data.StockTarget
    assert(stock==0 or stock==25 or stock==50 or stock==100 or stock==250 or stock==500,"Invalid inventory top-up target")
    assert(data.Repeat==nil or type(data.Repeat)=="boolean","Invalid repeat preference")
    assert(data.RepeatFast==nil or type(data.RepeatFast)=="boolean","Invalid repeat speed")
    local batch=data.AutoBatch==nil and 30 or data.AutoBatch
    assert(batch=="Max" or batch==30 or batch==60 or batch==100 or batch==250 or batch==500 or batch==1000,"Invalid auto batch")
    local order=data.Order==nil and "Same stack" or data.Order
    assert(order=="Same stack" or order=="Balance chests","Invalid chest order")
    return {Version=1,Name=data.Name,ItemMode=data.ItemMode,Items=items,Discover=data.Discover,Whole=data.Whole,
        Speed=data.Speed,Travel=data.Travel,Range=data.Range,Goal=data.Goal,StockTarget=stock,Repeat=data.Repeat==true,RepeatFast=data.RepeatFast==true,AutoBatch=batch,Order=order}
end
function RemoteCatalog.ValidateChestProfiles(data)
    assert(type(data)=="table" and data.Version==1 and type(data.Profiles)=="table","Invalid chest profiles file")
    local result={}
    for key,profile in pairs(data.Profiles) do
        assert(key=="1" or key=="2" or key=="3","Invalid chest profile slot")
        result[tonumber(key)]=RemoteCatalog.ValidateChestProfile(profile)
    end
    return result
end
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestProfiles()
    local slot=RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileSlot
    local profile=RemoteCatalog.ChestProfiles[slot]
    RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileSlotButton.Text="Profile: "..slot.." / 3"
    if profile then
        local items=profile.ItemMode=="All" and "All learned items" or #profile.Items==0 and "No items selected" or #profile.Items.." selected items"
        RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileSummary.Text=profile.Name.." · "..(RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilePersistence[slot] or "Session only").."\n"..items.." · "..profile.Speed.." · "..(profile.Travel=="Hop" and "TP hops" or profile.Travel).."\n"..(profile.Discover and "All matching" or "Learned only").." · "..(profile.Whole and "Whole chest" or "Learned slots").." · Goal "..(profile.Goal==0 and "Unlimited" or profile.Goal).." · Top-up/item "..((profile.StockTarget or 0)==0 and "OFF" or profile.StockTarget)..(profile.Repeat and (profile.RepeatFast and " · Repeat 0.5s" or " · Repeat 2s") or " · One pass")
    else
        RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileSummary.Text="Empty profile "..slot..". "..(RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesFileState or "Session only").."\nSave current settings here (overwrites this slot). Load never starts collecting."
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.ReadChestProfiles()
    if type(readfile)~="function" then RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesFileState="File reading unavailable";return false end
    local ok,result=pcall(function()
        local encoded=readfile("RebornChestProfiles_"..tostring(player.UserId)..".json")
        assert(type(encoded)=="string" and #encoded<=65536,"Invalid chest profiles file size")
        return RemoteCatalog.ValidateChestProfiles(HttpService:JSONDecode(encoded))
    end)
    if not ok then RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesFileState="File missing or invalid; session settings retained";return false end
    for slot,profile in pairs(result) do
        if not RemoteCatalog.ChestProfiles[slot] then
            RemoteCatalog.ChestProfiles[slot]=profile;RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilePersistence[slot]="Loaded from file"
        end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesFileState="File loaded"
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileIdle()
    if not gui.Parent then return false end
    if player.UserId~=RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileOwner then setStatus("Reload the hub after changing accounts before using chest profiles",COLORS.warn);return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferBusy then setStatus("Wait for chest setup import/export to finish",COLORS.warn);return false end
    local slot=RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileSlot
    if type(slot)~="number" or slot%1~=0 or slot<1 or slot>3 then setStatus("Choose a chest profile slot from 1 to 3",COLORS.warn);return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled or RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy or RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnChestOnly then
        setStatus("Finish or stop chest collection/learning before saving or loading profiles",COLORS.warn);return false
    end
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.CurrentChestProfile()
    local selected,mode={},"All"
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestItem then
        mode="Selected"
        if not RemoteCatalog.ChestItems or RemoteCatalog.ChestItems[RemoteCatalog.ChestItem] then table.insert(selected,RemoteCatalog.ChestItem) end
    elseif RemoteCatalog.ChestItems then
        mode="Selected"
        for item,enabled in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestItems) do if enabled then table.insert(selected,item) end end
    end
    local name=RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileName.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    return RemoteCatalog.ValidateChestProfile({Version=1,Name=name,ItemMode=mode,Items=selected,
        Discover=RemoteCatalog.ChestDiscover,Whole=RemoteCatalog.ChestWhole,Speed=RemoteCatalog.ChestSpeed,
        Travel=RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel,Range=RemoteCatalog.ChestScanRange,Goal=RemoteCatalog.ChestGoal or 0,StockTarget=RemoteCatalog.ChestStockTarget or 0,Repeat=RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeat==true,RepeatFast=RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatFast==true,AutoBatch=RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoBatch,Order=RemoteCatalog.ChestOrder})
end
function RemoteCatalog.SaveChestProfile()
    if not RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileIdle() then return false end
    local ok,profile=pcall(RemoteCatalog.CurrentChestProfile)
    if not ok then setStatus("Profile not saved: "..tostring(profile),COLORS.warn);return false end
    local slot=RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileSlot
    RemoteCatalog.ChestProfiles[slot]=profile;RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileName.Text=profile.Name
    local saved=false
    if type(writefile)=="function" then
        saved=pcall(function()
            local envelope={Version=1,Profiles={}}
            for index,entry in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestProfiles) do envelope.Profiles[tostring(index)]=RemoteCatalog.ValidateChestProfile(entry) end
            local encoded=HttpService:JSONEncode(envelope)
            assert(type(encoded)=="string" and #encoded<=65536,"Chest profiles file exceeds its size limit")
            local result=writefile("RebornChestProfiles_"..tostring(player.UserId)..".json",encoded)
            assert(result~=false,"Profile file writer reported failure")
        end)
    end
    -- A successful write stores every current profile, including earlier session-only saves.
    if saved then for index in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestProfiles) do RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilePersistence[index]="File + session" end
    else RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilePersistence[slot]="Session only" end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestProfiles()
    setStatus("Saved chest profile "..slot..": "..profile.Name..(saved and " (file + session)" or " (session only; file saving unavailable or failed)"),COLORS.good)
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ApplyChestProfile(data)
    if not RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileIdle() then return false end
    local ok,profile=pcall(RemoteCatalog.ValidateChestProfile,data)
    if not ok then setStatus("Invalid chest setup: "..tostring(profile):sub(1,180),COLORS.warn);return false end
    local items
    if profile.ItemMode=="Selected" then items={};for _,item in ipairs(profile.Items) do items[item]=true end end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestItems=items;RemoteCatalog.ChestItem=nil;RemoteCatalog.ChestSelection=nil
    RemoteCatalog.ChestDiscover=profile.Discover;RemoteCatalog.ChestWhole=profile.Whole;RemoteCatalog.ChestSpeed=profile.Speed
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel=profile.Travel;RemoteCatalog.ChestScanRange=profile.Range;RemoteCatalog.ChestGoal=profile.Goal>0 and profile.Goal or nil
    RemoteCatalog.ChestStockTarget=profile.StockTarget>0 and profile.StockTarget or nil
    RemoteCatalog.ChestStockButton.Text="Top-up/item: "..(RemoteCatalog.ChestStockTarget or "No limit").."  ▼"
    RemoteCatalog.ChestOrder=profile.Order
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestOrderMenu then RemoteCatalog.ChestOrderMenu:Refresh() end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoBatch=profile.AutoBatch
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestBatchMenu then RemoteCatalog.ChestBatchMenu:Refresh() end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeat=profile.Repeat;RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatFast=profile.RepeatFast==true
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatMenu then RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatMenu:Refresh() end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileName.Text=profile.Name
    RemoteCatalog.ChestSpeedButton.Text="Pace: "..profile.Speed
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTravelButton.Text="Movement: "..(profile.Travel=="Hop" and "TP hops" or profile.Travel)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestRangeButton.Text="Walk range: "..profile.Range.." studs"
    RemoteCatalog.ChestGoalButton.Text="Auto goal: "..(profile.Goal>0 and profile.Goal.." items" or "Unlimited")
    RemoteCatalog.ChestScopeButton.Text=profile.Discover and "Scope: All matching" or "Scope: Learned only"
    RemoteCatalog.ChestWholeButton.Text=profile.Whole and "Whole chest: ON" or "Whole chest: OFF"
    RemoteCatalog.ChestItemButton.Text="Items: "..RemoteCatalog.ChestItemSelectionText().."  ▾"
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus();RemoteCatalog.UpdateChestSelectionUI();RemoteCatalog.PreviewChestSelection();RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestProfiles()
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.LoadChestProfile()
    if not RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileIdle() then return false end
    local profile=RemoteCatalog.ChestProfiles[RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileSlot]
    if not profile then setStatus("Save a valid profile in this slot before loading it",COLORS.warn);return false end
    if not RemoteCatalog.ApplyChestProfile(profile) then return false end
    setStatus("Loaded "..profile.Name..". Chest choice reset to all in scope; learn slots this session, then press START COLLECTING.",COLORS.good)
    return true
end
-- CHEST SETUP TRANSFER BEGIN
function RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferMessage(text,notice)
    if not gui.Parent then return end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferHint then RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferHint.Text=notice or text end
    setStatus(text,COLORS.warn)
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetChestTransferOpen(open)
    if not gui.Parent then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesPanel.Visible=true;RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesButton.Text="Chest profiles  ▴"
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferPanel.Visible=open==true
    RemoteCatalog.ChestProfilesPanel.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,open and 448 or 196)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferButton.Text=open and "Backup / share setup  ▴" or "Backup / share setup  ▾"
    RemoteCatalog.LayoutChestControls()
    return true
end
RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferFields={"ChestProfileSlot","ChestItem","ChestItems","ChestSelection","ChestDiscover","ChestWhole",
    "ChestSpeed","ChestTravel","ChestScanRange","ChestGoal","ChestStockTarget","ChestRepeat","ChestRepeatFast","ChestAutoBatch","ChestOrder"}
function RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferContext()
    local context={Name=RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileName.Text,Items={}}
    for _,key in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferFields) do context[key]=RemoteCatalog[key] end
    for item,value in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestItems or {}) do context.Items[item]=value end
    return context
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferUnchanged(context)
    if not RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileIdle() then return false end
    local same=context.Name==RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileName.Text
    for _,key in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferFields) do if context[key]~=RemoteCatalog[key] then same=false end end
    for item,value in pairs(context.Items) do if not RemoteCatalog.ChestItems or RemoteCatalog.ChestItems[item]~=value then same=false end end
    for item,value in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestItems or {}) do if context.Items[item]~=value then same=false end end
    if not same then RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferMessage("Chest settings changed during transfer. Try again when idle.");return false end
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ExportChestSetup(copy)
    if not RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileIdle() then return false end
    local context=RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferContext()
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferBusy=true
    local ok,encoded=pcall(function()
        local profile=RemoteCatalog.CurrentChestProfile()
        local text=HttpService:JSONEncode({Version=1,Kind="RebornChestSetup",Profile=profile})
        assert(type(text)=="string" and #text>0 and #text<=32768,"Setup JSON must fit within 32 KiB")
        return text
    end)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferBusy=false
    if not RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferUnchanged(context) then return false end
    if not ok then RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferMessage("Export failed. Existing JSON kept. "..tostring(encoded):sub(1,180),"Export failed. Existing JSON kept; see status for details.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferText.Text=encoded
    RemoteCatalog.SetChestTransferOpen(true)
    local copied=false
    if copy then
        local copier=setclipboard or toclipboard
        if type(copier)=="function" then local ran,result=pcall(copier,encoded);copied=ran and result~=false end
    end
    if not RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferUnchanged(context) then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferMessage(copy and (copied and "Setup JSON copied; also shown below."
        or "Clipboard unavailable or failed. Select and copy the setup JSON below.")
        or "Current setup exported below. Copy the JSON to back it up or share it.")
    return true,encoded
end
function RemoteCatalog.ImportChestSetup(text)
    if not RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileIdle() then return false end
    if type(text)~="string" or #text==0 or #text>32768 then RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferMessage("Paste setup JSON of 1–32768 bytes. Current settings kept.");return false end
    local context=RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferContext()
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferBusy=true
    local ok,profile=pcall(function()
        local data=HttpService:JSONDecode(text)
        assert(type(data)=="table" and data.Version==1 and data.Kind=="RebornChestSetup","Use an exported Reborn chest setup")
        return RemoteCatalog.ValidateChestProfile(data.Profile)
    end)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferBusy=false
    if not RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferUnchanged(context) then return false end
    if not ok then RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferMessage("Import rejected. Current settings and saved profiles kept. "..tostring(profile):sub(1,180),"Import rejected. Settings and saved profiles kept; see status for details.");return false end
    if not RemoteCatalog.ApplyChestProfile(profile) then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.SetChestTransferOpen(true)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferMessage("Applied "..profile.Name..". Collection stays OFF. Save profile to retain these settings; saved slots unchanged.")
    return true
end

RemoteCatalog.ReadChestProfiles()
if RemoteCatalog.ChestProfiles[RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileSlot] then RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileName.Text=RemoteCatalog.ChestProfiles[RemoteCatalog.ChestProfileSlot].Name end
RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestProfiles()
-- CHEST PROFILES END

-- CHEST AUTO BEGIN
function RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount(item)
    local total=0
    for _,tool in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools()) do
        if tool.Name==(item or "carrotHarvested") then
            local count=RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(tool)
            -- A newly replicated Tool can exist before its quantity metadata arrives.
            if count==nil then return nil,"pending" end
            -- Invalid quantities must still stop before another request.
            if type(count)~="number" or count<0 or count%1~=0 or count>9007199254740991-total then return nil,"invalid" end
            total+=count
        end
    end
    return total
end
function RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInventory(item,active,previous,timeout)
    local count,reason=RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount(item)
    local attempts=math.floor((timeout or 2)*10+.5)
    for attempt=0,attempts do
        if not active() then return nil,"cancelled" end
        -- Missing metadata can settle; malformed numbers must never be accepted.
        if reason~="pending" and (count==nil or previous==nil or count>previous) then return count,reason end
        if attempt==attempts then return count,reason end
        task.wait(.1)
        count,reason=RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount(item)
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(text,color)
    if not gui.Parent then return end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestLastDetail="Reborn mob-stop-178\n"..text
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestRunMetrics then RemoteCatalog.ChestRunMetrics.Detail=tostring(text):sub(1,1200) end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestResultLabel.Text=text
    RemoteCatalog.ChestResultLabel.TextColor3=color or COLORS.muted
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestResultView then RemoteCatalog.ChestResultView.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero end
end
-- Telemetry is read-only and must never fail or pace a withdrawal.
function RemoteCatalog.ChestRunTime(run)
    if run.ClockInvalid then return nil end
    local ok,value=pcall(run.Clock)
    if not ok or type(value)~="number" or not (value>=0 and value<math.huge) or run.LastTime and value<run.LastTime then
        run.ClockInvalid=true;return nil
    end
    run.LastTime=value
    return value
end
function RemoteCatalog.TrackChestPause(paused)
    local run=RemoteCatalog.ChestRunMetrics
    if not run then return end
    local at=RemoteCatalog.ChestRunTime(run)
    if not at then return end
    if paused then run.PauseStarted=run.PauseStarted or at
    elseif run.PauseStarted then run.PausedSeconds+=at-run.PauseStarted;run.PauseStarted=nil end
end
function RemoteCatalog.RecordChestRun(outcome,total,items,goal,stockTarget,run)
    local snapshot,names={},{}
    for item,count in pairs(items or {}) do snapshot[item]=count;table.insert(names,item) end
    table.sort(names)
    local entry={Outcome=outcome,Total=total,Items=snapshot,Goal=goal,StockTarget=stockTarget}
    local text=outcome..": "..total.." confirmed items"..(goal and " · goal "..goal or " · unlimited")
    if stockTarget then text..=" · top-up "..stockTarget.."/item" end
    if run then
        entry.Requests=run.Requests;entry.RateLimits=run.RateLimits
        entry.Detail=run.Detail
        entry.Settings=table.clone(run.Settings)
        local ended=RemoteCatalog.ChestRunTime(run)
        if ended and run.Started then
            entry.Duration=ended-run.Started
            entry.PausedSeconds=math.min(entry.Duration,run.PausedSeconds+(run.PauseStarted and ended-run.PauseStarted or 0))
            entry.ActiveSeconds=math.max(0,entry.Duration-entry.PausedSeconds)
            local rate=entry.ActiveSeconds>0 and total*60/entry.ActiveSeconds or nil
            entry.ItemsPerMinute=rate and rate<math.huge and rate or nil
            entry.TimingText=string.format("Elapsed %.1fs · paused %.1fs · %s",entry.Duration,entry.PausedSeconds,
                entry.ItemsPerMinute and string.format("%.1f confirmed items/min excluding pause",entry.ItemsPerMinute) or "rate unavailable")
        else entry.TimingText="Timing unavailable; confirmed totals retained" end
        text..="\n"..entry.TimingText.."\nRequests: "..entry.Requests.." · TOO_FAST replies: "..entry.RateLimits
        text..="\nSettings: "..tostring(entry.Settings.Batch).." batch · "..tostring(entry.Settings.Speed).." · "..tostring(entry.Settings.Travel).." · "..tostring(entry.Settings.Order)..(entry.Settings.Repeat and " · Repeat" or " · One pass")
        if entry.Detail then text..="\nLast observed: "..entry.Detail end
    end
    for _,item in ipairs(names) do text..="\n"..item..": "..snapshot[item] end
    entry.Text=text
    local history=RemoteCatalog.ChestHistory or {}
    RemoteCatalog.ChestHistory=history
    table.insert(history,1,entry)
    while #history>5 do table.remove(history) end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestHistoryIndex=0
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestHistoryButton then RemoteCatalog.ChestHistoryButton.Text="Runs ("..#history..")" end
    return entry
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestHistoryReport()
    local history=RemoteCatalog.ChestHistory or {}
    if #history==0 then return nil end
    local lines={"Reborn mob-stop-178 · Chest run history", "Newest first · "..#history.." / 5 retained · current hub session only",
        "Confirmed inventory gains only. Elapsed includes waits and cleanup; rate excludes explicit pauses, and includes server cooldown/walking."}
    for index,entry in ipairs(history) do table.insert(lines,"\nRun "..index.." / "..#history.."\n"..entry.Text) end
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestTooFast(response)
    local seen={}
    local function check(value,depth)
        if type(value)=="string" then return value:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):upper()=="TOO_FAST" end
        if type(value)~="table" or depth>3 or seen[value] then return false end
        seen[value]=true
        for _,key in ipairs({"error","code","reason","message","value"}) do if check(value[key],depth+1) then return true end end
        return false
    end
    return check(response,0)
end
-- Distinguish retryable batch rejection from an unknown transfer outcome.
function RemoteCatalog.ChestFailureKind(response,origin)
    if origin=="transport" or origin=="context" or origin=="invalid" or origin=="blocked" or origin=="skip" then return origin end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestTooFast(response) then return "rate" end
    local seen={}
    local priority={amount=1,skip=2,context=3,capacity=4}
    local result="unknown"
    local function record(kind) if (priority[kind] or 0)>(priority[result] or 0) then result=kind end end
    local function inspect(value,depth)
        if type(value)=="string" then
            local code=value:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):upper():gsub("[%s%-]+","_")
            if code=="INVENTORY_FULL" or code=="BACKPACK_FULL" or code=="NO_SPACE" or code=="NOT_ENOUGH_SPACE" or code=="NOT_ENOUGH_INVENTORY_SPACE" then record("capacity")
            elseif code=="NO_PERMISSION" or code=="PERMISSION_DENIED" or code=="UNAUTHORIZED" or code=="FORBIDDEN" or code=="INVALID_CONTEXT" or code=="INVALID_SESSION" or code=="EXPIRED_SESSION" then record("context")
            elseif code=="INVALID_SLOT" or code=="EMPTY_SLOT" or code=="SLOT_EMPTY" or code=="ITEM_MISMATCH" or code=="INVALID_ITEM" or code=="CHANGE" or code=="CHANGED" or code=="CHEST_CHANGED" then record("skip")
            elseif code=="EMPTY" or code=="EMPTY_OR_INSUFFICIENT" or code=="AMOUNT_TOO_LARGE" or code=="BATCH_TOO_LARGE" or code=="INSUFFICIENT" or code=="INSUFFICIENT_ITEMS" or code=="INSUFFICIENT_STOCK" or code=="INSUFFICIENT_SALAD" or code:match("^NOT_ENOUGH_ITEMS") or code:match("^NOT_ENOUGH_CARROTS") then record("amount") end
        elseif type(value)=="table" and depth<=3 and not seen[value] then
            seen[value]=true
            for _,key in ipairs({"error","code","reason","message","value"}) do inspect(value[key],depth+1) end
        end
    end
    inspect(response,0)
    return result
end

-- Measure spacing between attempts, including request/confirmation time.
function RemoteCatalog.MarkChestRequest()
    if RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow then RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow.Blocked=true end
    if RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow then RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow.Blocked=true end
    local now=(RemoteCatalog.ChestClock or os.clock)()
    local previous=RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestAt
    RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestAt=now
    return previous and math.max(0,now-previous) or nil
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestBackoff(gap)
    local previous=RemoteCatalog.ChestRateDelay or 0
    RemoteCatalog.ChestRateSuccesses=0;RemoteCatalog.ChestRateAccepted=0
    if gap then RemoteCatalog.ChestRateFloor=math.max(RemoteCatalog.ChestRateFloor or 0,gap) end
    local floor=RemoteCatalog.ChestRateFloor or 0
    local ceiling=RemoteCatalog.ChestRateCeiling
    if ceiling and ceiling<=floor+.001 then ceiling=nil;RemoteCatalog.ChestRateCeiling=nil end
    -- Reuse a known working interval before trying a longer exponential delay.
    RemoteCatalog.ChestRateDelay=ceiling and ceiling<=4 and ceiling or math.min(4,math.max(.5,previous*2))
    return RemoteCatalog.ChestRateDelay
end
function RemoteCatalog.ObserveChestPace(sent,response,base,gap,origin)
    if origin=="skip" then return end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestTooFast(response) or not (sent or type(response)=="table" and type(response.success)=="boolean") then
        RemoteCatalog.ChestRateSuccesses=0
        -- No trustworthy timing observation follows a local/transport failure.
        if not RemoteCatalog.ChestTooFast(response) then RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestAt=nil end
        return
    end
    if gap and gap>=base*.9 then
        local floor=RemoteCatalog.ChestRateFloor or 0
        if gap<=floor+.001 then RemoteCatalog.ChestRateFloor=nil;RemoteCatalog.ChestRateCeiling=nil end
        RemoteCatalog.ChestRateCeiling=math.min(RemoteCatalog.ChestRateCeiling or math.huge,gap)
    end
    local delay=RemoteCatalog.ChestRateDelay
    if not delay or delay<=base then RemoteCatalog.ChestRateSuccesses=0;return end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestRateAccepted=(RemoteCatalog.ChestRateAccepted or 0)+1
    -- Revisit an old rejection after sustained acceptance, so transient load
    -- cannot permanently pin the session to a stale lower bound.
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestRateAccepted>=12 then
        RemoteCatalog.ChestRateFloor=nil;RemoteCatalog.ChestRateAccepted=0
    end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestRateSuccesses=(RemoteCatalog.ChestRateSuccesses or 0)+1
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestRateSuccesses>=3 then
        local floor=RemoteCatalog.ChestRateFloor or 0
        local ceiling=RemoteCatalog.ChestRateCeiling or delay
        local nextDelay=delay*.8
        if floor>0 and RemoteCatalog.ChestRateCeiling and ceiling>floor then
            local margin=math.max(.1,ceiling*.1)
            nextDelay=ceiling-floor<=margin+.001 and ceiling or (floor+ceiling)/2
        end
        RemoteCatalog.ChestRateDelay=math.max(base,math.min(delay,math.ceil(nextDelay*100-.0001)/100))
        RemoteCatalog.ChestRateSuccesses=0
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInterval(interval,active,ready,kind)
    local elapsed=RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestAt and math.max(0,(RemoteCatalog.ChestClock or os.clock)()-RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestAt) or 0
    return RemoteCatalog.WaitChestCooldown(math.max(0,interval-elapsed),active,ready,kind)
end
function RemoteCatalog.WaitChestCooldown(seconds,active,ready,kind)
    local remaining=seconds
    RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldownKind=kind or "retry"
    while remaining>1e-6 do
        if not active() or ready and not ready() then RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldown=nil;RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldownKind=nil;return false end
        RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldown=string.format("%.1fs",remaining)
        RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
        local tick=math.min(.1,remaining)
        task.wait(tick);remaining=math.max(0,remaining-tick)
    end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldown=nil;RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldownKind=nil
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
    return active()
end
-- Keep action labels stable; progress belongs in the status line.
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
    if not gui.Parent then return end
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestExclusions then RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestExclusions() end
    local auto=RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled
    local cleanup=not auto and RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker~=nil
    local manual=RemoteCatalog.ChestManualRunning
    local paused=auto and RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused
    local locked=auto or cleanup or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy
    for _,key in ipairs({"ChestAmountButton","ChestSpeedButton","ChestLearnedButton","ChestStockButton","ChestRepeatButton","ChestBatchButton","ChestQuickButton","ChestOrderButton","ChestConveyorButton","ChestHistoryButton","ChestCopyRunsButton"}) do
        local control=RemoteCatalog[key]
        if control then
            control.Active=not locked;control.Selectable=not locked;control.AutoButtonColor=not locked
            control.TextColor3=locked and COLORS.muted or COLORS.text
        end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoButton.Text=auto and "STOP AUTO TAKE" or cleanup and "STOPPING…" or "START COLLECTING"
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoButton.BackgroundColor3=auto and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoButton.Active=not manual and not cleanup
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoButton.Selectable=not manual and not cleanup
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoButton.AutoButtonColor=not manual and not cleanup
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestWithdrawButton then
        RemoteCatalog.ChestWithdrawButton.Active=not cleanup
        RemoteCatalog.ChestWithdrawButton.Selectable=not cleanup
        RemoteCatalog.ChestWithdrawButton.AutoButtonColor=not cleanup
        RemoteCatalog.ChestWithdrawButton.Text=manual and "STOP WITHDRAWAL" or auto and (paused and "RESUME AUTO TAKE" or "PAUSE AUTO TAKE") or cleanup and "Wait for cleanup" or (RemoteCatalog.ChestManualCaption and RemoteCatalog.ChestManualCaption() or "Withdraw once")
        RemoteCatalog.ChestWithdrawButton.BackgroundColor3=(manual or paused) and COLORS.on or COLORS.panel
        RemoteCatalog.ChestWithdrawButton.TextColor3=cleanup and COLORS.muted or COLORS.text
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestIntro then
        local learning=RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnChestOnly
        RemoteCatalog.ChestIntro.Text=cleanup and "Stopping · waiting for the current request"
            or paused and (RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy and "Pausing · finishing current request" or "Paused · Resume continues this run; Stop ends it")
            or auto and RemoteCatalog.ChestInventoryWaiting and ("Waiting for "..RemoteCatalog.ChestInventoryWaiting.." quantity · no new request sent")
            or auto and RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestPending and ("Waiting for server · "..RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestPending.." · request still in flight")
            or auto and RemoteCatalog.ChestConfirming and ("Confirming "..RemoteCatalog.ChestConfirming.." · no next request until inventory settles")
            or auto and RemoteCatalog.ChestReachWaiting and (RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel~="Stay" and "Waiting · no reachable selected chest; see result" or "Waiting · stand within 20 studs or choose Walk")
            or RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldown and ((RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldownKind=="pace" and "Request pace" or "Server cooldown").." · "..RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldown..(auto and " · "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal or 0).." collected" or ""))
            or manual and ("Withdrawing · "..(RemoteCatalog.ChestManualProgress or "starting"))
            or auto and (RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatWaiting and ("Waiting · next scan in "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestNextScan or 2).."s") or ("Collecting · "..(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoProgress or "starting")))
            or learning and "Learning · withdraw once from each chest" or "Ready · learn chests, choose targets, then collect"
        if setStatus and (auto or manual or cleanup) then setStatus(RemoteCatalog.ChestIntro.Text,(auto or manual) and COLORS.accent or COLORS.warn) end
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetChestPaused(state)
    if type(state)~="boolean" or not gui.Parent or not RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled or not RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker then return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused==state then return true end
    RemoteCatalog.TrackChestPause(state)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused=state
    if state then RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Stop("Chest") end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoStates(targets,batch,probe)
    local states={}
    for _,entry in ipairs(targets) do
        local adaptive=batch=="Max"
        local maximum=adaptive and 1000 or batch or entry.Binding.Amount
        if not RemoteCatalog.ChestTargetProtected(entry.Binding) and type(maximum)=="number" and maximum>=1 and maximum%1==0 and maximum<=1000000 then
            local unconfirmed=probe or entry.Binding.Probe
            table.insert(states,{Recorder=entry.Recorder,Binding=entry.Binding,Maximum=maximum,Amount=unconfirmed and 1 or adaptive and math.min(1000,math.max(30,entry.Binding.Amount or 30)) or maximum,Adaptive=adaptive,Probe=unconfirmed,NoProgress=0,RateRetries=0})
        end
    end
    return states
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetChestAuto(state)
    if state and RemoteCatalog.Mobs and (RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Worker or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press) then
        RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Stop("Stopped · another mode started")
        if RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press then setStatus("Weapon release pending · press STOP in Mobs",COLORS.warn);return false end
    end
    if state and RemoteCatalog.ChestTransferBusy then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Wait for chest setup import/export to finish");return false end
    if state and RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Wait for the current deposit to finish");return false end
    if state and RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Stop crafting and wait for its current request to finish first");return false end
    if state and RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(false);RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Wait for Auto Plow input cleanup");return false end
    if not state then
        RemoteCatalog.TrackChestPause(false)
        RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Stop("Chest")
        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled=false
        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused=false
        RemoteCatalog.ChestConfirming=nil
        RemoteCatalog.ChestInventoryWaiting=nil
        RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldown=nil;RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldownKind=nil
        RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatWaiting=false;RemoteCatalog.ChestReachWaiting=false
        RemoteCatalog.ChestNextScan=nil
        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoGeneration or 0)+1
        if gui.Parent then
            RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoButton.Text="START COLLECTING"
            RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoButton.BackgroundColor3=COLORS.off
            RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
        end
        return true
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled then return true end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy then
        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Wait for the current chest request to finish")
        return false
    end
    local stockTarget=RemoteCatalog.ChestStockTarget
    if stockTarget~=nil and stockTarget~=25 and stockTarget~=50 and stockTarget~=100 and stockTarget~=250 and stockTarget~=500 then
        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Choose a valid inventory top-up target before collecting");return false
    end
    local batch=RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoBatch
    local balanced=RemoteCatalog.ChestOrder=="Balance chests"
    local repeating=RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeat==true
    local states=RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoStates(RemoteCatalog.SelectedChestTargets(),batch,false)
    if #states==0 then
        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(RemoteCatalog.ChestItems and next(RemoteCatalog.ChestItems)==nil and "No items selected. Choose items or All learned items." or ("No eligible chest targets. Check excluded chests. Conveyor I/O chests are skipped unless Include is chosen; learn/select an allowed chest."))
        return false
    end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoGeneration or 0)+1
    local generation=RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoGeneration
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker=generation
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled=true
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused=false
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal=0
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoItems={}
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPass=1
    RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatWaiting=false;RemoteCatalog.ChestReachWaiting=false
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestStats then RemoteCatalog.ChestStats["AUTO COLLECTED"].Text="0" end
    local goal=RemoteCatalog.ChestGoal
    local fast=RemoteCatalog.ChestSpeed=="Fast"
    local successPause,retryPause,emptyPause=fast and .1 or .25,fast and .2 or .35,fast and .5 or 1
    local run={Clock=RemoteCatalog.ChestClock or os.clock,PausedSeconds=0,Requests=0,RateLimits=0,
        Settings={Batch=batch or "Learned",Speed=RemoteCatalog.ChestSpeed or "Standard",Travel=RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel or "Stay",Order=balanced and "Balance chests" or "Same stack",Repeat=repeating}}
    run.Started=RemoteCatalog.ChestRunTime(run)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestRunMetrics=run
    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoProgress="starting"
    if RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus then RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus() end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
    task.spawn(function()
        local ownsBusy=false
        local completed=false
        local goalReached=false
        local stockMet=false
        local stoppedOutcome=nil
        local function active()
            return gui.Parent~=nil and RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled and RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoGeneration==generation
        end
        -- Pause holds this worker and its stack state. In-flight confirmation uses
        -- active(), so pausing never discards an already-sent transfer.
        local function ready()
            if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused then RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions() end
            while active() and RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused do task.wait(.1) end
            return active()
        end
        local function moving() return active() and not RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused end
        local function inventoryUnavailable(state,reason)
            if reason~="pending" then stoppedOutcome="Inventory unreadable";RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Cannot read item inventory count. No new withdrawal sent.");return false end
            state.InventoryRetries=(state.InventoryRetries or 0)+1
            if state.InventoryRetries>=3 then stoppedOutcome="Inventory unreadable";RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Cannot read item inventory count after three checks. No new withdrawal sent; let inventory settle, then restart.");return false end
            state.Waiting=true;state.InventoryWaiting=true
            RemoteCatalog.ChestInventoryWaiting=tostring(state.Binding.Item or "carrotHarvested");RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
            RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Waiting for "..tostring(state.Binding.Item or "carrotHarvested").." quantity · check "..state.InventoryRetries.."/3. No withdrawal sent; other readable items can continue.")
            return true
        end
        local function paced(base)
            local delay=math.max(base,RemoteCatalog.ChestRateDelay or 0)
            if delay>base then return RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInterval(delay,active,ready,"pace") end
            task.wait(base)
            return active()
        end
        local ok,failure=pcall(function()
            local index=0
            local currentChest=nil
            local preferredSlot=nil
            local lastVisitedChest=nil
            local balanceCursors={}
            local chestNumbers,chestCount={},0
            for _,state in ipairs(states) do
                local chest=state.Binding.Chest
                if chest and not chestNumbers[chest] then chestCount+=1;chestNumbers[chest]=chestCount end
            end
            while active() do
                if goal and RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal>=goal then goalReached=true;break end
                if not ready() then return end
                local finished,waiting=0,0
                for _,state in ipairs(states) do if state.Done then finished+=1 elseif state.Waiting then waiting+=1 end end
                RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoProgress=RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal.." items · "..finished.."/"..#states.." slots finished"
                RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
                if finished==#states then
                    completed=true
                    if stockTarget then
                        stockMet=true
                        local checked={}
                        for _,state in ipairs(states) do
                            local item=state.Binding.Item or "carrotHarvested"
                            if not checked[item] then
                                checked[item]=true
                                local current=RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount(item)
                                if current==nil or current<stockTarget then stockMet=false;break end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not repeating then break end
                    -- Keep one worker and the cumulative goal while the chest refills.
                    local atTarget=stockMet
                    completed=false;stockMet=false
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatWaiting=true
                    local steps=RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatFast and 5 or 20
                    for step=0,steps-1 do
                        if not ready() then return end
                        if step%10==0 then
                            local left=(steps-step)/10
                            RemoteCatalog.ChestNextScan=math.ceil(left)
                            RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
                            RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage((atTarget and "Inventory target met; watching for items you use." or "Waiting for chest refill.").."\nNext pass in "..(left>=1 and tostring(math.ceil(left)) or tostring(left)).."s · "..RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal.." confirmed items · pass "..RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPass..". Stop cancels.")
                        end
                        task.wait(.1)
                    end
                    if not ready() then return end
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatWaiting=false;RemoteCatalog.ChestReachWaiting=false
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestNextScan=nil
                    local refreshed,valid
                    local function refresh()
                        refreshed=RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoStates(RemoteCatalog.SelectedChestTargets(),batch,true)
                        valid=false
                        for _,state in ipairs(refreshed) do
                            if state.Recorder:CanUseChestBinding(state.Binding) then valid=true;break end
                        end
                    end
                    refresh()
                    -- Chests read from Contents are just empty until a conveyor or player refills them.
                    while not valid and RemoteCatalog.ContentsChestRecorder and RemoteCatalog.ContentsChestRecorder() do
                        RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatWaiting=true
                        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Selected chests are empty · waiting for a refill.\n"..RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal.." confirmed items · pass "..RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPass..". Stop cancels.")
                        RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
                        for _=1,RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatFast and 5 or 20 do if not ready() then return end;task.wait(.1) end
                        RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatWaiting=false
                        refresh()
                    end
                    if not valid then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Repeat stopped: no current learned targets remain. Learn/select a withdrawal again.");return end
                    states=refreshed
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPass+=1
                    index=0;currentChest=nil;preferredSlot=nil;lastVisitedChest=nil;balanceCursors={}
                    for _,state in ipairs(states) do
                        local chest=state.Binding.Chest
                        if chest and not chestNumbers[chest] then chestCount+=1;chestNumbers[chest]=chestCount end
                    end
                    continue
                end
                if waiting>0 and waiting==#states-finished then
                    local inventoryWaits=0
                    for _,state in ipairs(states) do if state.Waiting and state.InventoryWaiting then inventoryWaits+=1 end end
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestReachWaiting=inventoryWaits==0
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestInventoryWaiting=inventoryWaits>0 and "selected items" or nil
                    RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
                    if inventoryWaits>0 then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Waiting for inventory metadata · "..inventoryWaits.." selected checks need a readable quantity. Rescanning in 1s; no withdrawal sent for these checks.")
                    else RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage((RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel~="Stay" and "No selected chest can currently be reached. Check your character, path and Walk range." or "No selected chest is within reach. Stay sends only within 20 studs; move closer or choose Movement: Walk. Walk range controls walking only.").."\nRescanning in 1s. "..RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal.." confirmed items; no withdrawal sent while waiting.") end
                    task.wait(1)
                    for _,state in ipairs(states) do state.Waiting=false;state.InventoryWaiting=false end
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestReachWaiting=false
                    continue
                end
                index=index%#states+1
                if preferredSlot and (states[preferredSlot].Done or states[preferredSlot].Waiting) then preferredSlot=nil end
                if preferredSlot then index=preferredSlot
                elseif balanced and lastVisitedChest then
                    for step=0,#states-1 do
                        local candidate=(index-1+step)%#states+1
                        if not states[candidate].Done and not states[candidate].Waiting and states[candidate].Binding.Chest~=lastVisitedChest then index=candidate;break end
                    end
                elseif RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel~="Stay" and currentChest then
                    local stayed=false
                    for candidate,state in ipairs(states) do
                        if not state.Done and not state.Waiting and state.Binding.Chest==currentChest then index=candidate;stayed=true;break end
                    end
                    -- Chest finished: continue with the nearest remaining chest from here, not the start order.
                    if not stayed and RemoteCatalog.NearestChestState then index=RemoteCatalog.NearestChestState(states) or index end
                end
                if balanced and not preferredSlot then
                    local chest=states[index].Binding.Chest
                    local cursor=balanceCursors[chest]
                    if cursor then
                        for step=1,#states do
                            local candidate=(cursor-1+step)%#states+1
                            if not states[candidate].Done and not states[candidate].Waiting and states[candidate].Binding.Chest==chest then index=candidate;break end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local state=states[index]
                if state.Done or state.Waiting then continue end
                RemoteCatalog.ChestInventoryWaiting=nil
                local recorder,binding=state.Recorder,state.Binding
                local target="Chest #"..tostring(chestNumbers[binding.Chest] or index)..(binding.FromContents and "" or " · slot "..tostring(binding.Slot or "?")).." · "..tostring(binding.Item or "carrotHarvested")
                if not recorder:CanUseChestBinding(binding) then
                    state.Done=true
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Skipping "..target..": its session or chest is no longer valid")
                    continue
                end
                lastVisitedChest=binding.Chest
                if balanced then balanceCursors[binding.Chest]=index end
                if stockTarget then
                    local current,quantityState=RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount(binding.Item)
                    if current==nil and quantityState=="pending" then
                        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Waiting for "..tostring(binding.Item or "carrotHarvested").." inventory quantity before top-up…")
                        RemoteCatalog.ChestInventoryWaiting=tostring(binding.Item or "carrotHarvested");RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
                        current,quantityState=RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInventory(binding.Item,active)
                        RemoteCatalog.ChestInventoryWaiting=nil
                        if not active() then break end
                    end
                    if current==nil then if inventoryUnavailable(state,quantityState) then continue else break end end
                    if current>=stockTarget then
                        state.Done=true
                        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Top-up already satisfied: "..tostring(binding.Item or "carrotHarvested").." "..current.."/"..stockTarget..". No approach or withdrawal needed.")
                        continue
                    end
                end
                local reached,reason=RemoteCatalog.ApproachChest(recorder,moving,binding)
                if not active() then break end
                if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused then preferredSlot=index;continue end
                if reached and RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestAt and (RemoteCatalog.ChestRateDelay or 0)>successPause then
                    if not RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInterval(RemoteCatalog.ChestRateDelay,active,ready,"pace") then return end
                    reached,reason=RemoteCatalog.ApproachChest(recorder,moving,binding)
                    if not active() then break end
                    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused then preferredSlot=index;continue end
                end
                if not reached then
                    currentChest=nil;preferredSlot=nil
                    for _,candidate in ipairs(states) do if candidate.Binding.Chest==binding.Chest and not candidate.Done then candidate.Waiting=true;candidate.InventoryWaiting=false end end
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(target.." waiting: "..tostring(reason))
                    continue
                end
                currentChest=binding.Chest
                local before,quantityState=RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount(binding.Item)
                if before==nil and quantityState=="pending" then
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Waiting for "..tostring(binding.Item or "carrotHarvested").." inventory quantity before withdrawal…")
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestInventoryWaiting=tostring(binding.Item or "carrotHarvested");RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
                    before,quantityState=RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInventory(binding.Item,active)
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestInventoryWaiting=nil
                    if not active() then break end
                end
                if before==nil then
                    if inventoryUnavailable(state,quantityState) then continue else break end
                end
                state.InventoryRetries=0;state.InventoryWaiting=false
                -- Resume rechecks reach and live inventory, rather than using a pre-pause count.
                if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused then preferredSlot=index;continue end
                -- Approach can yield while another action changes inventory. Recheck now.
                if stockTarget and before>=stockTarget then state.Done=true;continue end
                -- Inventory replication can yield after approach. Recheck the live
                -- session and interaction range before acquiring the request lock.
                if not recorder:CanUseChestBinding(binding) then state.Done=true;RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Skipping "..target..": learn this chest again.");continue end
                if RemoteCatalog.ChestTargetProtected(binding) then state.Done=true;continue end
                if RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestReady then
                    local allowed,why=RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestReady(binding)
                    if not allowed then
                        state.Waiting=true;state.InventoryWaiting=false;preferredSlot=nil
                        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(target.." waiting: "..tostring(why))
                        continue
                    end
                end
                RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy=true;ownsBusy=true
                local amount=goal and math.min(state.Amount,goal-RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal) or state.Amount
                if stockTarget then amount=math.min(amount,stockTarget-before) end
                state.Amount=amount
                RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Taking "..amount.." × "..tostring(binding.Item or "carrotHarvested").."\n"..target.."\nWaiting for inventory confirmation…")
                local gap=RemoteCatalog.MarkChestRequest()
                RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestPending=tostring(binding.Item or "carrotHarvested");RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
                run.Requests+=1
                local ran,sent,response,origin=pcall(RemoteCatalog.WithdrawCarrots,amount,recorder,binding)
                RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestPending=nil
                if not active() then break end
                if not ran then sent,response,origin=false,sent,"transport" end
                local kind=RemoteCatalog.ChestFailureKind(response,origin)
                local after,afterState
                if sent then
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestConfirming=tostring(binding.Item or "carrotHarvested");RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
                    after,afterState=RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInventory(binding.Item,active,before,5)
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestConfirming=nil
                else after=before end
                RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy=false;ownsBusy=false
                if not active() then break end
                if not sent and RemoteCatalog.ChestTooFast(response) then
                    run.RateLimits+=1
                    preferredSlot=index
                    state.RateRetries+=1
                    if state.RateRetries>=5 then stoppedOutcome="Rate limited";RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Server keeps returning TOO_FAST. Stopped after five attempts; the batch was not reduced. Wait before restarting.");return end
                    local cooldown=RemoteCatalog.ChestBackoff(gap)
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(target..": TOO_FAST; waiting "..cooldown.."s, then retrying the same "..amount.."-item batch.")
                    if not RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInterval(cooldown,active,ready) then return end
                    continue
                end
                state.RateRetries=0
                if not sent and kind~="amount" then
                    if kind=="skip" then
                        state.Done=true;preferredSlot=nil
                        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Skipping "..target..": "..RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(response)..". Other selected slots can continue.")
                        if not paced(retryPause) then return end
                        continue
                    end
                    stoppedOutcome=kind=="transport" and "Needs review" or "Blocked"
                    RemoteCatalog.ObserveChestPace(false,nil,successPause)
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(target..": "..(kind=="transport" and "Transfer outcome unknown; request will not be replayed. Check inventory before restarting." or kind=="capacity" and "Inventory has no space; clear space before restarting. Batch was not reduced." or kind=="context" and "Chest permission/session changed; learn a fresh withdrawal before restarting." or "Withdrawal rejected; batch kept and run stopped. Check the result before restarting.").."\n"..RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(response))
                    return
                end
                if ran then RemoteCatalog.ObserveChestPace(sent,response,successPause,gap,origin) else RemoteCatalog.ObserveChestPace(false,nil,successPause) end
                if sent and after~=nil and after<=before then
                    -- From the user's continuous-collect patch: a chest emptied between the scan and the
                    -- request (another player, a conveyor) answers "empty"/"insufficient", or its stack is
                    -- simply gone. That is a completed check for this pass, not a reason to stop the run.
                    local resultText=string.lower(tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(response)))
                    local clearlyEmpty=string.find(resultText,"empty",1,true) or string.find(resultText,"no items",1,true)
                        or string.find(resultText,"nothing to collect",1,true) or string.find(resultText,"out of stock",1,true)
                        or string.find(resultText,"insufficient",1,true) or string.find(resultText,"not enough",1,true)
                        or binding.Stack~=nil and binding.Stack.Parent==nil
                    if clearlyEmpty then
                        state.Done=true;state.Waiting=false;state.InventoryWaiting=false;preferredSlot=nil
                        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(target..": chest is empty right now · waiting for the next scan to find a refill.\n"..RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(response))
                        if not paced(emptyPause) then return end
                        continue
                    end
                end
                if sent and (after==nil or after<=before) then
                    stoppedOutcome="Needs review"
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(target..": "..(afterState=="pending" and "Quantity did not become readable within 5 seconds." or after==nil and "Item quantity became invalid or unreadable." or "No inventory gain confirmed within 5 seconds.").." No further requests sent and batch not reduced. Check inventory before restarting.\n"..RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(response))
                    return
                end
                local gained=math.max(0,after-before)
                if sent and gained>0 then
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal+=gained
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoProgress=RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal.." items · "..finished.."/"..#states.." slots finished"
                    local item=binding.Item or "carrotHarvested"
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoItems[item]=(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoItems[item] or 0)+gained
                    if RemoteCatalog.ChestStats then RemoteCatalog.ChestStats["AUTO COLLECTED"].Text=tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal) end
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Collected "..RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal.." items · "..finished.."/"..#states.." checks finished\n"..target,COLORS.good)
                    if state.Adaptive then
                        if state.Reduced or gained<amount then
                            state.Maximum=math.min(state.Maximum,gained)
                            state.Adaptive=false;state.Amount=state.Maximum
                        else state.Amount=state.Probe and math.min(state.Maximum,30) or math.min(state.Maximum,amount*2) end
                    else
                        if not state.Probe then state.Maximum=math.min(state.Maximum,state.Amount) end
                        state.Amount=state.Maximum
                    end
                    state.NoProgress=0;state.Probe=false
                    for _,candidate in ipairs(states) do candidate.Waiting=false;candidate.InventoryWaiting=false end
                    preferredSlot=index -- Same-stack mode retains its v60 continuation.
                    if balanced then preferredSlot=nil;currentChest=nil end
                    if not paced(successPause) then return end
                else
                    preferredSlot=index -- Keep remainder retries on the same stack, bounded below.
                    RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(target..": no inventory gain. "..RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(response))
                    if state.Probe then
                        state.Done=true
                        if not paced(fast and .1 or .2) then return end
                    elseif state.Amount>1 then
                        if state.Adaptive then state.Maximum=math.min(state.Maximum,state.Amount-1);state.Reduced=true end
                        state.Amount=math.max(1,math.floor(state.Amount/2))
                        if not paced(retryPause) then return end
                    else
                        state.NoProgress+=1
                        if state.NoProgress>=3 then state.Done=true elseif not paced(emptyPause) then return end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        if ownsBusy then RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy=false end
        RemoteCatalog.ChestRepeatWaiting=false;RemoteCatalog.ChestReachWaiting=false
        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused=false
        RemoteCatalog.ChestConfirming=nil
        RemoteCatalog.ChestInventoryWaiting=nil
        RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldown=nil;RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldownKind=nil
        RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker=nil
        RemoteCatalog.ChestRequestPending=nil
        RemoteCatalog.ChestNextScan=nil
        RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
        if RemoteCatalog.ChestRunMetrics==run then RemoteCatalog.ChestRunMetrics=nil end
        local runRecord
        if gui.Parent then
            if not ok then run.Detail="Worker error: "..tostring(failure):sub(1,1200) end
            local outcome=not ok and "Failed" or stoppedOutcome or goalReached and "Goal reached" or stockMet and "Inventory targets met" or completed and "Pass finished" or "Stopped"
            runRecord=RemoteCatalog.RecordChestRun(outcome,RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal,RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoItems,goal,stockTarget,run)
        end
        if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoGeneration==generation then
            RemoteCatalog.SetChestAuto(false)
            if not ok then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Auto withdraw stopped: "..RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(failure))
            elseif goalReached then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Goal reached: "..RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal.." items collected. Remaining slots were not checked.",COLORS.good)
            elseif stockMet then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Inventory targets met: at least "..stockTarget.." of each selected item. Collected "..RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal.." items this run.",COLORS.good)
            elseif completed then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Pass finished: "..RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoTotal.." items collected. All "..#states.." selected slot checks finished; empty, mismatched or unavailable slots were skipped.\nLast result: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestResultLabel.Text),COLORS.good) end
            if stockTarget and completed and not stockMet then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(RemoteCatalog.ChestResultLabel.Text.."\nSome selected items remain below "..stockTarget.."; empty, unavailable or unconfirmed checks were skipped.") end
            local names,totals={},{}
            for item in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoItems) do table.insert(names,item) end
            table.sort(names)
            for _,item in ipairs(names) do table.insert(totals,item..": "..RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoItems[item]) end
            if #totals>0 then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(RemoteCatalog.ChestResultLabel.Text.."\nBy item: "..table.concat(totals,", "),RemoteCatalog.ChestResultLabel.TextColor3) end
            if runRecord then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage(RemoteCatalog.ChestResultLabel.Text.."\n"..runRecord.TimingText,RemoteCatalog.ChestResultLabel.TextColor3) end
        end
    end)
    return true
end
-- CHEST AUTO END

    RemoteCatalog.SetChestAuto(not RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled)
end))

track(RemoteCatalog.ChestWithdrawButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled then RemoteCatalog.SetChestPaused(not RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoPaused);return end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker then return end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker then RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoMessage("Stop crafting before withdrawing items");return end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy then
        RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration or 0)+1
        RemoteCatalog.ChestWithdrawButton.Text="Stopping…"
        return
    end
    RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration or 0)+1
    local generation=RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration
    RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy=true
    RemoteCatalog.ChestManualRunning=true
    RemoteCatalog.ChestManualProgress=nil
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
    task.spawn(function()
        local ran,ok,reason=pcall(RemoteCatalog.WithdrawSelectedCarrots,generation)
        RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy=false
        RemoteCatalog.ChestManualRunning=false
        RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldown=nil;RemoteCatalog.ChestCooldownKind=nil
        RemoteCatalog.ChestManualProgress=nil
        if not gui.Parent then return end
        RemoteCatalog.RefreshChestActions()
        if RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration~=generation then return end
        local detail=ran and ok and "Withdrawal request sent. Check inventory; server response: "..RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(reason)
            or "Withdrawal failed: "..RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(ran and reason or ok)
        RemoteCatalog.ChestLastDetail="Reborn mob-stop-178\nAmount: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestAmount).."\n"..detail
        RemoteCatalog.ChestResultLabel.Text=detail
        RemoteCatalog.ChestResultView.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero
        RemoteCatalog.ChestResultLabel.TextColor3=ran and ok and COLORS.good or COLORS.warn
        setStatus(ran and ok and "Withdrawal requests sent; check inventory" or "Chest rejected the request. See the result below or copy it.",ran and ok and COLORS.good or COLORS.warn)
    end)
end))

function RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(text)
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused and RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker then text="Paused · "..text end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunning and RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueIndex then text="Queue "..RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueIndex.." / "..RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunSize.." · "..text end
    if gui.Parent and RemoteCatalog.CraftInfo then RemoteCatalog.CraftInfo.Text=text end
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue then RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue() end
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftMaterials then RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftMaterials() end
end
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    if not gui.Parent or not RemoteCatalog.CraftToggle then return end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftToggle.Text=RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled and "STOP CRAFTING" or RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker and "FINISHING REQUEST…" or "START CRAFTING"
    RemoteCatalog.CraftToggle.BackgroundColor3=RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftTargetButton then
        RemoteCatalog.CraftTargetButton.Active=RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker==nil and RemoteCatalog.CraftMode~="Continuous"
        RemoteCatalog.CraftTargetButton.TextColor3=RemoteCatalog.CraftMode=="Continuous" and COLORS.muted or COLORS.text
    end
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    RemoteCatalog.CraftLearnButton.Text=recorder and recorder.LearnCraftOnly and "Cancel recipe learning" or "Learn recipe"
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftLearning and not (recorder and not recorder.Stopped and recorder.LearnCraftOnly) then
        RemoteCatalog.CraftLearning=false
        local binding=recorder and recorder.CraftBinding
        if binding and binding~=RemoteCatalog.CraftLearningBefore and recorder:CanUseCraftBinding(binding) and not RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker then
            RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
            RemoteCatalog.CraftItem=binding.Item or "bait"
            RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Learned recipe: "..RemoteCatalog.CraftItem..". Choose a run mode, then Start crafting. Uses your materials.")
        end
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipeMenu then RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipeMenu:Refresh() end
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue then RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue() end
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftCatalogUI then RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftCatalogUI() end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftPauseButton then
        RemoteCatalog.CraftPauseButton.Text=RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused and "RESUME CRAFTING" or "PAUSE CRAFTING"
        RemoteCatalog.CraftPauseButton.Active=RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled==true and RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker~=nil
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.StopCraftLearning()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftLearning=false
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if recorder and recorder.LearnCraftOnly then
        recorder.LearnCraftOnly=false
        if not recorder.Active and not recorder.LearnWoodOnly and not recorder.LearnBaitOnly and not recorder.LearnChestOnly and not recorder.LearnPlowOnly and not recorder.LearnMobOnly then recorder:Stop() end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
end
function RemoteCatalog.BeginCraftLearning()
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Wait for preset file work to finish first.");return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Stop crafting and wait for the current request to finish first.");return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnCraftOnly then RemoteCatalog.StopCraftLearning();RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Craft learning cancelled.");return true end
    local other=RemoteCatalog.OtherLearning and RemoteCatalog.OtherLearning("LearnCraftOnly")
    if other then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(other);return false end
    local ok,recorder=pcall(RemoteCatalog.StartCapture)
    if not ok or not recorder then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("This host cannot learn craft requests.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.Recorder=recorder
    recorder.LearnCraftOnly=true;recorder.Active=false
    RemoteCatalog.CraftLearning=true;RemoteCatalog.CraftLearningBefore=recorder.CraftBinding
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Craft the item once manually at your own workbench, then choose it in Recipe. Learning sends no extra requests.")
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftRecorders()
    local list={}
    if RemoteCatalog.Recorder then table.insert(list,RemoteCatalog.Recorder) end
    local other=RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("CraftBinding")
    if other and other~=RemoteCatalog.Recorder then table.insert(list,other) end
    local ok,existing=pcall(function() return (type(getgenv)=="function" and getgenv() or _G).RebornCapture end)
    if ok and existing and not table.find(list,existing) then table.insert(list,existing) end
    return list
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipes()
    local names,seen={"bait"},{bait=true}
    for _,recorder in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.CraftRecorders()) do
        local bindings=type(recorder)=="table" and recorder.CraftBindings
        for name,binding in pairs(type(bindings)=="table" and bindings or {}) do
            if type(name)=="string" and type(binding)=="table" and type(recorder.CanUseCraftBinding)=="function" and not seen[name] and recorder:CanUseCraftBinding(binding) then seen[name]=true;table.insert(names,name) end
        end
        local binding=recorder.CraftBinding
        local name=binding and (binding.Item or "bait")
        if name and type(recorder.CanUseCraftBinding)=="function" and not seen[name] and recorder:CanUseCraftBinding(binding) then seen[name]=true;table.insert(names,name) end
    end
    for name in pairs(RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalog or {}) do if not seen[name] then seen[name]=true;table.insert(names,name) end end
    table.sort(names)
    return names
end
