RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalog={}
RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogStatus="Press Load all recipes to show the game's available recipe list."
-- CRAFT MATERIALS BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterials={}
function RemoteCatalog.ReadCraftMaterials(value,ingredients)
    local function id(name)
        return type(name)=="string" and #name>0 and #name<=128 and not name:find("%c") and name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")==name and name or nil
    end
    local function positive(amount)
        return type(amount)=="number" and amount>0 and amount<=1000000000 and amount%1==0
    end
    if type(ingredients)~="table" then return {Error="Ingredient quantities unavailable"} end
    if rawget(value,"cost")~=nil or rawget(value,"currency")~=nil or rawget(value,"coins")~=nil then return {Error="Additional recipe costs are not supported"} end
    local totals,entries={},0
    for key,entry in next,ingredients do
        entries+=1
        if entries>64 then return {Error="Ingredient list exceeds 64 entries"} end
        local name,amount
        if type(entry)=="number" then name=id(key);amount=entry
        elseif type(entry)=="table" then
            if rawget(entry,"alternatives")~=nil or rawget(entry,"options")~=nil then return {Error="Alternative ingredients are not supported"} end
            name=id(rawget(entry,"item")) or id(rawget(entry,"itemType")) or id(rawget(entry,"itemName")) or id(rawget(entry,"toolName")) or id(rawget(entry,"type")) or id(key)
            amount=rawget(entry,"amount") or rawget(entry,"quantity") or rawget(entry,"count")
        end
        if not name or not positive(amount) then return {Error="Ingredient quantities unavailable or unsupported"} end
        totals[name]=(totals[name] or 0)+amount
        if totals[name]>1000000000 then return {Error="Ingredient quantity exceeds supported range"} end
    end
    if entries==0 then return {Error="No readable ingredient quantities"} end
    local output=rawget(value,"output") or rawget(value,"result") or rawget(value,"outputItem")
    local amount=rawget(value,"outputAmount") or rawget(value,"outputCount") or rawget(value,"resultAmount")
    if amount==nil and type(output)=="table" then amount=rawget(output,"amount") or rawget(output,"quantity") or rawget(output,"count") end
    if amount~=nil and not positive(amount) then return {Error="Output quantity is invalid"} end
    local rows={}
    for name,cost in pairs(totals) do table.insert(rows,{Item=name,Amount=cost}) end
    table.sort(rows,function(a,b) return a.Item<b.Item end)
    return {Ingredients=rows,OutputAmount=amount}
end
function RemoteCatalog.RememberCraftMaterials(target,name,value,ingredients)
    local recipe=RemoteCatalog.ReadCraftMaterials(value,ingredients)
    local previous=target[name]
    if not previous then target[name]=recipe;return end
    local same=previous.Error==recipe.Error and previous.OutputAmount==recipe.OutputAmount
    if same and previous.Ingredients and recipe.Ingredients then
        same=#previous.Ingredients==#recipe.Ingredients
        if same then for index,row in ipairs(previous.Ingredients) do
            local other=recipe.Ingredients[index]
            if row.Item~=other.Item or row.Amount~=other.Amount then same=false;break end
        end end
    elseif previous.Ingredients or recipe.Ingredients then same=false end
    if not same then target[name]={Error="Multiple recipe variants; material costs cannot be selected reliably"} end
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialCount(item)
    if type(RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount)~="function" then return nil end
    local ok,count=pcall(RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount,item)
    if ok and type(count)=="number" and count>=0 and count<=9007199254740991 and count%1==0 then return count end
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialReport()
    local run=RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker and RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialRun
    local item=run and run.Item or RemoteCatalog.CraftItem
    local mode=run and run.Mode or RemoteCatalog.CraftMode
    local target=run and run.Target or RemoteCatalog.CraftTarget
    local batch=run and run.Batch or RemoteCatalog.CraftBatch
    local lines={"Recipe: "..tostring(item).." · "..tostring(mode)}
    local recipe=RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterials[item]
    if not recipe then
        table.insert(lines,"Material data unavailable. Press Load all recipes first; learning a request alone does not provide costs.")
        return table.concat(lines,"\n")
    end
    if recipe.Error then table.insert(lines,recipe.Error..". No total estimated.");return table.concat(lines,"\n") end
    local desired
    if mode=="Make amount" then desired=type(target)=="number" and math.max(0,target-(run and run.Confirmed or 0))
    elseif mode=="Continuous" then desired=batch
    elseif mode=="Top up stock" then local stock=RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialCount(item);if stock~=nil and type(target)=="number" then desired=math.max(0,target-stock) end end
    if type(desired)~="number" or desired<0 or desired>10000 or desired%1~=0 then
        table.insert(lines,"Target or output inventory unreadable; showing per-craft costs only.");desired=nil
    end
    local crafts
    if desired~=nil and recipe.OutputAmount then
        crafts=math.ceil(desired/recipe.OutputAmount)
        table.insert(lines,(mode=="Continuous" and "Next batch: " or run and "Remaining: " or "Planned: ")..desired.." more "..item.." · "..crafts.." crafts × "..recipe.OutputAmount.." output")
    elseif desired==0 then crafts=0;table.insert(lines,"Target already met; no materials needed.")
    elseif not recipe.OutputAmount then table.insert(lines,"Output quantity unknown; showing per-craft costs only.") end
    local missing,unknown,available=0,0,nil
    for _,row in ipairs(recipe.Ingredients) do
        local need=row.Amount*(crafts or 1)
        local have=RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialCount(row.Item)
        local deficit=have~=nil and math.max(0,need-have) or nil
        if deficit==nil then unknown+=1 elseif deficit>0 then missing+=1 end
        if have~=nil then local can=math.floor(have/row.Amount);available=available and math.min(available,can) or can end
        table.insert(lines,row.Item.." · need "..string.format("%.0f",need).." · have "..(have~=nil and string.format("%.0f",have) or "unknown").." · missing "..(deficit~=nil and string.format("%.0f",deficit) or "unknown"))
    end
    if unknown==0 and available then
        local maximum=recipe.OutputAmount and available*recipe.OutputAmount or available
        if maximum<=9007199254740991 then table.insert(lines,"Craftable from readable materials: "..string.format("%.0f",maximum)..(recipe.OutputAmount and " output items" or " crafts (output quantity unknown)"))
        else table.insert(lines,"Craftable amount exceeds supported numeric range") end
    end
    table.insert(lines,missing.." material types short; "..unknown.." unreadable. "..(crafts==nil and "Per craft only. " or "").."Client recipe estimate; server checks still apply.")
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunning then table.insert(lines,"Current queue job only; later jobs are not included.") end
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end
-- CRAFT QUEUE MATERIALS BEGIN
function RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueMaterialPlan(countOf)
    countOf=countOf or RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialCount
    local plan={Jobs={},Rows={},Complete=false,MissingTypes=0,UnknownTypes=0}
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker or RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled then plan.Reason="Crafting active or finishing. Stop and wait for cleanup to estimate the next full run.";return plan end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLoading or RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy then plan.Reason="Wait for recipe or preset loading to finish.";return plan end
    if type(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue)~="table" or next(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue)==nil then plan.Reason="Queue empty. Add finite jobs or load a saved preset first.";return plan end
    local valid,preset=pcall(RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPreset,{Version=1,Name="Material plan",Jobs=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue})
    if not valid then plan.Reason="Invalid queue. Choose 1–8 valid finite jobs before estimating.";return plan end
    plan.TotalJobs=#preset.Jobs
    local ledger={}
    local function entry(item)
        if not ledger[item] then
            local have=countOf(item)
            ledger[item]={Item=item,Have=have,Stock=have,Need=0,Produced=0,Missing=have~=nil and 0 or nil}
        end
        return ledger[item]
    end
    for index,job in ipairs(preset.Jobs) do
        local output=entry(job.Item)
        local desired=job.Target
        if job.Mode=="Top up stock" then
            if output.Stock==nil then plan.Reason="Job "..index.." · "..job.Item..": output inventory unreadable; later jobs not estimated.";break end
            desired=math.max(0,job.Target-output.Stock)
        end
        local recipe=RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterials[job.Item]
        local crafts=0
        local costs={}
        if desired>0 then
            local reason
            if type(recipe)~="table" then reason="material data unavailable; press Load all recipes"
            elseif recipe.Error then reason=recipe.Error
            elseif type(recipe.OutputAmount)~="number" or recipe.OutputAmount<=0 or recipe.OutputAmount>1000000000 or recipe.OutputAmount%1~=0 then reason="output quantity unknown or invalid"
            elseif type(recipe.Ingredients)~="table" or #recipe.Ingredients==0 or #recipe.Ingredients>64 then reason="ingredient quantities unavailable" end
            if reason then plan.Reason="Job "..index.." · "..job.Item..": "..reason.."; later jobs not estimated.";break end
            -- Round each chosen request batch separately. Do not credit any
            -- possible rounding surplus as inventory for a later queue job.
            crafts=math.floor(desired/job.Batch)*math.ceil(job.Batch/recipe.OutputAmount)+math.ceil((desired%job.Batch)/recipe.OutputAmount)
            local count=0
            for key,row in pairs(recipe.Ingredients) do
                count+=1
                if type(key)~="number" or key%1~=0 or key<1 or key>#recipe.Ingredients or count>64 or type(row)~="table"
                    or type(row.Item)~="string" or #row.Item<1 or #row.Item>128 or row.Item:find("%c") or row.Item:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")~=row.Item
                    or type(row.Amount)~="number" or row.Amount<=0 or row.Amount>1000000000 or row.Amount%1~=0 then reason="ingredient quantities invalid";break end
                costs[row.Item]=(costs[row.Item] or 0)+row.Amount*crafts
            end
            if count~=#recipe.Ingredients then reason="ingredient quantities invalid" end
            if costs[job.Item] then reason="recipe consumes its own output; net gain unknown" end
            if reason then plan.Reason="Job "..index.." · "..job.Item..": "..reason.."; later jobs not estimated.";break end
        end
        -- All costs for this job are known before applying any deductions.
        for item,need in pairs(costs) do
            local row=entry(item)
            row.Need+=need
            if row.Stock~=nil then
                local missing=math.max(0,need-row.Stock)
                row.Missing+=missing;row.Stock=math.max(0,row.Stock-need)
            end
        end
        output.Produced+=desired
        if output.Stock~=nil then output.Stock=math.min(9007199254740991-desired,output.Stock)+desired end
        table.insert(plan.Jobs,{Index=index,Item=job.Item,Mode=job.Mode,Desired=desired,Crafts=crafts})
    end
    plan.Complete=#plan.Jobs==plan.TotalJobs
    for _,row in pairs(ledger) do
        if row.Need>0 then
            table.insert(plan.Rows,{Item=row.Item,Need=row.Need,Have=row.Have,Produced=row.Produced,Missing=row.Missing})
            if row.Missing==nil then plan.UnknownTypes+=1 elseif row.Missing>0 then plan.MissingTypes+=1 end
        end
    end
    table.sort(plan.Rows,function(a,b) return a.Item<b.Item end)
    return plan
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueMaterialReport()
    local plan=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueMaterialPlan()
    local lines={"WHOLE QUEUE · next full run"}
    if not plan.TotalJobs then table.insert(lines,plan.Reason);return table.concat(lines,"\n") end
    table.insert(lines,(plan.Complete and "Estimated " or "PARTIAL · estimated prefix ")..#plan.Jobs.." / "..plan.TotalJobs.." jobs in queue order.")
    for _,job in ipairs(plan.Jobs) do table.insert(lines,job.Index..". "..job.Item.." · "..job.Mode.." · +"..job.Desired.." planned · "..job.Crafts.." estimated crafts") end
    if plan.Reason then table.insert(lines,plan.Reason.." No full-queue total available.") end
    if #plan.Rows==0 then table.insert(lines,plan.Complete and "No materials needed; stock targets already met." or "No material totals available for this prefix.") end
    for _,row in ipairs(plan.Rows) do
        table.insert(lines,row.Item.." · use "..string.format("%.0f",row.Need).." · have "..(row.Have~=nil and string.format("%.0f",row.Have) or "unknown")..
            " · queue output "..string.format("%.0f",row.Produced).." · missing in order "..(row.Missing~=nil and string.format("%.0f",row.Missing) or "unknown"))
    end
    table.insert(lines,plan.MissingTypes.." material types short; "..plan.UnknownTypes.." unreadable."..(plan.Complete and "" or " Prefix only; remaining jobs unknown."))
    table.insert(lines,"Shared stock is counted once. Assumes prior jobs succeed and you supply shortages as needed. Restocking can change Top up jobs: refresh before running.")
    table.insert(lines,"Per-batch costs round up; output surplus is not credited. Client estimate only; no materials reserved or crafting started.")
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end
-- CRAFT QUEUE MATERIALS END
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftMaterials()
    if not gui.Parent or not RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialsLabel then return end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialsLabel.Text=RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialsScope=="Whole queue" and RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueMaterialReport() or RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialReport()
end
-- CRAFT MATERIALS END

function RemoteCatalog.ReadCraftRecipes(data,output,recipeRoot,materials)
    local seen,nodes={},0
    local function id(value)
        return type(value)=="string" and #value>0 and #value<=128 and not value:find("%c") and value:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")==value and value or nil
    end
    local function item(value)
        if type(value)=="string" then return id(value) end
        if type(value)=="table" then return id(rawget(value,"toolName")) or id(rawget(value,"itemName")) or id(rawget(value,"itemType")) or id(rawget(value,"item")) or id(rawget(value,"type")) or id(rawget(value,"name")) end
    end
    local function walk(value,key,recipeContext,hint,depth)
        if type(value)~="table" or seen[value] or depth>8 or nodes>=10000 then return end
        seen[value]=true;nodes+=1
        local ingredients=rawget(value,"ingredients") or rawget(value,"requiredItems") or rawget(value,"materials") or rawget(value,"inputs") or (recipeContext and rawget(value,"items"))
        local explicit=item(rawget(value,"toolName")) or item(rawget(value,"outputItem")) or item(rawget(value,"output")) or item(rawget(value,"result")) or item(rawget(value,"itemName")) or (recipeContext and item(rawget(value,"itemType")))
        local name=explicit or hint or (recipeContext and id(key))
        if name and (type(ingredients)=="table" or recipeContext and (explicit or hint)) then
            output[name]=true
            if materials then RemoteCatalog.RememberCraftMaterials(materials,name,value,ingredients) end
        end
        for field,child in next,value do
            if type(child)=="table" then
                local lower=type(field)=="string" and string.lower(field):gsub("[^%w]","") or ""
                local excluded=lower=="ingredients" or lower=="requireditems" or lower=="materials" or lower=="inputs" or lower=="cost" or lower=="requirements" or lower=="output" or lower=="outputitem" or lower=="result" or (recipeContext and lower=="items")
                if not excluded then
                    local container=lower=="recipes" or lower=="craftingrecipes" or lower=="craftrecipes"
                    local single=lower=="recipe" or lower=="craftingrecipe"
                    walk(child,field,container or single or recipeContext,single and (explicit or id(key)) or nil,depth+1)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    walk(data,nil,recipeRoot==true,nil,0)
    return nodes
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipeModule(name)
    name=tostring(name):match("([^%.]+)$") or tostring(name)
    local lower=string.lower(name):gsub("[^%w]","")
    return string.find(lower,"recipe",1,true)~=nil or lower=="craftingmeta" or lower=="craftingconfig" or lower=="craftingdata" or lower=="itemmeta" or lower=="itemconfig"
end
function RemoteCatalog.LoadCraftCatalog()
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Wait for preset file work to finish first.");return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker or RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLoading then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Finish or stop crafting before loading recipes.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLoading=true
    RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogStatus="Reading recipe data…"
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogButton then RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogButton.Text="Loading recipes…" end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftCatalogUI()
    local found,sources,failed,attempts={},0,0,0
    local materials={}
    local visited,exports,paths={},{},{}
    local limited=false
    local function budget()
        if not gui.Parent then return false end
        if attempts>=32 then limited=true;return false end
        attempts+=1;return true
    end
    local function accept(data,name)
        if exports[data] then return end
        exports[data]=true
        RemoteCatalog.ReadCraftRecipes(data,found,string.find(string.lower(tostring(name)),"recipe",1,true)~=nil,materials)
        sources+=1
    end
    local ok=pcall(function()
        for path,data in pairs(RemoteCatalog.ModuleCache or {}) do
            if RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipeModule(path) and type(data)=="table" and not exports[data] then
                if not budget() then break end
                paths[path]=true;accept(data,path)
            end
        end
        local root=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local read=require
        if type(getrenv)=="function" then
            local available,environment=pcall(getrenv)
            if available and type(environment)=="table" and type(environment.require)=="function" then read=environment.require end
        end
        local metadata={recipe=true,recipes=true,craftingrecipe=true,craftingrecipes=true,craftrecipes=true,itemmeta=true,itemconfig=true,craftingconfig=true,craftingmeta=true,craftingdata=true}
        local function inspect(module,strict)
            if visited[module] then return end
            local candidate,name=false,nil
            pcall(function()
                name=module.Name
                local normalized=string.lower(tostring(name)):gsub("[^%w]","")
                candidate=typeof(module)=="Instance" and module:IsA("ModuleScript") and module:IsDescendantOf(root) and (strict and metadata[normalized]==true or not strict and RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipeModule(name))
            end)
            if not candidate then return end
            visited[module]=true
            local named,path=pcall(function() return module:GetFullName() end)
            if named and paths[path] then return end
            if not budget() then return end
            local loaded,data=pcall(read,module)
            if not gui.Parent then return end
            if loaded and type(data)=="table" then accept(data,name) else failed+=1 end
        end
        -- Read exports only. Recipe functions and craft requests are never called.
        if gui.Parent and not limited and type(getloadedmodules)=="function" then
            local listed,modules=pcall(getloadedmodules)
            if listed and type(modules)=="table" then
                for _,module in pairs(modules) do
                    if not gui.Parent or limited then break end
                    inspect(module,false)
                end
            end
        end
        -- A partial loaded list can omit recipes from unopened stations. Check
        -- explicitly named metadata too, sharing the same read budget/visited set.
        if gui.Parent and not limited then
            local listed,modules=pcall(function() return root:GetDescendants() end)
            if listed and type(modules)=="table" then
                for _,module in ipairs(modules) do
                    if not gui.Parent or limited then break end
                    inspect(module,true)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLoading=false
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogButton and gui.Parent then RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogButton.Text="Load all recipes" end
    if not gui.Parent then return false end
    local count=0;for _ in pairs(found) do count+=1 end
    if ok and count>0 then
        RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalog=found;RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterials=materials
        RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogStatus=count.." recipes loaded from "..sources.." tables. Search to choose one."
        if failed>0 or limited then RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogStatus=RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogStatus.." Partial scan: "..failed.." failed reads"..(limited and "; 32-read limit reached." or ".") end
    else
        RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogStatus=not ok and "Recipe data could not be read; existing list kept." or "Could not find the game's recipe list. Open a crafting station and try again; learned recipes stay available."
        if failed>0 or limited then RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogStatus=RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogStatus.." "..failed.." failed reads"..(limited and "; 32-read limit reached." or ".") end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogSources=sources;RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogFailures=failed
    RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogAttempts=attempts;RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLimited=limited
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftCatalogUI()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogStatus)
    return ok and count>0
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipeOptions()
    local query=RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipeSearch and RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipeSearch.Text or ""
    query=string.lower(query):gsub("[%s_%-]","")
    local options={}
    for _,name in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipes()) do
        if string.find(string.lower(name):gsub("[%s_%-]",""),query,1,true) then
            table.insert(options,name)
            if #options==60 then break end
        end
    end
    return options
end
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftCatalogUI()
    if not gui.Parent then return end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLabel then
        local total=#RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipes()
        local shown=#RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipeOptions()
        local recorder=RemoteCatalog.CraftRecorder()
        RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLabel.Text=RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogStatus.."\n"..shown.." shown / "..total.." available (up to 60; use search). "..(recorder and "Selected recipe learned." or "Learn the selected recipe before starting Auto Craft.")
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogButton then RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogButton.Active=not RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker and not RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLoading end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipeSearch then RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipeSearch.TextEditable=RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker==nil end
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftPresets then RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftPresets() end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftMaterials()
end
-- CRAFT CATALOG END
function RemoteCatalog.CraftRecorder(item)
    item=item or RemoteCatalog.CraftItem
    local selected,chosen
    for _,recorder in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.CraftRecorders()) do
        local binding=recorder.CraftBindings and recorder.CraftBindings[item]
        if not binding and recorder.CraftBinding and (recorder.CraftBinding.Item or "bait")==item then binding=recorder.CraftBinding end
        if binding and type(recorder.CanUseCraftBinding)=="function" and recorder:CanUseCraftBinding(binding)
            and (type(recorder.CraftItem)=="function" or item=="bait" and type(recorder.CraftBait)=="function")
            and (not chosen or (binding.ObservedAt or 0)>(chosen.ObservedAt or 0)) then selected,chosen=recorder,binding end
    end
    return selected,chosen
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftReachable(bench)
    local island=getPlayerIsland()
    local cursor=bench
    while cursor and cursor~=island do cursor=cursor.Parent end
    if not island or cursor~=island then return false,"Use the learned workbench on your own island." end
    local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local position=getPartPosition(bench)
    if not root or not position or (root.Position-position).Magnitude>20 then return false,"Waiting · stand within 20 studs of the learned workbench. Crafting stays ON." end
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.MakeCraftJob(item,mode,batch,target,allowContinuous)
    if type(item)~="string" or #item==0 or #item>128 or (mode~="Make amount" and mode~="Top up stock" and not (allowContinuous and mode=="Continuous"))
        or (batch~=25 and batch~=50 and batch~=100) or not table.find({100,250,500,1000,2500,5000,10000},target) then
        return nil,"Choose a valid recipe, finite mode, batch and amount. Continuous is available for single-recipe runs."
    end
    local recorder,binding=RemoteCatalog.CraftRecorder(item)
    if not recorder then return nil,"Learn "..item.." on this character/server first, then choose it in Recipe." end
    return {Item=item,Mode=mode,Batch=batch,Target=target,Recorder=recorder,Binding=binding}
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueEditable()
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    return gui.Parent~=nil and not RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker and not RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled and not RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy and not RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferBusy
        and not RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLoading and not RemoteCatalog.CraftLearning and not (recorder and recorder.LearnCraftOnly)
end
-- CRAFT QUEUE CHECK BEGIN
function RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckMessage(text)
    if gui.Parent and RemoteCatalog.CraftInfo then RemoteCatalog.CraftInfo.Text=text end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue()
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckCurrent(result)
    if not result or not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueEditable() then return false end
    local char=player.Character
    local ok,root=pcall(function() return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end)
    local age=os.clock()-result._At
    if not ok or age<0 or age>30 or result._Queue~=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue or result._Revision~=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRevision
        or result._Generation~=RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration or result._Character~=char or result._Root~=root or result._Owner~=player.UserId
        or result._JobId~=(game and game.JobId) or result._PlaceId~=(game and game.PlaceId) or result._Materials~=RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterials then return false end
    if result._Jobs then
        if #result._Jobs~=#RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue then return false end
        local count=0;for _ in pairs(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue) do count+=1 end
        if count~=#result._Jobs then return false end
        for index,job in ipairs(result._Jobs) do
            local current=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue[index]
            if type(current)~="table" or current.Item~=job.Item or current.Mode~=job.Mode or current.Batch~=job.Batch or current.Target~=job.Target then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.CheckCraftQueue(copy)
    if not gui.Parent then return false end
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueEditable() or RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckBusy then
        RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckMessage("Stop crafting and wait for learning, loading, transfers and cleanup before checking the queue.");return false
    end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    local char=player.Character
    local actorOK,root=pcall(function() return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end)
    local result={Checks={},Jobs={},Actions=0,Unknown=0,NextSteps={},_At=os.clock(),_Queue=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue,
        _Revision=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRevision,_Generation=RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration,_Character=char,_Root=root,_Owner=player.UserId,
        _JobId=game and game.JobId,_PlaceId=game and game.PlaceId,_Materials=RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterials}
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckResult=nil;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckBusy=true
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue()
    local function add(name,state,detail)
        table.insert(result.Checks,{Name=name,State=state,Detail=detail})
        if state=="ACTION" then result.Actions+=1 elseif state=="UNKNOWN" then result.Unknown+=1 end
    end
    local ok,failure=pcall(function()
        add("Character",actorOK and root and "OK" or "ACTION",actorOK and root and "Character root available" or "Wait for your character to spawn")
        if not actorOK or not root then table.insert(result.NextSteps,"Wait for your character, then refresh Check queue.") end
        if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy then
            add("Automation","ACTION","Crafting waits while chest collection or its request cleanup is active")
            table.insert(result.NextSteps,"Finish chest collection and wait for request cleanup.")
        end
        local valid,preset=pcall(RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPreset,{Version=1,Name="Queue check",Jobs=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue})
        if not valid then
            add("Queue","ACTION","Add or import 1–8 valid finite jobs before running")
            table.insert(result.NextSteps,"Add finite jobs or import a valid queue, then check again.")
            return
        end
        result._Jobs=preset.Jobs
        add("Queue","OK",#preset.Jobs.." valid finite jobs; requests remain capped at 100")
        local counts={}
        local function stock(item)
            if not counts[item] then counts[item]={Value=RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialCount(item)} end
            return counts[item].Value
        end
        local unlearned,reachProblems={},0
        for index,job in ipairs(preset.Jobs) do
            local row={Index=index,Item=job.Item};table.insert(result.Jobs,row)
            local inspected,recorder,binding=pcall(RemoteCatalog.CraftRecorder,job.Item)
            row.Learned=inspected and recorder~=nil and binding~=nil
            if not inspected then add("Job "..index.." · "..job.Item,"UNKNOWN","Could not inspect the current learned request")
            elseif not row.Learned then
                add("Job "..index.." · "..job.Item,"ACTION","Learn this recipe on the current character/server")
                unlearned[job.Item]=true
            else
                add("Job "..index.." · "..job.Item,"OK","Current learned recipe available")
                local checked,reachable,reason=pcall(RemoteCatalog.CraftReachable,binding.Workbench)
                row.Reachable=checked and reachable==true
                add("Workbench "..index,not checked and "UNKNOWN" or reachable and "OK" or "ACTION",
                    not checked and "Could not inspect workbench reach/ownership" or reachable and "Own learned workbench within 20 studs"
                    or tostring(reason or "Use a reachable learned workbench on your own island"):gsub(" Crafting stays ON%.",""))
                if checked and not reachable then reachProblems+=1 end
            end
            row.Inventory=stock(job.Item)
            add("Output inventory "..index,row.Inventory~=nil and "OK" or "UNKNOWN",row.Inventory~=nil and tostring(row.Inventory).." currently owned" or "Output quantity unreadable; wait and refresh before running")
        end
        local names={};for name in pairs(unlearned) do table.insert(names,name) end;table.sort(names)
        if #names>0 then table.insert(result.NextSteps,"Learn recipes: "..table.concat(names,", ")..". Imported queues do not include learned requests.") end
        if reachProblems>0 then table.insert(result.NextSteps,"Use the learned workbenches on your own island and stand within 20 studs; Check queue does not walk.") end
        local planned,plan=pcall(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueMaterialPlan,stock)
        if not planned or type(plan)~="table" then add("Materials","UNKNOWN","Material estimate unavailable")
        else
            result.Materials=plan
            add("Materials",plan.Complete and "OK" or "UNKNOWN",plan.Complete and "Full queue estimated in order; client metadata only" or tostring(plan.Reason or "Partial estimate; later jobs unknown"))
            if (plan.UnknownTypes or 0)>0 then add("Material inventory","UNKNOWN",plan.UnknownTypes.." quantities unreadable") end
            if (plan.MissingTypes or 0)>0 then
                local missing={}
                for _,row in ipairs(plan.Rows) do if row.Missing and row.Missing>0 then table.insert(missing,row.Item.." ×"..string.format("%.0f",row.Missing)) end end
                add("Shortages","ACTION",table.concat(missing,", ")..(plan.Complete and "" or " (estimated prefix only)"))
                table.insert(result.NextSteps,"Collect estimated missing materials: "..table.concat(missing,", ")..". Refresh after restocking; Top up jobs can change.")
            end
        end
    end)
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckBusy=false
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckCurrent(result) then
        if gui.Parent then
            if RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker or RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled then RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue()
            else RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckMessage("Queue or character changed during the check. Refresh Check queue; old results discarded.") end
        end
        return false
    end
    if not ok then add("Inspection","UNKNOWN","Could not complete the check: "..tostring(failure)) end
    result.Summary=result.Actions>0 and "ACTION NEEDED" or result.Unknown>0 and "CHECKS INCOMPLETE" or "LOCAL CHECKS PASS"
    if result.Unknown>0 then table.insert(result.NextSteps,"Load all recipes for material metadata, let inventory settle, then refresh the check.") end
    if #result.NextSteps==0 then table.insert(result.NextSteps,"Review the queue, then Run Queue. Server ingredient and permission checks still apply.") end
    local lines={"CRAFT QUEUE CHECK · snapshot",result.Summary.." · "..result.Actions.." action checks · "..result.Unknown.." unknown checks","Next: "..result.NextSteps[1]}
    for _,check in ipairs(result.Checks) do table.insert(lines,"["..check.State.."] "..check.Name..": "..check.Detail) end
    for _,step in ipairs(result.NextSteps) do table.insert(lines,"→ "..step) end
    if result.Materials then
        for _,row in ipairs(result.Materials.Rows) do table.insert(lines,row.Item.." · estimated use "..row.Need.." · have "..tostring(row.Have or "unknown").." · queue output "..row.Produced.." · missing in order "..tostring(row.Missing or "unknown")) end
    end
    table.insert(lines,"Read-only snapshot; expires after 30s. Refresh after moving, learning or inventory/world changes. No crafting started, materials reserved or files written. Costs assume earlier jobs succeed and shortages are supplied as needed.")
    result.Text=table.concat(lines,"\n")
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckResult=result
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueView then RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueView.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckMessage("Queue check: "..result.Summary..". Read the scrollable queue report below; no crafting started.")
    if copy then
        local copier=setclipboard or toclipboard
        local ran,copied=false,false
        if type(copier)=="function" then ran,copied=pcall(copier,result.Text) end
        if ran and copied~=false then RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckMessage("Queue check copied. Snapshot also shown in the queue report.")
        else print(result.Text);RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckMessage("Queue check printed to console; clipboard unavailable or failed.") end
    end
    return result
end
-- CRAFT QUEUE CHECK END
function RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueChanged()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRevision=(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRevision or 0)+1;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckResult=nil
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueDone=0;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueTotal=0;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueIndex=nil
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunSize=nil;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueActiveItem=nil;RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialRun=nil
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueJobOptions()
    local options={}
    for index,job in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue) do table.insert(options,index.." · "..tostring(type(job)=="table" and job.Item or "Invalid job")) end
    return options
end
function RemoteCatalog.SelectCraftQueueJob(index)
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueEditable() or type(index)~="number" or index%1~=0 then return false end
    local ok,preset=pcall(RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPreset,{Version=1,Name="Queue edit",Jobs={RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue[index]}})
    if not ok then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Choose a valid queue job first.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    local job=preset.Jobs[1]
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected=index
    RemoteCatalog.CraftItem=job.Item;RemoteCatalog.CraftMode=job.Mode;RemoteCatalog.CraftBatch=job.Batch;RemoteCatalog.CraftTarget=job.Target
    for _,name in ipairs({"CraftRecipeMenu","CraftModeMenu","CraftBatchMenu","CraftTargetMenu"}) do
        if RemoteCatalog[name] then RemoteCatalog[name]:Refresh() end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Editing job "..index..": change the recipe, mode, batch or amount above, then Apply settings. Queue unchanged until applied.")
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.MoveCraftQueueJob(direction)
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueEditable() or (direction~=-1 and direction~=1) then return false end
    local index=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected
    if type(index)~="number" or index%1~=0 or not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue[index] or not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue[index+direction] then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    local queue=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue
    queue[index],queue[index+direction]=queue[index+direction],queue[index]
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected=index+direction;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueChanged()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Moved selected job to position "..RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected..". No crafting started.")
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ApplyCraftQueueJob()
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueEditable() then return false end
    local index=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected
    if type(index)~="number" or index%1~=0 or not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue[index] then return false end
    local ok,preset=pcall(RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPreset,{Version=1,Name="Queue edit",Jobs={{Item=RemoteCatalog.CraftItem,Mode=RemoteCatalog.CraftMode,Batch=RemoteCatalog.CraftBatch,Target=RemoteCatalog.CraftTarget}}})
    if not ok then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Choose a valid recipe, finite mode, batch and amount. Selected job kept.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue[index]=preset.Jobs[1];RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueChanged()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Updated job "..index..". Saved presets unchanged; save again to update a preset. Run Queue validates all learned recipes.")
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueText()
    local check=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckResult
    if check and not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckCurrent(check) then RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckResult=nil;check=nil end
    local lines={"QUEUE · "..#RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue.." / 8 jobs"}
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckBusy then table.insert(lines,"Checking queue · no crafting started")
    elseif check then table.insert(lines,check.Summary.." · snapshot\nNext: "..check.NextSteps[1]) end
    if #RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue==0 then table.insert(lines,"Choose a recipe, Make amount or Top up stock, then Add to queue. Each request remains capped at 100.") end
    for index,job in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue) do
        local marker=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunning and index==RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueIndex and "▶ " or index<=(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueDone or 0) and "✓ " or ""
        if index==RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected then marker..="EDIT · " end
        if type(job)=="table" then
            table.insert(lines,marker..index..". "..tostring(job.Item).." · "..tostring(job.Mode).." "..tostring(job.Target).." · batch "..tostring(job.Batch))
        else table.insert(lines,index..". Invalid job; clear the queue.") end
    end
    if check then table.insert(lines,"\n"..check.Text) end
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue()
    if not gui.Parent then return end
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftPresets then RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftPresets() end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueLabel then RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueLabel.Text=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueText() end
    local busy=not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueEditable()
    local index=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected
    local selected=type(index)=="number" and index%1==0 and RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue[index]~=nil
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueJobMenu then RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueJobMenu:Refresh() end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRemoveButton then RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRemoveButton.Text=selected and "Remove selected job" or "Remove last job" end
    for _,name in ipairs({"CraftQueueAddButton","CraftQueueRemoveButton","CraftQueueClearButton","CraftQueueJobButton","CraftQueueUpButton","CraftQueueDownButton","CraftQueueApplyButton","CraftQueueCheckButton","CraftQueueCopyCheckButton"}) do
        local control=RemoteCatalog[name]
        if control then
            local available=not busy
            if name=="CraftQueueAddButton" then available=available and RemoteCatalog.CraftMode~="Continuous" and #RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue<8
            elseif name=="CraftQueueJobButton" or name=="CraftQueueRemoveButton" or name=="CraftQueueClearButton" then available=available and #RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue>0
            elseif name=="CraftQueueApplyButton" then available=available and selected and RemoteCatalog.CraftMode~="Continuous"
            elseif name=="CraftQueueUpButton" then available=available and selected and index>1
            elseif name=="CraftQueueDownButton" then available=available and selected and index<#RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue
            elseif name=="CraftQueueCheckButton" or name=="CraftQueueCopyCheckButton" then available=available and not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckBusy end
            control.Active=available;control.Selectable=available;control.TextColor3=available and COLORS.text or COLORS.muted
        end
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunButton then
        RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunButton.Text=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunning and (RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled and "STOP QUEUE" or "FINISHING…") or "RUN QUEUE"
        RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunButton.Active=not busy or (RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunning==true and RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled==true)
        RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunButton.Selectable=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunButton.Active
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.AddCraftQueueJob()
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueEditable() then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Stop crafting/learning and wait for loading or cleanup before editing the queue.");return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Wait for preset file work to finish first.");return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Stop crafting and wait for cleanup before editing the queue.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    if #RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue>=8 then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Queue is full: remove a job or clear the queue first.");return false end
    local job,reason=RemoteCatalog.MakeCraftJob(RemoteCatalog.CraftItem,RemoteCatalog.CraftMode,RemoteCatalog.CraftBatch,RemoteCatalog.CraftTarget,false)
    if not job then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(reason);return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    table.insert(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue,{Item=job.Item,Mode=job.Mode,Batch=job.Batch,Target=job.Target})
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected=#RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueChanged()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Added "..job.Item.." to queue. Run Queue starts from the first job and uses your materials.")
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.EditCraftQueue(clear)
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueEditable() then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Stop crafting/learning and wait for loading or cleanup before editing the queue.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    local index=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected or #RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue
    if clear then RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue={}
    elseif type(index)=="number" and index%1==0 and RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue[index] then table.remove(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue,index)
    else return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected=nil;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueChanged()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(clear and "Queue cleared. No crafting started." or "Queue job removed. No crafting started.")
    return true
end
-- CRAFT PRESETS BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.CraftPresets={}
RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetPersistence={}
RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetSlot=1
RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetOwner=player.UserId
RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetFileState="No saved file read yet"
function RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPreset(data)
    assert(type(data)=="table" and data.Version==1,"Unsupported queue preset version")
    assert(type(data.Name)=="string" and #data.Name>=1 and #data.Name<=48 and not data.Name:find("%c") and data.Name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")==data.Name,"Use a preset name of 1–48 bytes")
    assert(type(data.Jobs)=="table" and #data.Jobs>=1 and #data.Jobs<=8,"Save a queue with 1–8 finite jobs")
    local count,jobs=0,{}
    for key in pairs(data.Jobs) do
        assert(type(key)=="number" and key%1==0 and key>=1 and key<=#data.Jobs,"Queue jobs must be a consecutive list")
        count+=1
    end
    assert(count==#data.Jobs,"Queue jobs must be a consecutive list")
    for _,job in ipairs(data.Jobs) do
        assert(type(job)=="table" and type(job.Item)=="string" and #job.Item>=1 and #job.Item<=128 and not job.Item:find("%c") and job.Item:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")==job.Item,"Invalid recipe ID in queue")
        assert(job.Mode=="Make amount" or job.Mode=="Top up stock","Saved queues support finite modes only")
        assert(job.Batch==25 or job.Batch==50 or job.Batch==100,"Invalid queue batch")
        assert(table.find({100,250,500,1000,2500,5000,10000},job.Target),"Invalid queue amount/stock target")
        table.insert(jobs,{Item=job.Item,Mode=job.Mode,Batch=job.Batch,Target=job.Target})
    end
    return {Version=1,Name=data.Name,Jobs=jobs}
end
function RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPresets(data)
    assert(type(data)=="table" and data.Version==1 and type(data.Presets)=="table","Invalid queue presets file")
    local presets={}
    for slot,preset in pairs(data.Presets) do
        assert(slot=="1" or slot=="2" or slot=="3","Invalid queue preset slot")
        presets[tonumber(slot)]=RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPreset(preset)
    end
    return presets
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetIdle()
    if not gui.Parent then return false end
    local slot=RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetSlot
    if type(slot)~="number" or slot%1~=0 or slot<1 or slot>3 then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Choose a queue preset slot from 1 to 3.");return false end
    if player.UserId~=RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetOwner or type(player.UserId)~="number" or player.UserId<1 or player.UserId%1~=0 then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Queue presets belong to this hub's account. Reload the hub for another account.");return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferBusy or RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy or RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker or RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled or RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLoading or RemoteCatalog.CraftLearning or RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnCraftOnly then
        RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Finish or stop crafting, recipe loading/learning and preset file work before editing presets.");return false
    end
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftPresets()
    if not gui.Parent or not RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetSummary then return end
    local slot=RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetSlot
    local preset=RemoteCatalog.CraftPresets[slot]
    local busy=RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferBusy or RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy or RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker~=nil or RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled or RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLoading or RemoteCatalog.CraftLearning or RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnCraftOnly
    for _,key in ipairs({"CraftPresetSlotButton","CraftPresetSaveButton","CraftPresetLoadButton","CraftExportButton","CraftCopyQueueButton","CraftImportButton"}) do
        local control=RemoteCatalog[key]
        if control then
            local available=not busy and (key~="CraftPresetLoadButton" or preset~=nil)
                and (key~="CraftExportButton" and key~="CraftCopyQueueButton" or #RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue>0)
            control.Active=available;control.Selectable=available;control.AutoButtonColor=available
            control.TextColor3=available and COLORS.text or COLORS.muted
        end
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName then RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName.TextEditable=not busy end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferText then RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferText.TextEditable=not busy end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetSlotButton then RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetSlotButton.Text="Preset: "..tostring(slot).." / 3" end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetSummary.Text=(preset and (preset.Name.." · "..#preset.Jobs.." jobs · "..(RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetPersistence[slot] or "Session only")) or ("Empty preset "..tostring(slot))).."\n"..RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetFileState.."\nLoad replaces the working queue and keeps crafting OFF. Learn each recipe on this character/server before Run Queue."
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetCraftPresetSlot(slot)
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetIdle() then return false end
    if type(slot)~="number" or slot%1~=0 or slot<1 or slot>3 then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetSlot=slot
    local preset=RemoteCatalog.CraftPresets[slot]
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName then RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName.Text=preset and preset.Name or "Craft queue "..slot end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftPresets()
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ReadCraftPresets()
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetIdle() then return false end
    if type(readfile)~="function" then RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetFileState="File reading unavailable; session only";RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftPresets();return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy=true;RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftPresets();RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue()
    local ok,result=pcall(function()
        local encoded=readfile("RebornCraftQueues_"..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetOwner)..".json")
        assert(type(encoded)=="string" and #encoded>0 and #encoded<=65536,"Invalid queue presets file size")
        return RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPresets(HttpService:JSONDecode(encoded))
    end)
    RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy=false
    if not gui.Parent then return false end
    if ok then
        for slot,preset in pairs(result) do
            if not RemoteCatalog.CraftPresets[slot] then RemoteCatalog.CraftPresets[slot]=preset;RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetPersistence[slot]="Loaded from file" end
        end
        RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetFileState="Saved file loaded"
        local selected=RemoteCatalog.CraftPresets[RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetSlot]
        if selected and RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName then RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName.Text=selected.Name end
    else RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetFileState="File missing, unreadable or invalid; session presets retained" end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftPresets();RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue()
    return ok
end
function RemoteCatalog.SaveCraftPreset()
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetIdle() then return false end
    local name=RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName and RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName.Text
    if type(name)=="string" then name=name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
    local ok,preset=pcall(RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPreset,{Version=1,Name=name,Jobs=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue})
    if not ok then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Preset not saved: "..tostring(preset));return false end
    local slot=RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetSlot
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftPresets[slot]=preset
    RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName.Text=preset.Name
    RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy=true;RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftPresets();RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue()
    local saved=false
    if type(writefile)=="function" then saved=pcall(function()
        local envelope={Version=1,Presets={}}
        for index,entry in pairs(RemoteCatalog.CraftPresets) do
            assert(index==1 or index==2 or index==3,"Invalid preset slot")
            envelope.Presets[tostring(index)]=RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPreset(entry)
        end
        local encoded=HttpService:JSONEncode(envelope)
        assert(type(encoded)=="string" and #encoded>0 and #encoded<=65536,"Invalid queue presets file size")
        assert(writefile("RebornCraftQueues_"..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetOwner)..".json",encoded)~=false,"File writer reported failure")
    end) end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy=false
    if saved then
        for index in pairs(RemoteCatalog.CraftPresets) do RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetPersistence[index]="File + session" end
        RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetFileState="Saved file written"
    else RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetPersistence[slot]="Session only";RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetFileState="File saving unavailable or failed; preset kept in session" end
    if not gui.Parent then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftPresets();RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Saved queue preset "..slot..": "..preset.Name..(saved and " (file + session)." or " (session only; file saving unavailable or failed).").." No crafting started.")
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.LoadCraftPreset()
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetIdle() then return false end
    local slot=RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetSlot
    local ok,preset=pcall(RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPreset,RemoteCatalog.CraftPresets[slot])
    if not ok then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Save a valid preset in this slot before loading it. Current queue kept.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue=preset.Jobs
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected=nil
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueDone=0;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueTotal=0;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueIndex=nil;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunSize=nil;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueActiveItem=nil;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunning=false
    RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled=false;RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused=false;RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialRun=nil
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName then RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName.Text=preset.Name end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Loaded "..preset.Name..": "..#preset.Jobs.." jobs. Working queue replaced; crafting stays OFF. Run Queue validates every learned recipe before starting.")
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferMessage(text,notice)
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(text)
    if gui.Parent and RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferHint then RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferHint.Text=notice or text end
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetCraftTransferOpen(open)
    if not gui.Parent or not RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferPanel then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferPanel.Visible=open==true
    RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferPanel.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,open and 250 or 0)
    RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferButton.Text=open and "Queue backup / share  ▴" or "Queue backup / share  ▾"
    if not open then pcall(function() RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferText:ReleaseFocus() end) end
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferReady()
    if not gui.Parent then return false end
    if player.UserId~=RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetOwner then RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferMessage("Reload the hub after changing accounts before importing/exporting queues.");return false end
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueEditable() then RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferMessage("Stop crafting and wait for learning, catalog, file and request cleanup before importing/exporting queues.","Stop and wait for crafting, learning and file work before transferring.");return false end
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ExportCraftQueue(copy)
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferReady() then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    local queue,generation=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue,RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration
    local name=RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName and RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "Shared craft queue"
    if name=="" then name="Shared craft queue" end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferBusy=true;RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    local ok,encoded=pcall(function()
        -- Export a fresh descriptor snapshot; learned packets never enter JSON.
        local preset=RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPreset({Version=1,Name=name,Jobs=queue})
        local text=HttpService:JSONEncode(preset)
        assert(type(text)=="string" and #text>0 and #text<=32768,"Queue export must fit within 32 KiB")
        return text
    end)
    RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferBusy=false;RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferReady() or RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue~=queue or RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration~=generation then
        RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferMessage("Queue or crafting state changed during transfer. Try again when idle.");return false
    end
    if not ok then RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferMessage("Export failed: "..tostring(encoded)..". Queue and transfer text kept.","Export failed. Existing transfer text kept; see craft status for details.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferText.Text=encoded
    RemoteCatalog.SetCraftTransferOpen(true)
    local copied=false
    if copy then
        local copier=setclipboard or toclipboard
        if type(copier)=="function" then local ran,result=pcall(copier,encoded);copied=ran and result~=false end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferMessage(copy and (copied and "Queue JSON copied. Export is also shown below." or "Clipboard unavailable or failed. Select and copy the queue JSON shown below.")
        or "Queue exported below. Copy JSON to back it up or share it. No crafting started.")
    return true,encoded
end
function RemoteCatalog.ImportCraftQueue(text)
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferReady() then return false end
    if type(text)~="string" or #text==0 or #text>32768 then RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferMessage("Paste queue JSON of 1–32768 bytes. Current queue kept.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    local queue,generation=RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue,RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration
    RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferBusy=true;RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    local ok,preset=pcall(function() return RemoteCatalog.ValidateCraftPreset(HttpService:JSONDecode(text)) end)
    RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferBusy=false;RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    if not RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferReady() or RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue~=queue or RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration~=generation then
        RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferMessage("Queue or crafting state changed during transfer. Try again when idle.");return false
    end
    if not ok then RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferMessage("Import rejected: "..tostring(preset)..". Current queue and saved presets kept.","Import rejected. Working queue and saved presets kept; see craft status for details.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue=preset.Jobs;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueSelected=nil
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueChanged();RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunning=false;RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused=false
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName then RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetName.Text=preset.Name end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferMessage("Imported "..preset.Name..": "..#preset.Jobs.." jobs. Working queue replaced; saved presets kept. Learn each recipe here, then Run Queue. Save a preset to retain it.",
        "Imported "..#preset.Jobs.." jobs. Crafting stays OFF. Save a preset to retain this queue.")
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    return true
end
-- CRAFT PRESETS END

function RemoteCatalog.SetCraftPaused(state)
    if type(state)~="boolean" or not gui.Parent or not RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled or not RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused=state
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(state and "Crafting held. Any in-flight confirmation may finish; no next request is sent." or "Resumed the current job and its confirmed progress.")
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetCraftEnabled(state,queued)
    if state and RemoteCatalog.CraftTransferBusy then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Wait for queue import/export to finish before starting crafting.");return false end
    if state and RemoteCatalog.CraftPresetBusy then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Wait for preset file work to finish before starting crafting.");return false end
    if state and RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLoading then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Wait for recipe loading to finish first.");return false end
    if not state then
        RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled=false;RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused=false
        RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration or 0)+1
        RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
        RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker and "Stopped · waiting for the in-flight request to finish." or "Crafting OFF. Choose a learned recipe and run mode, then Start.")
        return true
    end
    -- Settle completed learning before choosing the recipe for a new run.
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled then return true end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Wait for the current craft request to finish before restarting.");return false end
    local requested=queued and RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue or {{Item=RemoteCatalog.CraftItem,Mode=RemoteCatalog.CraftMode,Batch=RemoteCatalog.CraftBatch,Target=RemoteCatalog.CraftTarget}}
    if type(requested)~="table" or #requested==0 or #requested>8 then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Add 1–8 finite jobs before running the queue.");return false end
    local requestedCount=0
    for key in pairs(requested) do
        requestedCount+=1
        if type(key)~="number" or key%1~=0 or key<1 or key>#requested then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Queue entries must be a consecutive list.");return false end
    end
    if requestedCount~=#requested then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Queue entries must be a consecutive list.");return false end
    local jobs={}
    for index,entry in ipairs(requested) do
        if type(entry)~="table" then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Invalid queue job "..index);return false end
        local job,reason=RemoteCatalog.MakeCraftJob(entry.Item,entry.Mode,entry.Batch,entry.Target,not queued)
        if not job then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage((queued and "Queue job "..index..": " or "")..reason);return false end
        table.insert(jobs,job)
    end
    -- Stop Mobs only after every start check passed, so a refused start leaves it running.
    if RemoteCatalog.Mobs and (RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Worker or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press) then
        RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Stop("Stopped · another mode started")
        if RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press then setStatus("Weapon release pending · press STOP in Mobs",COLORS.warn);return false end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.StopCraftLearning()
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
    RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration or 0)+1
    local generation=RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration
    RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker=generation;RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled=true;RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused=false
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunning=queued==true;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunSize=#jobs
    RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueIndex=nil;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueDone=0;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueTotal=0
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    task.spawn(function()
        local function active() return gui.Parent~=nil and RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled and RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration==generation end
        local function ready()
            while active() and RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused do task.wait(.1) end
            return active()
        end
        local function waitFor(seconds)
            for _=1,math.ceil(seconds/.1) do if not ready() then return false end;task.wait(.1) end
            return active()
        end
        local outcome="Stopped."
        local ok,failure=pcall(function()
            for index,job in ipairs(jobs) do
                if not ready() then return end
                local item,batch,target,mode=job.Item,job.Batch,job.Target,job.Mode
                local runRecorder,runBinding=job.Recorder,job.Binding
                local makeAmount,continuous=mode=="Make amount",mode=="Continuous"
                local confirmed,retries=0,0
                RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialRun={Item=item,Mode=mode,Batch=batch,Target=target,Confirmed=0}
                RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftMaterials()
                local completed=false
                if queued then RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueIndex=index;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueActiveItem=item;RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue() end
                local function runRecipe()
                    while active() do
                        if not ready() then return end
                        local recorder,binding=runRecorder,runBinding
                        if not recorder:CanUseCraftBinding(binding) then outcome="Craft context changed · learn this recipe again.";return end
                        if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy then
                            RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Waiting · finish chest collection before crafting.")
                            if not waitFor(.5) then return end
                            continue
                        end
                        local reachable,reason=RemoteCatalog.CraftReachable(binding.Workbench)
                        if not reachable then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(reason);if not waitFor(1) then return end;continue end
                        local before=RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInventory(item,active)
                        if not active() then return end
                        if before==nil then outcome="Item quantity is unreadable · no craft sent.";return end
                        if not continuous and ((makeAmount and confirmed>=target) or (not makeAmount and before>=target)) then
                            outcome=makeAmount and ("Made +"..confirmed.." "..item.." this run · inventory "..before) or ("Stock target reached · "..before.." / "..target.." "..item..". Choose Make amount to craft extra items.")
                            completed=true;return
                        end
                        -- Quantity replication or Pause may yield; check readiness, actor and reach again.
                        -- A Pause here leaves `before` stale: start the step over with a fresh count.
                        if RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused then if not ready() then return end;continue end
                        if not ready() then return end
                        if not recorder:CanUseCraftBinding(binding) then outcome="Craft context changed · learn this recipe again.";return end
                        reachable,reason=RemoteCatalog.CraftReachable(binding.Workbench)
                        if not reachable then RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(reason);if not waitFor(1) then return end;continue end
                        local amount=math.min(100,batch,continuous and batch or makeAmount and target-confirmed or target-before)
                        RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Crafting "..amount.." "..item.." · "..mode.." · +"..confirmed.." confirmed"..(continuous and " · until Stop" or makeAmount and (" / "..target.." extra") or (" · stock "..before.." / "..target)))
                        local sent,response
                        if RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow then RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow.Blocked=true end
                        if RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow then RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow.Blocked=true end
                        if recorder.CraftItem then sent,response=recorder:CraftItem(amount,binding) else sent,response=recorder:CraftBait(amount) end
                        if not active() then return end
                        if not sent and RemoteCatalog.ChestTooFast(response) then
                            retries+=1
                            if retries>5 then outcome="Server cooldown persisted · stopped after 5 retries.";return end
                            RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Server cooldown · retrying batch "..amount.." ("..retries.."/5)")
                            if not waitFor(math.min(4,.5*2^(retries-1))) then return end
                            continue
                        end
                        if not sent then outcome="Craft rejected · check materials/workbench. "..RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(response);return end
                        local after=RemoteCatalog.WaitChestInventory(item,active,before)
                        if not active() then return end
                        if not after or after<=before then outcome="No confirmed item gain · stopped. Check materials and quantity metadata.";return end
                        confirmed+=after-before;retries=0
                        RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialRun.Confirmed=confirmed
                        if queued then RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueTotal+=after-before end
                        RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("+"..confirmed.." confirmed · "..mode.." · inventory "..after)
                        if not continuous and ((makeAmount and confirmed>=target) or (not makeAmount and after>=target)) then
                            outcome=makeAmount and ("Made +"..confirmed.." "..item.." this run · inventory "..after) or ("Stock target reached · "..after.." / "..target.." "..item.."; +"..confirmed.." confirmed this run.")
                            completed=true;return
                        end
                        if not waitFor(.5) then return end
                    end

                end
                runRecipe()
                if not completed or not active() then return end
                if queued then RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueDone=index;RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftQueue() end
                if index<#jobs and not waitFor(.5) then return end
            end
            if queued then outcome="Queue finished · "..#jobs.." jobs · +"..RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueTotal.." confirmed items. Queue kept; Run Queue repeats from the first job." end
        end)
        RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker=nil;RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused=false;RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialRun=nil
        if not ok then outcome="Craft stopped: "..tostring(failure) end
        if queued and (RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueDone or 0)<#jobs then outcome="Queue stopped at job "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueIndex or 1).." / "..#jobs.." · "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueActiveItem or "unknown").." · "..outcome end
        RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueRunning=false;RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueActiveItem=nil
        if RemoteCatalog.CraftGeneration==generation then
            RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled=false
            RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(outcome)
        elseif not RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled then
            RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage("Crafting OFF · cleanup complete. Check inventory before restarting.")
        end
        RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
    end)
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftPlanText()
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftMode=="Continuous" then return "OFF · Repeatedly craft "..RemoteCatalog.CraftItem..", up to "..RemoteCatalog.CraftBatch.." per request until Stop or a failure. Uses your materials." end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftMode=="Make amount" then
        return "OFF · Make "..RemoteCatalog.CraftTarget.." extra "..RemoteCatalog.CraftItem..", up to "..RemoteCatalog.CraftBatch.." per batch. Existing stock does not limit this run. Uses your materials."
    end
    local count=RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount(RemoteCatalog.CraftItem)
    if count and count>=RemoteCatalog.CraftTarget then return "OFF · Stock target already met ("..count.." / "..RemoteCatalog.CraftTarget.."). Choose Make amount to craft extra items." end
    return "OFF · Top up stock to "..RemoteCatalog.CraftTarget.." "..RemoteCatalog.CraftItem..", up to "..RemoteCatalog.CraftBatch.." per batch. Uses your materials."
end
function RemoteCatalog.CraftDiagnosticReport()
    local count=RemoteCatalog.CarrotCount(RemoteCatalog.CraftItem)
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.CraftRecorder()
    local learning=RemoteCatalog.Recorder and not RemoteCatalog.Recorder.Stopped and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnCraftOnly==true
    local action
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker then action=RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled and "Running; see last status" or "Waiting for current request cleanup"
    elseif RemoteCatalog.CraftMode=="Top up stock" and count and count>=RemoteCatalog.CraftTarget then action="Stock target already met. Choose Make amount to craft extra items."
    elseif learning then action="Craft the item once manually (not Use item), choose it in Recipe, then press Start crafting."
    elseif not recorder then action="Press Learn recipe, craft the item once manually at your own workbench, then select it in Recipe."
    else action="Press Start crafting; remain within 20 studs of the learned workbench." end
    return table.concat({"Reborn mob-stop-178 · Craft diagnostics",
        "Recipe: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftItem),
        "Craft mode: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftMode),
        "Batch: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftBatch),
        "Per-request limit: 100",
        "Amount / stock target: "..(RemoteCatalog.CraftMode=="Continuous" and "not used (until Stop)" or tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftTarget)),
        "Item inventory: "..tostring(count or "unreadable"),
        "Craft request ready: "..tostring(recorder~=nil),
        "Craft learner: "..tostring(learning==true),
        "Auto Craft: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftEnabled==true),
        "Worker active: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker~=nil),
        "Paused: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftPaused==true),
        "Recipe catalog: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogStatus),
        "Catalog data tables read: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogSources or 0).."; read failures: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogFailures or 0),
        "Catalog read attempts: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogAttempts or 0).."/32; limit reached: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftCatalogLimited==true),
        "Queue: "..#RemoteCatalog.CraftQueue.." jobs; "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueDone or 0).." finished; "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueTotal or 0).." confirmed items",
        "Active queue recipe: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueActiveItem or "none"),
        "Last craft status: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.CraftInfo and RemoteCatalog.CraftInfo.Text or "not started"),
        "Next step: "..action, "", "Queue check snapshot:",
        RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckCurrent(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckResult) and RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCheckResult.Text or "Not checked, expired or context changed. Use Check queue for a fresh read-only report.",
        "", "Materials:", RemoteCatalog.CraftMaterialReport(), "", RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueMaterialReport()},"\n")
end

track(RemoteCatalog.CraftQueueCopyCheckButton.Activated:Connect(function() RemoteCatalog.CheckCraftQueue(true) end))
RemoteCatalog.ReadCraftPresets()
RemoteCatalog.CraftMessage(RemoteCatalog.CraftPlanText())
RemoteCatalog.RefreshCraftUI()
