function RemoteCatalog.TeleportSpotValid(spot)
    return spot~=nil and spot.PlaceId==game.PlaceId and (spot.Preset==true or spot.OwnerUserId==player.UserId and spot.JobId==game.JobId)
end
function RemoteCatalog.GetTeleportSpot(name)
    local preset=RemoteCatalog.TeleportPresets[name]
    if preset then
        if preset.PlaceId==game.PlaceId and not preset.CFrame then preset.CFrame=CFrame.new(table.unpack(preset.Values)) end
        return preset
    end
    if name=="Water hole" then return RemoteCatalog.WaterSpot end
    if name=="Previous" then return RemoteCatalog.TeleportPrevious end
    return RemoteCatalog.TeleportSpots and RemoteCatalog.TeleportSpots[name]
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetTeleportSpot(name,point)
    if RemoteCatalog.TeleportPresets[name] then return end
    if name=="Water hole" then RemoteCatalog.WaterSpot=point
    elseif name=="Previous" then RemoteCatalog.TeleportPrevious=point
    else
        RemoteCatalog.TeleportSpots=RemoteCatalog.TeleportSpots or {}
        RemoteCatalog.TeleportSpots[name]=point
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.SaveTeleportSpot(name)
    if name~="Water hole" and name~="Island / home" and name~="Custom spot" then return false,"Choose a saved destination" end
    local character=player.Character
    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not root.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return false,"Wait for your character before saving a position" end
    if baitBusy or fishingInputBusy then return false,"Wait for the current tool input to finish" end
    RemoteCatalog.SetTeleportSpot(name,{CFrame=root.CFrame,OwnerUserId=player.UserId,PlaceId=game.PlaceId,JobId=game.JobId})
    RemoteCatalog.TeleportGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.TeleportGeneration or 0)+1
    return true,name.." saved for this server"
end
function RemoteCatalog.SaveWaterSpot() return RemoteCatalog.SaveTeleportSpot("Water hole") end
function RemoteCatalog.TeleportSavedSpot(name)
    local spot=RemoteCatalog.GetTeleportSpot(name)
    if not spot then return false,name=="Previous" and "No previous teleport position yet" or "Save "..name.." first" end
    if not RemoteCatalog.TeleportSpotValid(spot) then
        if spot.Preset then return false,name.." preset is only available in PlaceId "..tostring(spot.PlaceId) end
        RemoteCatalog.SetTeleportSpot(name,nil)
        return false,"Saved spot belongs to another account or server; save it again"
    end
    local character=player.Character
    local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not root.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return false,"Wait for your character before teleporting" end
    if baitBusy or fishingInputBusy then return false,"Wait for the current tool input to finish before teleporting" end
    if root.Anchored then return false,"Your character cannot move right now" end
    local previous={CFrame=root.CFrame,OwnerUserId=player.UserId,PlaceId=game.PlaceId,JobId=game.JobId}
    if RemoteCatalog.Mobs then RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Stop("Stopped · teleport requested") end
    RemoteCatalog.SetChestAuto(false)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration or 0)+1
    setEnabled(false);setBaitEnabled(false)
    setFarmMode("crop",false);setFarmMode("wood",false);setFarmMode("mine",false)
    buildController:Stop()
    RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Stop()
    local ok,reason=pcall(function()
        root.CFrame=spot.CFrame
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity*0
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=root.AssemblyAngularVelocity*0
    end)
    if not ok then return false,"Teleport failed: "..tostring(reason) end
    RemoteCatalog.TeleportPrevious=previous
    RemoteCatalog.TeleportGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.TeleportGeneration or 0)+1
    local generation=RemoteCatalog.TeleportGeneration
    RemoteCatalog.TeleportLastResult="Teleport to "..name.." requested; checking arrival. Automation is paused."
    task.spawn(function()
        local function current()
            return gui.Parent~=nil and RemoteCatalog.TeleportGeneration==generation and player.Character==character
                and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")==root and root.Parent~=nil
        end
        local checked,distance
        for _,delay in ipairs({.25,.75,1}) do
            task.wait(delay)
            if not current() then return end
            checked,distance=pcall(function() return (root.Position-spot.CFrame.Position).Magnitude end)
            if not checked or distance>8 then break end
        end
        if not checked then
            RemoteCatalog.TeleportLastResult="Teleport requested; position check unavailable. Automation is paused."
        elseif distance>8 then
            RemoteCatalog.TeleportLastResult="Teleport corrected or target not reached. Try walking closer; no automatic retry."
        else
            RemoteCatalog.TeleportLastResult="Arrived at "..name..". Automation is paused."
        end
        if RemoteCatalog.TeleportStatus then RemoteCatalog.TeleportStatus.Text=RemoteCatalog.TeleportLastResult end
        setStatus(RemoteCatalog.TeleportLastResult,checked and distance<=8 and COLORS.good or COLORS.warn)
    end)
    return true,RemoteCatalog.TeleportLastResult
end
function RemoteCatalog.TeleportWaterSpot() return RemoteCatalog.TeleportSavedSpot("Water hole") end
-- WATER SPOT END
function RemoteCatalog.UpdateTeleportLabels()
    local char=player.Character
    local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    for name,card in pairs(RemoteCatalog.TeleportCards) do
        local spot=RemoteCatalog.GetTeleportSpot(name)
        local valid=RemoteCatalog.TeleportSpotValid(spot)
        local text=card.Preset and (valid and "Built-in destination" or "Available in PlaceId "..tostring(spot.PlaceId))
            or (valid and "Saved for this server" or "Not saved")
        if valid and root then
            local ok,distance=pcall(function() return (root.Position-spot.CFrame.Position).Magnitude end)
            if ok then text=text.." · "..math.floor(distance).." studs away" end
        end
        card.Label.Text=text
        card.Teleport.Text=card.Preset and name or valid and "Teleport" or "Save a position first"
        card.Teleport.BackgroundColor3=valid and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    end
end


-- AUTO PLOW BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.PlowEnabled=false
RemoteCatalog.PlowGeneration=0
RemoteCatalog.PlowRadius=15
RemoteCatalog.PlowMode="Auto"
RemoteCatalog.PlowRunMode="Continuous"
function RemoteCatalog.UpdatePlowControls()
    local stopping=RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker and not RemoteCatalog.PlowEnabled
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowButton then
        RemoteCatalog.PlowButton.Text=RemoteCatalog.PlowPendingStart and "RESTART QUEUED · cancel" or stopping and "STOPPING… · restart" or RemoteCatalog.PlowEnabled and "AUTO PLOW: ON" or "AUTO PLOW: OFF"
        RemoteCatalog.PlowButton.BackgroundColor3=RemoteCatalog.PlowEnabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowStopButton then
        RemoteCatalog.PlowStopButton.Text=stopping and "STOPPING…" or "STOP PLOW"
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.TogglePlow()
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowEnabled or RemoteCatalog.PlowPendingStart then return RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(false) end
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then
        RemoteCatalog.PlowPendingStart=true
        RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Restart queued. Waiting for the previous request/input to finish; click again or Stop to cancel.")
        RemoteCatalog.UpdatePlowControls()
        return true
    end
    return RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(true)
end
function RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage(text)
    if gui.Parent and RemoteCatalog.PlowInfo then RemoteCatalog.PlowInfo.Text=text end
end
function RemoteCatalog.PlowRecorder()
    if type(RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder)~="function" then return nil end
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("PlowBinding")
    if recorder and type(recorder.CanUsePlowBinding)=="function" and type(recorder.Plow)=="function" and recorder:CanUsePlowBinding() then return recorder end
    -- No learned hoe request on this server: the game's stable plow request needs no learning.
    local endpoint=type(RemoteCatalog.GameEndpoint)=="function" and RemoteCatalog.GameEndpoint("CLIENT_PLOW_BLOCK_REQUEST")
    if endpoint and type(endpoint.CallServer)=="function" then
        RemoteCatalog.NativePlowRecorder=RemoteCatalog.NativePlowRecorder or {NativePlow=true,
            CanUsePlowBinding=function() return player.Character~=nil end,
            Plow=function(_,block)
                local current=RemoteCatalog.GameEndpoint("CLIENT_PLOW_BLOCK_REQUEST")
                if not current then return false,"Game hoe request unavailable" end
                return RemoteCatalog.SendEndpoint(current,{block=block})
            end}
        return RemoteCatalog.NativePlowRecorder
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.StopPlowLearning()
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if recorder and recorder.LearnPlowOnly then
        recorder.LearnPlowOnly=false
        if not recorder.LearnCraftOnly and not recorder.LearnWoodOnly and not recorder.LearnBaitOnly and not recorder.LearnChestOnly and not recorder.LearnMobOnly and not recorder.Active then recorder:Stop() end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.PlowLearning=false
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowLearnButton then RemoteCatalog.PlowLearnButton.Text="Learn hoe request" end
end
function RemoteCatalog.UpdatePlowUI()
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    local learning=recorder and not recorder.Stopped and recorder.LearnPlowOnly
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowLearnButton then RemoteCatalog.PlowLearnButton.Text=learning and "Cancel hoe learning" or "Learn hoe request" end
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowLearning and not learning then
        RemoteCatalog.PlowLearning=false
        RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage(RemoteCatalog.PlowRecorder() and "Hoe request learned for this character/server. Auto uses it; enable Auto Plow when ready." or "Hoe learning ended without a usable current binding. Input mode remains available.")
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.BeginPlowLearning()
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(false);RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Wait for Plow cleanup, then click Learn hoe request again.");return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowOtherBusy() then RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Stop other automation and blueprint picking before learning a hoe request.");return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnPlowOnly then RemoteCatalog.StopPlowLearning();RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Hoe learning cancelled.");return true end
    local other=RemoteCatalog.OtherLearning and RemoteCatalog.OtherLearning("LearnPlowOnly")
    if other then RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage(other);return false end
    RemoteCatalog.CaptureAttempted=true
    local ok,recorder=pcall(RemoteCatalog.StartCapture)
    if not ok or not recorder then RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("This host cannot learn requests. Input mode still uses the hoe normally.");return false end
    RemoteCatalog.Recorder=recorder;recorder.LearnPlowOnly=true;recorder.Active=false;RemoteCatalog.PlowLearning=true
    RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Hoe learning ready. Hide/move the hub, equip your hoe and plow one grass/dirt block manually. Then enable Auto Plow. Learning sends no extra requests.")
    RemoteCatalog.UpdatePlowUI();RemoteCatalog.UpdateCaptureUI()
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.PlowOtherBusy()
    return enabled or baitEnabled or baitBusy or harvestEnabled or woodEnabled or mineEnabled or RemoteCatalog.Planting
        or RemoteCatalog.FishingMouseInput or RemoteCatalog.BaitMouseInput or RemoteCatalog.ResourceInputBusy or RemoteCatalog.MobMouseInput
        or buildController.Running or buildController.WorkerToken or buildController.Picking
        or RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoEnabled or RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy
end
function RemoteCatalog.PlowSurface(block,blocks,root)
    if not root or block.Parent~=blocks or not block:IsA("BasePart") or (block.Name~="grass" and block.Name~="dirt") then return nil end
    if block.CFrame.UpVector.Y<.99 or (block.Position-root.Position).Magnitude>RemoteCatalog.PlowRadius then return nil end
    local point=block.Position+Vector3.new(0,block.Size.Y/2-.03,0)
    local params=RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local ignore={block}
    if player.Character then table.insert(ignore,player.Character) end
    if buildController.PreviewFolder then table.insert(ignore,buildController.PreviewFolder) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore
    if workspace:Raycast(point+Vector3.new(0,.08,0),Vector3.new(0,3,0),params) then return nil end
    return point
end
function RemoteCatalog.ScanPlowArea(quiet,cooldowns)
    local blocks=RemoteCatalog.BuildIslandBlocks()
    local char=player.Character;local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not blocks or not root then
        if not quiet then RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Stand on your own island with a character before scanning.") end
        return nil
    end
    local targets={}
    for _,block in ipairs(blocks:GetChildren()) do
        if (not cooldowns or not cooldowns[block] or cooldowns[block]<=os.clock()) and RemoteCatalog.PlowSurface(block,blocks,root) then table.insert(targets,{Block=block,Position=block.Position,Distance=(block.Position-root.Position).Magnitude}) end
    end
    table.sort(targets,function(a,b) return a.Distance<b.Distance end)
    local total=#targets
    while #targets>100 do table.remove(targets) end
    if not quiet then RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Scan: "..total.." exposed grass/dirt blocks within "..RemoteCatalog.PlowRadius.." studs; at most 100 per scan. Continuous stays ON as you move. Scan sends no input.") end
    return targets,blocks,char
end
function RemoteCatalog.PlowSoilAt(blocks,position)
    for _,block in ipairs(blocks:GetChildren()) do
        if block:IsA("BasePart") and block.Name=="soil" and (block.Position-position).Magnitude<.3 then return true end
    end
    return false
end
function RemoteCatalog.PlowClick(block,blocks,tool,active)
    if not active() then return false,"Plowing stopped" end
    local char=player.Character;local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or tool.Parent~=char or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")~=tool then return false,"Keep the hoe equipped" end
    local position=RemoteCatalog.PlowSurface(block,blocks,root)
    if not position then return false,"Block is covered, changed or outside the selected area" end
    local reach=RemoteCatalog.GameModule("ReplicatedStorage.Shared.SharedConfig","CLIENT_REACH")
    if type(reach)~="number" or reach~=reach or reach<=0 or reach==math.huge then reach=20 end
    if (position-root.Position).Magnitude>reach then return false,"Move within normal hoe reach" end
    local focused,field=pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() end)
    if not focused or field then return false,"Close chat or finish editing first" end
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return false,"Camera unavailable" end
    local point,visible=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(position)
    if not visible or point.Z<=0 then return false,"Face the target blocks" end
    local params=RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local ignore={char};if buildController.PreviewFolder then table.insert(ignore,buildController.PreviewFolder) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore
    local hit=workspace:Raycast(camera.CFrame.Position,position-camera.CFrame.Position,params)
    if not hit or hit.Instance~=block then return false,"Target is obstructed or not queryable" end
    if hub.Root.Visible then
        local p,size=hub.Root.AbsolutePosition,hub.Root.AbsoluteSize
        if point.X>=p.X and point.X<=p.X+size.X and point.Y>=p.Y and point.Y<=p.Y+size.Y then return false,"Move the hub away from the target" end
    end
    local checked,objects=pcall(function() return playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(point.X,point.Y) end)
    if not checked then return false,"Cannot verify clear game input" end
    for _,object in ipairs(objects) do if object:IsA("GuiButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then return false,"Target overlaps on-screen controls" end end
    local host=type(mousemoveabs)=="function" and type(mouse1press)=="function" and type(mouse1release)=="function"
    local moved=pcall(function() if host then mousemoveabs(point.X,point.Y) else VirtualInputManager:SendMouseMoveEvent(point.X,point.Y,game) end end)
    if not moved then return false,"Tool input unavailable" end
    task.wait(.03)
    if not active() or tool.Parent~=char or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")~=tool or not RemoteCatalog.PlowSurface(block,blocks,root) then return false,"Plow target/tool changed" end
    local focusOK,currentField=pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() end)
    if not focusOK or currentField then return false,"Chat or text editing opened" end
    local function input(down)
        if host then if down then mouse1press() else mouse1release() end
        else VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(point.X,point.Y,0,down,game,0) end
    end
    local pressed=pcall(input,true)
    if pressed then RemoteCatalog.PlowMouseHeld=function() return pcall(input,false) end end
    local held=pcall(function() if pressed then task.wait(.06) end end)
    local released=pcall(input,false)
    if released then RemoteCatalog.PlowMouseHeld=nil end
    if not pressed or not held or not released then return false,"Hoe input failed"..(not released and " · mouse release retried on Stop" or "") end
    return active(),"Hoe click sent"
end
function RemoteCatalog.PlowAction(block,blocks,tool,active,recorder)
    if not recorder then return RemoteCatalog.PlowClick(block,blocks,tool,active) end
    if not active() or not recorder:CanUsePlowBinding() then return false,"Current hoe binding expired; learn a fresh manual action" end
    local char=player.Character;local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or tool.Parent~=char or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")~=tool then return false,"Keep the hoe equipped" end
    local position=RemoteCatalog.PlowSurface(block,blocks,root)
    if not position then return false,"Block is covered, changed or outside the selected area" end
    local reach=RemoteCatalog.GameModule("ReplicatedStorage.Shared.SharedConfig","CLIENT_REACH")
    if type(reach)~="number" or reach~=reach or reach<=0 or reach==math.huge then reach=20 end
    if (position-root.Position).Magnitude>reach then return false,"Move within normal hoe reach" end
    if not active() then return false,"Plowing stopped" end
    local ran,sent,result=pcall(recorder.Plow,recorder,block)
    if not ran then return false,sent end
    return sent==true,result
end
function RemoteCatalog.ReleasePlowMouse()
    -- A running worker releases its own click; this retry is for a release that failed after the
    -- worker ended, so the button never stays down.
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then return end
    local release=RemoteCatalog.PlowMouseHeld
    if type(release)=="function" and release() then RemoteCatalog.PlowMouseHeld=nil end
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(state)
    if not state then
        RemoteCatalog.PlowEnabled=false;RemoteCatalog.PlowPendingStart=false;RemoteCatalog.PlowGeneration+=1
        RemoteCatalog.ReleasePlowMouse()
        RemoteCatalog.UpdatePlowControls()
        RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage(RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker and "Stopping: no further blocks will be attempted. Waiting for the current request/input to finish." or "Auto Plow is OFF. Press ON to start again.")
        return true
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowEnabled then return true end
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Wait for the previous hoe input to finish.");return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowOtherBusy() then RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Stop other automation and blueprint picking before Auto Plow.");return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowLearning or RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnPlowOnly then RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Plow one block manually to finish learning, or cancel hoe learning first.");return false end
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.PlowMode~="Input" and RemoteCatalog.PlowRecorder() or nil
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowMode=="Captured" and not recorder then RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Learn hoe request first: equip your hoe and plow one grass/dirt block manually.");return false end
    local targets,blocks,char=RemoteCatalog.ScanPlowArea()
    if not targets then return false end
    if #targets==0 and RemoteCatalog.PlowRunMode=="One pass" then RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("No exposed grass/dirt in range. Move closer or choose Continuous.");return false end
    local previous=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    local hoe
    for _,tool in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools()) do
        local name=string.lower(tool.Name)
        if tool:IsA("Tool") and (name=="hoe" or name=="plow" or name:match("hoe$")) then
            hoe=tool;if tool==previous then break end
        end
    end
    if not hoe then RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Own a hoe tool before starting Auto Plow. No blocks were changed.");return false end
    -- Stop Mobs only after every start check passed, so a refused start leaves it running.
    if RemoteCatalog.Mobs and (RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Worker or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press) then
        RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Stop("Stopped · another mode started")
        if RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press then setStatus("Weapon release pending · press STOP in Mobs",COLORS.warn);return false end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.PlowGeneration+=1;local token=RemoteCatalog.PlowGeneration
    RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker=token;RemoteCatalog.PlowEnabled=true;RemoteCatalog.PlowPendingStart=false
    RemoteCatalog.PlowConfirmed=0;RemoteCatalog.PlowFailed=0;RemoteCatalog.PlowSkipped=0
    RemoteCatalog.PlowBackend=recorder and (recorder.NativePlow and "Game hoe request" or "Captured request") or "Hoe input"
    RemoteCatalog.UpdatePlowControls()
    local continuous=RemoteCatalog.PlowRunMode=="Continuous"
    task.spawn(function()
        local stopReason
        local function active()
            if not gui.Parent then stopReason="Hub closed";return false end
            if not RemoteCatalog.PlowEnabled or RemoteCatalog.PlowGeneration~=token then stopReason="Stopped by user";return false end
            if player.Character~=char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then stopReason="Character changed; start again after spawning";return false end
            if RemoteCatalog.BuildIslandBlocks()~=blocks then stopReason="Owned island changed; start again on your island";return false end
            if RemoteCatalog.PlowOtherBusy() then stopReason="Another automation mode took control";return false end
            return true
        end
        local outcome="Pass finished"
        local cooldowns=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
        local ok,failure=pcall(function()
            if not RemoteCatalog.EquipTool(hoe) then error("Could not equip the owned hoe") end
            task.wait(.1)
            while active() do
                local streak=0
                local reason
                for index,entry in ipairs(targets) do
                    if not active() then return end
                    if hoe.Parent~=char or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")~=hoe then outcome="Stopped: selected tool changed. Equip a hoe and start again.";return end
                    if recorder and not recorder:CanUsePlowBinding() then outcome="Stopped: hoe request expired. Learn one manual hoe action again.";return end
                    local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if cooldowns[entry.Block] and cooldowns[entry.Block]>os.clock() then continue end
                    if not RemoteCatalog.PlowSurface(entry.Block,blocks,root) then RemoteCatalog.PlowSkipped+=1;continue end
                    RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Plowing "..index.."/"..#targets.." · "..RemoteCatalog.PlowConfirmed.." observed soil conversions · "..RemoteCatalog.PlowBackend..". OFF cancels.")
                    local sent,detail=RemoteCatalog.PlowAction(entry.Block,blocks,hoe,active,recorder)
                    reason=detail
                    if not active() then return end
                    local confirmed=false
                    if sent then
                        for attempt=1,20 do
                            if not active() then return end
                            if RemoteCatalog.PlowSoilAt(blocks,entry.Position) then confirmed=true;break end
                            task.wait(.1)
                        end
                    end
                    if not active() then return end
                    if confirmed then RemoteCatalog.PlowConfirmed+=1;streak=0
                    else
                        RemoteCatalog.PlowFailed+=1;streak+=1
                        cooldowns[entry.Block]=os.clock()+10
                        if sent then reason="no soil appeared; check hoe behavior and island permissions" end
                    end
                    if streak>=3 then
                        outcome="Paused after 3 unconfirmed attempts: "..tostring(reason)
                        if not continuous then return end
                        break
                    end
                    task.wait(.2)
                end
                if not continuous then return end
                if not active() then return end
                if hoe.Parent~=char or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")~=hoe then outcome="Stopped: selected tool changed. Equip a hoe and start again.";return end
                if recorder and not recorder:CanUsePlowBinding() then outcome="Stopped: hoe request expired. Learn one manual hoe action again.";return end
                RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage((streak>=3 and outcome..". Cooling down; failed blocks wait 10 seconds." or "Waiting for exposed grass/dirt in range. Move around your own island; Auto Plow stays ON.").."\n"..RemoteCatalog.PlowConfirmed.." observed soil · "..RemoteCatalog.PlowFailed.." failed. OFF stops.")
                -- Check Stop throughout the scan delay; never overlap a pending call.
                for _=1,streak>=3 and 30 or 5 do if not active() then return end;task.wait(.1) end
                if not active() then return end
                local nextTargets,nextBlocks,nextChar=RemoteCatalog.ScanPlowArea(true,cooldowns)
                if not nextTargets or nextBlocks~=blocks or nextChar~=char then outcome="Stopped: owned island or character unavailable";return end
                targets=nextTargets
            end
        end)
        -- Restore only when the worker still owns tool selection on the same character.
        if player.Character==char and previous and previous~=hoe and previous.Parent and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")==hoe then pcall(RemoteCatalog.EquipTool,previous) end
        if RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker~=token then return end
        local restart=RemoteCatalog.PlowPendingStart
        RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker=nil;RemoteCatalog.PlowEnabled=false;RemoteCatalog.PlowPendingStart=false
        if not gui.Parent then return end
        RemoteCatalog.UpdatePlowControls()
        RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage((not ok and "Plow error: "..tostring(failure) or stopReason or outcome).."\n"..RemoteCatalog.PlowConfirmed.." observed soil · "..RemoteCatalog.PlowSkipped.." skipped · "..RemoteCatalog.PlowFailed.." failed. No seeds were planted.")
        if restart then
            if player.Character==char and RemoteCatalog.BuildIslandBlocks()==blocks and not RemoteCatalog.PlowOtherBusy() then RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(true)
            else RemoteCatalog.PlowMessage("Restart cancelled: character, island or active automation changed. Press ON when ready.") end
        end
    end)
    return true
end
-- AUTO PLOW END

-- MOB FARM UI BEGIN
-- Floating damage numbers: a TextLabel whose text is a whole number within a moment of being
-- added anywhere in the world or the player's GUI. Only the hub's own GUI is ignored.
RemoteCatalog.DamageNumbers={}
function RemoteCatalog.NoteDamageLabel(object)
    if not object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsDescendantOf(gui) then return end
    task.delay(.05,function()
        if not object.Parent then return end
        local value=tonumber(string.match(tostring(object.Text),"^%s*%-?(%d+)%s*$"))
        if not value or value<=0 or value>100000 then return end
        -- Where the number floats: the billboard's adornee (the mob hit) when there is one, so a
        -- number over another mob, or over the character, is not taken for our hit.
        local position,mine
        pcall(function()
            local billboard=object:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui")
            local anchor=billboard and (billboard.Adornee or billboard.Parent)
            if anchor and player.Character and anchor:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then mine=true end
            if anchor and anchor:IsA("Model") then anchor=anchor.PrimaryPart or anchor:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") end
            if anchor and anchor:IsA("BasePart") then position=anchor.Position end
        end)
        -- A number over the character is damage taken, never a hit on the mob.
        if mine then return end
        local list=RemoteCatalog.DamageNumbers
        table.insert(list,{At=os.clock(),Value=value,Position=position})
        if #list>50 then table.remove(list,1) end
    end)
end
pcall(function() track(workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object) pcall(RemoteCatalog.NoteDamageLabel,object) end)) end)
pcall(function() track(playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object) pcall(RemoteCatalog.NoteDamageLabel,object) end)) end)
-- Prepared foods only; crops, bait and seeds are never eaten by the farm.
RemoteCatalog.FoodWords={"salad","bread","cooked","roast","fried","grilled","pie","soup","stew","cake","cookie","juice","sushi","sandwich","steak","meal","food"}
function RemoteCatalog.FoodTool()
    local best,bestCount
    for _,tool in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools()) do
        local name=string.lower(tool.Name)
        if not string.find(name,"bait",1,true) and not string.find(name,"seed",1,true) then
            for _,word in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.FoodWords) do
                if string.find(name,word,1,true) then
                    local count=RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(tool) or 1
                    if not best or count>bestCount then best,bestCount=tool,count end
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best,bestCount
end
function RemoteCatalog.MobBusy()
    if enabled then return "Fishing is ON · stop Fishing before Auto Mobs" end
    if baitEnabled or baitBusy then return "Auto Bait is active · stop Bait before Auto Mobs" end
    if harvestEnabled then return "Crop Farm is ON · stop harvesting before Auto Mobs" end
    if woodEnabled then return "Wood Farm is ON · stop it before Auto Mobs" end
    if mineEnabled then return "Mining is ON · stop it before Auto Mobs" end
    if RemoteCatalog.Planting then return "Planting is active · wait for it to finish" end
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then return "Auto Plow is active or finishing · stop it and wait for cleanup" end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker then return "Crafting is active or finishing · stop it and wait for cleanup" end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy then return "Chest collection is active or finishing · stop it and wait for cleanup" end
    if buildController.Running or buildController.WorkerToken or buildController.Picking then return "Auto Build is active · stop building and blueprint picking" end
    if RemoteCatalog.DropEnabled or RemoteCatalog.DropHeld then return "Auto Drop is active · stop dropping before Auto Mobs" end
    if RemoteCatalog.FishingMouseInput or RemoteCatalog.BaitMouseInput or RemoteCatalog.ResourceInputBusy then return "Another tool input is finishing · wait a moment before starting" end
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if recorder and (recorder.LearnPlowOnly or recorder.LearnCraftOnly or recorder.LearnChestOnly or recorder.LearnWoodOnly or recorder.LearnBaitOnly) then
        return "Finish or cancel the other learning action first"
    end
end
-- Native activation uses only the learned weapon and server session, so a respawn keeps it.
function RemoteCatalog.MobBindingUsable(recorder)
    local b=recorder and recorder.MobBinding
    if not b then return false end
    -- Attacks use native weapon activation, so a remembered weapon works on any server.
    if b.Remembered then return player.Character~=nil and b.WeaponName==CONFIG.MobWeapon end
    if b.OwnerUserId==nil then return recorder.CanUseMobBinding~=nil and recorder:CanUseMobBinding() end
    return b.Remote~=nil and b.Remote.Parent~=nil and b.OwnerUserId==player.UserId
        and b.JobId==game.JobId and b.PlaceId==game.PlaceId and player.Character~=nil
end
function RemoteCatalog.MobRecorder()
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("MobBinding")
    if RemoteCatalog.MobBindingUsable(recorder) then
        local name=recorder.MobBinding.WeaponName
        if type(name)=="string" and name~="" and CONFIG.MobWeapon~=name then CONFIG.MobWeapon=name;savePreferences() end
        return recorder
    end
    if type(CONFIG.MobWeapon)=="string" and CONFIG.MobWeapon~="" then
        local remembered=RemoteCatalog.RememberedMobRecorder
        if not remembered or remembered.MobBinding.WeaponName~=CONFIG.MobWeapon then
            remembered={MobBinding={WeaponName=CONFIG.MobWeapon,Remembered=true}}
            RemoteCatalog.RememberedMobRecorder=remembered
        end
        return remembered
    end
end
-- SCOREBOARD BEGIN
-- Totals across every run, saved with the preferences. Only counts observed in the hub are added.
function RemoteCatalog.CountTable(value)
    local copy={}
    if type(value)~="table" then return copy end
    for name,count in pairs(value) do
        if type(name)=="string" and #name<=64 and type(count)=="number" and count>=0 and count<1e9 then copy[name]=math.floor(count) end
    end
    return copy
end
function RemoteCatalog.ValidMobScore(data)
    local score={}
    for _,key in ipairs({"Runs","Seconds","Swings","Hits","Kills","Loot","Damage","HitsTaken","Deaths","Packets","BestRate"}) do
        local value=type(data)=="table" and data[key]
        score[key]=type(value)=="number" and value==value and value>=0 and value<1e12 and value or 0
    end
    score.KillsByName=RemoteCatalog.CountTable(type(data)=="table" and data.KillsByName)
    score.LootByName=RemoteCatalog.CountTable(type(data)=="table" and data.LootByName)
    local last=type(data)=="table" and type(data.Last)=="string" and data.Last
    score.Last=last and last:sub(1,200) or nil
    -- The last eight runs, newest first, for the trend line.
    score.Recent={}
    local recent=type(data)=="table" and data.Recent
    if type(recent)=="table" then
        for _,entry in ipairs(recent) do
            if #score.Recent>=8 then break end
            if type(entry)=="table" and type(entry.Kills)=="number" and type(entry.Loot)=="number" and type(entry.Seconds)=="number" and entry.Seconds>=30 and entry.Seconds<1e7 then
                table.insert(score.Recent,{Kills=math.max(0,math.floor(entry.Kills)),Loot=math.max(0,math.floor(entry.Loot)),Seconds=entry.Seconds})
            end
        end
    end
    return score
end
function RemoteCatalog.MobScore()
    if CONFIG.MobScoreUnchecked or type(CONFIG.MobScore)~="table" then CONFIG.MobScore=RemoteCatalog.ValidMobScore(CONFIG.MobScore);CONFIG.MobScoreUnchecked=nil end
    return CONFIG.MobScore
end
-- Kills reach the Mobs goal and the lifetime totals as they are observed.
function RemoteCatalog.TrackMobGoal(farm)
    farm=farm or RemoteCatalog.Mobs
    if not farm then return end
    local kills=(farm.Defeats or 0)+(farm.LikelyDefeats or 0)
    local seen=RemoteCatalog.MobGoalSeen or 0
    if kills<seen then seen=0 end
    while seen<kills do
        seen+=1;RemoteCatalog.MobGoalSeen=seen
        RemoteCatalog.LifetimeAdd("Kills",1)
        RemoteCatalog.ProgressModeGoal("mobs");RemoteCatalog.CompleteModeGoal("mobs")
    end
    RemoteCatalog.MobGoalSeen=seen
end
function RemoteCatalog.RecordMobRun(farm)
    local seconds=farm:RunTime()
    if seconds<=0 then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.LifetimeAdd("Seconds",seconds)
    local score=RemoteCatalog.MobScore()
    local kills=(farm.Defeats or 0)+(farm.LikelyDefeats or 0)
    score.Runs+=1;score.Seconds+=seconds;score.Swings+=farm.Swings or 0
    score.Hits+=math.max(farm.DamageNumbers or 0,farm.Drops or 0);score.Kills+=kills;score.Loot+=farm.Loot or 0
    score.Damage+=farm.DamageTaken or 0;score.HitsTaken+=farm.HitsTaken or 0;score.Deaths+=farm.Deaths or 0;score.Packets+=farm.LearnedHits or 0
    if seconds>=30 then score.BestRate=math.max(score.BestRate,kills*60/seconds) end
    for name,count in pairs(farm.KillsByName or {}) do score.KillsByName[name]=(score.KillsByName[name] or 0)+count end
    for name,count in pairs(farm.LootByName or {}) do score.LootByName[name]=(score.LootByName[name] or 0)+count end
    score.Last=string.format("%d kills · %d loot · %d swings · %d:%02d · %d HP taken%s",kills,farm.Loot or 0,farm.Swings or 0,math.floor(seconds/60),math.floor(seconds%60),math.floor((farm.DamageTaken or 0)+.5),(farm.Deaths or 0)>0 and " · died" or "")
    score.Recent=score.Recent or {}
    if seconds>=30 then
        table.insert(score.Recent,1,{Kills=kills,Loot=farm.Loot or 0,Seconds=seconds})
        while #score.Recent>8 do table.remove(score.Recent) end
    end
    savePreferences()
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ResetMobScore()
    CONFIG.MobScore=RemoteCatalog.ValidMobScore(nil)
    -- The learned tuning goes with the totals: distance bias, cadence, retreat threshold, hits per kill.
    CONFIG.MobKeepBias=nil;CONFIG.MobCadence=nil;CONFIG.MobRetreatBelow=nil;CONFIG.MobHitsToKill=nil
    local farm=RemoteCatalog.Mobs
    if farm then farm.KeepBias=0;farm.Cadence=.65;farm.RetreatBelow=.45;farm.HitsToKill={};farm.HPPerKill=nil;farm.JumpByName={};farm.JumpIntervals={};farm.JumpPeriod=nil;farm.JumpPeriods=nil end
    savePreferences()
end
function RemoteCatalog.TopText(counts,limit)
    local list={}
    for name,count in pairs(counts) do table.insert(list,{name,count}) end
    table.sort(list,function(a,b) return a[2]>b[2] or a[2]==b[2] and a[1]<b[1] end)
    local parts={}
    for i=1,math.min(limit or 4,#list) do table.insert(parts,list[i][1].." "..list[i][2]) end
    return #parts>0 and table.concat(parts,", ") or "none yet"
end
function RemoteCatalog.MobScoreText()
    local s=RemoteCatalog.MobScore()
    local seconds=math.floor(s.Seconds)
    local lines={
        string.format("Runs %d · time %d:%02d:%02d · kills %d (best %.1f/min) · loot %d",s.Runs,math.floor(seconds/3600),math.floor(seconds%3600/60),seconds%60,s.Kills,s.BestRate,s.Loot),
        string.format("Swings %d · hits %d (%d%%) · packets %d · damage taken %d HP in %d hits · deaths %d",s.Swings,s.Hits,s.Swings>0 and math.floor(s.Hits*100/s.Swings+.5) or 0,s.Packets,math.floor(s.Damage+.5),s.HitsTaken,s.Deaths),
        "Top mobs: "..RemoteCatalog.TopText(s.KillsByName),
        "Top loot: "..RemoteCatalog.TopText(s.LootByName),
        s.Seconds>=60 and string.format("Per hour (all runs): %.0f kills · %.0f loot · %.0f HP taken",s.Kills*3600/s.Seconds,s.Loot*3600/s.Seconds,s.Damage*3600/s.Seconds) or "Per hour: needs a minute of farming",
        "Kills/min trend (oldest → newest): "..RemoteCatalog.MobTrendText(s),
        "Last run: "..(s.Last or "none yet"),
    }
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end
-- Block-character sparkline of kills per minute over the recent runs, with the numbers.
function RemoteCatalog.MobTrendText(score)
    local recent=score and score.Recent or {}
    if #recent==0 then return "no finished run of 30 s yet" end
    local rates={}
    for i=#recent,1,-1 do table.insert(rates,recent[i].Kills*60/recent[i].Seconds) end
    local top=0
    for _,rate in ipairs(rates) do top=math.max(top,rate) end
    local bars={"▁","▂","▃","▄","▅","▆","▇","█"}
    local spark,numbers={},{}
    for _,rate in ipairs(rates) do
        local level=top>0 and math.max(1,math.min(8,math.ceil(rate/top*8))) or 1
        table.insert(spark,bars[level]);table.insert(numbers,string.format("%.1f",rate))
    end
    return table.concat(spark).." "..table.concat(numbers," · ")
end
function RemoteCatalog.CopyMobScore()
    local report="Reborn mob-stop-178 · Mobs scoreboard\n"..RemoteCatalog.MobScoreText()
    local function copyWith(fn)
        if type(fn)~="function" then return false end
        local ok,result=pcall(fn,report);return ok and result~=false
    end
    if copyWith(setclipboard) or toclipboard~=setclipboard and copyWith(toclipboard) then setStatus("Scoreboard copied",COLORS.good);return true end
    print(report);setStatus("Scoreboard printed to the console (no clipboard)",COLORS.warn);return false
end
-- SCOREBOARD END
function RemoteCatalog.MobKillText(farm)
    local list={}
    for name,count in pairs(farm.KillsByName or {}) do table.insert(list,{name,count}) end
    table.sort(list,function(a,b) return a[2]>b[2] or a[2]==b[2] and a[1]<b[1] end)
    local parts={}
    for _,entry in ipairs(list) do table.insert(parts,entry[1].." "..entry[2]) end
    return #parts>0 and table.concat(parts,", ") or "none yet"
end
function RemoteCatalog.MobRunText(farm)
    local seconds=math.floor(farm:RunTime())
    local text=string.format("Run %d:%02d",math.floor(seconds/60),seconds%60)
    if seconds>=30 then text..=string.format("   ·   %.1f kills/min",(farm.Defeats+(farm.LikelyDefeats or 0))*60/seconds) end
    return text
end
-- "live" when this server's packet was learned, "remembered" when the stable definition from an
-- earlier server resolves here, nil otherwise.
-- Ground within 12 studs below a point (3 studs above it to clear small steps), ignoring the
-- character and mobs; a miss means water, void or the island's edge.
-- Walkable ground under a point: cast from well above it (a ray that starts inside a slope sees
-- nothing) and accept a hit between 15 studs below and 8 studs above the point. Higher means a
-- wall or a roof, lower means a drop, nothing means water, void or the island's edge.
function RemoteCatalog.MobGroundAt(point)
    local params=RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local exclude={}
    if player.Character then table.insert(exclude,player.Character) end
    pcall(function() for _,folder in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.MobFarmModule.Roots(workspace)) do table.insert(exclude,folder) end end)
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances=exclude
    -- Water is not ground: the terrain ray must pass through it, and a water part never counts.
    params.IgnoreWater=true
    local hit=workspace:Raycast(point+Vector3.new(0,24,0),Vector3.new(0,-48,0),params)
    if not hit or (hit.Instance and hit.Instance.CanCollide==false) then return nil end
    local water=false
    pcall(function() if hit.Material~=nil and Enum.Material and hit.Material==Enum.Material.Water then water=true end end)
    pcall(function() if hit.Instance and string.find(string.lower(hit.Instance.Name),"water",1,true) then water=true end end)
    if water then return nil end
    if hit.Position.Y<point.Y-15 or hit.Position.Y>point.Y+8 then return nil end
    return hit.Position
end
function RemoteCatalog.MobGround(point) return RemoteCatalog.MobGroundAt(point)~=nil end
-- What the hop and walk ground check sees at the character's feet and 8 studs ahead; for the reports.
function RemoteCatalog.MobGroundText(root)
    local ok,text=pcall(function()
        local here=RemoteCatalog.MobGroundAt(root.Position)
        local ahead=RemoteCatalog.MobGroundAt(root.Position+root.CFrame.LookVector*8)
        return (here and ("yes (%.1f studs below)"):format(root.Position.Y-here.Y) or "none (water, void or a slope the check cannot see)")
            ..(" · 8 studs ahead: "..(ahead and "ground" or "none"))
    end)
    return ok and text or ("unavailable: "..tostring(text))
end
-- One TP hop that follows the terrain: the character lands standing on the ground under the
-- destination, uphill or downhill, never inside a slope or in the air, facing the target.
function RemoteCatalog.MobHop(root,destination,target)
    local ground=RemoteCatalog.MobGroundAt(destination)
    if not ground then error("No ground under the next hop",0) end
    local humanoid=root.Parent and root.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local height=root.Size.Y/2+(humanoid and humanoid.HipHeight or 2)
    local point=Vector3.new(destination.X,ground.Y+height,destination.Z)
    local flat=Vector3.new(target.Position.X,point.Y,target.Position.Z)
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
    root.CFrame=(flat-point).Magnitude>.1 and CFrame.lookAt(point,flat) or root.CFrame+(point-root.Position)
    return point
end
-- One portion of food from a learned craft recipe whose item name is a food word, sent through the
-- same craft binding Crafting uses; only when the learned workbench is on the island and in reach.
function RemoteCatalog.MobCraftFood()
    local names={}
    pcall(function() names=RemoteCatalog.CraftRecipes() end)
    for _,name in ipairs(names) do
        local lower=string.lower(tostring(name))
        local isFood=false
        if not string.find(lower,"bait",1,true) then
            for _,word in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.FoodWords) do if string.find(lower,word,1,true) then isFood=true;break end end
        end
        if isFood then
            local recorder,binding=RemoteCatalog.CraftRecorder(name)
            if recorder and binding and type(recorder.CraftItem)=="function" then
                local reachable,reason=RemoteCatalog.CraftReachable(binding.Workbench)
                if not reachable then return false,name..": "..tostring(reason) end
                local ok,result=recorder:CraftItem(1,binding)
                if not ok then return false,name.." craft rejected: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(result)) end
                for _=1,30 do if RemoteCatalog.FoodTool() then return true,name end;task.wait(.1) end
                return false,name.." crafted but no food appeared"
            end
        end
    end
    return false,"no learned food recipe (learn one in Crafting while at your workbench)"
end
function RemoteCatalog.MobHitSource()
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("MobBinding")
    if recorder and recorder.MobHit and recorder.CanUseMobBinding and recorder:CanUseMobBinding() then return "live" end
    if RemoteCatalog.RememberedMobHitReady() then return "remembered" end
    return nil
end
-- Keys and short values of the learned hit packet, so a per-swing field (a nonce, an attack id)
-- can be spotted from a report; the envelope's own values stay private.
function RemoteCatalog.MobPacketText()
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("MobBinding")
    local binding=recorder and recorder.MobBinding
    if not binding or not binding.Args then return "none on this server" end
    local ok,text=pcall(function()
        local envelope=binding.Args[1]
        local parts={}
        for key,value in pairs(envelope) do
            if key~=binding.BodyKey then table.insert(parts,tostring(key).."="..type(value)..(type(value)=="string" and ("["..#value.."]") or "")) end
        end
        table.sort(parts)
        local body={}
        local inner=envelope[binding.BodyKey]
        if type(inner)=="table" then
            for key,value in pairs(inner) do
                if key=="hitUnit" then table.insert(body,"hitUnit="..(typeof(value)=="Instance" and value.Name or typeof(value)))
                else table.insert(body,tostring(key).."="..tostring(value):sub(1,24)) end
            end
        end
        table.sort(body)
        local names={}
        pcall(function() names=RemoteCatalog.RequestDefinitionNames() end)
        return "remote "..tostring(binding.Remote and binding.Remote.Name).." · envelope {"..table.concat(parts,", ").."} · body "..tostring(binding.BodyKey).."={"..table.concat(body,", ").."} · definitions exposed: "..#names
    end)
    return ok and text or ("unreadable: "..tostring(text))
end
function RemoteCatalog.RememberedMobHitReady()
    local name=type(CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions)=="table" and CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions.MobBinding
    if type(name)~="string" or type(CONFIG.MobHitBody)~="table" then return false end
    local endpoint=RemoteCatalog.GameEndpoint(name)
    return endpoint~=nil and type(endpoint.CallServer)=="function"
end
function RemoteCatalog.RememberedMobHit(model)
    local name=type(CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions)=="table" and CONFIG.LearnedDefinitions.MobBinding
    local endpoint=type(name)=="string" and RemoteCatalog.GameEndpoint(name)
    if not endpoint or type(CONFIG.MobHitBody)~="table" then return false,"no remembered hit" end
    local tool=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if not tool or (CONFIG.MobWeapon and tool.Name~=CONFIG.MobWeapon) then return false,"Equip the learned weapon" end
    local body={}
    for key,value in pairs(CONFIG.MobHitBody) do body[key]=value end
    body.hitUnit=model
    return RemoteCatalog.SendEndpoint(endpoint,body)
end
-- Auto-learn: while the farm clicks, a swing that really lands makes the game send its hit packet;
-- the recorder captures it, and every later swing adds the packet. Nothing extra is sent.
function RemoteCatalog.ArmMobLearning()
    if RemoteCatalog.MobHitSource()=="live" then return false end
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if recorder and recorder.LearnMobOnly then return true end
    if recorder and (recorder.LearnPlowOnly or recorder.LearnCraftOnly or recorder.LearnChestOnly or recorder.LearnWoodOnly or recorder.LearnBaitOnly) then return false end
    local ok,started=pcall(RemoteCatalog.StartCapture)
    if not ok or not started then return false end
    local token={};RemoteCatalog.MobAutoLearnToken=token
    RemoteCatalog.Recorder=started;started.MobLearnToken=token;started.LearnMobOnly=true;started.Active=false
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.DisarmMobLearning()
    if not RemoteCatalog.MobAutoLearnToken then return end
    RemoteCatalog.MobAutoLearnToken=nil
    if RemoteCatalog.MobLearningToken then return end
    RemoteCatalog.StopMobLearning()
end
function RemoteCatalog.StopMobLearning()
    RemoteCatalog.MobLearningToken=nil
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.Recorder
    if recorder and recorder.LearnMobOnly then
        recorder.LearnMobOnly=false
        if not recorder.Active and not recorder.LearnCraftOnly and not recorder.LearnWoodOnly and not recorder.LearnBaitOnly and not recorder.LearnChestOnly and not recorder.LearnPlowOnly then recorder:Stop() end
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI()
    local farm=RemoteCatalog.Mobs
    if not farm or not RemoteCatalog.MobToggle or not gui.Parent then return end
    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.MobRecorder()
    local learning=RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnMobOnly and RemoteCatalog.MobLearningToken~=nil
    RemoteCatalog.MobToggle.Text=farm.Enabled and "FARMING ON" or farm.Worker and "FINISHING…" or "START FARMING"
    RemoteCatalog.MobToggle.BackgroundColor3=farm.Enabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.accent
    RemoteCatalog.MobToggle.TextColor3=farm.Enabled and COLORS.text or COLORS.accentDark
    RemoteCatalog.MobToggle.Active=not farm.Worker or farm.Enabled
    RemoteCatalog.MobStop.Text=farm.Worker and not farm.Enabled and "STOPPING…" or "STOP"
    RemoteCatalog.MobLearn.Text=learning and "Cancel attack learning" or recorder and "Relearn attack" or "Learn attack"
    RemoteCatalog.MobLearn.Active=not farm.Worker
    if RemoteCatalog.MobRadiusMenu then RemoteCatalog.MobRadiusMenu:Refresh()
    else RemoteCatalog.MobRadius.Text="Search radius: "..farm.Radius.." studs  ▼" end
    RemoteCatalog.MobTarget.Text="Target: "..tostring(farm.Kind).."  ↻"
    RemoteCatalog.MobEat.Text=farm.AutoEat and "AUTO EAT: ON" or "AUTO EAT: OFF"
    RemoteCatalog.MobEat.BackgroundColor3=farm.AutoEat and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    RemoteCatalog.MobSpeed.Text="Walk speed: "..tostring(farm.WalkSpeed).."  ↻"
    RemoteCatalog.MobKeep.Text="Keep distance: "..tostring(farm.KeepDistance)..(farm.KeepDistance~="Auto" and " studs" or "").."  ↻"
    RemoteCatalog.MobHitRun.Text=farm.HitAndRun and "HIT & RUN: ON" or "HIT & RUN: OFF"
    RemoteCatalog.MobHitRun.BackgroundColor3=farm.HitAndRun and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    RemoteCatalog.MobTarget.Active=not farm.Worker
    RemoteCatalog.MobWalk.Text=not farm.Walk and "AUTO MOVE: OFF" or farm.Travel=="Teleport" and "AUTO MOVE: TP HOPS" or "AUTO MOVE: WALK"
    RemoteCatalog.MobInfo.Text=learning and "Learning · hide the hub and hit one slime manually with your melee weapon. Then press START FARMING."
        or (#farm.Message>180 and farm.Message:sub(1,150).."… Copy result for details" or farm.Message)
    RemoteCatalog.MobWeapon.Text="Target: "..tostring(farm.Kind).." · "..(recorder and "Weapon: "..recorder.MobBinding.WeaponName..(recorder.MobBinding.Remembered and " (remembered)" or "") or "Weapon: learn one manual hit")
    RemoteCatalog.MobCounters.Text=string.format("%d swings   ·   %d HP drops   ·   %d loot   ·   %d defeats (+%d likely)",farm.Swings,farm.Drops,farm.Loot or 0,farm.Defeats,farm.LikelyDefeats or 0)
        ..(farm.StartedAt and "\n"..RemoteCatalog.MobRunText(farm) or "")
end
-- Read-only view of what the Entities folders hold, ignoring the radius, so an empty scan can be told
-- apart from slimes that are just far away, not streamed in, or named differently.
function RemoteCatalog.MobWorldReport()
    local module=RemoteCatalog.MobFarmModule
    local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not module or not root then return "World: character unavailable" end
    local roots=module.Roots(workspace)
    local lines,folders={},{}
    for _,folder in ipairs(roots) do table.insert(folders,folder:GetFullName().." ("..#folder:GetChildren().." children)") end
    table.insert(lines,"Entities folders: "..(#folders>0 and table.concat(folders,", ") or "none found (WildernessIsland.Entities / workspace.Entities)"))
    local nearest,named={},{}
    local matchingDistance
    for _,folder in ipairs(roots) do
        for _,model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            local health,part=module.Details(model,roots,Players,"All mobs")
            if health and part and health.Health>0 then
                local distance=math.floor((part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude)
                local entry=named[model.Name]
                if not entry then entry={Name=model.Name,Count=0,Distance=distance};named[model.Name]=entry;table.insert(nearest,entry) end
                entry.Count+=1;entry.Distance=math.min(entry.Distance,distance)
                if module.Matches(model.Name,RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Kind) then matchingDistance=math.min(matchingDistance or math.huge,distance) end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(nearest,function(a,b) return a.Distance<b.Distance end)
    local parts={}
    for index,entry in ipairs(nearest) do
        if index>8 then break end
        table.insert(parts,entry.Name.." ×"..entry.Count.." (nearest "..entry.Distance.." studs)")
    end
    table.insert(lines,"Living mobs loaded (any distance): "..(#parts>0 and table.concat(parts,", ") or "none loaded near you"))
    table.insert(lines,"Nearest matching target: "..(matchingDistance and (matchingDistance.." studs"..(matchingDistance>RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Radius and " · outside the search radius" or "")) or "none loaded"))
    table.insert(lines,"Ground under you: "..RemoteCatalog.MobGroundText(root))
    return table.concat(lines,"\n")
end

        "Search: "..farm.Radius.." studs · Auto Move "..(not farm.Walk and "OFF" or farm.Travel=="Teleport" and "TP hops ("..farm.HopDistance.." studs)" or "Walk").." · walk speed "..tostring(farm.WalkSpeed)..(movementController.WalkEnabled and " (Movement tab custom walk overrides it)" or "").." · keep distance "..tostring(farm.KeepDistance).." · hit and run "..(farm.HitAndRun and "ON" or "OFF"),

function RemoteCatalog.CopyMobResult()
    local report=RemoteCatalog.MobResultReport()
    local function copyWith(fn)
        if type(fn)~="function" then return false end
        local ok,result=pcall(fn,report);return ok and result~=false
    end
    if copyWith(setclipboard) or toclipboard~=setclipboard and copyWith(toclipboard) then
        setStatus("Mob result copied",COLORS.good);return true
    end
    print(report);setStatus("Mob result printed to console",COLORS.warn);return false
end
function RemoteCatalog.LearnMobAttack()
    if RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Worker then return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnMobOnly then
        RemoteCatalog.StopMobLearning();RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Message="Attack learning cancelled";RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI();return true
    end
    local busy=RemoteCatalog.MobBusy()
    if busy then RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Message=busy;RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI();return false end
    local char=player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
        local ready=RemoteCatalog.MobRecorder()
        RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Message=ready and ("Attack already ready · press START FARMING. Equip "..ready.MobBinding.WeaponName.." only to relearn.")
            or "Equip a melee weapon before learning"
        RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI();return false
    end
    local ok,recorder=pcall(RemoteCatalog.StartCapture)
    if not ok or not recorder then
        RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Message="Attack learning unavailable on this host";RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI();return false
    end
    local token={};RemoteCatalog.MobLearningToken=token
    RemoteCatalog.Recorder=recorder;recorder.MobLearnToken=token;recorder.LearnMobOnly=true;recorder.Active=false
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI()
    task.delay(30,function()
        if not gui.Parent or RemoteCatalog.MobLearningToken~=token then return end
        if recorder.LearnMobOnly then
            RemoteCatalog.StopMobLearning()
            RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Message="No supported attack observed · try Learn attack and hit a slime once"
            RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI()
        end
    end)
    return true
end
RemoteCatalog.Mobs=RemoteCatalog.MobFarmModule.new({
    Player=player,Players=Players,World=workspace,Navigation=RemoteCatalog.Navigation,
    Alive=function() return gui.Parent~=nil end,Busy=RemoteCatalog.MobBusy,Recorder=RemoteCatalog.MobRecorder,
    BindingUsable=RemoteCatalog.MobBindingUsable,
    PauseReason=function()
        local ok,field=pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() end)
        if not ok or field then return "Paused · finish typing in chat or a text field" end
        if RemoteCatalog.Recorder and RemoteCatalog.Recorder.LearnMobOnly and RemoteCatalog.MobLearningToken~=nil then return "Paused · finish attack learning first" end
        if RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy then return "Paused · depositing items into a chest" end
    end,
    Weapon=function(name)
        for _,tool in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools()) do if tool.Name==name then return tool end end
    end,
    Equip=RemoteCatalog.EquipTool,
    Hop=function(root,destination,target) return RemoteCatalog.MobHop(root,destination,target) end,
    -- Screen point of the target for a real click; nil with a reason when a click cannot land on it.
    Aim=function(target)
        local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
        local char=player.Character
        if not camera or not char then return nil,"camera unavailable" end
        local focused,textBox=pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() end)
        if focused and textBox then return nil,"typing" end
        if RemoteCatalog.MouseSteersCamera and RemoteCatalog.MouseSteersCamera() then return nil,"right mouse held" end
        local point,visible=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(target.Root.Position)
        local params=RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances={char}
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(camera.CFrame.Position,target.Root.Position-camera.CFrame.Position,params)
        -- Off screen or behind something: the swing still hits what the character faces, so a click
        -- on any free spot of the game view does the job; only a GUI click would not swing.
        local reason=(not visible or point.Z<=0) and "target off screen" or hit and not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target.Model) and ("target hidden behind "..hit.Instance.Name) or nil
        local x,y=point.X,point.Y
        local function covered(px,py)
            if hub.Root.Visible then
                local p,size=hub.Root.AbsolutePosition,hub.Root.AbsoluteSize
                if px>=p.X and px<=p.X+size.X and py>=p.Y and py<=p.Y+size.Y then return "hub covers the target" end
            end
            local checked,objects=pcall(function() return playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(px,py) end)
            if checked then
                for _,object in ipairs(objects) do
                    if object:IsA("GuiButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") or object:IsDescendantOf(statsOverlayGui) then return "a control covers the target" end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        reason=reason or covered(x,y)
        if not reason then return x,y end
        -- The melee swing hits what the character faces, not what the mouse is over: when the hub
        -- or a control sits over the target, click any free spot of the game view instead. Weapon
        -- activation plays no animation and the server then rejects the hit (NO_ANIMATION).
        local size=camera.ViewportSize
        for _,candidate in ipairs({{.5,.5},{.5,.3},{.75,.5},{.25,.5},{.5,.7},{.85,.3},{.15,.3}}) do
            local cx,cy=size.X*candidate[1],size.Y*candidate[2]
            if not covered(cx,cy) then return cx,cy,"on a free spot ("..reason..")" end
        end
        return nil,reason
    end,
    -- Host mouse when available (works with a captured camera), else VirtualInputManager.
    Click=function(x,y,down)
        local host=type(mousemoveabs)=="function" and type(mouse1press)=="function" and type(mouse1release)=="function"
        if down then
            local moved=pcall(function()
                if host then mousemoveabs(x,y) else VirtualInputManager:SendMouseMoveEvent(x,y,game) end
            end)
            if not moved then return false end
            RemoteCatalog.MobMouseInput=true
            local pressed=pcall(function()
                if host then mouse1press() else VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,0,true,game,0) end
            end)
            if not pressed then RemoteCatalog.MobMouseInput=false;return false end
            return true
        end
        local released=pcall(function()
            if host then mouse1release() else VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,0,false,game,0) end
        end)
        RemoteCatalog.MobMouseInput=false
        return released
    end,
    -- The game's hit packet: learned on this server (manually or from our own landed swing), or
    -- remembered by its stable request definition from an earlier server.
    LearnedHitReady=function()
        local source=RemoteCatalog.MobHitSource()
        -- A packet learned during the run is remembered for other servers as soon as it exists.
        if source=="live" and not CONFIG.MobHitBody and os.clock()-(RemoteCatalog.MobRememberAt or -math.huge)>5 then
            RemoteCatalog.MobRememberAt=os.clock();pcall(RemoteCatalog.RememberDefinitions)
        end
        return source~=nil
    end,
    LearnedHit=function(model)
        local recorder=RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("MobBinding")
        if recorder and recorder.MobHit and recorder.CanUseMobBinding and recorder:CanUseMobBinding() then return recorder:MobHit(model) end
        if RemoteCatalog.RememberedMobHitReady() then return RemoteCatalog.RememberedMobHit(model) end
        return false,"no learned hit on this server"
    end,
    -- Eats one prepared food from the inventory with the game's food request (the one Auto Bait
    -- uses), confirmed by HP rising or the stack shrinking, then re-equips the weapon.
    -- Faster walking only while the farm moves; nil restores. The Movement tab's custom walk wins.
    Boost=function(human,speed)
        RemoteCatalog.MobSpeedOriginal=RemoteCatalog.MobSpeedOriginal or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
        local originals=RemoteCatalog.MobSpeedOriginal
        if speed then
            -- The Movement tab's custom walk owns the speed; never boost over it.
            if movementController.WalkEnabled then return end
            if originals[human]==nil then originals[human]=human.WalkSpeed end
            human.WalkSpeed=speed
        elseif originals[human]~=nil then
            -- Always consume the saved original: if custom walk took over meanwhile it captured the
            -- boosted value as its baseline, so hand it the real one instead of writing the humanoid.
            local original=originals[human];originals[human]=nil
            if movementController.WalkEnabled then movementController:SetBaseline(human,"WalkSpeed",original)
            else human.WalkSpeed=original end
        end
    end,
    Eat=function()
        local char=player.Character
        local human=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not human then return false,"character unavailable" end
        local food=RemoteCatalog.FoodTool()
        if not food then
            -- No food: craft one portion from a learned food recipe when the workbench is in reach.
            local crafted,detail=RemoteCatalog.MobCraftFood()
            if crafted then food=RemoteCatalog.FoodTool() end
            if not food then return false,"no food in the inventory · "..tostring(detail) end
        end
        local endpoint=RemoteCatalog.GameEndpoint("CLIENT_EAT_FOOD")
        if not endpoint then return false,"game food request unavailable" end
        local previous=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        local before,count=human.Health,RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(food)
        if not RemoteCatalog.EquipTool(food) then return false,"could not equip "..food.Name end
        task.wait(.1)
        local ok,reason=RemoteCatalog.SendEndpoint(endpoint,{tool=food})
        local healed=false
        if ok then
            for _=1,15 do
                local now=RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(food)
                if human.Health>before+.5 or not food.Parent or count and now and now<count then healed=true;break end
                task.wait(.1)
            end
        end
        if previous and previous~=food and previous.Parent and player.Character==char then pcall(RemoteCatalog.EquipTool,previous) end
        if not ok then return false,food.Name.." rejected: "..tostring(RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText(reason)) end
        return healed,food.Name..(healed and (" · HP "..math.floor(human.Health).."/"..math.floor(human.MaxHealth)) or " · no HP change seen")
    end,
    -- Inventory snapshot {name=count} so loot can confirm a hit when mob HP never replicates.
    Inventory=function()
        local counts={}
        for _,tool in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools()) do
            local count=RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(tool)
            counts[tool.Name]=(counts[tool.Name] or 0)+(type(count)=="number" and count or 1)
        end
        return counts
    end,
    Flatten=function(v) return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z) end,
    -- Points on the circle `radius` studs around a position, for the free-side approach.
    Around=function(center,radius,count)
        local points={}
        for i=1,count do
            local angle=(i-1)/count*math.pi*2
            table.insert(points,Vector3.new(center.X+math.cos(angle)*radius,center.Y,center.Z+math.sin(angle)*radius))
        end
        return points
    end,
    Jump=function(human) human.Jump=true end,
    Ended=function(farm) if RemoteCatalog.MobEnded then RemoteCatalog.MobEnded(farm) end end,
    Remember=function(key,value)
        if key=="KeepBias" and CONFIG.MobKeepBias~=value then CONFIG.MobKeepBias=value;savePreferences() end
        if key=="Cadence" and type(value)=="number" and CONFIG.MobCadence~=value then CONFIG.MobCadence=value;savePreferences() end
        if key=="RetreatBelow" and type(value)=="number" and CONFIG.MobRetreatBelow~=value then CONFIG.MobRetreatBelow=value;savePreferences() end
        if key=="HitsToKill" and type(value)=="table" then
            local copy={}
            for name,hits in pairs(value) do if type(name)=="string" and type(hits)=="number" then copy[name]=math.floor(hits*10+.5)/10 end end
            CONFIG.MobHitsToKill=copy;savePreferences()
        end
    end,
    -- Count the game's floating damage numbers (numeric TextLabels created after a swing).
    DamageSeen=function(since,targetRoot)
        local count,total=0,0
        for i=#RemoteCatalog.DamageNumbers,1,-1 do
            local entry=RemoteCatalog.DamageNumbers[i]
            if entry.At<since then break end
            -- A number anchored more than 10 studs from the target, or closer to the character than
            -- to the target, belongs to someone else's hit or to damage taken.
            local me=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local foreign=entry.Position~=nil and targetRoot~=nil and ((entry.Position-targetRoot.Position).Magnitude>10
                or me~=nil and (entry.Position-me.Position).Magnitude<(entry.Position-targetRoot.Position).Magnitude and (entry.Position-me.Position).Magnitude<4)
            if foreign then entry.Foreign=true
            elseif not entry.Counted then entry.Counted=true;count+=1;total+=entry.Value end
        end
        return count,total
    end,
    -- One step perpendicular to the line from the threat, so a jumping mob lands beside the character.
    Sidestep=function(human,root,threatPosition,distance)
        local away=Vector3.new(root.Position.X-threatPosition.X,0,root.Position.Z-threatPosition.Z)
        if away.Magnitude<.1 then away=root.CFrame.LookVector end
        away=Vector3.new(away.X,0,away.Z).Unit
        local side=Vector3.new(-away.Z,0,away.X)
        -- Alternate sides so repeated jumps do not walk the character in one direction; never
        -- step over an edge.
        RemoteCatalog.MobDodgeSide=-(RemoteCatalog.MobDodgeSide or 1)
        local point=root.Position+side*(distance or 5)*RemoteCatalog.MobDodgeSide
        if not RemoteCatalog.MobGround(point) then
            point=root.Position-side*(distance or 5)*RemoteCatalog.MobDodgeSide
            if not RemoteCatalog.MobGround(point) then error("no ground beside the character",0) end
        end
        human:MoveTo(point)
    end,
    Ground=function(point) return RemoteCatalog.MobGround(point) end,
    Side=function(v) return Vector3.new(-v.Z,0,v.X) end,
    Face=function(root,target)
        -- Yaw only, so the character stays upright on slopes and hopping slimes.
        local flat=Vector3.new(target.Position.X,root.Position.Y,target.Position.Z)
        if (flat-root.Position).Magnitude<.1 then return end
        root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,flat)
    end,
    DescribeResult=RemoteCatalog.ChestResultText,
    ClearLine=function(root,target,char,model)
        -- Other mobs are not walls: a slime crowd must not turn TP hops into pathfinding.
        local params=RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local exclude={char}
        pcall(function() for _,folder in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.MobFarmModule.Roots(workspace)) do table.insert(exclude,folder) end end)
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances=exclude
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(root.Position,target.Position-root.Position,params)
        return not hit or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model)
    end,
    Update=function(farm) RemoteCatalog.TrackMobGoal(farm);RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI() end,
})
-- Auto-learn rides along with every run: armed at start, disarmed at stop. Manual Learn attack
-- keeps its own token, so the two never cancel each other.
do
    local farm=RemoteCatalog.Mobs
    local start,stop=farm.Start,farm.Stop
    local function finish(self)
        pcall(RemoteCatalog.DisarmMobLearning)
        if self.StartedAt and self.Recorded==false then self.Recorded=true;pcall(RemoteCatalog.RecordMobRun,self);pcall(RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobScore) end
    end
    function farm:Start(...)
        RemoteCatalog.MobGoalSeen=0;RemoteCatalog.ResetModeGoal("mobs")
        local ok=start(self,...)
        -- The first tick runs inside start(); a run that already ended there is neither armed nor recorded.
        if ok and self.Enabled then self.Recorded=false;pcall(RemoteCatalog.ArmMobLearning) end
        return ok
    end
    function farm:Stop(...)
        local result=stop(self,...)
        finish(self)
        return result
    end
    RemoteCatalog.MobEnded=finish
end
