-- MOB FARM UI END
-- AUTO DEPOSIT BEGIN
-- Puts farm items from the inventory into owned chests with the CLIENT_CHEST_TRANSACTION deposit
-- (same remote and body as the confirmed withdrawal, action="deposit"). Each item is confirmed by
-- its stack shrinking or leaving the inventory; weapons, tools, bait and seeds are never deposited.
RemoteCatalog.DepositCategories={"Crops","Crops + wood + ores","Wood + ores"}
RemoteCatalog.DepositIntervals={30,60,120,300}
RemoteCatalog.DepositGeneration=0
CONFIG.DepositCategory=CONFIG.DepositCategory or "Crops"
CONFIG.DepositInterval=CONFIG.DepositInterval or 60
do
    local never={"axe","sword","rod","hoe","sickle","hammer","bow","staff","wand","shovel","bucket","bait","seed","sapling","blueprint","totem","net","spear","dagger","club","mace","scythe",
        "shears","shield","armor","armour","helmet","boots","pick","rake","trowel","lantern","torch","tool","glove","ring","amulet"}
    local crops={"wheat","carrot","potato","corn","tomato","pumpkin","melon","cabbage","lettuce","berr","onion","radish","beet","rice","grape","pineapple","starfruit","dragonfruit","cactus","seaweed","flower","mushroom","spinach","garlic","chili","pepper","cucumber","fruit","orange","apple"}
    local wood={"log","wood","plank","lumber"}
    local ores={"ore","coal","stone","iron","gold","copper","tin","silver","crystal","gem","diamond","clay","sand","marble","slate","obsidian","electrite","bar"}
    local function has(name,words) for _,word in ipairs(words) do if string.find(name,word,1,true) then return true end end end
    function RemoteCatalog.DepositKind(name)
        name=string.lower(tostring(name))
        if has(name,never) then return nil end
        if has(name,crops) then return "crop" end
        if has(name,wood) then return "wood" end
        if has(name,ores) then return "ore" end
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.DepositWanted(kind)
    local category=CONFIG.DepositCategory
    if category=="Crops" then return kind=="crop" end
    if category=="Wood + ores" then return kind=="wood" or kind=="ore" end
    return kind~=nil
end
function RemoteCatalog.DepositItems()
    local items,seen={},{}
    local char=player.Character
    local held=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    -- Planting stock may be named exactly like the crop; replanting needs it in the inventory.
    local planting={}
    local crops=FarmLogic.SelectedCrops(CONFIG.HarvestCrops,CONFIG.HarvestCrop)
    table.insert(crops,CONFIG.PlantType)
    for _,crop in ipairs(crops) do
        for _,name in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.SeedNames(crop) or {}) do planting[name]=true end
    end
    for _,tool in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.OwnedTools()) do
        local kind=not planting[tool.Name] and RemoteCatalog.DepositKind(tool.Name) or nil
        -- The held tool is left alone so a running farm keeps its equipment.
        if not seen[tool] and tool~=held and tool.Parent and RemoteCatalog.DepositWanted(kind) then
            seen[tool]=true
            local amount=RemoteCatalog.DepositAmount(tool)
            -- A stack that reads 0 (or unreadable) would be a request for nothing, every cycle.
            if type(amount)=="number" and amount>0 then table.insert(items,{Tool=tool,Kind=kind,Amount=amount}) end
        end
    end
    table.sort(items,function(a,b) return a.Tool.Name<b.Tool.Name end)
    return items
end
-- Inventory quantities can live in attributes or other value names; read them like bait.
function RemoteCatalog.DepositAmount(tool)
    local count=RemoteCatalog.BaitCount and RemoteCatalog.BaitCount(tool)
    return type(count)=="number" and count>0 and math.floor(count) or RemoteCatalog.StackAmount(tool)
end
function RemoteCatalog.DepositChests()
    local island=getPlayerIsland()
    local blocks=island and island:FindFirstChild("Blocks")
    local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local list={}
    for _,chest in ipairs(blocks and root and blocks:GetChildren() or {}) do
        local binding={Chest=chest}
        if string.find(string.lower(chest.Name),"chest",1,true) and chest:FindFirstChild("Contents")
            and not RemoteCatalog.ChestTargetProtected(binding) then
            local position=getPartPosition(chest)
            if position then table.insert(list,{Chest=chest,Distance=(position-root.Position).Magnitude}) end
        end
    end
    table.sort(list,function(a,b) return a.Distance<b.Distance end)
    return list
end
function RemoteCatalog.DepositPreview()
    local items=RemoteCatalog.DepositItems()
    local chests=RemoteCatalog.DepositChests()
    local parts={}
    for _,item in ipairs(items) do table.insert(parts,item.Tool.Name.." ×"..item.Amount) end
    return (#items>0 and ("Would deposit "..#items.." stacks: "..table.concat(parts,", ")) or "Nothing to deposit for "..CONFIG.DepositCategory..".")
        .."\n"..(chests[1] and ("Nearest chest: "..chests[1].Chest.Name.." · "..math.floor(chests[1].Distance).." studs") or "No owned chest with readable contents.")
end
function RemoteCatalog.DepositOnce(active)
    active=active or function() return gui.Parent~=nil end
    if RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy then return 0,"A deposit is already running" end
    if RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy then return 0,"Waiting · chest collection is running" end
    if RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker or RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker or buildController.Running or buildController.WorkerToken then
        return 0,"Waiting · crafting, Auto Plow or Auto Build is running"
    end
    local remote=RemoteCatalog.ChestTransactionRemote()
    if not remote then return 0,"Chest request unavailable on this server" end
    local items=RemoteCatalog.DepositItems()
    if #items==0 then return 0,"Nothing to deposit for "..CONFIG.DepositCategory end
    local chests=RemoteCatalog.DepositChests()
    if #chests==0 then return 0,"No owned chest with readable contents" end
    local deposited,note=0,nil
    RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy=true
    local ok,failure=pcall(function()
        for index,entry in ipairs(chests) do
            if index>3 or #items==0 or not active() then break end
            local chest=entry.Chest
            local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local position=getPartPosition(chest)
            if not root or not position then break end
            if (position-root.Position).Magnitude>20 then
                -- Fishing keeps its cast: never walk away from the water for a deposit.
                if RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel=="Stay" or enabled then note="Stand within 20 studs of a chest, or choose chest Movement: Walk / TP hops";break end
                if (position-root.Position).Magnitude>RemoteCatalog.ChestScanRange then note="Nearest chest is outside the chest approach range";break end
                RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Stop()
                local mode=RemoteCatalog.ChestTravel=="Hop" and "Hop" or "Walk"
                RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Approach(player,chest,12,active,getPartPosition,mode,"Deposit")
                root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                position=getPartPosition(chest)
                if not root or not position or (position-root.Position).Magnitude>20 then note="Could not reach the chest";break end
            end
            local remaining={}
            for _,item in ipairs(items) do
                if not active() then break end
                local tool=item.Tool
                if tool.Parent then
                    local before=RemoteCatalog.DepositAmount(tool)
                    pcall(function()
                        remote.InvokeServer(remote,{chest=chest,player_tracking_category="join_from_web",amount=before,tool=tool,action="deposit"})
                    end)
                    local confirmed=false
                    for _=1,15 do
                        if not tool.Parent or RemoteCatalog.DepositAmount(tool)<before then confirmed=true;break end
                        task.wait(.1)
                    end
                    if confirmed then
                        deposited+=tool.Parent and before-RemoteCatalog.DepositAmount(tool) or before
                        if tool.Parent then table.insert(remaining,item) end
                    else table.insert(remaining,item) end
                    task.wait(.15)
                end
            end
            -- Whatever this chest did not take is tried in the next nearest chest.
            items=remaining
        end
    end)
    RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy=false
    if not ok then return deposited,"Deposit error: "..tostring(failure) end
    return deposited,(deposited>0 and ("Deposited "..deposited.." items") or "No deposit confirmed")..(note and (" · "..note) or "")..(#items>0 and (" · "..#items.." stacks left") or "")
end
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshDepositUI(message)
    if not RemoteCatalog.DepositToggle then return end
    RemoteCatalog.DepositToggle.Text=RemoteCatalog.DepositEnabled and "AUTO DEPOSIT: ON" or "AUTO DEPOSIT: OFF"
    RemoteCatalog.DepositToggle.BackgroundColor3=RemoteCatalog.DepositEnabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    RemoteCatalog.DepositItemsButton.Text="Items: "..CONFIG.DepositCategory.."  ↻"
    RemoteCatalog.DepositIntervalButton.Text="Every: "..CONFIG.DepositInterval.."s  ↻"
    if message then RemoteCatalog.DepositInfo.Text=message end
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetDepositEnabled(on)
    RemoteCatalog.DepositEnabled=on==true
    RemoteCatalog.DepositGeneration+=1
    local token=RemoteCatalog.DepositGeneration
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshDepositUI(on and "Auto deposit ON · first deposit now" or "Auto deposit OFF")
    if not on then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        local function active() return gui.Parent~=nil and RemoteCatalog.DepositEnabled and RemoteCatalog.DepositGeneration==token end
        while active() do
            local _,message=RemoteCatalog.DepositOnce(active)
            if not active() then return end
            for remaining=CONFIG.DepositInterval,1,-1 do
                if not active() then return end
                RemoteCatalog.RefreshDepositUI(message.."\nNext deposit in "..remaining.."s")
                task.wait(1)
            end
        end
    end)
end

    local page=RemoteCatalog.DepositPage

    RemoteCatalog.DepositInfo.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top;RemoteCatalog.DepositInfo.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    RemoteCatalog.DepositToggle=button({Parent=page,Switch=true,Text="AUTO DEPOSIT: OFF",TextSize=13,Bg=COLORS.off,Size=UDim2.new(.5,-9,0,36),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,84)})

    RemoteCatalog.DepositItemsButton=button({Parent=page,Text="",TextSize=12,Size=UDim2.new(.5,-9,0,34),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,126)})
    RemoteCatalog.DepositIntervalButton=button({Parent=page,Text="",TextSize=12,Size=UDim2.new(.5,-9,0,34),Position=UDim2.new(.5,3,0,126)})
    RemoteCatalog.DepositPreviewButton=button({Parent=page,Text="Preview (sends nothing)",TextSize=12,Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,34),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,166)})

    end))

    RemoteCatalog.RefreshDepositUI()
end

-- AUTO DROP BEGIN
RemoteCatalog.DropEnabled=false
RemoteCatalog.DropInterval=.15
RemoteCatalog.DropCount=0
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshDropUI(message)
    if not gui.Parent or not RemoteCatalog.DropButton then return end
    local cleanup=not RemoteCatalog.DropEnabled and RemoteCatalog.DropWorker~=nil
    RemoteCatalog.DropButton.Text=cleanup and "STOPPING · releasing Q" or RemoteCatalog.DropEnabled and "AUTO DROP: ON" or "AUTO DROP: OFF"
    RemoteCatalog.DropButton.BackgroundColor3=RemoteCatalog.DropEnabled and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    if message then RemoteCatalog.DropDetail=message end
    RemoteCatalog.DropInfo.Text=(RemoteCatalog.DropDetail or "Repeats the game's Q drop action. Choose your item, then enable.")
        .."\nQ presses this run: "..RemoteCatalog.DropCount.." · item drops are not confirmed."
end
function RemoteCatalog.ReleaseDropKey(press)
    press=press or RemoteCatalog.DropHeld
    if not press then return true end
    local ok,result=pcall(press.Send,false)
    if ok and result~=false then
        if RemoteCatalog.DropHeld==press then RemoteCatalog.DropHeld=nil end
        return true
    end
    RemoteCatalog.DropHeld=press
    return false
end
function RemoteCatalog.DropPauseReason()
    if RemoteCatalog.Mobs and RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled then return "Paused · Auto Mobs is using the weapon" end
    local checked,field=pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() end)
    if not checked then return "Paused · text focus unavailable" end
    if field then return "Paused · finish typing in chat or a text field" end
    local char=player.Character
    local humanoid=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not char or not char.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return "Paused · waiting for your character" end
    if RemoteCatalog.FishingMouseInput or RemoteCatalog.BaitMouseInput or RemoteCatalog.ResourceInputBusy or RemoteCatalog.MobMouseInput or RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then
        return "Paused · another input action is active"
    end
    -- Q drops the held tool: never while a farm or worker is holding its rod, axe, pickaxe, hoe or weapon.
    if enabled or baitEnabled or baitBusy or harvestEnabled or woodEnabled or mineEnabled or RemoteCatalog.Planting
        or type(buildController)=="table" and (buildController.Running or buildController.WorkerToken or buildController.Picking)
        or RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy or RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy
        or RemoteCatalog.Mobs and (RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Worker or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Press) then
        return "Paused · a farm or worker is holding its tool"
    end
end
function RemoteCatalog.SetDropEnabled(on)
    if not on then
        RemoteCatalog.DropEnabled=false
        local released=RemoteCatalog.ReleaseDropKey()
        RemoteCatalog.RefreshDropUI(released and "Stopped · no more Q presses" or "Q release failed · press STOP to retry")
        return released
    end
    if not gui.Parent then return false end
    if RemoteCatalog.DropEnabled then return true end
    if RemoteCatalog.DropWorker then RemoteCatalog.RefreshDropUI("Wait for the previous Q press to finish releasing");return false end
    if not RemoteCatalog.ReleaseDropKey() then RemoteCatalog.RefreshDropUI("Q release failed · press STOP to retry");return false end
    if not table.find({.1,.15,.25,.5,1},RemoteCatalog.DropInterval) then RemoteCatalog.RefreshDropUI("Choose a supported Q interval");return false end
    local pressKey,releaseKey=keypress,keyrelease
    local send
    if type(pressKey)=="function" and type(releaseKey)=="function" then
        send=function(down) return (down and pressKey or releaseKey)(0x51) end
    else
        send=function(down) return VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(down,Enum.KeyCode.Q,false,game) end
    end
    local token={}
    RemoteCatalog.DropWorker=token;RemoteCatalog.DropEnabled=true;RemoteCatalog.DropCount=0
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshDropUI("Repeating Q · select the item you want to drop")
    task.spawn(function()
        local function active() return gui.Parent~=nil and RemoteCatalog.DropEnabled and RemoteCatalog.DropWorker==token end
        local ok,failure=pcall(function()
            while active() do
                local paused=RemoteCatalog.DropPauseReason()
                if paused then RemoteCatalog.RefreshDropUI(paused);task.wait(.1)
                else
                    local press={Send=send}
                    RemoteCatalog.DropHeld=press
                    local ran,result=pcall(send,true)
                    if not ran or result==false then error("Q input unavailable; no fallback replay sent") end
                    task.wait(.03)
                    if not RemoteCatalog.ReleaseDropKey(press) then error("Q release failed · press STOP to retry") end
                    RemoteCatalog.DropCount+=1
                    if not active() then break end
                    RemoteCatalog.RefreshDropUI("Repeating Q · select the item you want to drop")
                    task.wait(math.max(.07,RemoteCatalog.DropInterval-.03))
                end
            end
        end)
        local released=RemoteCatalog.ReleaseDropKey()
        if RemoteCatalog.DropWorker==token then
            RemoteCatalog.DropWorker=nil;RemoteCatalog.DropEnabled=false
            RemoteCatalog.RefreshDropUI(not released and "Q release failed · press STOP to retry"
                or not ok and ("Stopped · "..tostring(failure):sub(1,160)) or "Stopped · no more Q presses")
        end
    end)
    return true
end

end

    function RemoteCatalog.ReadProfiles()
        if type(readfile)~="function" or type(isfile)~="function" then return RemoteCatalog.SessionProfiles or {} end
        local ok,data=pcall(function()
            if not isfile(RemoteCatalog.ProfileFile) then return {} end
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(RemoteCatalog.ProfileFile))
        end)
        return ok and type(data)=="table" and data or {}
    end
    function RemoteCatalog.WriteProfiles(profiles)
        RemoteCatalog.SessionProfiles=profiles
        if type(writefile)~="function" then return false end
        return (pcall(function() writefile(RemoteCatalog.ProfileFile,HttpService:JSONEncode(profiles)) end))
    end
    function RemoteCatalog.RefreshProfileUI()
        local profile=RemoteCatalog.ReadProfiles()[tostring(RemoteCatalog.ProfileSlot)]
        RemoteCatalog.ProfileSlotButton.Text="Profile "..RemoteCatalog.ProfileSlot..": "..(type(profile)=="table" and tostring(profile.Name) or "empty").."  ↻"
    end
    function RemoteCatalog.SaveHubProfile()
        local farm=RemoteCatalog.Mobs
        if farm then CONFIG.MobRadius,CONFIG.MobWalk,CONFIG.MobTravel,CONFIG.MobKind,CONFIG.MobAutoEat,CONFIG.MobWalkSpeed,CONFIG.MobKeep,CONFIG.MobHitRun=farm.Radius,farm.Walk,farm.Travel,farm.Kind,farm.AutoEat,farm.WalkSpeed,farm.KeepDistance,farm.HitAndRun end
        local data=savePreferences(true)
        -- Settings only: learned/remembered data and lifetime statistics belong to the account, not a profile.
        data.MobWeapon=nil;data.LearnedDefinitions=nil;data.RememberedChests=nil;data.MobScore=nil;data.MobHitBody=nil;data.MobHitsToKill=nil;data.Lifetime=nil
        local stamp="saved"
        pcall(function() stamp=os.date("%d/%m %H:%M") end)
        local profiles=RemoteCatalog.ReadProfiles()
        profiles[tostring(RemoteCatalog.ProfileSlot)]={Name=stamp,Data=data}
        local written=RemoteCatalog.WriteProfiles(profiles)
        RemoteCatalog.RefreshProfileUI()
        setStatus("Profile "..RemoteCatalog.ProfileSlot.." saved"..(written and "" or " for this session only (no file access)"),COLORS.good)
        return true
    end
    function RemoteCatalog.LoadHubProfile()
        if enabled or baitEnabled or baitBusy or harvestEnabled or woodEnabled or mineEnabled or RemoteCatalog.Planting or RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker
            or RemoteCatalog.CraftWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestAutoWorker or RemoteCatalog.ChestBusy or RemoteCatalog.DepositBusy
            or buildController.Running or buildController.WorkerToken
            or RemoteCatalog.Mobs and (RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled or RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Worker) then
            setStatus("Stop running farms and workers before loading a profile",COLORS.warn);return false
        end
        local profile=RemoteCatalog.ReadProfiles()[tostring(RemoteCatalog.ProfileSlot)]
        -- A profile written by an older build may still carry account memory; never load it from there.
        if type(profile)=="table" and type(profile.Data)=="table" then profile.Data.MobScore=nil;profile.Data.MobHitBody=nil;profile.Data.MobHitsToKill=nil;profile.Data.MobWeapon=nil;profile.Data.LearnedDefinitions=nil;profile.Data.RememberedChests=nil;profile.Data.Lifetime=nil end
        if type(profile)~="table" or type(profile.Data)~="table" then setStatus("Profile "..RemoteCatalog.ProfileSlot.." is empty",COLORS.warn);return false end
        if not loadPreferences(profile.Data) then setStatus("Profile could not be read",COLORS.bad);return false end
        CONFIG.HarvestCrops=FarmLogic.NormalizeCrops(CONFIG.HarvestCrops,CONFIG.HarvestCrop)
        if not CONFIG.HarvestCrops[CONFIG.PlantType] then CONFIG.PlantType=FarmLogic.SelectedCrops(CONFIG.HarvestCrops,CONFIG.HarvestCrop)[1] end
        local farm=RemoteCatalog.Mobs
        if farm then
            farm.Radius=CONFIG.MobRadius or farm.Radius;if CONFIG.MobWalk~=nil then farm.Walk=CONFIG.MobWalk end
            farm.Travel=CONFIG.MobTravel or farm.Travel;farm.HopDistance=CONFIG.HopSize or farm.HopDistance;farm.Kind=CONFIG.MobKind or farm.Kind
            if CONFIG.MobAutoEat~=nil then farm.AutoEat=CONFIG.MobAutoEat end
            farm.WalkSpeed=CONFIG.MobWalkSpeed or farm.WalkSpeed;farm.KeepDistance=CONFIG.MobKeep or farm.KeepDistance
            if CONFIG.MobHitRun~=nil then farm.HitAndRun=CONFIG.MobHitRun end
        end
        RemoteCatalog.Navigation.HopSize=CONFIG.HopSize
        RemoteCatalog.HopSizeButton.Text="TP hop size: "..CONFIG.HopSize.." studs  ↻"
        RemoteCatalog.ReflectPreferences()
        if RemoteCatalog.RefreshKeybinds then RemoteCatalog.RefreshKeybinds() end
        if RemoteCatalog.RefreshRejoinButton then RemoteCatalog.RefreshRejoinButton() end
        if RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI then RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI() end
        if RemoteCatalog.RefreshDepositUI then RemoteCatalog.RefreshDepositUI() end
        savePreferences()
        setStatus("Profile "..RemoteCatalog.ProfileSlot.." loaded · "..tostring(profile.Name),COLORS.good)
        return true
    end
    RemoteCatalog.ProfileSlotButton=button({Parent=RemoteCatalog.SettingsQuickBody,Text="",TextSize=12,Size=UDim2.new(.5,-16,0,36),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,88)})
    RemoteCatalog.ProfileSaveButton=button({Parent=RemoteCatalog.SettingsQuickBody,Text="Save profile",TextSize=12,Size=UDim2.new(.25,-8,0,36),Position=UDim2.new(.5,6,0,88)})

-- PERFORMANCE MODE BEGIN
-- Shadows and particle-style effects off; only what this mode switched off is restored.
RemoteCatalog.Performance={On=false,Disabled=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})}
function RemoteCatalog.SetPerformanceMode(on)
    local state=RemoteCatalog.Performance
    if on==state.On then return end
    state.On=on
    local lighting=game:GetService("Lighting")
    local function quiet(object)
        local effect=object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Trail") or object:IsA("Beam")
            or object:IsA("Smoke") or object:IsA("Fire") or object:IsA("Sparkles")
        if effect and object.Enabled then state.Disabled[object]=true;object.Enabled=false end
    end
    if on then
        pcall(function() state.Shadows=lighting.GlobalShadows;lighting.GlobalShadows=false end)
        pcall(function() for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do pcall(quiet,object) end end)
        pcall(function() state.Connection=workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object) pcall(quiet,object) end) end)
    else
        if state.Connection then state.Connection:Disconnect();state.Connection=nil end
        if state.Shadows~=nil then pcall(function() lighting.GlobalShadows=state.Shadows end);state.Shadows=nil end
        for object in pairs(state.Disabled) do pcall(function() if object.Parent then object.Enabled=true end end) end
        table.clear(state.Disabled)
    end
    if RemoteCatalog.PerformanceButton then
        RemoteCatalog.PerformanceButton.Text=on and "Performance mode: ON" or "Performance mode: OFF"
        RemoteCatalog.PerformanceButton.BackgroundColor3=on and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
    end
end
RemoteCatalog.PerformanceButton=button({Parent=RemoteCatalog.SettingsAdvancedBody,Switch=true,Text="Performance mode: OFF",TextSize=12,
    Size=UDim2.new(.5,-16,0,36),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,88),Bg=COLORS.off})
track(RemoteCatalog.PerformanceButton.Activated:Connect(function() RemoteCatalog.SetPerformanceMode(not RemoteCatalog.Performance.On) end))
-- PERFORMANCE MODE END
-- KEYBINDS BEGIN
-- Click a row, then press a key; Escape cancels. A key used elsewhere moves to this action.
RemoteCatalog.KeybindActions={{"StopAllKey","Stop all"},{"ToggleKey","Fishing"},{"HarvestKey","Harvest"},{"MobKey","Mobs"},{"ReportKey","Copy reports"}}
RemoteCatalog.KeybindButtons={}
function RemoteCatalog.RefreshKeybinds()
    for _,entry in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.KeybindActions) do
        local key,name=entry[1],entry[2]
        local control=RemoteCatalog.KeybindButtons[key]
        if control then control.Text=name..": "..(RemoteCatalog.BindingKey==key and "press a key…" or CONFIG[key].Name) end
    end
    toggle.Text=(enabled and "FISH ON  [" or "FISH OFF  [")..CONFIG.ToggleKey.Name.."]"
    if RemoteCatalog.RefreshSettingsText then RemoteCatalog.RefreshSettingsText() end
end
function RemoteCatalog.CaptureKeybind(input)
    local key=RemoteCatalog.BindingKey
    if not key or input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return false end
    RemoteCatalog.BindingKey=nil
    local code=input.KeyCode
    -- Escape cancels; reserved keys cannot be bound.
    if not RemoteCatalog.KeyReserved(code) then
        for _,entry in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.KeybindActions) do
            if entry[1]~=key and CONFIG[entry[1]]==code then CONFIG[entry[1]]=CONFIG[key] end
        end
        CONFIG[key]=code
        savePreferences()
    end
    RemoteCatalog.RefreshKeybinds()
    return true
end
for index,entry in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.KeybindActions) do
    local key=entry[1]
    local column,row=(index-1)%2,math.floor((index-1)/2)
    local control=button({Parent=RemoteCatalog.SettingsAdvancedBody,Text="",TextSize=12,
        Size=UDim2.new(.5,-16,0,36),Position=UDim2.new(column*.5,column==0 and 10 or 6,0,132+row*44)})
    RemoteCatalog.KeybindButtons[key]=control
    track(control.Activated:Connect(function()
        RemoteCatalog.BindingKey=RemoteCatalog.BindingKey~=key and key or nil
        RemoteCatalog.RefreshKeybinds()
        -- An armed row must not capture an ordinary key (W, A, S, D) much later.
        local armed={}
        RemoteCatalog.BindingToken=armed
        task.delay(8,function()
            if RemoteCatalog.BindingToken==armed and RemoteCatalog.BindingKey then RemoteCatalog.BindingKey=nil;RemoteCatalog.RefreshKeybinds() end
        end)
    end))
end
RemoteCatalog.RefreshKeybinds()
table.insert(RemoteCatalog.MenuClosers,function()
    if RemoteCatalog.BindingKey then RemoteCatalog.BindingKey=nil;RemoteCatalog.RefreshKeybinds() end
end)
-- KEYBINDS END
-- AUTO REJOIN BEGIN
-- Rejoins only after connection-type errors, never after a deliberate kick or ban, at most 3 times an hour.
-- Farms that were running resume when the hub loads again (autoexec) within 15 minutes.
RemoteCatalog.RejoinFile="IslandsFarmingHub_"..tostring(player.UserId).."_rejoin.json"
RemoteCatalog.RejoinReasons={"disconnect","connection","timed out","timeout","idle","shut down","shutdown","restart","no response","error code: 277","error code: 279"}
-- 267 kicked by the game, 268 unexpected client behaviour, 273 same account joined elsewhere.
RemoteCatalog.RejoinRefusals={"ban","exploit","cheat","hack","suspicious","moderat","267","268","273"}
function RemoteCatalog.RejoinAllowed(message,history,now)
    local text=string.lower(tostring(message or ""))
    for _,word in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.RejoinRefusals) do
        if string.find(text,word,1,true) then return false,"Not rejoining: the message mentions "..word end
    end
    if string.find(text,"kick",1,true) and not string.find(text,"idle",1,true) then return false,"Not rejoining: you were kicked" end
    local connection=false
    for _,word in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.RejoinReasons) do if string.find(text,word,1,true) then connection=true;break end end
    if not connection then return false,"Not rejoining: this was not a connection error" end
    local recent=0
    for _,at in ipairs(type(history)=="table" and history or {}) do if type(at)=="number" and now-at<3600 then recent+=1 end end
    if recent>=3 then return false,"Not rejoining: already rejoined 3 times this hour" end
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ReadRejoinState()
    if type(readfile)~="function" or type(isfile)~="function" then return {} end
    local ok,data=pcall(function()
        if not isfile(RemoteCatalog.RejoinFile) then return {} end
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(RemoteCatalog.RejoinFile))
    end)
    return ok and type(data)=="table" and data or {}
end
function RemoteCatalog.WriteRejoinState(data)
    if type(writefile)~="function" then return false end
    return (pcall(function() writefile(RemoteCatalog.RejoinFile,HttpService:JSONEncode(data)) end))
end
function RemoteCatalog.RunningModes()
    local modes={}
    if enabled then table.insert(modes,"fishing") end
    if baitEnabled then table.insert(modes,"bait") end
    if harvestEnabled then table.insert(modes,"crop") end
    if woodEnabled then table.insert(modes,"wood") end
    if mineEnabled then table.insert(modes,"mine") end
    if RemoteCatalog.Mobs and RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled then table.insert(modes,"mobs") end
    return modes
end
function RemoteCatalog.HandleDisconnect(message)
    if not CONFIG.AutoRejoin or RemoteCatalog.Rejoining then return false end
    local state=RemoteCatalog.ReadRejoinState()
    local now=os.time()
    local allowed,reason=RemoteCatalog.RejoinAllowed(message,state.History,now)
    if not allowed then setStatus(reason,COLORS.warn);return false end
    RemoteCatalog.Rejoining=true
    local history={}
    for _,at in ipairs(type(state.History)=="table" and state.History or {}) do if type(at)=="number" and now-at<3600 then table.insert(history,at) end end
    table.insert(history,now)
    RemoteCatalog.WriteRejoinState({History=history,Resume={At=now,Modes=RemoteCatalog.RunningModes()}})
    setStatus("Connection lost · rejoining shortly",COLORS.warn)
    task.spawn(function()
        local teleport=game:GetService("TeleportService")
        for attempt=1,3 do
            task.wait(5*attempt)
            -- A successful teleport ends this client; a failed one is retried with a longer wait.
            pcall(function() teleport:Teleport(game.PlaceId,player) end)
        end
        RemoteCatalog.Rejoining=false
    end)
    return true
end
function RemoteCatalog.ResumeAfterRejoin()
    local state=RemoteCatalog.ReadRejoinState()
    local resume=state.Resume
    if not CONFIG.AutoRejoin or type(resume)~="table" or type(resume.At)~="number" or os.time()-resume.At>900 then return {} end
    -- One resume per rejoin, even if this load fails part way.
    state.Resume=nil;RemoteCatalog.WriteRejoinState(state)
    local started={}
    for _,mode in ipairs(type(resume.Modes)=="table" and resume.Modes or {}) do
        local ok,running=pcall(function()
            -- Starts refuse by returning, not by raising; read the mode's own state afterwards.
            if mode=="fishing" then setEnabled(true);return enabled
            elseif mode=="bait" then setBaitEnabled(true);return baitEnabled
            elseif mode=="crop" then setFarmMode(mode,true);return harvestEnabled
            elseif mode=="wood" then setFarmMode(mode,true);return woodEnabled
            elseif mode=="mine" then setFarmMode(mode,true);return mineEnabled
            elseif mode=="mobs" and RemoteCatalog.Mobs then RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Start();return RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled end
            return false
        end)
        if ok and running then table.insert(started,mode) end
    end
    if #started>0 then setStatus("Resumed after rejoin: "..table.concat(started,", "),COLORS.good) end
    return started
end

    RemoteCatalog.RejoinButton.Text=CONFIG.AutoRejoin and "Auto rejoin: ON" or "Auto rejoin: OFF"
    RemoteCatalog.RejoinButton.BackgroundColor3=CONFIG.AutoRejoin and COLORS.on or COLORS.off
end

    track(game:GetService("GuiService").ErrorMessageChanged:Connect(function(message)
        if type(message)=="string" and message~="" then RemoteCatalog.HandleDisconnect(message) end
    end))

function RemoteCatalog.StopAllAutomation()
    if RemoteCatalog.SetDepositEnabled then RemoteCatalog.SetDepositEnabled(false) end
    RemoteCatalog.StopMobLearning()
    RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Stop()
    RemoteCatalog.SetDropEnabled(false)
    RemoteCatalog.SetCraftEnabled(false)
    RemoteCatalog.StopCraftLearning()
    RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(false)
    RemoteCatalog.StopPlowLearning()
    RemoteCatalog.StopTimerDeadline=nil
    RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration or 0)+1
    RemoteCatalog.SetChestAuto(false)
    RemoteCatalog.StopChestLearning()
    RemoteCatalog.AntiAFK:SetEnabled(false)
    RemoteCatalog.PlantGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.PlantGeneration or 0)+1
    RemoteCatalog.Planting=false
    plantBtn.Text="Plant selected crop"
    buildController:Stop()
    movementController:Reset()
    cycleId += 1
    harvestCycleId += 1
    setEnabled(false)
    setBaitEnabled(false)
    setFarmMode("crop", false)
    setFarmMode("wood", false)
    setFarmMode("mine", false)
    setStatus("All automation stopped — all cycle tokens invalidated", COLORS.warn)
    refreshModeStatus()
    if stopAllButton then stopAllButton.Text = "ALL STOPPED ✓"; task.delay(1.5, function() if stopAllButton and stopAllButton.Parent then stopAllButton.Text = "STOP ALL AUTOMATION" end end) end
    RemoteCatalog.UpdateDashboard()
end
track(stopAllButton.Activated:Connect(RemoteCatalog.StopAllAutomation))

RemoteCatalog.CropControlPositions={}
function RemoteCatalog.SetCropDropdown(open)
    if open then RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus() end
    cropDropdownOpen=open
    cropDropdown.Visible=open
    local offset=open and cropDropdown.Size.Y.Offset+8 or 0
    for _,child in ipairs(harvestPage:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child~=cropDropdown then
            local base=RemoteCatalog.CropControlPositions[child]
            if not base and child.Position.Y.Offset>=160 then
                base=child.Position
                RemoteCatalog.CropControlPositions[child]=base
            end
            if base then child.Position=UDim2.new(base.X.Scale,base.X.Offset,base.Y.Scale,base.Y.Offset+offset) end
        end
    end
    refreshCropSelectionUI()
end
table.insert(RemoteCatalog.MenuClosers,function() RemoteCatalog.SetCropDropdown(false) end)

    RemoteCatalog.SetCropDropdown(not cropDropdownOpen)

    end))
end

-- Real expanding dropdowns matching the crop selector's visual style.
local function makeToolDropdown(page, anchor, options, kind, yPosition, onChoose)
    local menu = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    menu.Name = kind .. "Dropdown"
    menu.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, math.min(#options * 36, 180))
    menu.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0,#options * 36)
    menu.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    menu.ScrollBarImageColor3 = COLORS.accent
    menu.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
    menu.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, yPosition)
    menu.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.panel
    menu.BorderSizePixel = 0
    menu.Visible = false
    menu.ClipsDescendants = true
    menu.ZIndex = 25
    menu.Parent = page
    corner(menu, 6)
    RemoteCatalog.RegisterMenuRegion(anchor,menu)
    local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
    list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    list.Parent = menu
    local buttons={}
    local function refresh()
        local selected=kind=="Axe" and woodToolPreference or mineToolPreference
        anchor.Text=kind..": "..selected..(menu.Visible and "  ▲" or "  ▼")
        for i,opt in ipairs(buttons) do
            local chosen=options[i]==selected
            opt.Text=(chosen and "✓  " or "    ")..options[i]
            opt.BackgroundColor3=chosen and COLORS.off or COLORS.panel
            opt.TextColor3=chosen and COLORS.accent or COLORS.text
        end
    end
    for i, optionName in ipairs(options) do
        local opt = button({Parent = menu, Text = optionName, TextSize = 12,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(), Bg = COLORS.panel})
        opt.LayoutOrder = i
        opt.ZIndex = 26
        buttons[i]=opt
        track(opt.Activated:Connect(function()
            onChoose(i)
            menu.Visible = false
            refresh()
        end))
    end
    table.insert(RemoteCatalog.MenuClosers,function() menu.Visible=false;refresh() end)
    track(anchor.Activated:Connect(function()
        local show=not menu.Visible
        RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
        menu.Visible = show
        refresh()
    end))
    RemoteCatalog.ToolMenuRefresh=RemoteCatalog.ToolMenuRefresh or {}
    RemoteCatalog.ToolMenuRefresh[menu]=refresh
    track(menu:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(refresh))
    refresh()
end

-- MENU DISMISS INPUT BEGIN
function RemoteCatalog.DismissMenuInput(input)
    if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus();return end
    -- While picking, a click is the pick (or the Pick toggle itself), not a request to close menus.
    if buildController.Picking and activeTab=="Auto Build" then return end
    if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
    local point=input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.Position or UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local ok,objects=pcall(function() return playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(point.X,point.Y) end)
    if not ok then return end
    for _,object in ipairs(objects) do
        local current=object
        while current and current~=playerGui do
            for _,region in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.MenuRegions) do
                if region.Menu.Visible and (current==region.Menu or current==region.Anchor) then return end
            end
            current=current.Parent
        end
    end
    RemoteCatalog.CloseMenus()
end
track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(RemoteCatalog.DismissMenuInput))
-- MENU DISMISS INPUT END

-- BUILD PICK INPUT BEGIN
function RemoteCatalog.TryPickBuildInput(input,processed)
    if processed or not gui.Parent or not buildController.Picking or buildController.Running or buildController.WorkerToken
        or activeTab~="Auto Build" or not hub.Open or not hub.Root.Visible then return false end
    if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return false end
    local focused,field=pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() end)
    if not focused or field then return false end
    local point=input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.Position or UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local x,y=point.X,point.Y
    local p,size=hub.Root.AbsolutePosition,hub.Root.AbsoluteSize
    if x>=p.X and x<=p.X+size.X and y>=p.Y and y<=p.Y+size.Y then return false end
    local checked,objects=pcall(function() return playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(x,y) end)
    if not checked then return false end
    for _,object in ipairs(objects) do if object:IsA("GuiButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then return false end end
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera or not RemoteCatalog.BuildPicker then return false end
    -- GetMouseLocation is viewport space (top-bar inset included); a touch position is GUI space.
    -- Each needs its own ray builder or the pick lands one block row off.
    local ray=input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and camera:ScreenPointToRay(x,y) or camera:ViewportPointToRay(x,y)
    local params=RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local ignore={}
    if player.Character then table.insert(ignore,player.Character) end
    if buildController.PreviewFolder then table.insert(ignore,buildController.PreviewFolder) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore
    local hit=workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin,ray.Direction*1000,params)
    local limit=hit and (hit.Position-ray.Origin).Magnitude or 1000
    return RemoteCatalog.BuildPicker(ray.Origin,ray.Direction,limit)
end
track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
    if not buildController.Picking then return end
    pcall(RemoteCatalog.TryPickBuildInput,input,processed)
end))
-- BUILD PICK INPUT END

track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then
		return
	end
	if RemoteCatalog.CaptureKeybind and RemoteCatalog.CaptureKeybind(input) then return end
	if input.KeyCode == CONFIG.ToggleKey then
		setEnabled(not enabled)
	elseif input.KeyCode == CONFIG.HarvestKey then
		setHarvestEnabled(not harvestEnabled)
	elseif input.KeyCode == CONFIG.StopAllKey then
		RemoteCatalog.StopAllAutomation()
	elseif input.KeyCode == CONFIG.MobKey and RemoteCatalog.Mobs then
		if RemoteCatalog.Mobs.Enabled then RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Stop() else RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Start() end
		RemoteCatalog.RefreshMobUI()
	elseif input.KeyCode == CONFIG.ReportKey and RemoteCatalog.CopyAllReports then
		RemoteCatalog.CopyAllReports()
	end
end))

track(reset.Activated:Connect(function()
	local wasOn = stats.onSince ~= nil
	stats = newStats()
    RemoteCatalog.ResetPropellers()
	if wasOn then
		stats.onSince = os.clock()
	end
	updateBoard()
end))

    local recorder=RemoteCatalog.LiveRecorder("HotbarBinding")
    local layout=recorder and recorder.HotbarLayout or "stonePickaxe,stoneAxe,fishingRod,coal,stone,fertilizerBasic,bait,sapling"
    local ok = setHotbarLayout(layout)
	if ok then
		setStatus("Hotbar layout request sent", COLORS.good)
	else
		setStatus("Change hotbar manually once with capture active, then retry", COLORS.bad)
	end
end))

track(plantBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    if RemoteCatalog.PlowWorker then RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(false);setStatus("Wait for Auto Plow input cleanup before planting",COLORS.warn);return end
    if RemoteCatalog.Planting then return end
    RemoteCatalog.PlantGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.PlantGeneration or 0)+1
    local token=RemoteCatalog.PlantGeneration
    RemoteCatalog.Planting=true
    plantBtn.Text="Planting… use Stop All to cancel"
    setStatus("Planting "..CONFIG.PlantType.."...",COLORS.good)
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,n=pcall(plantAroundPlayer,CONFIG.PlantType,token)
        if not gui.Parent or RemoteCatalog.PlantGeneration~=token then return end
        RemoteCatalog.Planting=false
        plantBtn.Text="Plant selected crop"
        if not ok then setStatus("Planting stopped: "..tostring(n),COLORS.warn)
        elseif n>0 then setStatus("Placement requests sent: "..n.." × "..CONFIG.PlantType,COLORS.good)
        else setStatus("No placement requests sent. Place a block manually first; check tool and range.",COLORS.warn) end
    end)
end))

gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
    pcall(savePreferences)
    pcall(RemoteCatalog.SetPerformanceMode,false)
    if RemoteCatalog.SetDepositEnabled then pcall(RemoteCatalog.SetDepositEnabled,false) end
    RemoteCatalog.StopMobLearning()
    RemoteCatalog.Mobs:Stop()
    RemoteCatalog.SetDropEnabled(false)
    pcall(RemoteCatalog.ReleasePlowMouse)
    RemoteCatalog.PropellerWindow=nil;RemoteCatalog.PropellerPendingWindow=nil
    RemoteCatalog.SetCraftEnabled(false)
    RemoteCatalog.StopCraftLearning()
    RemoteCatalog.SetPlowEnabled(false)
    RemoteCatalog.StopPlowLearning()
    RemoteCatalog.StopTimerDeadline=nil
    for _,connection in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestItemConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(RemoteCatalog.ChestItemConnections)
    for _,connection in ipairs(RemoteCatalog.ChestMenuConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(RemoteCatalog.ChestMenuConnections)
    RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.ChestManualGeneration or 0)+1
    RemoteCatalog.SetChestAuto(false)
    hub._destroyed=true
    hub._transitionGeneration=(hub._transitionGeneration or 0)+1
    hub._inPage=nil;hub._outPage=nil
    RemoteCatalog.PlantGeneration=(RemoteCatalog.PlantGeneration or 0)+1
    RemoteCatalog.Planting=false
    woodEnabled=false;mineEnabled=false
    RemoteCatalog.AntiAFK:Destroy()
    RemoteCatalog.Navigation.Stop()
    buildController:Destroy()
    RemoteCatalog.BuildPicker=nil
    movementController:Reset()
    if RemoteCatalog.Recorder then RemoteCatalog.Recorder:Stop() end
    for _, conn in ipairs(hub._connections) do conn:Disconnect() end
    hub._connections = {}
    if statsOverlayGui then statsOverlayGui:Destroy() end
    baitEnabled = false
    baitCycleId += 1
	enabled = false
    RemoteCatalog.UpdatePropellerStatsClock(false)
	harvestEnabled = false
	cycleId += 1
	harvestCycleId += 1
	for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
end)
